	private static SR loader;

	private ResourceManager[] resources;

	private SR()
	{
		string text = "Infragistics.Documents.Core.strings;Infragistics.Documents.Core.Html.strings";
		string[] array = text.Split(';');
		int num = 0;
		string[] array2 = array;
		foreach (string text2 in array2)
		{
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		resources = new ResourceManager[num];
		Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
		int num2 = 0;
		string[] array3 = array;
		foreach (string text3 in array3)
		{
			if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
			{
				resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
			}
		}
	}

	private static SR GetLoader()
	{
		if (loader == null)
		{
			lock (typeof(SR))
			{
				if (loader == null)
				{
					loader = new SR();
				}
			}
		}
		return loader;
	}

	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
	}

	private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = null;
		if (allowCustomizedStrings)
		{
			text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
		}
		if (text == null)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
		}
		if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

namespace Infragistics.Collections
{
	internal class LfuCache<TKey, TValue>
	{
		[DebuggerDisplay("{Frequency}")]
		private class FrequencyNode : LinkedListNode
		{
			internal int Frequency;

			internal readonly LinkedList Caches;

			internal FrequencyNode()
			{
				Caches = new LinkedList();
			}
		}

		[DebuggerDisplay("{Key}, {Value}")]
		private class CacheNode : LinkedListNode
		{
			internal FrequencyNode Parent;

			public TKey Key;

			public TValue Value;
		}

		private int _capacity;

		private readonly Dictionary<TKey, CacheNode> _keys;

		private LinkedList _list;

		public int Capacity
		{
			get
			{
				return _capacity;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				_capacity = value;
				for (int num = _keys.Count - value; num > 0; num--)
				{
					RemoveLast();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => _keys.Count;

		public TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				TValue result;
				if (_keys.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					result = value.Value;
					Promote(value);
				}
				else
				{
					result = default(TValue);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal LfuCache(int capacity, IEqualityComparer<TKey> keyComparer = null)
		{
			if (keyComparer == null)
			{
				keyComparer = EqualityComparer<TKey>.Default;
			}
			_keys = new Dictionary<TKey, CacheNode>(keyComparer);
			_list = new LinkedList();
			Capacity = capacity;
		}

		public void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			if (_keys.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
			{
				value2.Value = value;
				Promote(value2);
				return;
			}
			value2 = new CacheNode();
			value2.Key = key;
			value2.Value = value;
			Promote(value2);
			_keys.Add(key, value2);
			if (_keys.Count > _capacity)
			{
				RemoveLast();
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_keys.Clear();
			_list.Clear();
		}

		private void Promote(CacheNode cache)
		{
			FrequencyNode frequencyNode = cache.Parent;
			if (frequencyNode == null)
			{
				frequencyNode = (FrequencyNode)_list.Last;
				if (frequencyNode == null || frequencyNode.Frequency != 1)
				{
					frequencyNode = new FrequencyNode();
					frequencyNode.Frequency = 1;
					frequencyNode.MoveToLast(_list);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FrequencyNode frequencyNode2 = (FrequencyNode)frequencyNode.Previous;
				if (frequencyNode.Caches.First == frequencyNode.Caches.Last)
				{
					if (frequencyNode2 == null || frequencyNode2.Frequency - 1 > frequencyNode.Frequency)
					{
						frequencyNode.Frequency++;
					}
					else
					{
						cache.Remove();
						frequencyNode.Remove();
						frequencyNode = frequencyNode2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (frequencyNode2 == null || frequencyNode2.Frequency - 1 > frequencyNode.Frequency)
					{
						FrequencyNode frequencyNode3 = new FrequencyNode();
						frequencyNode3.Frequency = frequencyNode.Frequency + 1;
						frequencyNode3.MoveBefore(frequencyNode);
						frequencyNode = frequencyNode3;
					}
					else
					{
						frequencyNode = frequencyNode2;
					}
					cache.Remove();
				}
			}
			cache.Parent = frequencyNode;
			cache.MoveToFirst(frequencyNode.Caches);
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			CacheNode value;
			bool flag = _keys.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			if (flag)
			{
				RemoveCache(value);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void RemoveCache(CacheNode cache)
		{
			_keys.Remove(cache.Key);
			cache.Remove();
			FrequencyNode parent = cache.Parent;
			if (parent.Caches.First == null)
			{
				parent.Remove();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLast()
		{
			FrequencyNode frequencyNode = (FrequencyNode)_list.Last;
			CacheNode cache = (CacheNode)frequencyNode.Caches.Last;
			RemoveCache(cache);
		}
	}
	internal class LinkedList
	{
		private LinkedListNode _first;

		private LinkedListNode _last;

		public LinkedListNode First
		{
			get
			{
				return _first;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_first = value;
			}
		}

		public LinkedListNode Last
		{
			get
			{
				return _last;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_last = value;
			}
		}

		internal void Clear(bool resetNodes = false)
		{
			if (resetNodes)
			{
				while (_last != null)
				{
					_last.Remove();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_first = (_last = null);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LinkedListNode
	{
		private LinkedList _list;

		private LinkedListNode _next;

		private LinkedListNode _previous;

		internal LinkedList List => _list;

		internal LinkedListNode Next => _next;

		internal LinkedListNode Previous => _previous;

		internal void MoveAfter(LinkedListNode other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			Remove();
			if (other._next == null)
			{
				MoveToLast(other._list);
				return;
			}
			other._next._previous = this;
			_next = other._next;
			other._next = this;
			_previous = other;
			_list = other._list;
		}

		internal void MoveBefore(LinkedListNode other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			Remove();
			if (other._previous == null)
			{
				MoveToFirst(other._list);
				return;
			}
			other._previous._next = this;
			_previous = other._previous;
			other._previous = this;
			_next = other;
			_list = other._list;
		}

		internal void MoveToFirst()
		{
			MoveToFirst(_list);
		}

		internal void MoveToFirst(LinkedList list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (list != _list || list.First != this)
			{
				Remove();
				_list = list;
				if (list.First == null)
				{
					LinkedListNode first = (list.Last = this);
					list.First = first;
				}
				else
				{
					_next = list.First;
					list.First = this;
					_next._previous = this;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void MoveToLast()
		{
			MoveToLast(List);
		}

		internal void MoveToLast(LinkedList list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (list != _list || list.Last != this)
			{
				Remove();
				_list = list;
				if (list.Last == null)
				{
					LinkedListNode first = (list.Last = this);
					list.First = first;
				}
				else
				{
					_previous = list.Last;
					list.Last = this;
					_previous._next = this;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Remove()
		{
			if (_list != null)
			{
				LinkedList list = _list;
				if (_previous != null)
				{
					_previous._next = _next;
				}
				if (_next != null)
				{
					_next._previous = _previous;
				}
				if (list.First == this)
				{
					list.First = _next;
				}
				if (list.Last == this)
				{
					list.Last = _previous;
				}
				_next = null;
				_previous = null;
				_list = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LruCache<TKey, TValue>
	{
		[DebuggerDisplay("{Key}, {Value}")]
		private class LruCacheNode : LinkedListNode
		{
			public TKey Key;

			public TValue Value;
		}

		private int _capacity;

		private readonly Dictionary<TKey, LruCacheNode> _keys;

		private LinkedList _list;

		public int Capacity
		{
			get
			{
				return _capacity;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				_capacity = value;
				for (int num = _keys.Count - value; num > 0; num--)
				{
					LruCacheNode lruCacheNode = (LruCacheNode)_list.Last;
					_keys.Remove(lruCacheNode.Key);
					lruCacheNode.Remove();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => _keys.Count;

		public TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				TValue result;
				if (_keys.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					result = value.Value;
					value.MoveToFirst();
				}
				else
				{
					result = default(TValue);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal LruCache(int capacity, IEqualityComparer<TKey> keyComparer = null)
		{
			if (keyComparer == null)
			{
				keyComparer = EqualityComparer<TKey>.Default;
			}
			_keys = new Dictionary<TKey, LruCacheNode>(keyComparer);
			_list = new LinkedList();
			Capacity = capacity;
		}

		public void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			if (_keys.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
			{
				value2.Value = value;
				value2.MoveToFirst();
				return;
			}
			value2 = new LruCacheNode();
			value2.Key = key;
			value2.Value = value;
			value2.MoveToFirst(_list);
			_keys.Add(key, value2);
			if (_keys.Count > _capacity)
			{
				_keys.Remove(((LruCacheNode)_list.Last).Key);
				_list.Last.Remove();
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_keys.Clear();
			_list.Clear();
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			LruCacheNode value;
			bool flag = _keys.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			if (flag)
			{
				value.Remove();
				_keys.Remove(key);
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}

			AVERAGEFunc,
			COUNTFunc,
			DEFINEDFunc,
			FALSE,
			INTFunc,
			MAXFunc,
			MINFunc,
			MODFunc,
			NOTFunc,
			ORFunc,
			PRODUCTFunc,
			ROUNDFunc,
			SIGNFunc,
			SUMFunc,
			TRUE,
			GeneralSwitch,
			Minus,
			Caret,
			Asterisk,
			Slash,
			Percent,
			Plus,
			Number,
			NumericSwitch,
			Semicolon,
			TextOrIdentifier
		}

		private int _currentPosition;

		private Token _currentToken;

		private readonly string _fieldText;

		private FieldParser(string fieldText)
		{
			_fieldText = fieldText;
			_currentToken = GetNextToken(LexerState.Default);
		}

		private string GetCurrentTextStartingAt(int startPosition)
		{
			return _fieldText.Substring(startPosition, _currentPosition - startPosition);
		}

		private Token GetNextToken(LexerState currentState)
		{
			MovePastInsignificantContent(currentState);
			return currentState switch
			{
				LexerState.Default => GetNextTokenDefault(), 
				LexerState.ArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext => GetNextTokenArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext(), 
				LexerState.IsInQuotedString => GetNextTokenIsInQuotedString(), 
				_ => new Token(TokenType.Null), 
			};
		}

		private Token GetNextTokenArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext()
		{
			int currentPosition = _currentPosition;
			char c = ReadNextChar();
			switch (c)
			{
			case '"':
				return new Token(TokenType.DoubleQuote, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '\\':
			{
				char c2 = ReadNextChar();
				switch (c2)
				{
				case '@':
					return new Token(TokenType.DateAndTimeFormattingSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				case '#':
					return new Token(TokenType.NumericFormattingSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				case '*':
					return new Token(TokenType.GeneralFormattingSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				if (!IsWhitespace(c2) && IsCharacter(c2))
				{
					while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && !IsWhitespace(_fieldText[_currentPosition]) && IsCharacter(_fieldText[_currentPosition]))
					{
						_currentPosition++;
					}
					return new Token(TokenType.FieldSpecificSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (!IsWhitespace(c) && IsCharacter(c))
			{
				while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && !IsWhitespace(_fieldText[_currentPosition]) && IsCharacter(_fieldText[_currentPosition]))
				{
					_currentPosition++;
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			}
			return new Token(TokenType.Null);
		}

		private Token GetNextTokenDefault()
		{
			int currentPosition = _currentPosition;
			char c = ReadNextChar();
			switch (c)
			{
			case 'A':
				switch (ReadNextChar())
				{
				case 'B':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("S(", allowTextAfter: true))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.ABSFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'D':
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'D':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("RESSBLOCK", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.ADDRESSBLOCK, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'V':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("ANCE", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.ADVANCE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 'N':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("D(", allowTextAfter: true))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.ANDFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'S':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("K", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.ASK, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'U':
				{
					char c3 = ReadNextChar();
					if (c3 != 'T')
					{
						break;
					}
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'H':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("OR", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.AUTHOR, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'O':
						if (MovePastText("TEXT"))
						{
							if (MovePastRemainingText("LIST", allowTextAfter: false))
							{
								return new Token(TokenType.AUTOTEXTLIST, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
							}
							if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
							{
								return new Token(TokenType.AUTOTEXT, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				case 'V':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("ERAGE(", allowTextAfter: true))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.AVERAGEFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 'B':
				switch (ReadNextChar())
				{
				case 'I':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("BLIOGRAPHY", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.BIBLIOGRAPHY, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'Y':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("TES", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.BYTES, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 'C':
				switch (ReadNextChar())
				{
				case 'A':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("TEGORY", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.CATEGORY, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'H':
					if (MovePastText("ARACTERS"))
					{
						if (MovePastRemainingText("WITHSPACES", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.CHARACTERSWITHSPACES, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.CHARACTERS, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
					}
					break;
				case 'I':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("TATION", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.CITATION, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'O':
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'M':
						switch (ReadNextChar())
						{
						case 'M':
							if (MovePastRemainingText("ENTS", allowTextAfter: false))
							{
								return new Token(TokenType.COMMENTS, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
							}
							break;
						case 'P':
							if (MovePastText("A"))
							{
								if (MovePastRemainingText("NY", allowTextAfter: false))
								{
									return new Token(TokenType.COMPANY, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
								}
								if (MovePastRemainingText("RE", allowTextAfter: false))
								{
									return new Token(TokenType.COMPARE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
								}
							}
							break;
						}
						break;
					case 'U':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("NT(", allowTextAfter: true))

							return new Token(TokenType.COUNTFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

					if (MovePastText("T"))

							return new Token(TokenType.DATABASE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

							return new Token(TokenType.DATE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

				case 'E':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("FINED(", allowTextAfter: true))

							return new Token(TokenType.FORMDROPDOWN, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 'H':
				if (MovePastText("YPERLINK"))
				{
					if (MovePastRemainingText("BASE", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.HYPERLINKBASE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.HYPERLINK, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}

			case 'I':

				{
				case 'F':

						return new Token(TokenType.IF, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

					break;

							return new Token(TokenType.INDEX, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'T':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("(", allowTextAfter: true))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.INTFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 'K':
				if (MovePastRemainingText("EYWORDS", allowTextAfter: false))
				{
					return new Token(TokenType.KEYWORDS, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				break;

				{
				case 'A':

							return new Token(TokenType.LASTSAVEDBY, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						if (MovePastRemainingText("TIME", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.LASTSAVEDTIME, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
					}
					else if (MovePastRemainingText("PRINTED", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.LASTPRINTED, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'I':
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'N':
						switch (ReadNextChar())
						{
						case 'E':
							if (MovePastRemainingText("S", allowTextAfter: false))

								return new Token(TokenType.LINES, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

							return new Token(TokenType.MERGEREC, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));

						if (MovePastRemainingText("SEQ", allowTextAfter: false))

					break;
				case 'H':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("APE", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.SHAPE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'I':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("GN(", allowTextAfter: true))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.SIGNFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'K':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("IPIF", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.SKIPIF, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'T':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("YLEREF", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.STYLEREF, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'U':
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'B':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("JECT", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.SUBJECT, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'M':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("(", allowTextAfter: true))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.SUMFunc, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 'Y':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("MBOL", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.SYMBOL, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 'T':
				switch (ReadNextChar())
				{
				case 'A':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.TA, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'C':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.TC, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'E':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("MPLATE", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.TEMPLATE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				case 'I':
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'M':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("E", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.TIME, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'T':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("LE", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.TITLE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 'O':
					switch (ReadNextChar())
					{
					case 'A':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.TOA, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'C':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.TOC, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					case 'T':
						if (MovePastRemainingText("ALEDITINGTIME", allowTextAfter: false))
						{
							return new Token(TokenType.TOTALEDITINGTIME, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 'R':
					if (MovePastRemainingText("UE", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.TRUE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 'U':
				if (MovePastText("SER"))
				{
					if (MovePastRemainingText("ADDRESS", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.USERADDRESS, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					if (MovePastRemainingText("INITIALS", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.USERINITIALS, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
					if (MovePastRemainingText("NAME", allowTextAfter: false))
					{
						return new Token(TokenType.USERNAME, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
					}
				}
				break;
			case 'W':
				if (MovePastRemainingText("ORDS", allowTextAfter: false))
				{
					return new Token(TokenType.WORDS, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				break;
			case 'X':
				if (MovePastRemainingText("E", allowTextAfter: false))
				{
					return new Token(TokenType.XE, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				break;
			case '=':
				return new Token(TokenType.EqualsSign, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case ':':
				return new Token(TokenType.Colon, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case ',':
				return new Token(TokenType.Comma, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '<':
			{
				int currentPosition4 = _currentPosition;
				switch (ReadNextChar())
				{
				case '>':
					return new Token(TokenType.NotEquals, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				case '=':
					return new Token(TokenType.LessThanOrEqual, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				default:
					_currentPosition = currentPosition4;
					return new Token(TokenType.LessThan, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
			}
			case '>':
			{
				int currentPosition3 = _currentPosition;
				char c3 = ReadNextChar();
				if (c3 == '=')
				{
					return new Token(TokenType.GreaterThanOrEqual, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				_currentPosition = currentPosition3;
				return new Token(TokenType.GreaterThan, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			}
			case '"':
				return new Token(TokenType.DoubleQuote, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '(':
				return new Token(TokenType.OpenParen, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case ')':
				return new Token(TokenType.CloseParen, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '\\':
			{
				char c2 = ReadNextChar();
				switch (c2)
				{
				case '@':
					return new Token(TokenType.DateAndTimeFormattingSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				case '#':
					return new Token(TokenType.NumericFormattingSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				case '*':
					return new Token(TokenType.GeneralFormattingSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				if (!IsWhitespace(c2) && IsCharacter(c2))
				{
					while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && !IsWhitespace(_fieldText[_currentPosition]) && IsCharacter(_fieldText[_currentPosition]))
					{
						_currentPosition++;
					}
					return new Token(TokenType.FieldSpecificSwitchStart, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				break;
			}
			case '-':
				return new Token(TokenType.Minus, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '^':
				return new Token(TokenType.Caret, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '*':
				return new Token(TokenType.Asterisk, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '/':
				return new Token(TokenType.Slash, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '%':
				return new Token(TokenType.Percent, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '+':
				return new Token(TokenType.Plus, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case ';':
				return new Token(TokenType.Semicolon, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '.':
				if (MovePastDecimalDigits())
				{
					return new Token(TokenType.Number, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Period, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			case '0':
			case '1':
			case '2':
			case '3':
			case '4':
			case '5':
			case '6':
			case '7':
			case '8':
			case '9':
			{
				int currentPosition2 = _currentPosition;
				MovePastDecimalDigits();
				if (ReadNextChar() == '.')
				{
					MovePastDecimalDigits();
				}
				else
				{
					_currentPosition = currentPosition2;
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Number, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			}
			}
			if (!IsWhitespace(c) && IsCharacter(c))
			{
				while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && !IsWhitespace(_fieldText[_currentPosition]) && IsCharacter(_fieldText[_currentPosition]))
				{
					_currentPosition++;
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, GetCurrentTextStartingAt(currentPosition));
			}
			return new Token(TokenType.Null);
		}

		private Token GetNextTokenIsInQuotedString()
		{
			if (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && _fieldText[_currentPosition] == '"')
			{
				_currentPosition++;
				return new Token(TokenType.DoubleQuote, "\"");
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int currentPosition = _currentPosition;
			while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length)
			{
				char c = _fieldText[_currentPosition];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '"':
					return new Token(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, stringBuilder.ToString());
				case '\\':
					if (_currentPosition + 1 < _fieldText.Length)
					{
						_currentPosition++;
						stringBuilder.Append(_fieldText[_currentPosition]);
					}
					break;
				default:
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					break;
				}
				_currentPosition++;
			}
			return new Token(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		private static bool IsCharacter(char c)
		{
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\t':
			case '\n':
			case '\r':
				return true;
			default:
				if (' ' <= c && c <= '\ud7ff')
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ('\ue000' <= c && c <= '\ufffd')
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsDecimalDigit(char c)
		{
			switch (c)
			{
			case '0':
			case '1':
			case '2':
			case '3':
			case '4':
			case '5':
			case '6':
			case '7':
			case '8':
			case '9':
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsInsignificant(char c, LexerState currentState)
		{
			return currentState switch
			{
				LexerState.IsInQuotedString => false, 
				_ => IsWhitespace(c), 
			};
		}

		private static bool IsWhitespace(char c)
		{
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\t':
			case '\n':
			case '\r':
			case ' ':
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool MovePastDecimalDigits()
		{
			bool result = false;
			while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && IsDecimalDigit(_fieldText[_currentPosition]))
			{
				result = true;
				_currentPosition++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void MovePastInsignificantContent(LexerState currentState)
		{
			while (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && IsInsignificant(_fieldText[_currentPosition], currentState))
			{
				_currentPosition++;
			}
		}

		private bool MovePastRemainingText(string remainingText, bool allowTextAfter)
		{
			int currentPosition = _currentPosition;
			for (int i = 0; i < remainingText.Length; i++)
			{
				if (_fieldText.Length <= _currentPosition || remainingText[i] != _fieldText[_currentPosition++])
				{
					_currentPosition = currentPosition;
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!allowTextAfter && _currentPosition < _fieldText.Length && char.IsLetter(_fieldText[_currentPosition]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool MovePastText(string text)
		{
			int currentPosition = _currentPosition;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				if (_fieldText.Length <= _currentPosition || text[i] != _fieldText[_currentPosition++])
				{
					_currentPosition = currentPosition;
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private char ReadNextChar()
		{
			if (_currentPosition < _fieldText.Length)
			{
				return _fieldText[_currentPosition++];
			}
			return '\0';
		}

		public static Field Parse(string fieldText)
		{
			FieldParser fieldParser = new FieldParser(fieldText);
			if (!fieldParser.TryParseFieldType(out var field))
			{
				return null;
			}
			fieldParser.TryParseSwitches(field);
			return field;
		}

		private bool TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType tokenType, LexerState nextTokenLexerState)
		{
			if (_currentToken.Type != tokenType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_currentToken = GetNextToken(nextTokenLexerState);
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryParseDateAndTime(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseDateAndTimeFormattingSwitch(out FormattingCategory switchType, out string argument)
		{
			switchType = FormattingCategory.DateAndTime;
			return TryParseFormattingSwitchHelper(TokenType.DateAndTimeFormattingSwitchStart, out argument);
		}

		private bool TryParseDocumentAutomation(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseDocumentInformation(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseDocumentProperty(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseEquationsAndFormulas(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseFieldArgument(out string argument)
		{
			if (_currentToken.Type == TokenType.TextOrIdentifier)
			{
				argument = _currentToken.Text;
				return TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, LexerState.Default);
			}
			if (TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.DoubleQuote, LexerState.IsInQuotedString))
			{
				argument = _currentToken.Text;
				if (TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, LexerState.IsInQuotedString))
				{
					return TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.DoubleQuote, LexerState.Default);
				}
				return false;
			}
			argument = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseFieldSpecificSwitch(out string switchType, out string argument)
		{
			if (_currentToken.Type != TokenType.FieldSpecificSwitchStart)
			{
				switchType = null;
				argument = null;
				return false;
			}
			switchType = _currentToken.Text.Substring(1);
			if (!TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.FieldSpecificSwitchStart, LexerState.ArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext))
			{
				argument = null;
				return false;
			}
			TryParseFieldArgument(out argument);
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryParseFieldType(out Field field)
		{
			switch (_currentToken.Type)
			{
			case TokenType.CREATEDATE:
			case TokenType.DATE:
			case TokenType.EDITTIME:
			case TokenType.PRINTDATE:
			case TokenType.SAVEDATE:
			case TokenType.TIME:
				return TryParseDateAndTime(out field);
			case TokenType.COMPARE:
			case TokenType.DOCVARIABLE:
			case TokenType.GOTOBUTTON:
			case TokenType.IF:
			case TokenType.MACROBUTTON:
			case TokenType.PRINT:
			case TokenType.PRIVATE:
				return TryParseDocumentAutomation(out field);
			case TokenType.FILENAME:
			case TokenType.FILESIZE:
			case TokenType.LASTSAVEDBY:
			case TokenType.NUMCHARS:
			case TokenType.NUMPAGES:
			case TokenType.NUMWORDS:
			case TokenType.TEMPLATE:
				return TryParseDocumentInformation(out field);
			case TokenType.AUTHOR:
			case TokenType.COMMENTS:
			case TokenType.DOCPROPERTY:
			case TokenType.KEYWORDS:
			case TokenType.SUBJECT:
			case TokenType.TITLE:
				return TryParseDocumentProperty(out field);
			case TokenType.EqualsSign:
			case TokenType.ADVANCE:
			case TokenType.SYMBOL:
				return TryParseEquationsAndFormulas(out field);
			case TokenType.INDEX:
			case TokenType.RD:
			case TokenType.TA:
			case TokenType.TC:
			case TokenType.TOA:
			case TokenType.TOC:
			case TokenType.XE:
				return TryParseIndexAndTables(out field);
			case TokenType.AUTOTEXT:
			case TokenType.AUTOTEXTLIST:
			case TokenType.BIBLIOGRAPHY:
			case TokenType.CITATION:
			case TokenType.HYPERLINK:
			case TokenType.INCLUDEPICTURE:
			case TokenType.INCLUDETEXT:
			case TokenType.LINK:
			case TokenType.NOTEREF:
			case TokenType.PAGEREF:
			case TokenType.QUOTE:
			case TokenType.REF:
			case TokenType.SHAPE:
			case TokenType.STYLEREF:
			case TokenType.DoubleQuote:
				return TryParseLinksAndReferences(out field);
			case TokenType.TextOrIdentifier:
				if (TryParseLinksAndReferences(out field))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return TryParseUserDefinedField(out field);
			case TokenType.ADDRESSBLOCK:
			case TokenType.ASK:
			case TokenType.DATABASE:
			case TokenType.FILLIN:
			case TokenType.GREETINGLINE:
			case TokenType.MERGEFIELD:
			case TokenType.MERGEREC:
			case TokenType.MERGESEQ:
			case TokenType.NEXT:
			case TokenType.NEXTIF:
			case TokenType.SET:
			case TokenType.SKIPIF:
				return TryParseMailMerge(out field);
			case TokenType.LISTNUM:
			case TokenType.PAGE:
			case TokenType.REVNUM:
			case TokenType.SECTION:
			case TokenType.SECTIONPAGES:
			case TokenType.SEQ:
				return TryParseNumbering(out field);
			case TokenType.USERADDRESS:
			case TokenType.USERINITIALS:
			case TokenType.USERNAME:
				return TryParseUserInformation(out field);
			case TokenType.FORMCHECKBOX:
			case TokenType.FORMDROPDOWN:
			case TokenType.FORMTEXT:
				return TryParseFormField(out field);
			default:
				field = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseFormattingSwitch(out FormattingCategory switchType, out string argument)
		{
			switch (_currentToken.Type)
			{
			case TokenType.DateAndTimeFormattingSwitchStart:
				return TryParseDateAndTimeFormattingSwitch(out switchType, out argument);
			case TokenType.NumericFormattingSwitchStart:
				return TryParseNumericFormattingSwitch(out switchType, out argument);
			case TokenType.GeneralFormattingSwitchStart:
				return TryParseGeneralFormattingSwitch(out switchType, out argument);
			default:
				switchType = FormattingCategory.DateAndTime;
				argument = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseFormattingSwitchHelper(TokenType startTokenType, out string argument)
		{
			if (_currentToken.Type != startTokenType)
			{
				argument = null;
				return false;
			}
			if (!TryConsumeCurrentToken(startTokenType, LexerState.ArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext))
			{
				argument = null;
				return false;
			}
			return TryParseSwitchArgument(out argument);
		}

		private bool TryParseFormField(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseGeneralFormattingSwitch(out FormattingCategory switchType, out string argument)
		{
			switchType = FormattingCategory.General;
			return TryParseFormattingSwitchHelper(TokenType.GeneralFormattingSwitchStart, out argument);
		}

		private bool TryParseIndexAndTables(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseLinksAndReferences(out Field field)
		{
			field = null;
			switch (_currentToken.Type)
			{
			case TokenType.HYPERLINK:
			{
				if (!TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.HYPERLINK, LexerState.ArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!TryParseFieldArgument(out var argument2))
				{
					return false;
				}
				field = new HyperlinkField(argument2);
				return true;
			}
			case TokenType.INCLUDEPICTURE:
			{
				if (!TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.INCLUDEPICTURE, LexerState.ArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!TryParseFieldArgument(out var argument))
				{
					return false;
				}
				field = new IncludePictureField(argument);
				return true;
			}
			case TokenType.SHAPE:
				if (!TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.SHAPE, LexerState.ArgumentOrSwitchExpectedNext))
				{
					return false;
				}
				field = new ShapeField();
				return true;
			default:
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseMailMerge(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseNumericFormattingSwitch(out FormattingCategory switchType, out string argument)
		{
			switchType = FormattingCategory.Numeric;
			return TryParseFormattingSwitchHelper(TokenType.NumericFormattingSwitchStart, out argument);
		}

		private bool TryParseNumbering(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseSwitchArgument(out string argument)
		{
			if (_currentToken.Type == TokenType.TextOrIdentifier)
			{
				argument = _currentToken.Text;
				return TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, LexerState.Default);
			}
			if (TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.DoubleQuote, LexerState.IsInQuotedString))
			{
				argument = _currentToken.Text;
				if (TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.TextOrIdentifier, LexerState.IsInQuotedString))
				{
					return TryConsumeCurrentToken(TokenType.DoubleQuote, LexerState.Default);
				}
				return false;
			}
			argument = null;
			return false;
		}

		private void TryParseSwitches(Field field)
		{
			string switchType;
			string argument;
			while (TryParseFieldSpecificSwitch(out switchType, out argument))
			{
				field.ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(switchType, argument);
			}
			if (TryParseFormattingSwitch(out var switchType2, out argument))
			{
				field.ApplyFormattingSwitch(switchType2, argument);
			}
			while (TryParseFieldSpecificSwitch(out switchType, out argument))
			{
				field.ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(switchType, argument);
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseUserDefinedField(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseUserInformation(out Field field)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError("This field type is not supported.");
			field = null;
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class Field
	{
		public const string GeneralMergeFormatFormat = "MERGEFORMAT";

		public abstract FieldCategory Category { get; }

		public abstract string FieldInstructions { get; }

		public FormattingType FormattingType { get; set; }

		public abstract FieldType Type { get; }

		protected Field()
		{
			FormattingType = FormattingType.None;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return FieldInstructions;
		}

		protected static void AppendArgumentString(StringBuilder value, string argument)
		{
			if (argument == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			value.Append(' ');
			if (argument.Length == 0)
			{
				value.Append("\"\"");
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (char c in argument)
			{
				if (c != '_' && !char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				value.Append(argument);
				return;
			}
			value.Append('"');
			foreach (char c2 in argument)
			{
				switch (c2)
				{
				case '\\':
					value.Append("\\\\");
					break;
				case '"':
					value.Append("\\\"");
					break;
				default:
					value.Append(c2);
					break;
				}
			}
			value.Append('"');
		}

		protected static void AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(StringBuilder value, string switchType, string argument = null)
		{
			value.AppendFormat(" \\{0}", switchType);
			AppendArgumentString(value, argument);
		}

		protected static void AppendFormattingSwitch(StringBuilder value, FormattingCategory switchType, string argument)
		{
			value.Append(" \\");
			switch (switchType)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case FormattingCategory.DateAndTime:
				value.Append('@');
				break;
			case FormattingCategory.Numeric:
				value.Append('#');
				break;
			case FormattingCategory.General:
				value.Append('*');
				break;
			}
			AppendArgumentString(value, argument);
		}

		protected void AppendFormattingSwitches(StringBuilder value)
		{
			FormattingType formattingType = FormattingType;
			if (formattingType != FormattingType.None && formattingType == FormattingType.GeneralMergeFormat)
			{
				AppendFormattingSwitch(value, FormattingCategory.General, "MERGEFORMAT");
			}
		}

		public virtual void ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(string switchType, string argument)
		{
		}

		public virtual void ApplyFormattingSwitch(FormattingCategory switchType, string argument)
		{
			if (switchType == FormattingCategory.General && argument == "MERGEFORMAT")
			{
				FormattingType = FormattingType.GeneralMergeFormat;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class HyperlinkField : Field
	{
		private const string DocLocationSwitch = "l";

		private const string AppendCoordinatesForServerSideImageMapSwitch = "m";

		private const string OpenInNewWindowSwitch = "n";

		private const string ScreenTipSwitch = "o";

		private const string TargetFrameSwitch = "t";

		public readonly string Uri;

		public bool AppendCoordinatesForServerSideImageMap { get; set; }

		public string DocLocation { get; set; }

		public bool OpenInNewWindow { get; set; }

		public string ScreenTip { get; set; }

		public string TargetFrame { get; set; }

		public override FieldCategory Category => FieldCategory.LinksAndReferences;

		public override string FieldInstructions
		{
			get
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(Type.ToString());
				string argument = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Uri) ? " " : Uri);
				Field.AppendArgumentString(stringBuilder, argument);
				if (DocLocation != null)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "l", DocLocation);
				}
				if (AppendCoordinatesForServerSideImageMap)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "m");
				}
				if (OpenInNewWindow)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "n");
				}
				if (ScreenTip != null)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "o", ScreenTip);
				}
				if (TargetFrame != null)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "t", TargetFrame);
				}
				AppendFormattingSwitches(stringBuilder);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public override FieldType Type => FieldType.HYPERLINK;

		public HyperlinkField(string uri)
		{
			Uri = uri;
		}

		public override void ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(string switchType, string argument)
		{
			switch (switchType)
			{
			case "l":
				DocLocation = argument;
				break;
			case "m":
				AppendCoordinatesForServerSideImageMap = true;
				break;
			case "n":
				OpenInNewWindow = true;
				break;
			case "o":
				ScreenTip = argument;
				break;
			case "t":
				TargetFrame = argument;
				break;
			default:
				base.ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(switchType, argument);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class IncludePictureField : Field
	{
		private const string GraphicsFilterSwitch = "c";

		private const string ExcludeGraphicsDataSwitch = "d";

		public readonly string PictureLocation;

		public string GraphicsFilter { get; set; }

		public bool ExcludeGraphicsData { get; set; }

		public override FieldCategory Category => FieldCategory.LinksAndReferences;

		public override string FieldInstructions
		{
			get
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(Type.ToString());
				string argument = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(PictureLocation) ? " " : PictureLocation);
				Field.AppendArgumentString(stringBuilder, argument);
				if (GraphicsFilter != null)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "c", GraphicsFilter);
				}
				AppendFormattingSwitches(stringBuilder);
				if (ExcludeGraphicsData)
				{
					Field.AppendFieldSpecificSwitch(stringBuilder, "d");
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public override FieldType Type => FieldType.INCLUDEPICTURE;

		public IncludePictureField(string pictureLocation)
		{
			PictureLocation = pictureLocation;
		}

		public override void ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(string switchType, string argument)
		{
			if (!(switchType == "c"))
			{
				if (switchType == "d")
				{
					ExcludeGraphicsData = true;
				}
				else
				{
					base.ApplyFieldSpecificSwitch(switchType, argument);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GraphicsFilter = argument;
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class WordDocumentManager : OfficeDocumentManager
	{
		public const string HyperlinkRelationshipTypeValueTransitional = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink";

		public const string HyperlinkRelationshipTypeValueStrict = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/hyperlink";

		public sealed override OfficeApplication Application => OfficeApplication.Word;

		public override DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase DrawingPropertiesNamespace => DrawingMLPicture.Instance;

		protected WordDocumentManager(IPackageFactory packageFactory, Stream stream, bool isLoading, ST_ConformanceClass? conformance)
			: base(packageFactory, stream, isLoading, conformance)
		{
		}

		protected override ST_ConformanceClass GetConformance()
		{
			if (!base.IsLoading)
			{
				return ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
			}
			foreach (IPackageRelationship relationship in base.ZipPackage.GetRelationships())
			{
				string relationshipType = relationship.RelationshipType;
				if (!(relationshipType == "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument"))
				{
					if (!(relationshipType == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/officeDocument"))
					{
						continue;
					}
					return ST_ConformanceClass.strict;
				}
				return ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
			}
			return ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
		}

		public override void Initialize()
		{
			base.Initialize();
			RegisterNamespace(WordProcessingMLMain.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLWordProcessingDrawing.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(BmpPartManager.BmpInstance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(EmfPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(GifPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(JpegPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(PngPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(TiffPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(WmfPartManager.Instance);
		}

		public string CreateHyperlinkRelationship(Uri targetUri)
		{
			return CreateExternalRelationship(targetUri, GetHyperlinkRelationshipType());
		}

		private new string GetHyperlinkRelationshipType()
		{
			return base.Conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/hyperlink", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink", 
			};
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_TextScale
	{
		private readonly ST_TextScalePercent _value;

		public ST_TextScale(ST_TextScalePercent value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_TextScale? sT_TextScale = obj as ST_TextScale?;
			if (sT_TextScale.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_TextScale.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(ST_ConformanceClass.transitional);
		}

		public string ToString(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return _value.ToString(conformance);
		}

		public static ST_TextScale Parse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			ST_TextScale? sT_TextScale = TryParse(value, conformance);
			if (sT_TextScale.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_TextScale.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_TextScale>(value);
		}

		public static ST_TextScale? TryParse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return ST_TextScalePercent.TryParse(value, conformance);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_TextScale a, ST_TextScale b)
		{
			return a._value == b._value;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_TextScale a, ST_TextScale b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_TextScale(short value)
		{
			return new ST_TextScale(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_TextScale(ST_TextScalePercent value)
		{
			return new ST_TextScale(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator short(ST_TextScale value)
		{
			return value._value;
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_TextScalePercent(ST_TextScale value)
		{
			return value._value;
		}
	}
	internal struct ST_TextScalePercent
	{
		private readonly short _value;

		public ST_TextScalePercent(short value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_TextScalePercent? sT_TextScalePercent = obj as ST_TextScalePercent?;
			if (sT_TextScalePercent.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_TextScalePercent.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(ST_ConformanceClass.transitional);
		}

		public string ToString(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => _value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), 
				_ => _value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "%", 
			};
		}

		public static ST_TextScalePercent? TryParse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			short result;
			switch (conformance)
			{
			case ST_ConformanceClass.transitional:
				if (!short.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result))
				{
					return null;
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value[value.Length - 1] != '%')
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!short.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result))
				{
					return null;
				}
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_TextScalePercent a, ST_TextScalePercent b)
		{
			return a._value == b._value;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_TextScalePercent a, ST_TextScalePercent b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_TextScalePercent(short value)
		{
			return new ST_TextScalePercent(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator short(ST_TextScalePercent value)
		{
			return value._value;
		}
	}

		public static void ReadAnchorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_WrapDistance? distTValue, out ST_WrapDistance? distBValue, out ST_WrapDistance? distLValue, out ST_WrapDistance? distRValue, out bool simplePosValue, out uint relativeHeightValue, out bool behindDocValue, out bool lockedValue, out bool layoutInCellValue, out bool? hiddenValue, out bool allowOverlapValue)
		{
			distTValue = null;
			distBValue = null;
			distLValue = null;
			distRValue = null;
			simplePosValue = false;
			relativeHeightValue = 0u;
			behindDocValue = false;
			lockedValue = false;
			layoutInCellValue = false;
			hiddenValue = null;
			allowOverlapValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "distT":
					distTValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "distB":
					distBValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "distL":
					distLValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "distR":
					distRValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "simplePos":
					simplePosValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "relativeHeight":
					relativeHeightValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "behindDoc":
					behindDocValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "locked":
					lockedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "layoutInCell":
					layoutInCellValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "hidden":
					hiddenValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "allowOverlap":
					allowOverlapValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteAnchorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_WrapDistance? distTValue, ST_WrapDistance? distBValue, ST_WrapDistance? distLValue, ST_WrapDistance? distRValue, bool simplePosValue, uint relativeHeightValue, bool behindDocValue, bool lockedValue, bool layoutInCellValue, bool? hiddenValue, bool allowOverlapValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/wordprocessingDrawing/anchor", "wp");
			string value;
			if (distTValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = distTValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distT", value);
			}
			if (distBValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = distBValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distB", value);
			}
			if (distLValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = distLValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distL", value);
			}
			if (distRValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = distRValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distR", value);
			}
			if (simplePosValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(simplePosValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("simplePos", value);
			}
			value = relativeHeightValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("relativeHeight", value);
			value = ST_OnOff.ToString(behindDocValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("behindDoc", value);
			value = ST_OnOff.ToString(lockedValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("locked", value);
			value = ST_OnOff.ToString(layoutInCellValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("layoutInCell", value);
			if (hiddenValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(hiddenValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("hidden", value);
			}
			value = ST_OnOff.ToString(allowOverlapValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("allowOverlap", value);
		}

		public static void ReadExtentElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out long cxValue, out long cyValue)
		{
			cxValue = 0L;
			cyValue = 0L;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "cx"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "cy")
					{
						cyValue = long.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					cxValue = long.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteExtentElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, long cxValue, long cyValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/wordprocessingDrawing/extent", "wp");
			string value = cxValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cx", value);
			value = cyValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cy", value);
		}

		public static void ReadInlineElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_WrapDistance? distTValue, out ST_WrapDistance? distBValue, out ST_WrapDistance? distLValue, out ST_WrapDistance? distRValue)
		{
			distTValue = null;
			distBValue = null;
			distLValue = null;
			distRValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "distT":
					distTValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "distB":
					distBValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "distL":
					distLValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "distR":
					distRValue = ST_WrapDistance.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteInlineElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_WrapDistance? distTValue, ST_WrapDistance? distBValue, ST_WrapDistance? distLValue, ST_WrapDistance? distRValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/wordprocessingDrawing/inline", "wp");
			if (distTValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = distTValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distT", value);
			}
			if (distBValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = distBValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distB", value);
			}
			if (distLValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = distLValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distL", value);
			}
			if (distRValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = distRValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("distR", value);
			}
		}
	}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main", 
			};
		}

		private static string GetST_JcTableText(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_JcTable value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case ST_JcTable.start:
				if (partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
				{
					return "left";
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case ST_JcTable.end:
				if (partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
				{
					return "right";
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
				return value.ToString();
			}
		}

		private static ST_JcTable ParseST_JcTableText(string value, ST_JcTable defaultValue, XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return value switch
			{
				"center" => ST_JcTable.center, 
				"left" => ST_JcTable.start, 
				"start" => ST_JcTable.start, 
				"right" => ST_JcTable.end, 
				"end" => ST_JcTable.end, 
				_ => defaultValue, 
			};
		}

		private static string GetST_JcText(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Jc value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case ST_Jc.start:
				if (partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
				{
					return "left";
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case ST_Jc.end:
				if (partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
				{
					return "right";
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
				return value.ToString();
			}
		}

		private static ST_Jc ParseST_JcText(string value, ST_Jc defaultValue, XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return value switch
			{
				"both" => ST_Jc.both, 
				"center" => ST_Jc.center, 
				"distribute" => ST_Jc.distribute, 
				"mediumKashida" => ST_Jc.mediumKashida, 
				"numTab" => ST_Jc.numTab, 
				"highKashida" => ST_Jc.highKashida, 
				"lowKashida" => ST_Jc.lowKashida, 
				"thaiDistribute" => ST_Jc.thaiDistribute, 
				"left" => ST_Jc.start, 
				"start" => ST_Jc.start, 
				"right" => ST_Jc.end, 
				"end" => ST_Jc.end, 
				_ => defaultValue, 
			};
		}

		private static string GetST_TabJcText(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_TabJc value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case ST_TabJc.start:

				{
					return "left";
				}

		private static string GetST_TextDirectionText(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_TextDirection value)
		{
			if (partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.strict)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			return value switch
			{
				ST_TextDirection.tb => "lrTb", 
				ST_TextDirection.tbV => "lrTbV", 
				ST_TextDirection.lr => "btLr", 
				ST_TextDirection.lrV => "tbLrV", 
				ST_TextDirection.rl => "tbRl", 
				ST_TextDirection.rlV => "tbRlV", 
				_ => value.ToString(), 
			};
		}

		private static ST_TextDirection ParseST_TextDirectionText(string value, ST_TextDirection defaultValue, XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return value switch
			{
				"btLr" => ST_TextDirection.lr, 
				"lr" => ST_TextDirection.lr, 
				"tbLrV" => ST_TextDirection.lrV, 
				"lrV" => ST_TextDirection.lrV, 
				"tbRl" => ST_TextDirection.rl, 
				"rl" => ST_TextDirection.rl, 
				"tbRlV" => ST_TextDirection.rlV, 
				"rlV" => ST_TextDirection.rlV, 
				"lrTb" => ST_TextDirection.tb, 
				"tb" => ST_TextDirection.tb, 
				"lrTbV" => ST_TextDirection.tbV, 
				"tbV" => ST_TextDirection.tbV, 
				_ => defaultValue, 
			};
		}

		private static void ReadCT_BorderElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_Border valValue, out ST_HexColor? colorValue, out ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue, out ST_EighthPointMeasure? szValue, out ST_PointMeasure? spaceValue, out bool? shadowValue, out bool? frameValue, bool verifyElementName = true)
		{
			valValue = ST_Border.nil;
			colorValue = null;
			themeColorValue = null;
			themeTintValue = null;
			themeShadeValue = null;
			szValue = null;
			spaceValue = null;
			shadowValue = null;
			frameValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val":
					valValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, valValue);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color":
					colorValue = ST_HexColor.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor":
					themeColorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_ThemeColor.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint":
					themeTintValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade":
					themeShadeValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/sz":
					szValue = ST_EighthPointMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/space":
					spaceValue = ST_PointMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/shadow":
					shadowValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/frame":
					frameValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_BorderElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_Border valValue, ST_HexColor? colorValue, ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue, ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue, ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue, ST_EighthPointMeasure? szValue, ST_PointMeasure? spaceValue, bool? shadowValue, bool? frameValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "w");
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(valValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", enumAttributeString);
			if (colorValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = colorValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeColorValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(themeColorValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeTintValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = themeTintValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeShadeValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = themeShadeValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (szValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = szValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/sz", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (spaceValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = spaceValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/space", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (shadowValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(shadowValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/shadow", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (frameValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(frameValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/frame", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		private static void ReadCT_DecimalNumberElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_DecimalNumber valValue)
		{
			valValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Empty;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val")
				{
					valValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_DecimalNumberElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_DecimalNumber valValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "w");
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", valValue.ToString());
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private static void ReadCT_EmptyElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_EmptyElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "w");
		}

		private static void ReadCT_LanguageElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out string valValue, out string eastAsiaValue, out string bidiValue)
		{
			valValue = null;
			eastAsiaValue = null;
			bidiValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val":
					valValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/eastAsia":
					eastAsiaValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/bidi":
					bidiValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_LanguageElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string valValue, string eastAsiaValue, string bidiValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "w");
			string value = valValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", value);
			value = eastAsiaValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/eastAsia", value);
			value = bidiValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/bidi", value);
		}

		private static void ReadCT_TblWidthElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_MeasurementOrPercent wValue, out ST_TblWidth typeValue, bool verifyElementName = true)
		{
			wValue = new ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent(0.0, isDecimal: true);
			typeValue = ST_TblWidth.dxa;
			ST_ConformanceClass sT_ConformanceClass = partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/w"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/type")
					{
						typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					wValue = ST_MeasurementOrPercent.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, sT_ConformanceClass);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_TblWidthElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_MeasurementOrPercent wValue, ST_TblWidth typeValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "w");
			string value = wValue.ToString(partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/w", value);
			value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/type", value);
		}

		public static void ReadBackgroundElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_HexColor? colorValue, out ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue)
		{
			colorValue = null;
			themeColorValue = null;
			themeTintValue = null;
			themeShadeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color":
					colorValue = ST_HexColor.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor":
					themeColorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_ThemeColor.dark1);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint":
					themeTintValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade":
					themeShadeValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteBackgroundElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_HexColor? colorValue = null, ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue = null, ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue = null, ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/background", "w");
			if (colorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = colorValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color", value);
			}
			if (themeColorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(themeColorValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor", value);
			}
			if (themeTintValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = themeTintValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint", value);
			}
			if (themeShadeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = themeShadeValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadBrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_BrType typeValue, out ST_BrClear clearValue)
		{
			typeValue = ST_BrType.textWrapping;
			clearValue = ST_BrClear.none;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/type"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/clear")
					{
						clearValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, clearValue);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteBrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_BrType typeValue, ST_BrClear clearValue)

			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue, ST_BrType.textWrapping, valueIsRequired: false);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/type", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(clearValue, ST_BrClear.none, valueIsRequired: false);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/clear", enumAttributeString);
		}
