		public static void ReadFldCharElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_FldCharType fldCharTypeValue, out bool fldLockValue, out bool dirtyValue)
		{
			fldCharTypeValue = ST_FldCharType.begin;
			fldLockValue = false;
			dirtyValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fldCharType":
					fldCharTypeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, fldCharTypeValue);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fldLock":
					fldLockValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dirty":
					dirtyValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteFldCharElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_FldCharType fldCharTypeValue, bool fldLockValue = false, bool dirtyValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fldChar", "w");
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(fldCharTypeValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fldCharType", enumAttributeString);
			if (fldLockValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(fldLockValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fldLock", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (dirtyValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(dirtyValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dirty", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadFramePrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_DropCap? dropCapValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? linesValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? wValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? hValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? vSpaceValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? hSpaceValue, out ST_Wrap? wrapValue, out ST_HAnchor? hAnchorValue, out ST_VAnchor? vAnchorValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? xValue, out ST_XAlign? xAlignValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? yValue, out ST_YAlign? yAlignValue, out ST_HeightRule? hRuleValue, out bool? anchorLockValue)
		{
			dropCapValue = null;
			linesValue = null;
			wValue = null;
			hValue = null;
			vSpaceValue = null;
			hSpaceValue = null;
			wrapValue = null;
			hAnchorValue = null;
			vAnchorValue = null;
			xValue = null;
			xAlignValue = null;
			yValue = null;
			yAlignValue = null;
			hRuleValue = null;
			anchorLockValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dropCap":
					dropCapValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_DropCap.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lines":
					linesValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/w":
					wValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/h":
					hValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/vSpace":
					vSpaceValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hSpace":
					hSpaceValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/wrap":
					wrapValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Wrap.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hAnchor":
					hAnchorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_HAnchor.page);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/vAnchor":
					vAnchorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_VAnchor.page);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/x":
					xValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/xAlign":
					xAlignValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_XAlign.left);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/y":
					yValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/yAlign":
					yAlignValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_YAlign.bottom);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hRule":
					hRuleValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_HeightRule.auto);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/anchor":
					anchorLockValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/h", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (vSpaceValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = vSpaceValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/vSpace", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (hSpaceValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = hSpaceValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hSpace", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (wrapValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(wrapValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/wrap", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (hAnchorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(hAnchorValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hAnchor", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (vAnchorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(vAnchorValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/vAnchor", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (xValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = xValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/x", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (xAlignValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(xAlignValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/xAlign", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (yValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = yValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/y", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (yAlignValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(yAlignValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/yAlign", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (hRuleValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(hRuleValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hRule", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (anchorLockValue.HasValue)

				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(anchorLockValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/anchor", enumAttributeString);

		}

		public static void ReadHyperlinkElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string tgtFrameValue, out string tooltipValue, out string docLocationValue, out bool historyValue, out string anchorValue, out string idValue)
		{
			tgtFrameValue = null;
			tooltipValue = null;
			docLocationValue = null;
			historyValue = false;
			anchorValue = null;
			idValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tgtFrame":
					tgtFrameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tooltip":
					tooltipValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/docLocation":
					docLocationValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/history":
					historyValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/anchor":
					anchorValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteHyperlinkElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string tgtFrameValue, string tooltipValue, string docLocationValue, bool historyValue, string anchorValue, string idValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hyperlink", "w");
			string value = tgtFrameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tgtFrame", value);
			value = tooltipValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tooltip", value);
			value = docLocationValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/docLocation", value);
			if (historyValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(historyValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/history", value);
			}
			value = anchorValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/anchor", value);
			value = idValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id", value);
		}

		public static void ReadIndElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? startValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? startCharsValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? endValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? endCharsValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? hangingValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? hangingCharsValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? firstLineValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? firstLineCharsValue)
		{
			startValue = null;
			startCharsValue = null;
			endValue = null;
			endCharsValue = null;
			hangingValue = null;
			hangingCharsValue = null;
			firstLineValue = null;
			firstLineCharsValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/left":
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/start":
					startValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/leftChars":
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/startChars":
					startCharsValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/right":
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/end":
					endValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rightChars":
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/endChars":
					endCharsValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hanging":
					hangingValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hangingChars":
					hangingCharsValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstLine":
					firstLineValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstLineChars":
					firstLineCharsValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteIndElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? startValue, ST_DecimalNumber? startCharsValue, ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? endValue, ST_DecimalNumber? endCharsValue, ST_TwipsMeasure? hangingValue, ST_DecimalNumber? hangingCharsValue, ST_TwipsMeasure? firstLineValue, ST_DecimalNumber? firstLineCharsValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/ind", "w");
			if (startValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = startValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/start", value);
			}
			if (startCharsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = startCharsValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/startChars", value);
			}
			if (endValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = endValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/end", value);
			}
			if (endCharsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = endCharsValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/endChars", value);
			}
			if (hangingValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = hangingValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hanging", value);
			}
			if (hangingCharsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = hangingCharsValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hangingChars", value);
			}
			if (firstLineValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = firstLineValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstLine", value);
			}
			if (firstLineCharsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = firstLineCharsValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstLineChars", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadInsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string authorValue, out DateTime? dateValue, out string idValue)
		{
			authorValue = null;
			dateValue = null;
			idValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/author":
					authorValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/date":
					dateValue = DateTime.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteInsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string authorValue, DateTime? dateValue, string idValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/ins", "w");
			string value = authorValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/author", value);
			if (dateValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = dateValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/date", value);
			}
			value = idValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/id", value);
		}

		public static void ReadLvlElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_DecimalNumber ilvlValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? tplcValue, out bool? tentativeValue)
		{
			ilvlValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Empty;
			tplcValue = null;
			tentativeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/ilvl":
					ilvlValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tplc":
					tplcValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tentative":
					tentativeValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteLvlElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_DecimalNumber ilvlValue, ST_LongHexNumber? tplcValue = null, bool? tentativeValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lvl", "w");
			string value = ilvlValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/ilvl", value);
			if (tplcValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = tplcValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tplc", value);
			}
			if (tentativeValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(tentativeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tentative", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadLvlTextElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string valValue)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			valValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/null")
					{
						flag = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					valValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				valValue = null;
			}
		}

		public static void WriteLvlTextElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string valValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lvlText", "w");
			if (valValue == null)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.True.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/null", value);
			}
			else
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", valValue);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadNumFmtElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_NumberFormat valValue, out string formatValue)
		{
			valValue = ST_NumberFormat.bullet;
			formatValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/format")
					{
						formatValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					valValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, valValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadObjectElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string dxaOrigValue, out string dyaOrigValue)
		{
			dxaOrigValue = null;
			dyaOrigValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dxaOrig"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dyaOrig")
					{
						dyaOrigValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dxaOrigValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteObjectElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string dxaOrigValue = null, string dyaOrigValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/object", "w");
			string value = dxaOrigValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dxaOrig", value);
			value = dyaOrigValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/dyaOrig", value);
		}

		public static void ReadPElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRPrValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidDelValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidPValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRDefaultValue)
		{
			rsidRPrValue = null;
			rsidRValue = null;
			rsidDelValue = null;
			rsidPValue = null;
			rsidRDefaultValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidRPr":
					rsidRPrValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidR":
					rsidRValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidDel":
					rsidDelValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidP":
					rsidPValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidRDefault":
					rsidRDefaultValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WritePElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRPrValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidDelValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidPValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRDefaultValue = null)
		{
			XmlWriteManager xmlWriteManager = partManager.XmlWriteManager;
			xmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/p");
			if (rsidRPrValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidRPrValue.Value.ToString();
				xmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidRPr", value);
			}
			if (rsidRValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidRValue.Value.ToString();
				xmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidR", value);
			}
			if (rsidDelValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidDelValue.Value.ToString();
				xmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidDel", value);
			}
			if (rsidPValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidPValue.Value.ToString();
				xmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidP", value);
			}
			if (rsidRDefaultValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidRDefaultValue.Value.ToString();
				xmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidRDefault", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadRFontsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Hint? hintValue, out string asciiValue, out string hAnsiValue, out string eastAsiaValue, out string csValue, out ST_Theme? asciiThemeValue, out ST_Theme? hAnsiThemeValue, out ST_Theme? eastAsiaThemeValue, out ST_Theme? csthemeValue)
		{
			hintValue = null;
			asciiValue = null;
			hAnsiValue = null;
			eastAsiaValue = null;
			csValue = null;
			asciiThemeValue = null;
			hAnsiThemeValue = null;
			eastAsiaThemeValue = null;
			csthemeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hint":
					hintValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Hint._default);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/ascii":
					asciiValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hAnsi":
					hAnsiValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/eastAsia":
					eastAsiaValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/cs":
					csValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/asciiTheme":
					asciiThemeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Theme.majorEastAsia);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hAnsiTheme":
					hAnsiThemeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Theme.majorEastAsia);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/eastAsiaTheme":
					eastAsiaThemeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Theme.majorEastAsia);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/cstheme":
					csthemeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Theme.majorEastAsia);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteRFontsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Hint? hintValue = null, string asciiValue = null, string hAnsiValue = null, string eastAsiaValue = null, string csValue = null, ST_Theme? asciiThemeValue = null, ST_Theme? hAnsiThemeValue = null, ST_Theme? eastAsiaThemeValue = null, ST_Theme? csthemeValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rFonts", "w");
			if (hintValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(hintValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hint", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (asciiValue != null)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = asciiValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/ascii", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (hAnsiValue != null)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = hAnsiValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hAnsi", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (eastAsiaValue != null)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = eastAsiaValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/eastAsia", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (csValue != null)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = csValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/cs", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (asciiThemeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(asciiThemeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/asciiTheme", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (hAnsiThemeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(hAnsiThemeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hAnsiTheme", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (eastAsiaThemeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(eastAsiaThemeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/eastAsiaTheme", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (csthemeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(csthemeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/cstheme", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadShdElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Shd valValue, out ST_HexColor? colorValue, out ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue, out ST_HexColor? fillValue, out ST_ThemeColor? themeFillValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeFillTintValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeFillShadeValue)
		{
			valValue = ST_Shd.nil;
			colorValue = null;
			themeColorValue = null;
			themeTintValue = null;
			themeShadeValue = null;
			fillValue = null;
			themeFillValue = null;
			themeFillTintValue = null;
			themeFillShadeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val":
					valValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, valValue);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color":
					colorValue = ST_HexColor.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor":
					themeColorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_ThemeColor.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint":
					themeTintValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade":
					themeShadeValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fill":
					fillValue = ST_HexColor.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeFill":
					themeFillValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_ThemeColor.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeFillTint":
					themeFillTintValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeFillShade":
					themeFillShadeValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade", enumAttributeString);

			if (fillValue.HasValue)

				enumAttributeString = fillValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/fill", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeFillValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(themeFillValue.Value);

			if (themeFillTintValue.HasValue)
			{

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeFillTint", enumAttributeString);

			if (themeFillShadeValue.HasValue)

		public static void ReadSpacingElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_TwipsMeasure? beforeValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? beforeLinesValue, out bool? beforeAutospacingValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? afterValue, out ST_DecimalNumber? afterLinesValue, out bool? afterAutospacingValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? lineValue, out ST_LineSpacingRule? lineRuleValue)
		{
			beforeValue = null;
			beforeLinesValue = null;
			beforeAutospacingValue = null;
			afterValue = null;
			afterLinesValue = null;
			afterAutospacingValue = null;
			lineValue = null;
			lineRuleValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/before":
					beforeValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/beforeLines":
					beforeLinesValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/beforeAutospacing":
					beforeAutospacingValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/after":
					afterValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/afterLines":
					afterLinesValue = ST_DecimalNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/afterAutospacing":
					afterAutospacingValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/line":
					lineValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lineRule":
					lineRuleValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_LineSpacingRule.auto);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteSpacingElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_TwipsMeasure? beforeValue, ST_DecimalNumber? beforeLinesValue, bool? beforeAutospacingValue, ST_TwipsMeasure? afterValue, ST_DecimalNumber? afterLinesValue, bool? afterAutospacingValue, ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? lineValue, ST_LineSpacingRule? lineRuleValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/spacing", "w");
			if (beforeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = beforeValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/before", value);
			}
			if (beforeLinesValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = beforeLinesValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/beforeLines", value);
			}
			if (beforeAutospacingValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(beforeAutospacingValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/beforeAutospacing", value);
			}
			if (afterValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = afterValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/after", value);
			}
			if (afterLinesValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = afterLinesValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/afterLines", value);
			}
			if (afterAutospacingValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(afterAutospacingValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/afterAutospacing", value);
			}
			if (lineValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = lineValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/line", value);
			}
			if (lineRuleValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(lineRuleValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lineRule", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadStyleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_StyleType typeValue, out string styleIdValue, out bool defaultValue, out bool customStyleValue)
		{
			typeValue = ST_StyleType.paragraph;
			styleIdValue = null;
			defaultValue = false;
			customStyleValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/styleId":
					styleIdValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/default":
					defaultValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/customStyle":
					customStyleValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteStyleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_StyleType typeValue = ST_StyleType.paragraph, string styleIdValue = null, bool? defaultValue = null, bool? customStyleValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/style", "w");
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue, ST_StyleType.paragraph, valueIsRequired: false);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/type", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = styleIdValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/styleId", enumAttributeString);
			if (defaultValue == true)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(defaultValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/default", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (customStyleValue == true)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(customStyleValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/customStyle", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadTabElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_TabJc valValue, out ST_TabTlc? leaderValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure posValue)
		{
			valValue = ST_TabJc.bar;
			leaderValue = null;
			posValue = default(ST_SignedTwipsMeasure);
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val":
					valValue = ParseST_TabJcText(currentElementAttribute.Value, valValue, partManager);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/leader":
					leaderValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TabTlc.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/pos":
					posValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTabElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_TabJc valValue, ST_TabTlc? leaderValue, ST_SignedTwipsMeasure posValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tab", "w");
			string sT_TabJcText = GetST_TabJcText(partManager, valValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", sT_TabJcText);
			if (leaderValue.HasValue)
			{
				sT_TabJcText = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(leaderValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/leader", sT_TabJcText);
			}
			sT_TabJcText = posValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/pos", sT_TabJcText);
		}

		public static void ReadTblLookElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool? firstRowValue, out bool? lastRowValue, out bool? firstColumnValue, out bool? lastColumnValue, out bool? noHBandValue, out bool? noVBandValue, out string valValue)
		{
			firstRowValue = null;
			lastRowValue = null;
			firstColumnValue = null;
			lastColumnValue = null;
			noHBandValue = null;
			noVBandValue = null;
			valValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstRow":
					firstRowValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lastRow":
					lastRowValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstColumn":
					firstColumnValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lastColumn":
					lastColumnValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/noHBand":
					noHBandValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/noVBand":
					noVBandValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val":
					valValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTblLookElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool? firstRowValue, bool? lastRowValue, bool? firstColumnValue, bool? lastColumnValue, bool? noHBandValue, bool? noVBandValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tblLook", "w");
			if (firstRowValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(firstRowValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstRow", value);
			}
			if (lastRowValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(lastRowValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lastRow", value);
			}
			if (firstColumnValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(firstColumnValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/firstColumn", value);
			}
			if (lastColumnValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(lastColumnValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/lastColumn", value);
			}
			if (noHBandValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noHBandValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/noHBand", value);
			}
			if (noVBandValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noVBandValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/noVBand", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadTblPPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_TwipsMeasure? leftFromTextValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? rightFromTextValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? topFromTextValue, out ST_TwipsMeasure? bottomFromTextValue, out ST_VAnchor? vertAnchorValue, out ST_HAnchor? horzAnchorValue, out ST_XAlign? tblpXSpecValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? tblpXValue, out ST_YAlign? tblpYSpecValue, out ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? tblpYValue)
		{
			leftFromTextValue = null;
			rightFromTextValue = null;
			topFromTextValue = null;
			bottomFromTextValue = null;
			vertAnchorValue = null;
			horzAnchorValue = null;
			tblpXSpecValue = null;
			tblpXValue = null;
			tblpYSpecValue = null;
			tblpYValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/leftFromText":
					leftFromTextValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rightFromText":
					rightFromTextValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/topFromText":
					topFromTextValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/bottomFromText":
					bottomFromTextValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/vertAnchor":
					vertAnchorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_VAnchor.page);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/horzAnchor":
					horzAnchorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_HAnchor.page);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tblpXSpec":
					tblpXSpecValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_XAlign.center);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tblpX":
					tblpXValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tblpYSpec":
					tblpYSpecValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_YAlign.bottom);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tblpY":
					tblpYValue = ST_SignedTwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTblPPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_TwipsMeasure? leftFromTextValue, ST_TwipsMeasure? rightFromTextValue, ST_TwipsMeasure? topFromTextValue, ST_TwipsMeasure? bottomFromTextValue, ST_VAnchor? vertAnchorValue, ST_HAnchor? horzAnchorValue, ST_XAlign? tblpXSpecValue, ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? tblpXValue, ST_YAlign? tblpYSpecValue, ST_SignedTwipsMeasure? tblpYValue)

				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(vertAnchorValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/vertAnchor", value);
			}
			if (horzAnchorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(horzAnchorValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/horzAnchor", value);

			}
			if (tblpYValue.HasValue)

				string value = tblpYValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tblpY", value);

		{

			string sT_TextDirectionText = GetST_TextDirectionText(partManager, valValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", sT_TextDirectionText);
		}

		public static void ReadTrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRPrValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidDelValue, out ST_LongHexNumber? rsidTrValue)
		{
			rsidRPrValue = null;
			rsidRValue = null;
			rsidDelValue = null;
			rsidTrValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidRPr":
					rsidRPrValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidR":
					rsidRValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidDel":
					rsidDelValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidTr":
					rsidTrValue = ST_LongHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRPrValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidRValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidDelValue = null, ST_LongHexNumber? rsidTrValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/tr", "w");
			if (rsidRPrValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidRPrValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidRPr", value);
			}
			if (rsidRValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidRValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidR", value);
			}
			if (rsidDelValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidDelValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidDel", value);
			}
			if (rsidTrValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rsidTrValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/rsidTr", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadTrHeightElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_TwipsMeasure? valValue, out ST_HeightRule? hRuleValue)
		{
			valValue = null;
			hRuleValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hRule")
					{
						hRuleValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_HeightRule.auto);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					valValue = ST_TwipsMeasure.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTrHeightElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_TwipsMeasure? valValue, ST_HeightRule? hRuleValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/trHeight", "w");
			if (valValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = valValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", value);
			}
			if (hRuleValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(hRuleValue.GetValueOrDefault());
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/hRule", value);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadTrPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTrPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/trPr", "w");
		}

		public static void ReadUElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Underline? valValue, out ST_HexColor? colorValue, out ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue, out ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue)
		{
			valValue = null;
			colorValue = null;
			themeColorValue = null;
			themeTintValue = null;
			themeShadeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val":
					valValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Underline.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color":
					colorValue = ST_HexColor.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor":
					themeColorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_ThemeColor.none);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint":
					themeTintValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade":
					themeShadeValue = ST_UcharHexNumber.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteUElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Underline? valValue, ST_HexColor? colorValue, ST_ThemeColor? themeColorValue, ST_UcharHexNumber? themeTintValue, ST_UcharHexNumber? themeShadeValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/u", "w");
			if (valValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(valValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/val", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (colorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = colorValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/color", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeColorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(themeColorValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeColor", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeTintValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = themeTintValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeTint", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (themeShadeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = themeShadeValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main/themeShade", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

	internal abstract class ExcelDocumentManager : OfficeDocumentManager
	{
		private const string ExternalLinkPathRelationshipTypeValueTransitional = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/externalLinkPath";

		private const string ExternalLinkPathRelationshipTypeValueStrict = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/externalLinkPath";

		private const string OleObjectRelationshipTypeValueTransitional = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/oleObject";

		private const string OleObjectRelationshipTypeValueStrict = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/oleObject";

		public sealed override OfficeApplication Application => OfficeApplication.Excel;

		public override DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase DrawingPropertiesNamespace => DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing.Instance;

		protected ExcelDocumentManager(IPackageFactory packageFactory, Stream stream, bool isLoading, ST_ConformanceClass? conformance)
			: base(packageFactory, stream, isLoading, conformance)
		{
		}

		protected override ST_ConformanceClass GetConformance()
		{
			if (!base.IsLoading)
			{
				return ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
			}
			foreach (IPackageRelationship relationship in base.ZipPackage.GetRelationships())
			{
				string relationshipType = relationship.RelationshipType;
				if (!(relationshipType == "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument"))
				{
					if (!(relationshipType == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/officeDocument"))
					{
						continue;
					}
					return ST_ConformanceClass.strict;
				}
				return ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
			}
			return ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
		}

		public override void Initialize()
		{
			base.Initialize();
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(ExcelNamespace.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(Excel2006Main.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(SpreadsheetMLMain.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(SpreadsheetML2009Main.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(BmpPartManager.BmpInstance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(EmfPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(GifPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(JpegPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(PngPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(TiffPartManager.Instance);
			RegisterPartManagerPrototype(WmfPartManager.Instance);
		}

		public string GetExternalLinkPathRelationshipType()
		{
			return base.Conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/externalLinkPath", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/externalLinkPath", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/externalLinkPath", 
			};
		}

		public string GetOleObjectRelationshipType()
		{
			return base.Conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/oleObject", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/oleObject", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/oleObject", 
			};
		}
	}

			};
		}

	internal struct ST_Guid
	{
		private readonly Guid _value;

		public ST_Guid(Guid value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public static ST_Guid Parse(string value)
		{
			return new Guid(value);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _value.ToString("B").ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_Guid(Guid value)
		{
			return new ST_Guid(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator Guid(ST_Guid value)
		{
			return value._value;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing : DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase
	{
		private const string _NamespaceTransitional = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing";

		private const string _NamespaceStrict = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing";

		internal const string _NamespacePrefix = "xdr";

		public const string absoluteAnchor = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/absoluteAnchor";

		public const string clientData = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/clientData";

		public const string col = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/col";

		public const string colOff = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/colOff";

		public const string ext = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/ext";

		public const string from = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/from";

		public const string oneCellAnchor = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/oneCellAnchor";

		public const string pos = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/pos";

		public const string row = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/row";

		public const string rowOff = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/rowOff";

		public const string to = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/to";

		public const string twoCellAnchor = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/twoCellAnchor";

		public const string wsDr = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/wsDr";

		public new const string cxnSp = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/cxnSp";

		public new const string graphicFrame = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/graphicFrame";

		public new const string grpSp = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/grpSp";

		public new const string pic = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/pic";

		public new const string sp = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/sp";

		public new const string nvSpPr = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/nvSpPr";

		public new const string cNvPr = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/cNvPr";

		public new const string cNvSpPr = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/cNvSpPr";

		public new const string spPr = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/spPr";

		public new const string txBody = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/txBody";

		private const string editAs_Attribute = "editAs";

		private const string fLocksWithSheet_Attribute = "fLocksWithSheet";

		private const string fPrintsWithSheet_Attribute = "fPrintsWithSheet";

		public const string macro = "macro";

		public const string textlink = "textlink";

		public const string id = "id";

		public const string name = "name";

		public static readonly DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing Instance = new DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing();

		public override string NamespacePrefix => "xdr";

		private DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing()
			: base("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing")
		{
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private static void ReadCT_MarkerElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_MarkerElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "xdr");
		}

		private static void ReadST_CoordinateElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_Coordinate value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = ST_Coordinate.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue);
		}

		private static void WriteST_CoordinateElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_Coordinate value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "xdr");
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString());
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadAbsoluteAnchorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteAbsoluteAnchorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/absoluteAnchor", "xdr");
		}

		public static void ReadClientDataElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool fLocksWithSheetValue, out bool fPrintsWithSheetValue)
		{
			fLocksWithSheetValue = true;
			fPrintsWithSheetValue = true;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "fLocksWithSheet"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "fPrintsWithSheet")
					{
						fPrintsWithSheetValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					fLocksWithSheetValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteClientDataElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool fLocksWithSheetValue = true, bool fPrintsWithSheetValue = true)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/clientData", "xdr");
			if (!fLocksWithSheetValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fLocksWithSheetValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fLocksWithSheet", value);
			}
			if (!fPrintsWithSheetValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fPrintsWithSheetValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fPrintsWithSheet", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadColElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out int value)
		{
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ReadXmlIntElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/col", out value);
		}

		public static void WriteColElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, int value)
		{
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.WriteXmlIntElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/col", "xdr", value);
		}

		public static void ReadColOffElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Coordinate value)
		{
			ReadST_CoordinateElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/colOff", out value);
		}

		public static void WriteColOffElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Coordinate value)
		{
			WriteST_CoordinateElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/colOff", value);
		}

		public static void ReadExtElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_PositiveCoordinate cxValue, out ST_PositiveCoordinate cyValue)
		{
			DrawingMLMain.ReadCT_PositiveSize2DElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/ext", out cxValue, out cyValue);
		}

		public static void WriteExtElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_PositiveCoordinate cxValue, ST_PositiveCoordinate cyValue)
		{
			DrawingMLMain.WriteCT_PositiveSize2DElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/ext", cxValue, cyValue);
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadFromElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
		}

		public static void WriteFromElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			WriteCT_MarkerElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/spreadsheetDrawing/from");

		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = ST_TrueFalseBlank.ParseBool(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue);
		}

		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			string value2 = ST_TrueFalseBlank.ToString(value);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value2);
			}
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{

		public static void ReadDataValidationElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_DataValidationType typeValue, out ST_DataValidationErrorStyle errorStyleValue, out ST_DataValidationImeMode imeModeValue, out ST_DataValidationOperator operatorValue, out bool allowBlankValue, out bool showDropDownValue, out bool showInputMessageValue, out bool showErrorMessageValue, out string errorTitleValue, out string errorValue, out string promptTitleValue, out string promptValue)
		{
			typeValue = ST_DataValidationType.none;
			errorStyleValue = ST_DataValidationErrorStyle.stop;
			imeModeValue = ST_DataValidationImeMode.noControl;
			operatorValue = ST_DataValidationOperator.between;
			allowBlankValue = false;
			showDropDownValue = false;
			showInputMessageValue = false;
			showErrorMessageValue = false;
			errorTitleValue = null;
			errorValue = null;
			promptTitleValue = null;
			promptValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
					break;
				case "errorStyle":
					errorStyleValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, errorStyleValue);
					break;
				case "imeMode":
					imeModeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, imeModeValue);
					break;
				case "operator":
					operatorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, operatorValue);
					break;
				case "allowBlank":
					allowBlankValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showDropDown":
					showDropDownValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showInputMessage":
					showInputMessageValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showErrorMessage":
					showErrorMessageValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "errorTitle":
					errorTitleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "error":
					errorValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "promptTitle":
					promptTitleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "prompt":
					promptValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteDataValidationElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_DataValidationType typeValue = ST_DataValidationType.none, ST_DataValidationErrorStyle errorStyleValue = ST_DataValidationErrorStyle.stop, ST_DataValidationImeMode imeModeValue = ST_DataValidationImeMode.noControl, ST_DataValidationOperator operatorValue = ST_DataValidationOperator.between, bool allowBlankValue = false, bool showDropDownValue = false, bool showInputMessageValue = false, bool showErrorMessageValue = false, string errorTitleValue = null, string errorValue = null, string promptTitleValue = null, string promptValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/dataValidation", "x14");
			string enumAttributeString;
			if (typeValue != ST_DataValidationType.none)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("type", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (errorStyleValue != ST_DataValidationErrorStyle.stop)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(errorStyleValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("errorStyle", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (imeModeValue != ST_DataValidationImeMode.noControl)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(imeModeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("imeMode", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (operatorValue != ST_DataValidationOperator.between)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(operatorValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("operator", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (allowBlankValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(allowBlankValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("allowBlank", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (showDropDownValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(showDropDownValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showDropDown", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (showInputMessageValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(showInputMessageValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showInputMessage", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (showErrorMessageValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(showErrorMessageValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showErrorMessage", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = errorTitleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("errorTitle", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = errorValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("error", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = promptTitleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("promptTitle", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = promptValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("prompt", enumAttributeString);
		}

		public static void ReadDataValidationsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool disablePromptsValue, out uint? xWindowValue, out uint? yWindowValue, out uint? countValue)
		{
			disablePromptsValue = false;
			xWindowValue = null;
			yWindowValue = null;
			countValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "disablePrompts":
					disablePromptsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "xWindow":
					xWindowValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "yWindow":
					yWindowValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "count":
					countValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteDataValidationsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool disablePromptsValue = false, uint? xWindowValue = null, uint? yWindowValue = null, uint? countValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/dataValidations", "x14");
			if (disablePromptsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(disablePromptsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("disablePrompts", value);
			}
			if (xWindowValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = xWindowValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("xWindow", value);
			}
			if (yWindowValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = yWindowValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("yWindow", value);
			}
			if (countValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = countValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("count", value);
			}
		}
