		public static void ReadDatabarElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint? maxLength, out uint? minLength, out bool? showValue, out bool? hasBorder, out bool? hasGradient, out ST_DataBarDirection? direction, out bool? negativeBarColorSameAsPositive, out bool? negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive, out ST_DataBarAxisPosition? axisPosition)
		{
			maxLength = null;
			minLength = null;
			showValue = null;
			hasBorder = null;
			hasGradient = null;
			direction = null;
			negativeBarColorSameAsPositive = null;
			negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive = null;
			axisPosition = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "minLength":
					minLength = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "maxLength":
					maxLength = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "showValue":
					showValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "border":
					hasBorder = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "gradient":
					hasGradient = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "direction":
					direction = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_DataBarDirection.context);
					break;
				case "negativeBarColorSameAsPositive":
					negativeBarColorSameAsPositive = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive":
					negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "axisPosition":
					axisPosition = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_DataBarAxisPosition.automatic);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteDatabarElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint? minLength, uint? maxLength, bool? showValue, bool? border, bool? gradient, ST_DataBarDirection? direction, bool? negativeBarColorSameAsPositive, bool? negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive, ST_DataBarAxisPosition? axisPosition)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/dataBar", "x14");
			if (minLength.HasValue)
			{
				string value = minLength.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("minLength", value);
			}
			if (maxLength.HasValue)
			{
				string value = maxLength.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("maxLength", value);
			}
			if (showValue.HasValue && !showValue.Value)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showValue", value);
			}
			if (border.HasValue && border.Value)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(border.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("border", value);
			}
			if (gradient.HasValue && !gradient.Value)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(gradient.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("gradient", value);
			}
			if (direction.HasValue && direction.Value != ST_DataBarDirection.context)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(direction.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("direction", value);
			}
			if (negativeBarColorSameAsPositive.HasValue && negativeBarColorSameAsPositive.Value)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(negativeBarColorSameAsPositive.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("negativeBarColorSameAsPositive", value);
			}
			if (negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive.HasValue && !negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive.Value)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("negativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive", value);
			}
			if (axisPosition.HasValue && axisPosition.Value != ST_DataBarAxisPosition.automatic)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(axisPosition.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("axisPosition", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCfIconElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_IconSetType iconSet, out uint iconId)
		{
			iconSet = ST_IconSetType._3TrafficLights1;
			iconId = 0u;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "iconSet"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "iconId")
					{
						iconId = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					iconSet = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_IconSetType._3Arrows);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCfIconElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_IconSetType iconSet, uint iconId)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/cfIcon", "x14");
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(iconSet);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconSet", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = iconId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconId", enumAttributeString);
		}

		public static void ReadOleItemElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string nameValue, out bool iconValue, out bool adviseValue, out bool preferPicValue)
		{
			nameValue = null;
			iconValue = false;
			adviseValue = false;
			preferPicValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "icon":
					iconValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "advise":
					adviseValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "preferPic":
					preferPicValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteOleItemElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string nameValue = null, bool iconValue = false, bool adviseValue = false, bool preferPicValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/oleItem", "x14");
			string value = nameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("name", value);
			if (iconValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(iconValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("icon", value);
			}
			if (adviseValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(adviseValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("advise", value);
			}
			if (preferPicValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(preferPicValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("preferPic", value);
			}
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main", 
			};
		}

		private static void AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref StringBuilder result, string value, int currentCharIndex, ref int firstCharIndexToAppend)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				result = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
			}
			result.Append(value, firstCharIndexToAppend, currentCharIndex - firstCharIndexToAppend);
			firstCharIndexToAppend = currentCharIndex + 1;
		}

		private static string EscapeVString(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringBuilder result = null;
			int firstCharIndexToAppend = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = value[i];
				if (c == '_')
				{
					if (value.Length <= i + 6 || value[i + 1] != 'x' || value[i + 6] != '_' || !Utilities.IsHexDigit(value[i + 2]) || !Utilities.IsHexDigit(value[i + 3]) || !Utilities.IsHexDigit(value[i + 4]) || !Utilities.IsHexDigit(value[i + 5]))
					{
						continue;
					}
					AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, i, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
					result.Append("_x005F_");
				}
				if (c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && (' ' > c || c > '\ud7ff') && ('\ue000' > c || c > '\ufffd') && '\uffff' > c)
				{
					AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, i, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
					result.AppendFormat("_x{0:X4}_", (int)c);
				}
			}
			if (firstCharIndexToAppend == 0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, value.Length, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
			return result.ToString();
		}

		private static string UnescapeVString(string value, bool removeNewLines = false)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringBuilder result = null;
			int firstCharIndexToAppend = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = value[i];
				if (c != '_')
				{
					if (!removeNewLines)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (c)
					{
					case '\n':
						AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, i, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
						break;
					case '\r':
						AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, i, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
						if (i + 1 < value.Length && value[i + 1] == '\n')
						{
							i++;
							firstCharIndexToAppend++;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (value.Length > i + 6 && value[i + 1] == 'x' && value[i + 6] == '_')
				{
					string s = value.Substring(i + 2, 4);
					if (int.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result2))
					{
						AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, i, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
						result.Append((char)result2);
						i += 6;
						firstCharIndexToAppend += 6;
					}
				}
			}
			if (firstCharIndexToAppend == 0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			AppendPreviousCharBlock(ref result, value, value.Length, ref firstCharIndexToAppend);
			return result.ToString();
		}

		private static void ReadCT_BooleanPropertyElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out bool valValue)
		{
			valValue = true;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "val")
				{
					valValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_BooleanPropertyElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, bool valValue = true)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, null);
			if (!valValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(valValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("val", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCT_BorderPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_BorderStyle styleValue)
		{
			styleValue = ST_BorderStyle.none;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "style")
				{
					styleValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, styleValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCT_BorderPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_BorderStyle styleValue = ST_BorderStyle.none)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, null);
			if (styleValue != ST_BorderStyle.none)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(styleValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("style", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		internal static void ReadCT_ColorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out bool? autoValue, out uint? indexedValue, out ST_UnsignedIntHex? rgbValue, out uint? themeValue, out double tintValue)
		{
			autoValue = null;
			indexedValue = null;
			rgbValue = null;
			themeValue = null;
			tintValue = 0.0;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "auto":
					autoValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "indexed":
					indexedValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "rgb":
				{
					ST_UnsignedIntHex sT_UnsignedIntHex = ST_UnsignedIntHex.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					if (currentElementAttribute.Value != null && currentElementAttribute.Value.Length == 6)
					{
						sT_UnsignedIntHex = new ST_UnsignedIntHex((uint)sT_UnsignedIntHex | 0xFF000000u);
					}
					rgbValue = sT_UnsignedIntHex;
					break;
				}
				case "theme":
					themeValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "tint":
					tintValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void WriteCT_ColorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, bool? autoValue = null, uint? indexedValue = null, ST_UnsignedIntHex? rgbValue = null, uint? themeValue = null, double tintValue = 0.0)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, null);
			if (autoValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(autoValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("auto", value);
			}
			if (indexedValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = indexedValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("indexed", value);
			}
			if (rgbValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rgbValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rgb", value);
			}
			if (themeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = themeValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("theme", value);
			}
			if (tintValue != 0.0)
			{
				string value = tintValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tint", value);
			}
		}

		private static void ReadCT_PageBreakElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out uint countValue, out uint manualBreakCountValue)
		{
			countValue = 0u;
			manualBreakCountValue = 0u;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "count"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "manualBreakCount")
					{
						manualBreakCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					countValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_PageBreakElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, uint countValue = 0u, uint manualBreakCountValue = 0u)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, null);
			if (countValue != 0)
			{
				string value = countValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("count", value);
			}
			if (manualBreakCountValue != 0)
			{
				string value = manualBreakCountValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("manualBreakCount", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadAlignmentElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_HorizontalAlignment? horizontalValue, out ST_VerticalAlignment? verticalValue, out uint? textRotationValue, out bool wrapTextValue, out uint? indentValue, out int? relativeIndentValue, out bool justifyLastLineValue, out bool shrinkToFitValue, out uint? readingOrderValue)
		{
			horizontalValue = null;
			verticalValue = null;
			textRotationValue = null;
			wrapTextValue = false;
			indentValue = null;
			relativeIndentValue = null;
			justifyLastLineValue = false;
			shrinkToFitValue = false;
			readingOrderValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "horizontal":
					horizontalValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_HorizontalAlignment.general);
					break;
				case "vertical":
					verticalValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_VerticalAlignment.top);
					break;
				case "textRotation":
					textRotationValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "wrapText":
					wrapTextValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "indent":
					indentValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "relativeIndent":
					relativeIndentValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "justifyLastLine":
					justifyLastLineValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "shrinkToFit":
					shrinkToFitValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "readingOrder":
					readingOrderValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteAlignmentElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_HorizontalAlignment? horizontalValue = null, ST_VerticalAlignment? verticalValue = null, uint? textRotationValue = null, bool wrapTextValue = false, uint? indentValue = null, int? relativeIndentValue = null, bool justifyLastLineValue = false, bool shrinkToFitValue = false, uint? readingOrderValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/alignment", null);
			if (horizontalValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(horizontalValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("horizontal", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (verticalValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(verticalValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("vertical", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (textRotationValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = textRotationValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("textRotation", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (wrapTextValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(wrapTextValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("wrapText", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (indentValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = indentValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("indent", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (relativeIndentValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = relativeIndentValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("relativeIndent", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (justifyLastLineValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(justifyLastLineValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("justifyLastLine", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (shrinkToFitValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(shrinkToFitValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("shrinkToFit", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (readingOrderValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = readingOrderValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("readingOrder", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadAnchorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool moveWithCellsValue, out bool sizeWithCellsValue)
		{
			moveWithCellsValue = false;
			sizeWithCellsValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "moveWithCells"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "sizeWithCells")
					{
						sizeWithCellsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					moveWithCellsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteAnchorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool moveWithCellsValue = false, bool sizeWithCellsValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/anchor", null);
			if (moveWithCellsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(moveWithCellsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("moveWithCells", value);
			}
			if (sizeWithCellsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(sizeWithCellsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sizeWithCells", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadBrkElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint idValue, out uint? minValue, out uint? maxValue, out bool manValue, out bool ptValue)

					break;

		public static void ReadCalcPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint? calcIdValue, out ST_CalcMode calcModeValue, out bool fullCalcOnLoadValue, out ST_RefMode refModeValue, out bool iterateValue, out uint iterateCountValue, out double iterateDeltaValue, out bool fullPrecisionValue, out bool calcCompletedValue, out bool calcOnSaveValue, out bool concurrentCalcValue, out uint? concurrentManualCountValue, out bool? forceFullCalcValue)
		{
			calcIdValue = null;
			calcModeValue = ST_CalcMode.auto;
			fullCalcOnLoadValue = false;
			refModeValue = ST_RefMode.A1;
			iterateValue = false;
			iterateCountValue = 100u;
			iterateDeltaValue = 0.001;
			fullPrecisionValue = true;
			calcCompletedValue = true;
			calcOnSaveValue = true;
			concurrentCalcValue = true;
			concurrentManualCountValue = null;
			forceFullCalcValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "calcId":
					calcIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "calcMode":
					calcModeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, calcModeValue);
					break;
				case "fullCalcOnLoad":
					fullCalcOnLoadValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "refMode":
					refModeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, refModeValue);
					break;
				case "iterate":
					iterateValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "iterateCount":
					iterateCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "iterateDelta":
					iterateDeltaValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "fullPrecision":
					fullPrecisionValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "calcCompleted":
					calcCompletedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "calcOnSave":
					calcOnSaveValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "concurrentCalc":
					concurrentCalcValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "concurrentManualCount":
					concurrentManualCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "forceFullCalc":
					forceFullCalcValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCalcPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint? calcIdValue = null, ST_CalcMode calcModeValue = ST_CalcMode.auto, bool fullCalcOnLoadValue = false, ST_RefMode refModeValue = ST_RefMode.A1, bool iterateValue = false, uint iterateCountValue = 100u, double iterateDeltaValue = 0.001, bool fullPrecisionValue = true, bool calcCompletedValue = true, bool calcOnSaveValue = true, bool concurrentCalcValue = true, uint? concurrentManualCountValue = null, bool? forceFullCalcValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/calcPr", null);
			if (calcIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = calcIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("calcId", value);
			}
			if (calcModeValue != ST_CalcMode.auto)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(calcModeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("calcMode", value);
			}
			if (fullCalcOnLoadValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fullCalcOnLoadValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fullCalcOnLoad", value);
			}
			if (refModeValue != ST_RefMode.A1)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(refModeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("refMode", value);
			}
			if (iterateValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(iterateValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iterate", value);
			}
			if (iterateCountValue != 100)
			{
				string value = iterateCountValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iterateCount", value);
			}
			if (iterateDeltaValue != 0.001)
			{
				string value = iterateDeltaValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iterateDelta", value);
			}
			if (!fullPrecisionValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fullPrecisionValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fullPrecision", value);
			}
			if (!calcCompletedValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(calcCompletedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("calcCompleted", value);
			}
			if (!calcOnSaveValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(calcOnSaveValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("calcOnSave", value);
			}
			if (!concurrentCalcValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(concurrentCalcValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("concurrentCalc", value);
			}
			if (concurrentManualCountValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = concurrentManualCountValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("concurrentManualCount", value);
			}
			if (forceFullCalcValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(forceFullCalcValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("forceFullCalc", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string rValue, out uint sValue, out ST_CellType tValue, out uint cmValue, out uint vmValue, out bool phValue)
		{
			rValue = null;
			sValue = 0u;
			tValue = ST_CellType.n;
			cmValue = 0u;
			vmValue = 0u;
			phValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "r":
					rValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "s":
					sValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "t":
					tValue = ParseST_CellTypeValue(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "cm":
					cmValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "vm":
					vmValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "ph":
					phValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static ST_CellType ParseST_CellTypeValue(string value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				"b" => ST_CellType.b, 
				"d" => ST_CellType.d, 
				"e" => ST_CellType.e, 
				"n" => ST_CellType.n, 
				"s" => ST_CellType.s, 
				"str" => ST_CellType.str, 
				"inlineStr" => ST_CellType.inlineStr, 
				_ => ST_CellType.n, 
			};
		}

		public static void WriteCElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string rValue, uint sValue = 0u, ST_CellType tValue = ST_CellType.n, uint cmValue = 0u, uint vmValue = 0u, bool phValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElementLocal("c");
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttributeLocal("r", rValue);
			if (sValue != 0)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttributeLocal("s", sValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
			if (tValue != ST_CellType.n)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttributeLocal("t", tValue.ToStringFast());
			}
			if (cmValue != 0)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttributeLocal("cm", cmValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
			if (vmValue != 0)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttributeLocal("vm", vmValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
			if (phValue)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttributeLocal("ph", ST_OnOff.ToString(phValue));
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCellStyleXfsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint? countValue)
		{

		public static void ReadCfRuleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string strictElementName, out ST_CfType? typeValue, out uint? dxfIdValue, out int? priorityValue, out bool? stopIfTrueValue, out bool aboveAverageValue, out bool percentValue, out bool bottomValue, out ST_ConditionalFormattingOperator? operatorValue, out string textValue, out ST_TimePeriod? timePeriodValue, out uint? rankValue, out int? stdDevValue, out bool equalAverageValue, out string idValue, out bool? activePresentValue)
		{
			typeValue = null;
			dxfIdValue = null;
			priorityValue = null;
			stopIfTrueValue = null;
			aboveAverageValue = true;
			percentValue = false;
			bottomValue = false;
			operatorValue = null;
			textValue = null;
			timePeriodValue = null;
			rankValue = null;
			stdDevValue = null;
			equalAverageValue = false;
			idValue = null;
			activePresentValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_CfType.expression);
					break;
				case "dxfId":
					dxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "priority":
					priorityValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "stopIfTrue":
					stopIfTrueValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "aboveAverage":
					aboveAverageValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "activePresent":
					if (!(strictElementName != "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/cfRule"))
					{
						activePresentValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
					break;
				case "percent":
					percentValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "bottom":
					bottomValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "operator":
					operatorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_ConditionalFormattingOperator.lessThan);
					break;
				case "text":
					textValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "timePeriod":
					timePeriodValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TimePeriod.today);
					break;
				case "rank":
					rankValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "stdDev":
					stdDevValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "equalAverage":
					equalAverageValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "id":
					if (!(strictElementName != "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/cfRule"))
					{
						idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCfRuleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string strictElementName, ST_CfType? typeValue = null, uint? dxfIdValue = null, int priorityValue = 0, bool stopIfTrueValue = false, bool? aboveAverageValue = null, bool? percentValue = null, bool? bottomValue = null, ST_ConditionalFormattingOperator? operatorValue = null, string textValue = null, ST_TimePeriod? timePeriodValue = null, uint? rankValue = null, int? stdDevValue = null, bool? equalAverageValue = null, string id = null, bool? activePresent = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(strictElementName, null);
			string enumAttributeString;
			if (typeValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("type", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (dxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = dxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dxfId", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (priorityValue != 0)
			{
				enumAttributeString = priorityValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("priority", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (stopIfTrueValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(stopIfTrueValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("stopIfTrue", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (aboveAverageValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(aboveAverageValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("aboveAverage", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (percentValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(percentValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("percent", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (bottomValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(bottomValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("bottom", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (operatorValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(operatorValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("operator", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = textValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("text", enumAttributeString);
			if (timePeriodValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(timePeriodValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("timePeriod", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (rankValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = rankValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rank", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (stdDevValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = stdDevValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("stdDev", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (equalAverageValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(equalAverageValue.HasValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("equalAverage", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				enumAttributeString = id;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("id", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (activePresent.HasValue && activePresent.Value)
			{
				_ = strictElementName != "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/cfRule";
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(activePresent.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("activePresent", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCfvoElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_CfvoType typeValue, out string valValue, out bool gteValue)
		{
			ReadCfvoElementHelper(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/cfvo", out typeValue, out valValue, out gteValue);
		}

		internal static void ReadCfvoElementHelper(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string strictElementName, out ST_CfvoType typeValue, out string valValue, out bool gteValue)
		{
			typeValue = ST_CfvoType.num;
			valValue = null;
			gteValue = true;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
					break;
				case "val":
					valValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "gte":
					gteValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCfvoElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_CfvoType typeValue, string valValue = null, bool gteValue = true)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/cfvo", null);
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("type", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = valValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("val", enumAttributeString);
			if (!gteValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(gteValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("gte", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadConditionalFormattingElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out List<string> sqrefValue, out bool pivotValue)
		{
			sqrefValue = null;
			pivotValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "sqref"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "pivot")
					{
						pivotValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					sqrefValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseList(currentElementAttribute.Value, (string a) => a);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteConditionalFormattingElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, List<string> sqrefValue, bool pivotValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/conditionalFormatting", null);
			if (sqrefValue != null)
			{
				string value = string.Join(" ", sqrefValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sqref", value);
			}
			if (pivotValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(pivotValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("pivot", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadControlElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint shapeIdValue, out string idValue, out string nameValue)
		{
			shapeIdValue = 0u;
			idValue = null;
			nameValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "shapeId":
					shapeIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadControlPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool lockedValue, out bool defaultSizeValue, out bool printValue, out bool disabledValue, out bool recalcAlwaysValue, out bool uiObjectValue, out bool autoFillValue, out bool autoLineValue, out bool autoPictValue, out string macroValue, out string altTextValue, out string linkedCellValue, out string listFillRangeValue, out string cfValue, out string idValue)
		{
			lockedValue = true;
			defaultSizeValue = true;
			printValue = true;
			disabledValue = false;
			recalcAlwaysValue = false;
			uiObjectValue = false;
			autoFillValue = true;
			autoLineValue = true;
			autoPictValue = true;
			macroValue = null;
			altTextValue = null;
			linkedCellValue = null;
			listFillRangeValue = null;
			cfValue = "pict";
			idValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "locked":
					lockedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "defaultSize":
					defaultSizeValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "print":
					printValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "disabled":
					disabledValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "recalcAlways":
					recalcAlwaysValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "uiObject":
					uiObjectValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "autoFill":
					autoFillValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "autoLine":
					autoLineValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "autoPict":
					autoPictValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "macro":
					macroValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "altText":
					altTextValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "linkedCell":
					linkedCellValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "listFillRange":
					listFillRangeValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "cf":
					cfValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteControlPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool lockedValue = true, bool defaultSizeValue = true, bool printValue = true, bool disabledValue = false, bool recalcAlwaysValue = false, bool uiObjectValue = false, bool autoFillValue = true, bool autoLineValue = true, bool autoPictValue = true, string macroValue = null, string altTextValue = null, string linkedCellValue = null, string listFillRangeValue = null, string cfValue = "pict", string idValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/controlPr", null);
			string value;
			if (!lockedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(lockedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("locked", value);
			}
			if (!defaultSizeValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(defaultSizeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("defaultSize", value);
			}
			if (!printValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(printValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("print", value);
			}
			if (disabledValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(disabledValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("disabled", value);
			}
			if (recalcAlwaysValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(recalcAlwaysValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("recalcAlways", value);
			}
			if (uiObjectValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(uiObjectValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("uiObject", value);
			}
			if (!autoFillValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(autoFillValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("autoFill", value);
			}
			if (!autoLineValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(autoLineValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("autoLine", value);
			}
			if (!autoPictValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(autoPictValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("autoPict", value);
			}
			value = macroValue;
			DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase.WriteMacroAttribute(partManager, value);
			value = altTextValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("altText", value);
			value = linkedCellValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("linkedCell", value);
			value = listFillRangeValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("listFillRange", value);
			value = cfValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cf", value);
			value = idValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id", value);
		}

		public static void ReadCustomFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string valValue, out ST_FilterOperator operatorValue)
		{
			operatorValue = ST_FilterOperator.equal;
			valValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "operator"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "val")
					{
						valValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					operatorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, operatorValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCustomFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string valValue, ST_FilterOperator operatorValue = ST_FilterOperator.equal)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/customFilter", null);
			string enumAttributeString;
			if (operatorValue != ST_FilterOperator.equal)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(operatorValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("operator", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = valValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("val", enumAttributeString);
		}

		public static void WriteCustomWorkbookViewElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string nameValue, ST_Guid guidValue, uint activeSheetIdValue, uint windowWidthValue, uint windowHeightValue, bool autoUpdateValue = false, uint? mergeIntervalValue = null, bool changesSavedWinValue = false, bool onlySyncValue = false, bool personalViewValue = false, bool includePrintSettingsValue = true, bool includeHiddenRowColValue = true, bool maximizedValue = false, bool minimizedValue = false, bool showHorizontalScrollValue = true, bool showVerticalScrollValue = true, bool showSheetTabsValue = true, int xWindowValue = 0, int yWindowValue = 0, uint tabRatioValue = 600u, bool showFormulaBarValue = true, bool showStatusbarValue = true, ST_Comments showCommentsValue = ST_Comments.commIndicator, ST_Objects showObjectsValue = ST_Objects.all)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/customWorkbookView", null);
			string value = nameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("name", value);
			value = guidValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("guid", value);
			if (autoUpdateValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(autoUpdateValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("autoUpdate", value);
			}
			if (mergeIntervalValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = mergeIntervalValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("mergeInterval", value);
			}
			if (changesSavedWinValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(changesSavedWinValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("changesSavedWin", value);
			}
			if (onlySyncValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(onlySyncValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("onlySync", value);
			}
			if (personalViewValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(personalViewValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("personalView", value);
			}
			if (!includePrintSettingsValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(includePrintSettingsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("includePrintSettings", value);
			}
			if (!includeHiddenRowColValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(includeHiddenRowColValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("includeHiddenRowCol", value);
			}
			if (maximizedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(maximizedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("maximized", value);
			}
			if (minimizedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(minimizedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("minimized", value);
			}
			if (!showHorizontalScrollValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showHorizontalScrollValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showHorizontalScroll", value);
			}
			if (!showVerticalScrollValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showVerticalScrollValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showVerticalScroll", value);
			}
			if (!showSheetTabsValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showSheetTabsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showSheetTabs", value);
			}
			if (xWindowValue != 0)
			{
				value = xWindowValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("xWindow", value);
			}
			if (yWindowValue != 0)
			{
				value = yWindowValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("yWindow", value);
			}
			value = windowWidthValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("windowWidth", value);
			value = windowHeightValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("windowHeight", value);
			if (tabRatioValue != 600)
			{
				value = tabRatioValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tabRatio", value);
			}
			value = activeSheetIdValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("activeSheetId", value);
			if (!showFormulaBarValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showFormulaBarValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showFormulaBar", value);
			}
			if (!showStatusbarValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showStatusbarValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showStatusbar", value);
			}
			if (showCommentsValue != ST_Comments.commIndicator)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(showCommentsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showComments", value);
			}
			if (showObjectsValue != ST_Objects.all)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(showObjectsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showObjects", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadDdeLinkElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string service, out string topic)
		{
			service = null;
			topic = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "ddeService"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "ddeTopic")

				else

				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadDefinedNameElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string value, out string nameValue, out string commentValue, out string customMenuValue, out string descriptionValue, out string helpValue, out string statusBarValue, out uint? localSheetIdValue, out bool hiddenValue, out bool functionValue, out bool vbProcedureValue, out bool xlmValue, out uint? functionGroupIdValue, out string shortcutKeyValue, out bool publishToServerValue, out bool workbookParameterValue)
		{
			nameValue = null;
			commentValue = null;
			customMenuValue = null;
			descriptionValue = null;
			helpValue = null;
			statusBarValue = null;
			localSheetIdValue = null;
			hiddenValue = false;
			functionValue = false;
			vbProcedureValue = false;
			xlmValue = false;
			functionGroupIdValue = null;
			shortcutKeyValue = null;
			publishToServerValue = false;
			workbookParameterValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "comment":
					commentValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "customMenu":
					customMenuValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "description":
					descriptionValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "help":
					helpValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "statusBar":
					statusBarValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "localSheetId":
					localSheetIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "hidden":
					hiddenValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "function":
					functionValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "vbProcedure":
					vbProcedureValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "xlm":
					xlmValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "functionGroupId":
					functionGroupIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "shortcutKey":
					shortcutKeyValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "publishToServer":
					publishToServerValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "workbookParameter":
					workbookParameterValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
			value = UnescapeVString(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, removeNewLines: true);
		}

		public static void WriteDefinedNameElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string value, string nameValue, string commentValue = null, string customMenuValue = null, string descriptionValue = null, string helpValue = null, string statusBarValue = null, uint? localSheetIdValue = null, bool hiddenValue = false, bool functionValue = false, bool vbProcedureValue = false, bool xlmValue = false, uint? functionGroupIdValue = null, string shortcutKeyValue = null, bool publishToServerValue = false, bool workbookParameterValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/definedName", null);
			string value2 = nameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("name", value2);
			if (commentValue != null)
			{
				value2 = commentValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("comment", value2);
			}
			if (customMenuValue != null)
			{
				value2 = customMenuValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("customMenu", value2);
			}
			if (descriptionValue != null)
			{
				value2 = descriptionValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("description", value2);
			}
			if (helpValue != null)
			{
				value2 = helpValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("help", value2);
			}
			if (statusBarValue != null)
			{
				value2 = statusBarValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("statusBar", value2);
			}
			if (localSheetIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value2 = localSheetIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("localSheetId", value2);
			}
			if (hiddenValue)
			{
				value2 = ST_OnOff.ToString(hiddenValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("hidden", value2);
			}
			if (functionValue)
			{
				value2 = ST_OnOff.ToString(functionValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("function", value2);
			}
			if (vbProcedureValue)
			{
				value2 = ST_OnOff.ToString(vbProcedureValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("vbProcedure", value2);
			}
			if (xlmValue)
			{
				value2 = ST_OnOff.ToString(xlmValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("xlm", value2);
			}
			if (functionGroupIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value2 = functionGroupIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("functionGroupId", value2);
			}
			if (shortcutKeyValue != null)
			{
				value2 = shortcutKeyValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("shortcutKey", value2);
			}
			if (publishToServerValue)
			{
				value2 = ST_OnOff.ToString(publishToServerValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("publishToServer", value2);
			}
			if (workbookParameterValue)
			{
				value2 = ST_OnOff.ToString(workbookParameterValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("workbookParameter", value2);
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(EscapeVString(value));
			}
		}

		public static void ReadDynamicFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_DynamicFilterType typeValue, out double? valValue, out double? maxValValue)
		{
			typeValue = ST_DynamicFilterType._null;
			valValue = null;
			maxValValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
					break;
				case "val":
					valValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "maxVal":
					maxValValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteDynamicFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_DynamicFilterType typeValue, double? valValue = null, double? maxValValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/dynamicFilter", null);
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("type", enumAttributeString);
			if (valValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = valValue.Value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("val", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (maxValValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = maxValValue.Value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("maxVal", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadFElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_CellFormulaType tValue, out bool acaValue, out string refValue, out bool dt2DValue, out bool dtrValue, out bool del1Value, out bool del2Value, out string r1Value, out string r2Value, out bool caValue, out uint? siValue, out bool bxValue, out string value)
		{
			tValue = ST_CellFormulaType.normal;
			acaValue = false;
			refValue = null;
			dt2DValue = false;
			dtrValue = false;
			del1Value = false;
			del2Value = false;
			r1Value = null;
			r2Value = null;
			caValue = false;
			siValue = null;
			bxValue = false;
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "t":
					tValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, tValue);
					break;
				case "aca":
					acaValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "ref":
					refValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "dt2D":
					dt2DValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "dtr":
					dtrValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "del1":
					del1Value = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "del2":
					del2Value = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "r1":
					r1Value = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "r2":
					r2Value = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "ca":
					caValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "si":
					siValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "bx":
					bxValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace/space":
					flag = currentElementAttribute.Value == "preserve";
					break;
				}
			}
			value = partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue;
			if (value != null && !flag)
			{
				value = value.Trim();
			}
		}

		public static void WriteFElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string value, ST_CellFormulaType tValue = ST_CellFormulaType.normal, bool acaValue = false, string refValue = null, bool dt2DValue = false, bool dtrValue = false, bool del1Value = false, bool del2Value = false, string r1Value = null, string r2Value = null, bool caValue = false, uint? siValue = null, bool bxValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/f", null);
			string enumAttributeString;
			if (tValue != ST_CellFormulaType.normal)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(tValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("t", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (acaValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(acaValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("aca", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = refValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("ref", enumAttributeString);
			if (dt2DValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(dt2DValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dt2D", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (dtrValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(dtrValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dtr", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (del1Value)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(del1Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("del1", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (del2Value)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(del2Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("del2", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = r1Value;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("r1", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = r2Value;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("r2", enumAttributeString);
			if (caValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(caValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("ca", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (siValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = siValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("si", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (bxValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(bxValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("bx", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && (char.IsWhiteSpace(value[0]) || char.IsWhiteSpace(value[value.Length - 1])))
				{
					XmlNamespace.WriteSpacePreserveAttribute(partManager.XmlWriteManager);
				}
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadFileSharingElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string userNameValue, out bool readOnlyRecommendedValue, out ushort reservationPasswordValue)
		{
			readOnlyRecommendedValue = false;
			userNameValue = null;
			reservationPasswordValue = 0;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "readOnlyRecommended":
					readOnlyRecommendedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "userName":
					userNameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "reservationPassword":
					reservationPasswordValue = ST_UnsignedShortHex.ParseUShort(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(readOnlyRecommendedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("readOnlyRecommended", value);
			}
			value = userNameValue;

			value = new ST_UnsignedShortHex(reservationPasswordValue).ToString();

		}

		{
			readOnlyRecommendedValue = false;

			saltValueValue = null;

			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))

					userNameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "algorithmName":
					algorithmNameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "hashValue":
					hashValueValue = Convert.FromBase64String(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "saltValue":
					saltValueValue = Convert.FromBase64String(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "spinCount":
					spinCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadFiltersElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool blankValue, out ST_CalendarType calendarTypeValue)
		{
			blankValue = false;
			calendarTypeValue = ST_CalendarType.none;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "blank"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "calendarType")
					{
						calendarTypeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, calendarTypeValue);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					blankValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteFiltersElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool blankValue = false, ST_CalendarType calendarTypeValue = ST_CalendarType.none)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/filters", null);
			if (blankValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(blankValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("blank", value);
			}
			if (calendarTypeValue != ST_CalendarType.none)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(calendarTypeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("calendarType", value);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadFontElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadGradientFillElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_GradientType typeValue, out double degreeValue, out double leftValue, out double rightValue, out double topValue, out double bottomValue)
		{
			typeValue = ST_GradientType.linear;
			degreeValue = 0.0;
			leftValue = 0.0;
			rightValue = 0.0;
			topValue = 0.0;
			bottomValue = 0.0;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, typeValue);
					break;
				case "degree":
					degreeValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "left":
					leftValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "right":
					rightValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "top":
					topValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "bottom":
					bottomValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteGradientFillElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_GradientType typeValue = ST_GradientType.linear, double degreeValue = 0.0, double leftValue = 0.0, double rightValue = 0.0, double topValue = 0.0, double bottomValue = 0.0)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/gradientFill", null);
			if (typeValue != ST_GradientType.linear)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("type", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (degreeValue != 0.0)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = degreeValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("degree", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (leftValue != 0.0)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = leftValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("left", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (rightValue != 0.0)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = rightValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("right", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (topValue != 0.0)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = topValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("top", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (bottomValue != 0.0)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = bottomValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("bottom", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadHeaderFooterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool differentOddEvenValue, out bool differentFirstValue, out bool scaleWithDocValue, out bool alignWithMarginsValue)
		{
			differentOddEvenValue = false;
			differentFirstValue = false;
			scaleWithDocValue = true;
			alignWithMarginsValue = true;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "differentOddEven":
					differentOddEvenValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "differentFirst":
					differentFirstValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "scaleWithDoc":
					scaleWithDocValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "alignWithMargins":
					alignWithMarginsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteHeaderFooterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool differentOddEvenValue = false, bool differentFirstValue = false, bool scaleWithDocValue = true, bool alignWithMarginsValue = true)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/headerFooter", null);
			if (differentOddEvenValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(differentOddEvenValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("differentOddEven", value);
			}
			if (differentFirstValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(differentFirstValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("differentFirst", value);
			}
			if (!scaleWithDocValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(scaleWithDocValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("scaleWithDoc", value);
			}
			if (!alignWithMarginsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(alignWithMarginsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("alignWithMargins", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadHyperlinkElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string refValue, out string idValue, out string locationValue, out string tooltipValue, out string displayValue)

			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)

				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "ref":
					refValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;

				case "location":
					locationValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "tooltip":
					tooltipValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;

		}

		public static void ReadIconFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_IconSetType iconSetValue, out uint? iconIdValue)
		{
			iconSetValue = ST_IconSetType._3Arrows;
			iconIdValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "iconSet"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "iconId")
					{
						iconIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					iconSetValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, iconSetValue);
				}
			}
			_ = iconSetValue;
			_ = 16;
		}

		public static void WriteIconFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_IconSetType iconSetValue, uint? iconIdValue = null)
		{
			if ((int)iconSetValue <= 16)
			{
				WriteIconFilterElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/iconFilter", null, iconSetValue, iconIdValue);
				return;
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAlternateContentElement(new AlternateContentChoice[1]
			{
				new AlternateContentChoice(SpreadsheetML2009Main.Instance, delegate
				{
					WriteIconFilterElement(partManager, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/iconFilter", null, iconSetValue, iconIdValue);
				})
			}, delegate
			{
				WriteCustomFiltersElement(partManager);
				WriteCustomFilterElement(partManager, "");
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				WriteCustomFilterElement(partManager, " ", ST_FilterOperator.notEqual);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			});
		}

		private static void WriteIconFilterElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string strictElementName, string defaultPrefix, ST_IconSetType iconSetValue, uint? iconIdValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(strictElementName, defaultPrefix);
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(iconSetValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconSet", enumAttributeString);
			if (iconIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = iconIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconId", enumAttributeString);
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void ReadIconSetElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_IconSetType iconSetValue, out bool percent, out bool reverse, out bool? showValue, out bool custom)
		{
			iconSetValue = ST_IconSetType._3TrafficLights1;
			percent = true;
			reverse = false;
			showValue = null;
			custom = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "iconSet":
					iconSetValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, iconSetValue);
					break;
				case "percent":
					percent = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "reverse":
					reverse = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showValue":
					showValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "custom":
					custom = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteIconSetElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string strictElementName, ST_IconSetType? iconSetValue, bool? percent, bool? reverse, bool? showValue, bool? custom)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(strictElementName, null);
			if (iconSetValue.HasValue && iconSetValue.Value != ST_IconSetType._3TrafficLights1)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(iconSetValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconSet", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (percent.HasValue && !percent.Value)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(percent.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("percent", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (reverse.HasValue && reverse.Value)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(reverse.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("reverse", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (showValue.HasValue && !showValue.Value)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(showValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showValue", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (custom.HasValue && custom.Value)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = ST_OnOff.ToString(custom.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("custom", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}
