		public static void ReadOleItemElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string nameValue, out bool iconValue, out bool adviseValue, out bool preferPicValue)
		{
			nameValue = null;
			iconValue = false;
			adviseValue = false;
			preferPicValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "icon":
					iconValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "advise":
					adviseValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;

		public static void ReadPageSetupElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint paperSizeValue, out string paperHeightValue, out string paperWidthValue, out uint scaleValue, out uint firstPageNumberValue, out uint fitToWidthValue, out uint fitToHeightValue, out ST_PageOrder pageOrderValue, out ST_Orientation orientationValue, out bool usePrinterDefaultsValue, out bool blackAndWhiteValue, out bool draftValue, out ST_CellComments cellCommentsValue, out bool useFirstPageNumberValue, out ST_PrintError errorsValue, out uint horizontalDpiValue, out uint verticalDpiValue, out uint copiesValue, out string idValue)
		{
			paperSizeValue = 1u;
			paperHeightValue = null;
			paperWidthValue = null;
			scaleValue = 100u;
			firstPageNumberValue = 1u;
			fitToWidthValue = 1u;
			fitToHeightValue = 1u;
			pageOrderValue = ST_PageOrder.downThenOver;
			orientationValue = ST_Orientation._default;
			usePrinterDefaultsValue = true;
			blackAndWhiteValue = false;
			draftValue = false;
			cellCommentsValue = ST_CellComments.none;
			useFirstPageNumberValue = false;
			errorsValue = ST_PrintError.displayed;
			horizontalDpiValue = 600u;
			verticalDpiValue = 600u;
			copiesValue = 1u;
			idValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "paperSize":
					paperSizeValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "paperHeight":
					paperHeightValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "paperWidth":
					paperWidthValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "scale":
					scaleValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "firstPageNumber":
					firstPageNumberValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "fitToWidth":
					fitToWidthValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "fitToHeight":
					fitToHeightValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "pageOrder":
					pageOrderValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, pageOrderValue);
					break;
				case "orientation":
					orientationValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, orientationValue);
					break;
				case "usePrinterDefaults":
					usePrinterDefaultsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "blackAndWhite":
					blackAndWhiteValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "draft":
					draftValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "cellComments":
					cellCommentsValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, cellCommentsValue);
					break;
				case "useFirstPageNumber":
					useFirstPageNumberValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "errors":
					errorsValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, errorsValue);
					break;
				case "horizontalDpi":
					horizontalDpiValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "verticalDpi":
					verticalDpiValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "copies":
					copiesValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WritePageSetupElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint paperSizeValue = 1u, string paperHeightValue = null, string paperWidthValue = null, uint scaleValue = 100u, uint firstPageNumberValue = 1u, uint fitToWidthValue = 1u, uint fitToHeightValue = 1u, ST_PageOrder pageOrderValue = ST_PageOrder.downThenOver, ST_Orientation orientationValue = ST_Orientation._default, bool usePrinterDefaultsValue = true, bool blackAndWhiteValue = false, bool draftValue = false, ST_CellComments cellCommentsValue = ST_CellComments.none, bool useFirstPageNumberValue = false, ST_PrintError errorsValue = ST_PrintError.displayed, uint horizontalDpiValue = 600u, uint verticalDpiValue = 600u, uint copiesValue = 1u, string idValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/pageSetup", null);
			if (paperSizeValue != 1)
			{
				string value = paperSizeValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("paperSize", value);
			}
			if (paperHeightValue != null)
			{
				string value = paperHeightValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("paperHeight", value);
			}
			if (paperWidthValue != null)
			{
				string value = paperWidthValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("paperWidth", value);
			}
			if (scaleValue != 100)
			{
				string value = scaleValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("scale", value);
			}
			if (firstPageNumberValue != 1)
			{
				string value = firstPageNumberValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("firstPageNumber", value);
			}
			if (fitToWidthValue != 1)
			{
				string value = fitToWidthValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fitToWidth", value);
			}
			if (fitToHeightValue != 1)
			{
				string value = fitToHeightValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fitToHeight", value);
			}
			if (pageOrderValue != ST_PageOrder.downThenOver)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(pageOrderValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("pageOrder", value);
			}
			if (orientationValue != ST_Orientation._default)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(orientationValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("orientation", value);
			}
			if (!usePrinterDefaultsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(usePrinterDefaultsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("usePrinterDefaults", value);
			}
			if (blackAndWhiteValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(blackAndWhiteValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("blackAndWhite", value);
			}
			if (draftValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(draftValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("draft", value);
			}
			if (cellCommentsValue != ST_CellComments.none)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(cellCommentsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cellComments", value);
			}
			if (useFirstPageNumberValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(useFirstPageNumberValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("useFirstPageNumber", value);
			}
			if (errorsValue != ST_PrintError.displayed)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(errorsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("errors", value);
			}
			if (horizontalDpiValue != 600)
			{
				string value = horizontalDpiValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("horizontalDpi", value);
			}
			if (verticalDpiValue != 600)
			{
				string value = verticalDpiValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("verticalDpi", value);
			}
			if (copiesValue != 1)
			{
				string value = copiesValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("copies", value);
			}
			if (idValue != null)
			{
				string value = idValue;
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadPageSetUpPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool autoPageBreaksValue, out bool fitToPageValue)
		{
			autoPageBreaksValue = true;
			fitToPageValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "autoPageBreaks"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "fitToPage")
					{
						fitToPageValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					autoPageBreaksValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

			if (headingsValue)

				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(headingsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("headings", value);
			}
			if (gridLinesValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(gridLinesValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("gridLines", value);
			}
			if (!gridLinesSetValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(gridLinesSetValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("gridLinesSet", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadProtectedRangeElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string securityDescriptor, out string sqref, out string name, out ST_UnsignedShortHex? passwordValue)

					break;

					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadProtectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool? lockedValue, out bool? hiddenValue)
		{
			lockedValue = null;
			hiddenValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "locked"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "hidden")
					{
						hiddenValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					lockedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteProtectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool? lockedValue = null, bool? hiddenValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/protection", null);
			if (lockedValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(lockedValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("locked", value);
			}
			if (hiddenValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(hiddenValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("hidden", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadRowElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint? rValue, out List<string> spansValue, out uint sValue, out bool customFormatValue, out double? htValue, out bool hiddenValue, out bool customHeightValue, out byte outlineLevelValue, out bool collapsedValue, out bool thickTopValue, out bool thickBotValue, out bool phValue, bool ignoreSpansValue = false)
		{
			rValue = null;
			spansValue = null;
			sValue = 0u;
			customFormatValue = false;
			htValue = null;
			hiddenValue = false;
			customHeightValue = false;
			outlineLevelValue = 0;
			collapsedValue = false;
			thickTopValue = false;
			thickBotValue = false;
			phValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "r":
					rValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "spans":
					if (!ignoreSpansValue)
					{
						spansValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseList(currentElementAttribute.Value, (string s) => s);
					}
					break;
				case "s":
					sValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "customFormat":
					customFormatValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "ht":
					htValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "hidden":
					hiddenValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "customHeight":
					customHeightValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "outlineLevel":
					outlineLevelValue = byte.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "collapsed":
					collapsedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "thickTop":
					thickTopValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "thickBot":
					thickBotValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "ph":
					phValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteRowElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint? rValue = null, List<string> spansValue = null, uint sValue = 0u, bool customFormatValue = false, double? htValue = null, bool hiddenValue = false, bool customHeightValue = false, byte outlineLevelValue = 0, bool collapsedValue = false, bool thickTopValue = false, bool thickBotValue = false, bool phValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/row", null);
			if (rValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("r", value);
			}
			if (spansValue != null)
			{
				string value = string.Join(" ", spansValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("spans", value);
			}
			if (sValue != 0)
			{
				string value = sValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("s", value);
			}
			if (customFormatValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(customFormatValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("customFormat", value);
			}
			if (htValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = htValue.Value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("ht", value);
			}
			if (hiddenValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(hiddenValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("hidden", value);
			}
			if (customHeightValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(customHeightValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("customHeight", value);
			}
			if (outlineLevelValue != 0)
			{
				string value = outlineLevelValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("outlineLevel", value);
			}
			if (collapsedValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(collapsedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("collapsed", value);
			}
			if (thickTopValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(thickTopValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("thickTop", value);
			}
			if (thickBotValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(thickBotValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("thickBot", value);
			}
			if (phValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(phValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("ph", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadSelectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Pane paneValue, out string activeCellValue, out uint activeCellIdValue, out List<string> sqrefValue)
		{
			paneValue = ST_Pane.topLeft;
			activeCellValue = null;
			activeCellIdValue = 0u;
			sqrefValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "pane":
					paneValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, paneValue);
					break;
				case "activeCell":
					activeCellValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "activeCellId":
					activeCellIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "sqref":
					sqrefValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseList(currentElementAttribute.Value, (string r) => r);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteSelectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Pane paneValue = ST_Pane.topLeft, string activeCellValue = null, uint activeCellIdValue = 0u, List<string> sqrefValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/selection", null);
			string enumAttributeString;
			if (paneValue != ST_Pane.topLeft)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(paneValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("pane", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = activeCellValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("activeCell", enumAttributeString);
			if (activeCellIdValue != 0)
			{
				enumAttributeString = activeCellIdValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("activeCellId", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (sqrefValue != null)
			{
				enumAttributeString = string.Join(" ", sqrefValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sqref", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadSheetElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string nameValue, out uint sheetIdValue, out ST_SheetState stateValue, out string idValue)
		{
			nameValue = null;
			sheetIdValue = 0u;
			stateValue = ST_SheetState.visible;
			idValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "sheetId":
					sheetIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "state":
					stateValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, stateValue);
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteSheetElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string nameValue, uint sheetIdValue, ST_SheetState stateValue, string idValue)

			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("name", value);
			value = sheetIdValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sheetId", value);
			if (stateValue != ST_SheetState.visible)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(stateValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("state", value);
			}
			value = idValue;

		}

		public static void ReadSheetFormatPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out double defaultRowHeightValue, out uint baseColWidthValue, out double? defaultColWidthValue, out bool customHeightValue, out bool zeroHeightValue, out bool thickTopValue, out bool thickBottomValue, out byte outlineLevelRowValue, out byte outlineLevelColValue)
		{
			baseColWidthValue = 8u;
			defaultColWidthValue = null;
			defaultRowHeightValue = 0.0;
			customHeightValue = false;
			zeroHeightValue = false;
			thickTopValue = false;
			thickBottomValue = false;
			outlineLevelRowValue = 0;
			outlineLevelColValue = 0;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "baseColWidth":
					baseColWidthValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "defaultColWidth":
					defaultColWidthValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "defaultRowHeight":
					defaultRowHeightValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "customHeight":
					customHeightValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "zeroHeight":
					zeroHeightValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "thickTop":
					thickTopValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "thickBottom":
					thickBottomValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "outlineLevelRow":
					outlineLevelRowValue = byte.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "outlineLevelCol":
					outlineLevelColValue = byte.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteSheetFormatPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, double defaultRowHeightValue, uint baseColWidthValue = 8u, double? defaultColWidthValue = null, bool customHeightValue = false, bool zeroHeightValue = false, bool thickTopValue = false, bool thickBottomValue = false, byte outlineLevelRowValue = 0, byte outlineLevelColValue = 0)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/sheetFormatPr", null);
			string value;
			if (baseColWidthValue != 8)
			{
				value = baseColWidthValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("baseColWidth", value);
			}
			if (defaultColWidthValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = defaultColWidthValue.Value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("defaultColWidth", value);
			}
			value = defaultRowHeightValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("defaultRowHeight", value);
			if (customHeightValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(customHeightValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("customHeight", value);
			}
			if (zeroHeightValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(zeroHeightValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("zeroHeight", value);
			}
			if (thickTopValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(thickTopValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("thickTop", value);
			}
			if (thickBottomValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(thickBottomValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("thickBottom", value);
			}
			if (outlineLevelRowValue != 0)
			{
				value = outlineLevelRowValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("outlineLevelRow", value);
			}
			if (outlineLevelColValue != 0)
			{
				value = outlineLevelColValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("outlineLevelCol", value);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteSheetProtectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_UnsignedShortHex? passwordValue = null, bool sheetValue = false, bool objectsValue = false, bool scenariosValue = false, bool formatCellsValue = true, bool formatColumnsValue = true, bool formatRowsValue = true, bool insertColumnsValue = true, bool insertRowsValue = true, bool insertHyperlinksValue = true, bool deleteColumnsValue = true, bool deleteRowsValue = true, bool selectLockedCellsValue = false, bool sortValue = true, bool autoFilterValue = true, bool pivotTablesValue = true, bool selectUnlockedCellsValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/sheetProtection", null);
			if (passwordValue.HasValue)

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("password", value);
			}
			if (sheetValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(sheetValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sheet", value);
				if (objectsValue)
				{
					value = ST_OnOff.ToString(objectsValue);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("objects", value);
				}
				if (scenariosValue)
				{
					value = ST_OnOff.ToString(scenariosValue);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("scenarios", value);
				}
			}
			if (!formatCellsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(formatCellsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("formatCells", value);
			}
			if (!formatColumnsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(formatColumnsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("formatColumns", value);
			}
			if (!formatRowsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(formatRowsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("formatRows", value);
			}
			if (!insertColumnsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(insertColumnsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("insertColumns", value);
			}
			if (!insertRowsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(insertRowsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("insertRows", value);
			}
			if (!insertHyperlinksValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(insertHyperlinksValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("insertHyperlinks", value);
			}
			if (!deleteColumnsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(deleteColumnsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("deleteColumns", value);
			}
			if (!deleteRowsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(deleteRowsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("deleteRows", value);
			}
			if (selectLockedCellsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(selectLockedCellsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("selectLockedCells", value);
			}
			if (!sortValue)
			{

			{

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("selectUnlockedCells", value);
			}
		}

		public static bool ShouldReadStrictSheetProtectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			if (partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.strict)
			{
				return true;
			}
			using (List<AttributeValue>.Enumerator enumerator = partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes.GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					switch (enumerator.Current.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
					{
					case "algorithmName":
					case "hashValue":
					case "saltValue":
					case "spinCount":
						return true;
					case "password":
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

			colorIdValue = 64u;
			zoomScaleValue = 100u;

			zoomScalePageLayoutViewValue = 0u;
			workbookViewIdValue = 0u;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "windowProtection":

					break;
				case "showFormulas":
					showFormulasValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showGridLines":
					showGridLinesValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showRowColHeaders":
					showRowColHeadersValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showZeros":
					showZerosValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "rightToLeft":
					rightToLeftValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "tabSelected":
					tabSelectedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showRuler":
					showRulerValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showOutlineSymbols":
					showOutlineSymbolsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "defaultGridColor":
					defaultGridColorValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "showWhiteSpace":
					showWhiteSpaceValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "view":
					viewValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, viewValue);
					break;
				case "topLeftCell":
					topLeftCellValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "colorId":
					colorIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "zoomScale":
					zoomScaleValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "zoomScaleNormal":
					zoomScaleNormalValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "zoomScaleSheetLayoutView":
					zoomScaleSheetLayoutViewValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "zoomScalePageLayoutView":
					zoomScalePageLayoutViewValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "workbookViewId":
					workbookViewIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteSheetViewElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint workbookViewIdValue, bool windowProtectionValue = false, bool showFormulasValue = false, bool showGridLinesValue = true, bool showRowColHeadersValue = true, bool showZerosValue = true, bool rightToLeftValue = false, bool tabSelectedValue = false, bool showRulerValue = true, bool showOutlineSymbolsValue = true, bool defaultGridColorValue = true, bool showWhiteSpaceValue = true, ST_SheetViewType viewValue = ST_SheetViewType.normal, string topLeftCellValue = null, uint colorIdValue = 64u, uint zoomScaleValue = 100u, uint zoomScaleNormalValue = 0u, uint zoomScaleSheetLayoutViewValue = 0u, uint zoomScalePageLayoutViewValue = 0u)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/sheetView", null);
			string value;
			if (windowProtectionValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(windowProtectionValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("windowProtection", value);
			}
			if (showFormulasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showFormulasValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showFormulas", value);
			}
			if (!showGridLinesValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showGridLinesValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showGridLines", value);
			}
			if (!showRowColHeadersValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showRowColHeadersValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showRowColHeaders", value);
			}
			if (!showZerosValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showZerosValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showZeros", value);
			}
			if (rightToLeftValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(rightToLeftValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rightToLeft", value);
			}
			if (tabSelectedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(tabSelectedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tabSelected", value);
			}
			if (!showRulerValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showRulerValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showRuler", value);
			}
			if (!showOutlineSymbolsValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showOutlineSymbolsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showOutlineSymbols", value);
			}
			if (!defaultGridColorValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(defaultGridColorValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("defaultGridColor", value);
			}
			if (!showWhiteSpaceValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(showWhiteSpaceValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("showWhiteSpace", value);
			}
			if (viewValue != ST_SheetViewType.normal)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(viewValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("view", value);
			}
			value = topLeftCellValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("topLeftCell", value);
			if (colorIdValue != 64)
			{
				value = colorIdValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("colorId", value);
			}
			if (zoomScaleValue != 100)
			{
				value = zoomScaleValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("zoomScale", value);
			}
			if (zoomScaleNormalValue != 0)
			{
				value = zoomScaleNormalValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("zoomScaleNormal", value);
			}
			if (zoomScaleSheetLayoutViewValue != 0)
			{
				value = zoomScaleSheetLayoutViewValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("zoomScaleSheetLayoutView", value);
			}
			if (zoomScalePageLayoutViewValue != 0)
			{
				value = zoomScalePageLayoutViewValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("zoomScalePageLayoutView", value);
			}
			value = workbookViewIdValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("workbookViewId", value);
		}

		public static void ReadSortConditionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string refValue, out bool descendingValue, out ST_SortBy sortByValue, out string customListValue, out uint? dxfIdValue, out ST_IconSetType iconSetValue, out uint? iconIdValue)
		{
			descendingValue = false;
			sortByValue = ST_SortBy.value;
			refValue = null;
			customListValue = null;
			dxfIdValue = null;
			iconSetValue = ST_IconSetType._3Arrows;
			iconIdValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "descending":
					descendingValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "sortBy":
					sortByValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, sortByValue);
					break;
				case "ref":
					refValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "customList":
					customListValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "dxfId":
					dxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "iconSet":
					iconSetValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, iconSetValue);
					break;
				case "iconId":
					iconIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
			_ = iconSetValue;
			_ = 16;
		}

		public static void WriteSortConditionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string refValue, bool descendingValue = false, ST_SortBy sortByValue = ST_SortBy.value, string customListValue = null, uint? dxfIdValue = null, ST_IconSetType iconSetValue = ST_IconSetType._3Arrows, uint? iconIdValue = null)
		{
			if ((int)iconSetValue <= 16)
			{
				WriteSortConditionElement(partManager, "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/sortCondition", null, refValue, descendingValue, sortByValue, customListValue, dxfIdValue, iconSetValue, iconIdValue);
				return;
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAlternateContentElement(new AlternateContentChoice[1]
			{
				new AlternateContentChoice(SpreadsheetML2009Main.Instance, delegate
				{
					WriteSortConditionElement(partManager, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main/sortCondition", null, refValue, descendingValue, sortByValue, customListValue, dxfIdValue, iconSetValue, iconIdValue);
				})
			});
		}

		private static void WriteSortConditionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string strictElementName, string namespacePrefix, string refValue, bool descendingValue = false, ST_SortBy sortByValue = ST_SortBy.value, string customListValue = null, uint? dxfIdValue = null, ST_IconSetType iconSetValue = ST_IconSetType._3Arrows, uint? iconIdValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(strictElementName, namespacePrefix);
			string value;
			if (descendingValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(descendingValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("descending", value);
			}
			if (sortByValue != ST_SortBy.value)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(sortByValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sortBy", value);
			}
			value = refValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("ref", value);
			value = customListValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("customList", value);
			if (dxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = dxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dxfId", value);
			}
			if (iconSetValue != ST_IconSetType._3Arrows)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(iconSetValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconSet", value);
			}
			if (iconIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = iconIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("iconId", value);
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void ReadSortStateElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string refValue, out bool columnSortValue, out bool caseSensitiveValue, out ST_SortMethod sortMethodValue)
		{
			columnSortValue = false;
			caseSensitiveValue = false;
			sortMethodValue = ST_SortMethod.none;

			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "columnSort":
					columnSortValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "caseSensitive":
					caseSensitiveValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "sortMethod":
					sortMethodValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, sortMethodValue);
					break;
				case "ref":
					refValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadSstElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint? countValue, out uint? uniqueCountValue)
		{
			countValue = null;
			uniqueCountValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "count"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "uniqueCount")
					{
						uniqueCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					countValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		public static void ReadTableElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint idValue, out string nameValue, out string displayNameValue, out string commentValue, out string refValue, out ST_TableType tableTypeValue, out uint headerRowCountValue, out bool insertRowValue, out bool insertRowShiftValue, out uint totalsRowCountValue, out bool totalsRowShownValue, out bool publishedValue, out uint? headerRowDxfIdValue, out uint? dataDxfIdValue, out uint? totalsRowDxfIdValue, out uint? headerRowBorderDxfIdValue, out uint? tableBorderDxfIdValue, out uint? totalsRowBorderDxfIdValue, out string headerRowCellStyleValue, out string dataCellStyleValue, out string totalsRowCellStyleValue, out uint? connectionIdValue)
		{
			idValue = 0u;
			nameValue = null;
			displayNameValue = null;
			commentValue = null;
			refValue = null;
			tableTypeValue = ST_TableType.worksheet;
			headerRowCountValue = 1u;
			insertRowValue = false;
			insertRowShiftValue = false;
			totalsRowCountValue = 0u;
			totalsRowShownValue = true;
			publishedValue = false;
			headerRowDxfIdValue = null;
			dataDxfIdValue = null;
			totalsRowDxfIdValue = null;
			headerRowBorderDxfIdValue = null;
			tableBorderDxfIdValue = null;
			totalsRowBorderDxfIdValue = null;
			headerRowCellStyleValue = null;
			dataCellStyleValue = null;
			totalsRowCellStyleValue = null;
			connectionIdValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "id":
					idValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "displayName":
					displayNameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "comment":
					commentValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "ref":
					refValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "tableType":
					tableTypeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, tableTypeValue);
					break;
				case "headerRowCount":
					headerRowCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "insertRow":
					insertRowValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "insertRowShift":
					insertRowShiftValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "totalsRowCount":
					totalsRowCountValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "totalsRowShown":
					totalsRowShownValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "published":
					publishedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "headerRowDxfId":
					headerRowDxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "dataDxfId":
					dataDxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "totalsRowDxfId":
					totalsRowDxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "headerRowBorderDxfId":
					headerRowBorderDxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "tableBorderDxfId":
					tableBorderDxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "totalsRowBorderDxfId":
					totalsRowBorderDxfIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "headerRowCellStyle":
					headerRowCellStyleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "dataCellStyle":
					dataCellStyleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "totalsRowCellStyle":
					totalsRowCellStyleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "connectionId":
					connectionIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTableElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint idValue, string nameValue, string displayNameValue, string commentValue, string refValue, ST_TableType tableTypeValue = ST_TableType.worksheet, uint headerRowCountValue = 1u, bool insertRowValue = false, bool insertRowShiftValue = false, uint totalsRowCountValue = 0u, bool totalsRowShownValue = true, bool publishedValue = false, uint? headerRowDxfIdValue = null, uint? dataDxfIdValue = null, uint? totalsRowDxfIdValue = null, uint? headerRowBorderDxfIdValue = null, uint? tableBorderDxfIdValue = null, uint? totalsRowBorderDxfIdValue = null, string headerRowCellStyleValue = null, string dataCellStyleValue = null, string totalsRowCellStyleValue = null, uint? connectionIdValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/table", null);
			string value = idValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("id", value);
			value = nameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("name", value);
			value = displayNameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("displayName", value);
			value = commentValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("comment", value);
			value = refValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("ref", value);
			if (tableTypeValue != ST_TableType.worksheet)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(tableTypeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tableType", value);
			}
			if (headerRowCountValue != 1)
			{
				value = headerRowCountValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("headerRowCount", value);
			}
			if (insertRowValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(insertRowValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("insertRow", value);
			}
			if (insertRowShiftValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(insertRowShiftValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("insertRowShift", value);
			}
			if (totalsRowCountValue != 0)
			{
				value = totalsRowCountValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("totalsRowCount", value);
			}
			if (!totalsRowShownValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(totalsRowShownValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("totalsRowShown", value);
			}
			if (publishedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(publishedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("published", value);
			}
			if (headerRowDxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = headerRowDxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("headerRowDxfId", value);
			}
			if (dataDxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = dataDxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dataDxfId", value);
			}
			if (totalsRowDxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = totalsRowDxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("totalsRowDxfId", value);
			}
			if (headerRowBorderDxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = headerRowBorderDxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("headerRowBorderDxfId", value);
			}
			if (tableBorderDxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = tableBorderDxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tableBorderDxfId", value);
			}
			if (totalsRowBorderDxfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = totalsRowBorderDxfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("totalsRowBorderDxfId", value);
			}
			value = headerRowCellStyleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("headerRowCellStyle", value);
			value = dataCellStyleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dataCellStyle", value);
			value = totalsRowCellStyleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("totalsRowCellStyle", value);
			if (connectionIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = connectionIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("connectionId", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadTablePartElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string idValue)
		{
			idValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id")
				{
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadTop10Element(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out double valValue, out bool topValue, out bool percentValue, out double? filterValValue)
		{
			topValue = true;
			percentValue = false;
			valValue = 0.0;
			filterValValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "top":
					topValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "percent":
					percentValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "val":
					valValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "filterVal":
					filterValValue = double.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTop10Element(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, double valValue, bool topValue = true, bool percentValue = false, double? filterValValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/top10", null);
			string value;
			if (!topValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(topValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("top", value);
			}
			if (percentValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(percentValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("percent", value);
			}
			value = valValue.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("val", value);
			if (filterValValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = filterValValue.Value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("filterVal", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadWorkbookElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_ConformanceClass conformanceValue)
		{
			conformanceValue = ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "conformance")
				{
					conformanceValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, conformanceValue);
				}
			}
		}

					break;
				case "applyAlignment":
					applyAlignmentValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "applyProtection":
					applyProtectionValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteXfElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint? numFmtIdValue = null, uint? fontIdValue = null, uint? fillIdValue = null, uint? borderIdValue = null, uint? xfIdValue = null, bool quotePrefixValue = false, bool pivotButtonValue = false, bool? applyNumberFormatValue = null, bool? applyFontValue = null, bool? applyFillValue = null, bool? applyBorderValue = null, bool? applyAlignmentValue = null, bool? applyProtectionValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/xf", null);
			if (numFmtIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = numFmtIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("numFmtId", value);
			}
			if (fontIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = fontIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fontId", value);
			}
			if (fillIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = fillIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fillId", value);
			}
			if (borderIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = borderIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("borderId", value);
			}
			if (xfIdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = xfIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("xfId", value);
			}
			if (quotePrefixValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(quotePrefixValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("quotePrefix", value);
			}
			if (pivotButtonValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(pivotButtonValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("pivotButton", value);
			}
			if (applyNumberFormatValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(applyNumberFormatValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("applyNumberFormat", value);
			}
			if (applyFontValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(applyFontValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("applyFont", value);
			}
			if (applyFillValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(applyFillValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("applyFill", value);
			}
			if (applyBorderValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(applyBorderValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("applyBorder", value);
			}
			if (applyAlignmentValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(applyAlignmentValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("applyAlignment", value);
			}
			if (applyProtectionValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(applyProtectionValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("applyProtection", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadXmlColumnPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint mapIdValue, out string xpathValue, out string xmlDataTypeValue, out bool denormalizedValue)
		{
			mapIdValue = 0u;
			xpathValue = null;
			denormalizedValue = false;
			xmlDataTypeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "mapId":
					mapIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "xpath":
					xpathValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "denormalized":
					denormalizedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "xmlDataType":
					xmlDataTypeValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteXmlColumnPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint mapIdValue, string xpathValue, string xmlDataTypeValue, bool denormalizedValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/xmlColumnPr", null);
			string value = mapIdValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("mapId", value);
			value = xpathValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("xpath", value);
			if (denormalizedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(denormalizedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("denormalized", value);
			}
			value = xmlDataTypeValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("xmlDataType", value);
		}
	}

	internal class CT_Transform2D
	{
		public const bool DefaultHorizontalFlip = false;

		public const bool DefaultVerticalFlip = false;

		public static ST_Angle DefaultRotation = ST_Angle.FromDegrees(0f);

		public CT_PositiveSize2D Extents { get; set; }

		public bool? HorizontalFlip { get; set; }

		public CT_Point2D Offset { get; set; }

		public ST_Angle? Rotation { get; set; }

		public bool? VerticalFlip { get; set; }

		public CT_Transform2D()
		{
			HorizontalFlip = null;
			VerticalFlip = null;
			Rotation = null;
		}

		public bool GetHorizontalFlipResolved()
		{
			if (!HorizontalFlip.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return HorizontalFlip.Value;
		}

		public bool GetVerticalFlipResolved()
		{
			if (!VerticalFlip.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return VerticalFlip.Value;
		}

		public ST_Angle GetRotationResolved()
		{
			if (!Rotation.HasValue)
			{
				return DefaultRotation;
			}
			return Rotation.Value;
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_Angle
	{
		public const float UnitsPerDegree = 60000f;

		private readonly int _value;

		private ST_Angle(int value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_Angle? sT_Angle = obj as ST_Angle?;
			if (sT_Angle.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_Angle.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public static ST_Angle FromDegrees(float degrees)
		{
			return new ST_Angle((degrees != 0f) ? ((int)Utilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(degrees * 60000f)) : 0);
		}

		public static int DegreesToUnits(double degrees)
		{
			if (degrees != 0.0)
			{
				return (int)Utilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(degrees * 60000.0);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static ST_Angle Parse(string value)
		{
			ST_Angle? sT_Angle = TryParse(value);
			if (sT_Angle.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_Angle.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_Angle>(value);
		}

		public static double ToDegrees(int units)
		{
			return (float)units / 60000f;
		}

		public float ToDegrees()
		{
			return (float)ToDegrees(_value);
		}

		public static ST_Angle? TryParse(string value)
		{
			if (!int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ST_Angle(result);
		}

		public static bool AreEqual(ST_Angle a, ST_Angle b)
		{
			return a._value == b._value;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_Angle a, ST_Angle b)
		{
			return a._value == b._value;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_Angle a, ST_Angle b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}
	}
	internal struct ST_Coordinate
	{
		private ST_CoordinateUnqualified? _value1;

		private ST_UniversalMeasure? _value2;

		public ST_Coordinate(ST_CoordinateUnqualified value)
		{
			_value1 = value;
			_value2 = null;
		}

		public ST_Coordinate(ST_UniversalMeasure value)
		{
			_value1 = null;
			_value2 = value;
		}

		public long GetEmus()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().GetEmus();
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().GetEmus();
			}
			return 0L;
		}

		public double GetTwips()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().GetTwips();
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().GetTwips();
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public static ST_Coordinate Parse(string value)
		{
			ST_Coordinate? sT_Coordinate = TryParse(value);
			if (sT_Coordinate.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_Coordinate.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_Coordinate>(value);
		}

		public static ST_Coordinate? TryParse(string value)
		{
			return ((ST_Coordinate?)ST_CoordinateUnqualified.TryParse(value)) ?? ((ST_Coordinate?)ST_UniversalMeasure.TryParse(value));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().ToString();
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static ST_Coordinate FromLong(long value)
		{
			return new ST_Coordinate(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_Coordinate(long value)
		{
			return new ST_Coordinate(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_Coordinate(ST_CoordinateUnqualified value)
		{
			return new ST_Coordinate(value);
		}

		public static explicit operator ST_CoordinateUnqualified(ST_Coordinate value)
		{
			return value._value1.Value;
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_Coordinate(ST_UniversalMeasure value)
		{
			return new ST_Coordinate(value);
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_UniversalMeasure
	{
		private readonly ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType _unitType;

		private readonly double _value;

		public ST_UniversalMeasure(double value, ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType unitType)
		{
			_value = value;
			_unitType = unitType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_UniversalMeasure? sT_UniversalMeasure = obj as ST_UniversalMeasure?;
			if (sT_UniversalMeasure.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_UniversalMeasure.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (_unitType.GetHashCode() << 16) ^ _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToStringHelper(_value, _unitType);
		}

		public double? GetDoubleValue()
		{
			return GetTwips();
		}

		public long GetEmus()
		{
			return Utilities.TwipsToEMU(GetTwips());
		}

		public double GetTwips()
		{
			return GetTwipsHelper(_value, _unitType);
		}

		public static ST_UniversalMeasure? TryParse(string value)
		{
			if (!TryParseHelper(value, out var numericValue, out var unitType) || numericValue < 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ST_UniversalMeasure(numericValue, unitType);
		}

		public static double GetTwipsHelper(double numericValue, ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType unitType)
		{
			switch (unitType)
			{
			case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.centimeters:
				numericValue /= 2.54;
				goto case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.inches;
			case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.inches:
				numericValue *= 72.0;
				goto case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.points;
			case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.millimeters:
				numericValue /= 10.0;
				goto case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.centimeters;
			case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.points:
				return numericValue * 20.0;
			case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.pc:
			case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.pi:
				numericValue /= 12.0;
				goto case ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.points;
			default:
				return (int)numericValue;
			}
		}

		public static bool TryParseHelper(string value, out double numericValue, out ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType unitType)
		{
			numericValue = 0.0;
			unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.centimeters;
			if (value.Length < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string s = value.Substring(0, value.Length - 2);
			switch (value.Substring(value.Length - 2))
			{
			case "cm":
				unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.centimeters;
				break;
			case "mm":
				unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.millimeters;
				break;
			case "in":
				unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.inches;
				break;
			case "pt":
				unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.points;
				break;
			case "pc":
				unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.pc;
				break;
			case "pi":
				unitType = ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.pi;
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			if (!double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out numericValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static string ToStringHelper(double value, ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType unitType)
		{
			return value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + unitType switch
			{
				ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.centimeters => "cm", 
				ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.inches => "in", 
				ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.millimeters => "mm", 
				ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.points => "pt", 
				ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.pc => "pc", 
				ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType.pi => "pi", 
				_ => "pt", 
			};
		}

		public static bool AreEqual(ST_UniversalMeasure a, ST_UniversalMeasure b)
		{
			if (a._unitType == b._unitType)
			{
				return a._value == b._value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_UniversalMeasure a, ST_UniversalMeasure b)
		{
			if (a._unitType == b._unitType)
			{
				return a._value == b._value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_UniversalMeasure a, ST_UniversalMeasure b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}
	}
	internal enum ST_UniversalMeasure_UnitType
	{
		centimeters,
		millimeters,
		inches,
		points,
		pc,
		pi
	}

	internal struct AttributeValue
	{
		public readonly QualifiedNameInfo AttributeName;

		public readonly string Value;

		public bool IsEmpty => AttributeName.IsEmpty;

		public bool IsNamespaceDeclaration
		{
			get
			{
				if (AttributeName.NamespaceURI == "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/" && (AttributeName.LocalName == "xmlns" || AttributeName.Prefix == "xmlns"))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public AttributeValue(string prefix, string namespaceURI, string localName, string value)
		{
			AttributeName = new QualifiedNameInfo(prefix, namespaceURI, localName);
			Value = value;
		}

		public AttributeValue(QualifiedNameInfo attributeName, string value)
		{
			AttributeName = attributeName;
			Value = value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return AttributeName.ToString() + "=\"" + Value + "\"";
		}
	}

	internal class CT_AdjPoint2D
	{
		public ST_AdjCoordinate X { get; set; }

		public ST_AdjCoordinate Y { get; set; }

		public void Save(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			WriteAttributes(partManager, elementName, this);
		}

		private static void WriteAttributes(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, CT_AdjPoint2D instance)
		{
			XmlWriteManager xmlWriteManager = partManager.XmlWriteManager;
			xmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, null);
			string text = null;
			string text2 = null;
			text2 = "x";
			text = ST_AdjCoordinate.ToString(instance.X);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute(text2, text);
			text2 = "y";
			text = ST_AdjCoordinate.ToString(instance.Y);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute(text2, text);
			xmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}
	}

	internal class CT_GeomGuide
	{
		public string Fmla { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		internal static void Read(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string name, out string fmla)
		{
			name = null;
			fmla = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "name"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "fmla")
					{
						fmla = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					name = currentElementAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CT_Path2DArcTo : IPath2DCommand, ISaveToXLSX
	{
		public ST_AdjCoordinate WR { get; set; }

		public ST_AdjCoordinate HR { get; set; }

		public ST_AdjAngle StAng { get; set; }

		public ST_AdjAngle SwAng { get; set; }

		string ISaveToXLSX.ElementName => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/arcTo";

		public TResult Accept<TArg, TResult>(IPath2DCommandVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument = default(TArg))
		{
			return visitor.VisitCT_Path2DArcTo(this, argument);
		}

		void ISaveToXLSX.Save(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, XmlWriteManager writer, string elementName, object saveManager)
		{
			WriteAttributes(partManager, elementName, this);
		}

		public static void WriteAttributes(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, CT_Path2DArcTo instance)
		{
			XmlWriteManager xmlWriteManager = partManager.XmlWriteManager;
			xmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, null);
			string text = null;
			string text2 = null;
			text2 = "hR";
			text = ST_AdjCoordinate.ToString(instance.HR);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute(text2, text);
			text2 = "stAng";
			text = ST_AdjAngle.ToString(instance.StAng);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute(text2, text);
			text2 = "swAng";
			text = ST_AdjAngle.ToString(instance.SwAng);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute(text2, text);
			text2 = "wR";
			text = ST_AdjCoordinate.ToString(instance.WR);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute(text2, text);
			xmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}
	}

	internal class CT_TextParagraphProperties
	{
		public ST_TextMargin? MarL { get; set; }

		public ST_TextMargin? MarR { get; set; }

		public ST_TextIndentLevelType? Lvl { get; set; }

		public ST_TextIndent? Indent { get; set; }

		public ST_TextAlignType? Algn { get; set; }

		public ST_Coordinate32? DefTabSz { get; set; }

		public bool? Rtl { get; set; }

		public bool? EaLnBrk { get; set; }

		public ST_TextFontAlignType? FontAlgn { get; set; }

		public bool? LatinLnBrk { get; set; }

		public bool? HangingPunct { get; set; }

		public CT_TextCharacterPropertiesBase DefRPr { get; set; }

		public static CT_TextParagraphProperties Read_CT_TextParagraphProperties(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			ST_TextAlignType? algn = null;
			int? num = null;
			bool? eaLnBrk = null;
			ST_TextFontAlignType? fontAlgn = null;
			bool? hangingPunct = null;
			int? num2 = null;
			bool? latinLnBrk = null;
			int? num3 = null;
			int? num4 = null;
			int? num5 = null;
			bool? rtl = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "algn":
					algn = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextAlignType.l);
					break;
				case "defTabSz":
					num = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "eaLnBrk":
					eaLnBrk = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "fontAlgn":
					fontAlgn = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextFontAlignType.auto);
					break;
				case "hangingPunct":
					hangingPunct = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "indent":
					num2 = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "latinLnBrk":
					latinLnBrk = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "lvl":
					num3 = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "marL":
					num4 = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "marR":
					num5 = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "rtl":
					rtl = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new CT_TextParagraphProperties
			{
				Algn = algn,
				DefTabSz = num,
				EaLnBrk = eaLnBrk,
				FontAlgn = fontAlgn,
				HangingPunct = hangingPunct,
				Indent = num2,
				LatinLnBrk = latinLnBrk,
				Lvl = num3,
				MarL = num4,
				MarR = num5,
				Rtl = rtl
			};
		}
	}

	internal struct ElementLoadCallbacks
	{
		public readonly Action<XmlPartManagerBase> OnElementLoaded;

		public readonly Action<XmlPartManagerBase> OnChildrenLoaded;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (OnElementLoaded == null)
				{
					return OnChildrenLoaded == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public ElementLoadCallbacks(Action<XmlPartManagerBase> onElementLoaded, Action<XmlPartManagerBase> onChildrenLoaded)
		{
			OnElementLoaded = onElementLoaded;
			OnChildrenLoaded = onChildrenLoaded;
		}
	}
