	internal abstract class OfficeDocumentManager : IDisposable
	{
		private class PartRelationshipCounter
		{
			private int _relationshipCount;

			public int RelationshipCount => _relationshipCount;

			public void IncrementRelationshipCount()
			{
				_relationshipCount++;
			}
		}

		private const string HyperlinkRelationshipTypeValueTransitional = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink";

		private const string HyperlinkRelationshipTypeValueStrict = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/hyperlink";

		public const string RelationshipIdPrefix = "rId";

		private IPackagePart _activePart;

		private ST_ConformanceClass? _conformance;

		private readonly bool _isLoading;

		private readonly HashSet<string> _loadedPartPaths;

		private Stack<IPackagePart> _parentPartStack;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _partDataByPath;

		private readonly Stack<PartRelationshipCounter> _partRelationshipCounters;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase> _registeredNamespacesByNamespceUri;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, PartManagerBase> _registeredPartManagerPrototypesByContentType;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, PartManagerBase> _registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType;

		private ThemePartManager _themePartManagerPrototype;

		private IPackage _zipPackage;

		private readonly Stream _zipPackageStream;

		internal RoundTripControlData Office2007Extensibility;

		internal RoundTripControlData Office2010Extensibility;

		internal readonly WorkItem InitializationWorkItem;

		private string _lastStrictNamespaceUri;

		private string _lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri;

		private string _lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri_Empty;

		public IPackagePart ActivePart => _activePart;

		public abstract OfficeApplication Application { get; }

		public ST_ConformanceClass Conformance => _conformance ?? ST_ConformanceClass.transitional;

		public bool IsLoading => _isLoading;

		public bool IsThemePartLoaded { get; set; }

		public Stack<IPackagePart> ParentPartStack => _parentPartStack;

		public abstract DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase DrawingPropertiesNamespace { get; }

		protected internal IPackage ZipPackage => _zipPackage;

		protected OfficeDocumentManager(IPackageFactory packageFactory, Stream stream, bool isLoading, ST_ConformanceClass? conformance)
		{
			_loadedPartPaths = new HashSet<string>();
			_parentPartStack = new Stack<IPackagePart>();
			_partDataByPath = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			_partRelationshipCounters = new Stack<PartRelationshipCounter>();
			_partRelationshipCounters.Push(new PartRelationshipCounter());
			_registeredNamespacesByNamespceUri = new Dictionary<string, XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase>();
			_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByContentType = new Dictionary<string, PartManagerBase>();
			_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType = new Dictionary<string, PartManagerBase>();
			_conformance = conformance;
			_isLoading = isLoading;
			_zipPackageStream = stream;
			if (packageFactory != null && _zipPackageStream != null)
			{
				_zipPackage = packageFactory.Open(_zipPackageStream, _isLoading ? FileMode.Open : FileMode.Create);
				InitializationWorkItem = WorkItem.FromResult<object>(null);
			}
			else
			{
				InitializationWorkItem = WorkItem.FromResult<object>(null);
			}
		}

		~OfficeDocumentManager()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public string CreateInternalRelationship(Uri targetUri, PartManagerBase targetPartManager)
		{
			return CreateInternalRelationship(targetUri, targetPartManager.GetRelationshipType(Conformance));
		}

		public string CreateInternalRelationship(Uri targetUri, string relationshipType)
		{
			return CreateRelationship(targetUri, relationshipType, RelationshipTargetMode.Internal);
		}

		public string CreateExternalRelationship(Uri targetUri, string relationshipType)
		{
			return CreateRelationship(targetUri, relationshipType, RelationshipTargetMode.External);
		}

		public string CreateExternalRelationship(string targetAddress, string relationshipType)
		{
			if (UriUtilities.TryCreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(targetAddress, out var uri))
			{
				return CreateExternalRelationship(uri, relationshipType);
			}
			return CreateRelationship(null, relationshipType, RelationshipTargetMode.External, targetAddress);
		}

		public WorkItem<Tuple<Uri, string>> CreatePart(PartManagerBase partManagerPrototype, object context = null, string preferredRelationshipId = null)
		{
			string text = partManagerPrototype.GetPartName(Application);
			if (partManagerPrototype.IsNumbered)
			{
				text = GetNumberedPartName(text, !partManagerPrototype.NumberedPartsConsiderExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness);
			}
			return CreatePart(partManagerPrototype, text, context, preferredRelationshipId);
		}

		private WorkItem<Tuple<Uri, string>> CreatePart(PartManagerBase partManagerPrototype, string partPath, object context = null, string preferredRelationshipId = null)
		{
			Uri partName = UriUtilities.CreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(partPath);
			string relationshipId;
			if (preferredRelationshipId != null && IsRelationshipIdAvailable(preferredRelationshipId))
			{
				relationshipId = preferredRelationshipId;
				CreateRelationship(partName, partManagerPrototype.GetRelationshipType(Conformance), RelationshipTargetMode.Internal, relationshipId, null);
			}
			else
			{
				relationshipId = CreateRelationship(partName, partManagerPrototype.GetRelationshipType(Conformance), RelationshipTargetMode.Internal);
			}
			IPackagePart lastActivePart = _activePart;
			return Async.Try(delegate
			{
				if (lastActivePart != null)
				{
					_parentPartStack.Push(lastActivePart);
				}
				IPackagePart packagePart = _zipPackage.CreatePart(partName, partManagerPrototype.ContentType);
				_activePart = packagePart;
				_partRelationshipCounters.Push(new PartRelationshipCounter());
				return Async.Using(packagePart.GetStream(FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write), delegate(Stream stream)
				{
					PartManagerBase partManagerBase = partManagerPrototype.CloneForSerialization(this, stream);
					return partManagerBase.Save(context);
				}).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					_partRelationshipCounters.Pop();
					_partDataByPath.Add(partPath, context);
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
			}, delegate
			{
				if (lastActivePart != null)
				{
					_parentPartStack.Pop();
				}
				_activePart = lastActivePart;
			}).Then(() => Tuple.Create(partName, relationshipId));
		}

		public WorkItem<Tuple<Uri, string>> CreatePart(string contentType, string partPath, object context = null, string preferredRelationshipId = null)
		{
			if (partPath == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PartManagerBase partManagerPrototypeForContentType = GetPartManagerPrototypeForContentType(contentType);
			if (partManagerPrototypeForContentType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreatePart(partManagerPrototypeForContentType, partPath, context, preferredRelationshipId);
		}

		public string GetLocalPath()
		{
			if (_zipPackageStream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _zipPackageStream.GetFileName();
		}

		public XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase GetNamespaceDefinition(string namespaceUri)
		{
			_registeredNamespacesByNamespceUri.TryGetValue(namespaceUri, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public IPackagePart GetPart(Uri absolutePartPath)
		{
			return ZipPackage.GetPart(absolutePartPath);
		}

		public object GetPartData(IPackagePart part)
		{
			return GetPartData(part.Uri.ToString());
		}

		public object GetPartData(IPackageRelationship relationship)
		{
			string originalString = PackageUtilities.GetTargetPartPath(relationship).OriginalString;
			return GetPartData(originalString);
		}

		public Uri GetPartUri(object data)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in _partDataByPath)
			{
				if (object.Equals(item.Value, data))
				{
					return UriUtilities.CreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(item.Key);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object GetRelationshipDataFromActivePart(string relationshipId)
		{
			IPackageRelationship relationshipFromActivePart = GetRelationshipFromActivePart(relationshipId);
			if (relationshipFromActivePart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (relationshipFromActivePart.TargetMode == RelationshipTargetMode.External)
			{
				if (relationshipFromActivePart is IInvalidPackageRelationshipTarget)
				{
					return ((IInvalidPackageRelationshipTarget)relationshipFromActivePart).TargetString;
				}
				return relationshipFromActivePart.TargetUri;
			}
			return GetPartData(relationshipFromActivePart);
		}

		public Tuple<string, TData> GetRelationshipDataFromActivePart<TData>(PartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			string relationshipType = partManager.GetRelationshipType(Conformance);
			foreach (IPackageRelationship activeRelationship in GetActiveRelationships())
			{
				if (activeRelationship.RelationshipType == relationshipType)
				{
					object relationshipDataFromActivePart = GetRelationshipDataFromActivePart(activeRelationship.Id);
					if (relationshipDataFromActivePart != null)
					{
						return Tuple.Create(activeRelationship.Id, (TData)relationshipDataFromActivePart);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IPackageRelationship GetRelationshipFromActivePart(string relationshipId)
		{
			if (_activePart == null)
			{
				return _zipPackage.GetRelationship(relationshipId);
			}
			return _activePart.GetRelationship(relationshipId);
		}

		public IPackageRelationship GetRelationshipFromActivePart(object contextDataForPart)
		{
			foreach (IPackageRelationship activeRelationship in GetActiveRelationships())
			{
				if (GetPartData(activeRelationship) == contextDataForPart)
				{
					return activeRelationship;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal string GetTargetRelationshipType(ST_ConformanceClass targetConformance, string relationId)
		{
			ST_ConformanceClass sT_ConformanceClass = targetConformance;
			ST_ConformanceClass conformance = ((sT_ConformanceClass == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional) ? ST_ConformanceClass.strict : ST_ConformanceClass.transitional);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, PartManagerBase> item in _registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType)
			{
				string relationshipType = item.Value.GetRelationshipType(conformance);
				string relationshipType2 = item.Value.GetRelationshipType(sT_ConformanceClass);
				if (relationshipType == relationId || relationId == relationshipType2)
				{
					return relationshipType2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void Initialize()
		{
			RegisterNamespace(XmlNamespace.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(VmlNamespace.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(CoreProperties.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DcDcmiType.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DcElements.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DcTerms.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(Drawing2010Main.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(Drawing2010Slicer.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLChart.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLChart2014.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLChartEx2015_9_8.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLChartEx2015_10_21.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLChartEx2016_5_10.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(DrawingMLMain.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(EmptyNamespace.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(MarkupCompatibility2006.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(OfficeDocumentDocPropsVTypes.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(OfficeDocumentExtendedProperties.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(OfficeDocumentRelationships.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(OfficeNamespace.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(XmlSchemaInstance.Instance);
			RegisterNamespace(IGOfficeExtensions.Instance);
			DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase drawingPropertiesNamespace = DrawingPropertiesNamespace;
			if (drawingPropertiesNamespace != null)
			{
				RegisterNamespace(drawingPropertiesNamespace);
			}
			if (!_conformance.HasValue)
			{
				_conformance = GetConformance();
			}
		}

		public bool IsNamespaceRecognized(string namespaceUri)
		{
			return _registeredNamespacesByNamespceUri.ContainsKey(namespaceUri);
		}

		public WorkItem Load()
		{
			return InitializationWorkItem.Then((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
			{
				Initialize();
				return LoadCore();
			}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
		}

		public virtual void OnUnsupportedContentDetected()
		{
		}

		public string ResolveStrictNamespaceUri(string namespaceUri)
		{
			if (namespaceUri == null || namespaceUri.Length == 0)
			{
				if (_lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri_Empty != null)
				{
					return _lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri_Empty;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (object.Equals(namespaceUri, _lastStrictNamespaceUri))
				{
					return _lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri;
				}
				_lastStrictNamespaceUri = namespaceUri;
			}
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase namespaceDefinition = GetNamespaceDefinition(namespaceUri);
			if (namespaceDefinition != null)
			{
				namespaceUri = namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass.strict);
			}
			if (namespaceUri == null || namespaceUri.Length == 0)
			{
				_lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri_Empty = namespaceUri;
			}
			else
			{
				_lastResolveStrictNamespaceUri = namespaceUri;
			}
			return namespaceUri;
		}

		public WorkItem Save()
		{
			Initialize();
			return InitializationWorkItem.Then(() => SaveCore()).Then(() => Async.If(Office2007Extensibility != null, () => CreatePart(Office2007ExtensibilityPartManager.Instance))).Then(() => Async.If(Office2010Extensibility != null, () => CreatePart(Office2010ExtensibilityPartManager.Instance)));
		}

		public void UpdateConformance(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			_conformance = conformance;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (_zipPackage != null)
			{
				_zipPackage.Dispose();
				_zipPackage = null;
			}
		}

		protected abstract ST_ConformanceClass GetConformance();

		protected virtual WorkItem LoadCore()
		{
			return LoadPartRelationships(null, null, _zipPackage.GetRelationships(), hasSourcePartBeenLoaded: false).Then(delegate(WorkItem<bool> t)
			{
				bool result = t.GetResult();
				return Async.If(_themePartManagerPrototype != null && !IsThemePartLoaded, delegate
				{
					string numberedPartName = GetNumberedPartName(_themePartManagerPrototype.GetPartName(Application), ignoreExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness: false, ignoreOtherParts: true);
					Uri defaultThemePartUri = null;
					return Async.If(!_loadedPartPaths.Contains(numberedPartName) && Uri.TryCreate(numberedPartName, UriKind.Relative, out defaultThemePartUri) && _zipPackage.PartExists(defaultThemePartUri), () => LoadPart(_zipPackage.GetPart(defaultThemePartUri)));
				});
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnknownPartLoaded(IPackagePart part)
		{
			OnUnsupportedContentDetected();
		}

		protected void RegisterNamespace(XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase namespaceDefinition)
		{
			_registeredNamespacesByNamespceUri[namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass.strict)] = namespaceDefinition;
			_registeredNamespacesByNamespceUri[namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)] = namespaceDefinition;
		}

		protected void RegisterPartManagerPrototype(PartManagerBase partManagerPrototype, bool isDefaultPartManagerForContentType = true)
		{
			if (isDefaultPartManagerForContentType)
			{
				_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByContentType[partManagerPrototype.ContentType] = partManagerPrototype;
			}
			_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType[partManagerPrototype.GetRelationshipType(Conformance)] = partManagerPrototype;
			if (partManagerPrototype.ContentType == "image/jpeg")
			{
				_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByContentType["image/jpg"] = partManagerPrototype;
			}
			if (partManagerPrototype is ThemePartManager themePartManagerPrototype)
			{
				_themePartManagerPrototype = themePartManagerPrototype;
			}
		}

		protected abstract WorkItem SaveCore();

		private string CreateRelationship(Uri targetPartName, string relationshipType, RelationshipTargetMode targetMode, string externalTargetPart = null)
		{
			PartRelationshipCounter partRelationshipCounter = _partRelationshipCounters.Peek();
			string text = GenerateRelationshipId(partRelationshipCounter.RelationshipCount);
			CreateRelationship(targetPartName, relationshipType, targetMode, text, externalTargetPart);
			return text;
		}

		private void CreateRelationship(Uri targetPartName, string relationshipType, RelationshipTargetMode targetMode, string relationshipId, string externalTargetPart)
		{
			_partRelationshipCounters.Peek().IncrementRelationshipCount();
			Uri targetUri;
			if (targetMode == RelationshipTargetMode.Internal)
			{
				if (_activePart == null)
				{
					Uri sourcePart = new Uri('/'.ToString(), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
					targetUri = PackageUtilities.GetRelativePath(sourcePart, targetPartName);
				}
				else
				{
					targetUri = PackageUtilities.GetRelativePath(_activePart.Uri, targetPartName);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (targetPartName == null && externalTargetPart != null && _activePart is IPackagePartEx packagePartEx)
				{
					packagePartEx.CreateExternalRelationship(externalTargetPart, relationshipType, relationshipId);
					return;
				}
				targetUri = targetPartName;
			}
			if (_activePart == null)
			{
				_zipPackage.CreateRelationship(targetUri, targetMode, relationshipType, relationshipId);
			}
			else
			{
				_activePart.CreateRelationship(targetUri, targetMode, relationshipType, relationshipId);
			}
		}

		internal static string GenerateRelationshipId(int currentRelationshipCount)
		{
			return "rId" + (currentRelationshipCount + 1);
		}

		private IEnumerable<IPackageRelationship> GetActiveRelationships()
		{
			if (_activePart != null)
			{
				return _activePart.GetRelationships();
			}
			return _zipPackage.GetRelationships();
		}

		public string GetHyperlinkRelationshipType()
		{
			return Conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/hyperlink", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink", 
			};
		}

		private string GetNumberedPartName(string basePartName, bool ignoreExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness = false, bool ignoreOtherParts = false)
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			if (!ignoreOtherParts && ignoreExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness)
			{
				foreach (IPackagePart part in _zipPackage.GetParts())
				{
					string text = part.Uri.ToString();
					string extension = Path.GetExtension(text);
					string item = text.Substring(0, text.Length - extension.Length);
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
			}
			string extension2 = Path.GetExtension(basePartName);
			string text2 = basePartName.Substring(0, basePartName.Length - extension2.Length);
			int num = 1;
			string text4;
			while (true)
			{
				if (ignoreExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness)
				{
					string text3 = text2 + num;
					if (ignoreOtherParts || !hashSet.Contains(text3))
					{
						return text3 + extension2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					text4 = text2 + num + extension2;
					if (ignoreOtherParts || !_zipPackage.PartExists(UriUtilities.CreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(text4)))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
			return text4;
		}

		private object GetPartData(string absolutePartPath)
		{
			_partDataByPath.TryGetValue(absolutePartPath, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		private PartManagerBase GetPartManagerPrototypeForContentType(string partContentType)
		{
			_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByContentType.TryGetValue(partContentType, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		private PartManagerBase GetPartManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType(string partRelationshipType)
		{
			if (!_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType.TryGetValue(partRelationshipType, out var value))
			{
				if (!(partRelationshipType == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/worksheet"))
				{
					if (partRelationshipType == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/drawing")
					{
						_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType.TryGetValue("http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/drawing", out value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_registeredPartManagerPrototypesByRelationshipType.TryGetValue("http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet", out value);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool IsRelationshipIdAvailable(string relationshipId)
		{
			foreach (IPackageRelationship activeRelationship in GetActiveRelationships())
			{
				if (activeRelationship.Id == relationshipId)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private WorkItem LoadPart(IPackagePart part, PartManagerBase partManagerPrototype = null)
		{
			if (partManagerPrototype == null)
			{
				partManagerPrototype = GetPartManagerPrototypeForContentType(part.ContentType);
			}
			IEnumerable<IPackageRelationship> relationships = part.GetRelationships();
			string partName = part.Uri.ToString();
			if (!_loadedPartPaths.Add(partName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			object partData = null;
			PartManagerBase partManager = null;
			return LoadPartRelationships(part, partManagerPrototype, relationships, hasSourcePartBeenLoaded: false).Then(delegate(WorkItem<bool> t)
			{
				bool wereRelationshipsSkipped = t.GetResult();
				return Async.If(partManagerPrototype != null, delegate
				{
					IPackagePart lastActivePart = _activePart;
					return Async.Try(delegate
					{
						_activePart = part;
						return Async.Using(part.GetStream(FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read), delegate(Stream partStream)
						{
							partManager = partManagerPrototype.CloneForSerialization(this, partStream);
							return partManager.Load().Then(delegate(WorkItem<object> workItem)
							{
								partData = workItem.GetResult();
							});
						});
					}, delegate
					{
						_activePart = lastActivePart;
					});
				}, delegate
				{
					OnUnknownPartLoaded(part);
					return (WorkItem)null;
				}).Then((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
				{
					if (partData != null)
					{
						_partDataByPath[partName] = partData;
					}
					return Async.If(wereRelationshipsSkipped, () => LoadPartRelationships(part, partManagerPrototype, relationships, hasSourcePartBeenLoaded: true));
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					if (partManager != null)
					{
						partManager.OnPartAndRelationshipsLoaded();
					}
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
			});
		}

		private WorkItem<bool> LoadPartRelationships(IPackagePart sourcePart, PartManagerBase sourcePartManagerPrototype, IEnumerable<IPackageRelationship> relationships, bool hasSourcePartBeenLoaded)
		{
			bool wereRelationshipsSkipped = false;
			return Async.Try(delegate
			{
				if (sourcePart != null)
				{
					_parentPartStack.Push(sourcePart);
				}
				SortRelationshipsByPriority(sourcePartManagerPrototype, ref relationships);
				return Async.ForEach(relationships, delegate(IPackageRelationship relationship)
				{
					if (relationship.RelationshipType == GetHyperlinkRelationshipType())
					{
						return (WorkItem)null;
					}
					switch (relationship.TargetMode)
					{
					case RelationshipTargetMode.Internal:
					{
						if (sourcePartManagerPrototype != null)
						{
							PartManagerBase partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType = GetPartManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType(relationship.RelationshipType);
							bool flag = partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType != null && sourcePartManagerPrototype.ShouldBeLoadedBeforeTarget(partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType);
							if (hasSourcePartBeenLoaded != flag)
							{
								wereRelationshipsSkipped = true;
								return (WorkItem)null;
							}
						}
						if (relationship.TargetUri != null && relationship.TargetUri.OriginalString == "NULL")
						{
							return (WorkItem)null;
						}
						Uri targetPartPath = PackageUtilities.GetTargetPartPath(relationship);
						IPackagePart packagePart = _zipPackage.GetPart(targetPartPath);
						PartManagerBase partManagerBase = null;
						if (sourcePartManagerPrototype != null)
						{
							partManagerBase = sourcePartManagerPrototype.GetPreferredPartManager(packagePart, relationship);
						}
						if (partManagerBase == null && packagePart != null && packagePart.ContentType == "application/xml")
						{
							PartManagerBase partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType2 = GetPartManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType(relationship.RelationshipType);
							if (partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType2 != null && partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType2.ContentType != packagePart.ContentType)
							{
								packagePart = new OverrideContentTypePart(packagePart, partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType2.ContentType);
							}
							partManagerBase = partManagerPrototypeForRelationshipType2;
						}
						return LoadPart(packagePart, partManagerBase);
					}
					default:
						return (WorkItem)null;
					}
				});
			}, delegate
			{
				if (sourcePart != null)
				{
					_parentPartStack.Pop();
				}
			}).Then(() => wereRelationshipsSkipped);
		}

		private void SortRelationshipsByPriority(PartManagerBase partManagerPrototype, ref IEnumerable<IPackageRelationship> relationships)
		{
			if (partManagerPrototype == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<PartManagerBase, int> dictionary = partManagerPrototype.CreateTargetLoadPriorityDictionary();
			if (dictionary == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<string, int> relationshipPriorities = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<PartManagerBase, int> item in dictionary)
			{
				relationshipPriorities.Add(item.Key.GetRelationshipType(Conformance), item.Value);
			}
			List<IPackageRelationship> list = new List<IPackageRelationship>(relationships);
			list.Sort(delegate(IPackageRelationship p1, IPackageRelationship p2)
			{
				int value;
				bool flag = relationshipPriorities.TryGetValue(p1.RelationshipType, out value);
				int value2;
				bool flag2 = relationshipPriorities.TryGetValue(p2.RelationshipType, out value2);
				if (!flag && !flag2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (flag && !flag2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (!flag && flag2) ? 1 : value.CompareTo(value2);
			});
			relationships = list;
		}
	}
	internal struct QualifiedNameInfo
	{
		public static readonly QualifiedNameInfo Empty;

		public readonly string Prefix;

		public readonly string NamespaceURI;

		public readonly string LocalName;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Core.ValueTuple<string, string>, string> _cachedQualifiedNames;

		public bool IsEmpty => LocalName == null;

		public QualifiedNameInfo(string prefix, string namespaceURI, string localName)
		{
			if (prefix == string.Empty)
			{
				prefix = null;
			}
			Prefix = prefix;
			NamespaceURI = namespaceURI;
			LocalName = localName;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Prefix != null)
			{
				return Prefix + ":" + LocalName;
			}
			return LocalName;
		}

		private static string CreateQualifiedName(string namespaceUri, string localName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(namespaceUri))
			{
				return localName;
			}
			if (_cachedQualifiedNames == null)
			{
				_cachedQualifiedNames = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Core.ValueTuple<string, string>, string>();
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Core.ValueTuple<string, string> key = Infragistics.Documents.Core.ValueTuple.Create(namespaceUri, localName);
			if (!_cachedQualifiedNames.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				if (namespaceUri[namespaceUri.Length - 1] != '/')
				{
					namespaceUri += "/";
				}
				value = namespaceUri + localName;
				_cachedQualifiedNames[key] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public string GetStrictQualifiedName(OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			if (NamespaceURI == null)
			{
				return LocalName;
			}
			if (documentManager == null)
			{
				return CreateQualifiedName(NamespaceURI, LocalName);
			}
			return CreateQualifiedName(documentManager.ResolveStrictNamespaceUri(NamespaceURI), LocalName);
		}

		public QualifiedNameInfo ToCurrentConformance(OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			if (NamespaceURI == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (documentManager == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new QualifiedNameInfo(Prefix, documentManager.ResolveStrictNamespaceUri(NamespaceURI), LocalName);
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("UnknownElementCache: {_elementName}")]
	internal class UnknownElementCache
	{
		private List<AttributeValue> _attributes;

		private List<UnknownElementCache> _children;

		private readonly QualifiedNameInfo _elementName;

		private object _roundTripTag;

		private string _value;

		public List<AttributeValue> Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_attributes == null)
				{
					_attributes = new List<AttributeValue>();
				}
				return _attributes;
			}
		}

		public bool HasAttributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_attributes != null)
				{
					return _attributes.Count != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public List<UnknownElementCache> Children
		{
			get
			{
				if (_children == null)
				{
					_children = new List<UnknownElementCache>();
				}
				return _children;
			}
		}

		public bool HasChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (_children != null)
				{
					return _children.Count != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public QualifiedNameInfo ElementName => _elementName;

		public object RoundTripTag
		{
			get
			{
				return _roundTripTag;
			}
			set
			{
				_roundTripTag = value;
			}
		}

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		public UnknownElementCache(QualifiedNameInfo elementName, string value)
		{
			_elementName = elementName;
			_value = value;
		}

		public AttributeValue? GetAttribute(string strictAttributeName, OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue attribute in Attributes)
			{
				if (attribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(documentManager) == strictAttributeName)
				{
					return attribute;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public UnknownElementCache GetChild(string strictElementName, OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			return Children.FirstOrDefault((UnknownElementCache e) => e.ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(documentManager) == strictElementName);
		}

		public IEnumerable<UnknownElementCache> GetChildren(string strictElementName, OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			return Children.Where((UnknownElementCache e) => e.ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(documentManager) == strictElementName);
		}

		public IEnumerable<UnknownElementCache> GetDescendants(string strictElementName, OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			foreach (UnknownElementCache child in Children)
			{
				if (child.ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(documentManager) == strictElementName)
				{
					yield return child;
				}
				foreach (UnknownElementCache descendant in child.GetDescendants(strictElementName, documentManager))
				{
					yield return descendant;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public UnknownElementCache RootElement => _rootElement;

		public UnknownStructure(UnknownElementCache rootElement)
		{
			_rootElement = rootElement;
		}
	}
	internal class XmlReadManager
	{
		private class AlternateContentChoiceContext
		{
			public bool IsUnsupported;
		}

		private enum AlternateContentStatus
		{
			NotInAlternateContent,
			InAlternateContentPendingAcceptableChoice,
			InAlternateContentChoiceAccepted
		}

		private struct ElementContext
		{
			public readonly int OriginalContextStackCount;

			public readonly object OriginalContextStackCurrent;

			private HashSet<string> _ignorableNamespaces;

			public bool UseFastLoading;

			public HashSet<string> IgnorableNamespaces
			{
				get
				{
					if (_ignorableNamespaces == null)
					{
						_ignorableNamespaces = new HashSet<string>();
					}
					return _ignorableNamespaces;
				}
			}

			public ElementContext(XmlReadManager manager)
			{
				OriginalContextStackCount = manager._partManager.ContextStack.Count;
				OriginalContextStackCurrent = manager._partManager.ContextStack.Current;
				UseFastLoading = false;
				_ignorableNamespaces = null;
			}

			public bool ContainsIgnorableNamespace(string namespaceUri)
			{
				if (_ignorableNamespaces != null)
				{
					return _ignorableNamespaces.Contains(namespaceUri);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private struct LoadChildContext
		{
			public int CurrentChildIndex;

			public AlternateContentStatus AlternateContentStatus;

			public QualifiedNameInfo ElementName;

			public ElementLoadCallbacks ElementLoadCallbacks;

			public bool ShouldReadPastEndElement;

			public bool ShouldIncrementChildIndex;

			public bool IsNormalElement;

			public bool IsEmptyElement;
		}

		private struct LoadFastContext
		{
			public int CurrentChildIndex;

			public QualifiedNameInfo ElementName;

			public ElementLoadCallbacks ElementLoadCallbacks;
		}

		public readonly List<AttributeValue> CurrentElementAttributes;

		public int CurrentElementIndex;

		public QualifiedNameInfo CurrentElementName;

		public string CurrentElementValue;

		private readonly Stack<AlternateContentChoiceContext> _alternateContentChoiceContexts;

		private int _currentElementContextIndex;

		private UnknownElementCache _currentUnknownElementCache;

		private ElementContext[] _elementContexts;

		private readonly OfficeDocumentManager _documentManager;

		private readonly XmlPartManagerBase _partManager;

		private readonly XmlReader _xmlReader;

		private int _elementsLoadedThisSlice;

		private Stack<LoadChildContext> _loadChildContextStack = new Stack<LoadChildContext>();

		private Stack<LoadFastContext> _loadFastContextStack = new Stack<LoadFastContext>();

		private const int MAX_ELEMENTS_PER_SLICE = 1000;

		public UnknownElementCache CurrentUnknownElementCache => _currentUnknownElementCache;

		public bool IsInAlternateContentChoice => _alternateContentChoiceContexts.Count != 0;

		public string NamespaceUriRaw => _xmlReader.NamespaceURI;

		public XmlReadManager(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			_alternateContentChoiceContexts = new Stack<AlternateContentChoiceContext>();
			CurrentElementAttributes = new List<AttributeValue>();
			_currentElementContextIndex = -1;
			_elementContexts = new ElementContext[16];
			_documentManager = partManager.DocumentManager;
			_partManager = partManager;
			_xmlReader = xmlReader;
		}

		public bool CanNamespaceBeIgnored(string namespaceUri)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= _currentElementContextIndex; i++)
			{
				if (_elementContexts[i].ContainsIgnorableNamespace(namespaceUri))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasParent(string strictName)
		{
			if (_loadChildContextStack.Count > 0 && strictName == _loadChildContextStack.Peek().ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public WorkItem LoadChildElements()
		{
			_elementsLoadedThisSlice = 0;
			return LoadChildElementsHelper(_loadChildContextStack.Count);
		}

		private WorkItem LoadChildElementsHelper(int startStackDepth, int currentChildIndex = 0, AlternateContentStatus alternateContentStatus = AlternateContentStatus.NotInAlternateContent, bool isContinuation = false, bool justPopped = false)
		{
			LoadChildContext stackContext;
			if (isContinuation)
			{
				stackContext = _loadChildContextStack.Pop();
			}
			else
			{
				stackContext = default(LoadChildContext);
				stackContext.CurrentChildIndex = currentChildIndex;
				stackContext.AlternateContentStatus = alternateContentStatus;
			}
			string text = null;
			while (true)
			{
				if (justPopped)
				{
					justPopped = false;
				}
				else
				{
					if (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.EndElement)
					{
						if (_loadChildContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
						{
							break;
						}
						stackContext = _loadChildContextStack.Pop();
						justPopped = true;
						continue;
					}
					stackContext.ElementName = MoveToNextElement();
					if (stackContext.ElementName.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (_loadChildContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
						{
							break;
						}
						stackContext = _loadChildContextStack.Pop();
						justPopped = true;
						continue;
					}
					PushElementContext();
					stackContext.ShouldIncrementChildIndex = true;
					stackContext.ShouldReadPastEndElement = true;
					stackContext.IsNormalElement = false;
					text = stackContext.ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager);
					WorkItem<bool> workItem = null;
					switch (text)
					{
					case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/AlternateContent":
						return LoadAlternateContentElement(stackContext.ElementName, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex).Then((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
						{
							if (stackContext.ShouldReadPastEndElement && !_xmlReader.Read())
							{
								if (_loadChildContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
								{
									return (WorkItem)null;
								}
								stackContext = _loadChildContextStack.Pop();
								justPopped = true;
							}
							else
							{
								if (stackContext.ShouldIncrementChildIndex)
								{
									stackContext.CurrentChildIndex++;
								}
								PopElementContext();
							}
							_loadChildContextStack.Push(stackContext);
							return WorkItem.Create(() => LoadChildElementsHelper(startStackDepth, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex, stackContext.AlternateContentStatus, isContinuation: true, justPopped), WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
						}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
					case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Choice":
						workItem = TryLoadChoiceElement(stackContext.ElementName, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex, stackContext.AlternateContentStatus);
						break;
					case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Fallback":
						workItem = TryLoadFallbackElement(stackContext.ElementName, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex, stackContext.AlternateContentStatus);
						break;
					default:
						stackContext.IsNormalElement = true;
						break;
					}
					if (workItem != null)
					{
						return workItem.Then(delegate(WorkItem<bool> t)
						{
							if (!t.GetResult())
							{
								stackContext.ShouldIncrementChildIndex = false;
								stackContext.ShouldReadPastEndElement = false;
							}
							else
							{
								stackContext.AlternateContentStatus = AlternateContentStatus.InAlternateContentChoiceAccepted;
							}
							if (stackContext.ShouldReadPastEndElement && !_xmlReader.Read())
							{
								if (_loadChildContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
								{
									return (WorkItem)null;
								}
								stackContext = _loadChildContextStack.Pop();
								justPopped = true;
							}
							else
							{
								if (stackContext.ShouldIncrementChildIndex)
								{
									stackContext.CurrentChildIndex++;
								}
								PopElementContext();
							}
							_loadChildContextStack.Push(stackContext);
							return WorkItem.Create(() => LoadChildElementsHelper(startStackDepth, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex, stackContext.AlternateContentStatus, isContinuation: true, justPopped), WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
						});
					}
					if (stackContext.IsNormalElement)
					{
						bool flag = false;
						stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks = _partManager.GetElementLoadCallbacks(text);
						if (stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.IsEmpty && LoadUnknownElementStructure(stackContext.ElementName, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex))
						{
							stackContext.ShouldReadPastEndElement = false;
							flag = true;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							bool isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
							ReadAttributesAndValue(stackContext.ElementName, includeNamespaceDeclarations: false);
							stackContext.IsEmptyElement = isEmptyElement;
							if (stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnElementLoaded != null)
							{
								CurrentElementName = stackContext.ElementName;
								CurrentElementIndex = stackContext.CurrentChildIndex;
								stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnElementLoaded(_partManager);
							}
							if (!stackContext.IsEmptyElement)
							{
								if (_partManager.ShouldLoadChildren(stackContext.ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager)))
								{
									if (_elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex].UseFastLoading)
									{
										return LoadChildElementsFast(_loadFastContextStack.Count).Then((Action)delegate
										{
										}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default).Then((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
										{
											_loadChildContextStack.Push(stackContext);
											return WorkItem.Create(() => LoadChildElementsHelper(startStackDepth, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex, stackContext.AlternateContentStatus, isContinuation: true, justPopped: true), WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
										}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
									}
									_loadChildContextStack.Push(stackContext);
									stackContext = default(LoadChildContext);
									stackContext.CurrentChildIndex = 0;
									stackContext.AlternateContentStatus = AlternateContentStatus.NotInAlternateContent;
									continue;
								}
								while (_xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
								{
									_xmlReader.Skip();
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (stackContext.IsNormalElement && stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnChildrenLoaded != null)
				{
					CurrentElementName = stackContext.ElementName;
					CurrentElementIndex = stackContext.CurrentChildIndex;
					stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnChildrenLoaded(_partManager);
				}
				if (stackContext.ShouldReadPastEndElement && !_xmlReader.Read())
				{
					if (_loadChildContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
					{
						break;
					}
					stackContext = _loadChildContextStack.Pop();
					justPopped = true;
					continue;
				}
				if (stackContext.ShouldIncrementChildIndex)
				{
					stackContext.CurrentChildIndex++;
				}
				PopElementContext();
				_elementsLoadedThisSlice++;
				if (1000 < _elementsLoadedThisSlice)
				{
					_elementsLoadedThisSlice = 0;
					_loadChildContextStack.Push(stackContext);
					return WorkItem.Create(() => LoadChildElementsHelper(startStackDepth, stackContext.CurrentChildIndex, stackContext.AlternateContentStatus, isContinuation: true, justPopped), WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private WorkItem LoadChildElementsFast(int startStackDepth, bool isContinuation = false, bool justPopped = false)
		{
			LoadFastContext stackContext = (isContinuation ? _loadFastContextStack.Pop() : default(LoadFastContext));
			string text = null;
			while (true)
			{
				if (!justPopped)
				{
					if (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.EndElement)
					{
						if (_loadFastContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
						{
							break;
						}
						stackContext = _loadFastContextStack.Pop();
						justPopped = true;
						continue;
					}
					stackContext.ElementName = MoveToNextElement();
					if (stackContext.ElementName.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (_loadFastContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
						{
							break;
						}
						stackContext = _loadFastContextStack.Pop();
						justPopped = true;
						continue;
					}
					PushElementContext();
					text = stackContext.ElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager);
				}
				if (!justPopped && text == "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/AlternateContent")
				{
					return LoadAlternateContentElement(stackContext.ElementName, 0).Then((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
					{
						if (!_xmlReader.Read())
						{
							if (_loadFastContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
							{
								return (WorkItem)null;
							}
							stackContext = _loadFastContextStack.Pop();
							justPopped = true;
						}
						else
						{
							stackContext.CurrentChildIndex++;
							PopElementContext();
						}
						_loadFastContextStack.Push(stackContext);
						return WorkItem.Create(() => LoadChildElementsFast(startStackDepth, isContinuation: true, justPopped), WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
					}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
				}
				if (justPopped)
				{
					justPopped = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks = _partManager.GetElementLoadCallbacks(text);
					bool isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
					ReadAttributesAndValue(stackContext.ElementName, includeNamespaceDeclarations: false);
					if (stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnElementLoaded != null)
					{
						CurrentElementName = stackContext.ElementName;
						CurrentElementIndex = stackContext.CurrentChildIndex;
						stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnElementLoaded(_partManager);
					}
					if (!isEmptyElement)
					{
						_loadFastContextStack.Push(stackContext);
						stackContext = default(LoadFastContext);
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnChildrenLoaded != null)
				{
					CurrentElementName = stackContext.ElementName;
					CurrentElementIndex = stackContext.CurrentChildIndex;
					stackContext.ElementLoadCallbacks.OnChildrenLoaded(_partManager);
				}
				if (!_xmlReader.Read())
				{
					if (_loadFastContextStack.Count == startStackDepth)
					{
						break;
					}
					stackContext = _loadFastContextStack.Pop();
					justPopped = true;
					continue;
				}
				stackContext.CurrentChildIndex++;
				PopElementContext();
				if (1000 >= ++_elementsLoadedThisSlice)
				{
					continue;
				}
				_elementsLoadedThisSlice = 0;
				_loadFastContextStack.Push(stackContext);
				return WorkItem.Create(() => LoadChildElementsFast(startStackDepth, isContinuation: true, justPopped), WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string LookupNamespace(string prefix)
		{
			return _xmlReader.LookupNamespace(prefix);
		}

		public void MarkCurrentAlternateContentChoiceUnsupported()
		{
			if (_alternateContentChoiceContexts.Count != 0)
			{
				_alternateContentChoiceContexts.Peek().IsUnsupported = true;
			}
		}

		public void UseFastLoadingForDescendants()
		{
			_elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex].UseFastLoading = true;
		}

		private void AddIgnorableAttributes(HashSet<string> ignorableAttirbutes, params string[] ignorablePrefixes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ignorablePrefixes.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = LookupNamespace(ignorablePrefixes[i]);
				if (text != null)
				{
					ignorableAttirbutes.Add(text);
				}
			}
		}

		private WorkItem LoadAlternateContentElement(QualifiedNameInfo elementName, int currentChildIndex)
		{
			bool isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
			ReadAttributesAndValue(elementName, includeNamespaceDeclarations: false);
			CurrentElementName = elementName;
			CurrentElementIndex = currentChildIndex;
			if (!isEmptyElement)
			{
				return LoadChildElementsHelper(_loadChildContextStack.Count, currentChildIndex, AlternateContentStatus.InAlternateContentPendingAcceptableChoice);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private UnknownElementCache LoadUnknownElementCache(QualifiedNameInfo elementName, out bool isEmptyElement)
		{
			isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
			ReadAttributesAndValue(elementName, includeNamespaceDeclarations: true, attributesWillBeCached: true);
			UnknownElementCache unknownElementCache = new UnknownElementCache(elementName, CurrentElementValue);
			if (CurrentElementAttributes.Count != 0)
			{
				unknownElementCache.Attributes.AddRange(CurrentElementAttributes);
			}
			return unknownElementCache;
		}

		private UnknownElementCache LoadUnknownElementChild(QualifiedNameInfo childElementName, int currentChildIndex)
		{
			PushElementContext();
			bool isEmptyElement;
			UnknownElementCache unknownElementCache = LoadUnknownElementCache(childElementName, out isEmptyElement);
			ElementLoadCallbacks elementLoadCallbacks = _partManager.GetElementLoadCallbacks(childElementName);
			if (elementLoadCallbacks.OnElementLoaded != null)
			{
				CurrentElementName = childElementName;
				CurrentElementIndex = currentChildIndex;
				_currentUnknownElementCache = unknownElementCache;
				elementLoadCallbacks.OnElementLoaded(_partManager);
				_currentUnknownElementCache = null;
			}
			if (!isEmptyElement)
			{
				if (_partManager.ShouldLoadChildren(childElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager)))
				{
					LoadUnknownElementChildren(unknownElementCache);
				}
				else
				{
					while (_xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
					{
						_xmlReader.Skip();
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementLoadCallbacks.OnChildrenLoaded != null)
			{
				CurrentElementName = childElementName;
				CurrentElementIndex = currentChildIndex;
				_currentUnknownElementCache = unknownElementCache;
				elementLoadCallbacks.OnChildrenLoaded(_partManager);
				_currentUnknownElementCache = null;
			}
			_partManager.OnUnknownStructureElementAndChildrenLoaded(unknownElementCache);
			PopElementContext();
			return unknownElementCache;
		}

		private void LoadUnknownElementChildren(UnknownElementCache parentElementCache)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (_xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
			{
				QualifiedNameInfo childElementName = MoveToNextElement();
				if (!childElementName.IsEmpty)
				{
					parentElementCache.Children.Add(LoadUnknownElementChild(childElementName, num));
					if (_xmlReader.Read())
					{
						num++;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool LoadUnknownElementStructure(QualifiedNameInfo elementName, int currentChildIndex)
		{
			string strictQualifiedName = elementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager);
			switch (_partManager.GetUnknownElementAction(strictQualifiedName))
			{
			default:
				_xmlReader.Skip();
				return true;
			case UnknownElementAction.CacheXml:
			{
				string xml = _xmlReader.ReadOuterXml();
				_partManager.OnUnknownXmlLoaded(strictQualifiedName, xml);
				return true;
			}
			case UnknownElementAction.CacheStructure:
			{
				UnknownElementCache rootElement = LoadUnknownElementChild(elementName, currentChildIndex);
				UnknownStructure unknownStructure = new UnknownStructure(rootElement);
				_partManager.OnUnknownStructureLoaded(unknownStructure);
				_xmlReader.Read();
				return true;
			}
			case UnknownElementAction.LoadChildrenNormally:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private QualifiedNameInfo MoveToNextElement()
		{
			switch (_xmlReader.NodeType)
			{
			case XmlNodeType.Element:
				return new QualifiedNameInfo(_xmlReader.Prefix, _xmlReader.NamespaceURI, _xmlReader.LocalName);
			case XmlNodeType.Comment:
			case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
			case XmlNodeType.XmlDeclaration:
				do
				{
					_xmlReader.Read();
				}
				while (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace || _xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.XmlDeclaration || _xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Comment);
				return MoveToNextElement();
			default:
				return QualifiedNameInfo.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void PopElementContext()
		{
			_partManager.ContextStack.ClearToCountOrCurrent(_elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex].OriginalContextStackCount, _elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex].OriginalContextStackCurrent);
			_elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex] = default(ElementContext);
			_currentElementContextIndex--;
		}

		private void PushElementContext()
		{
			_currentElementContextIndex++;
			while (_elementContexts.Length <= _currentElementContextIndex)
			{
				ElementContext[] array = new ElementContext[_elementContexts.Length * 2];
				Array.Copy(_elementContexts, array, _elementContexts.Length);
				_elementContexts = array;
			}
			_elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex] = new ElementContext(this);
		}

		private void ReadAttributesAndValue(QualifiedNameInfo elementNameInfo, bool includeNamespaceDeclarations, bool attributesWillBeCached = false)
		{
			CurrentElementAttributes.Clear();
			CurrentElementValue = null;
			bool isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
			if (_xmlReader.MoveToFirstAttribute())
			{
				do
				{
					string namespaceURI = _xmlReader.NamespaceURI;
					if (includeNamespaceDeclarations || !(namespaceURI == "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/") || (!(_xmlReader.LocalName == "xmlns") && !(_xmlReader.Prefix == "xmlns")))
					{
						AttributeValue item = new AttributeValue(_xmlReader.Prefix, namespaceURI, _xmlReader.LocalName, _xmlReader.Value);
						if (item.AttributeName.LocalName == "Ignorable" && item.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager) == "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Ignorable")
						{
							AddIgnorableAttributes(_elementContexts[_currentElementContextIndex].IgnorableNamespaces, item.Value.Split(new char[1] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries));
						}
						else
						{
							CurrentElementAttributes.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				while (_xmlReader.MoveToNextAttribute());
				_xmlReader.MoveToElement();
			}
			if (isEmptyElement || !_xmlReader.Read())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace && elementNameInfo.LocalName == "t" && elementNameInfo.GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager) == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/t")
			{
				CurrentElementValue = _xmlReader.Value;
				return;
			}
			while (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
			{
				_xmlReader.Read();
			}
			if (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.SignificantWhitespace || _xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Text)
			{
				CurrentElementValue = _xmlReader.Value;
				_xmlReader.Read();
			}
		}

		public string ResolveRawEntityName(string name)
		{
			int num = name.IndexOf(':');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return name;
			}
			string prefix = name.Substring(0, num);
			string localName = name.Substring(num + 1);
			string namespaceURI = LookupNamespace(prefix);
			return new QualifiedNameInfo(prefix, namespaceURI, localName).GetStrictQualifiedName(_documentManager);
		}

		private WorkItem<bool> TryLoadChoiceElement(QualifiedNameInfo elementName, int currentChildIndex, AlternateContentStatus alternateContentStatus)
		{
			if (alternateContentStatus != AlternateContentStatus.InAlternateContentPendingAcceptableChoice)
			{
				_xmlReader.Skip();
				return WorkItem.FromResult(result: false);
			}
			bool isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
			ReadAttributesAndValue(elementName, includeNamespaceDeclarations: false);
			CurrentElementName = elementName;
			CurrentElementIndex = currentChildIndex;
			MarkupCompatibility2006.ReadChoiceElement(_partManager, out var requiresValue);
			if (!_partManager.ShouldLoadAlternateContentChoice(requiresValue))
			{
				while (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					_xmlReader.Skip();
					if (_xmlReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
					{
						_xmlReader.Skip();
					}
				}
				_xmlReader.Read();
				return WorkItem.FromResult(result: false);
			}
			bool result = true;
			return Async.If(!isEmptyElement, delegate
			{
				_alternateContentChoiceContexts.Push(new AlternateContentChoiceContext());
				WorkItem result2 = LoadChildElementsHelper(_loadChildContextStack.Count);
				AlternateContentChoiceContext alternateContentChoiceContext = _alternateContentChoiceContexts.Pop();
				if (alternateContentChoiceContext.IsUnsupported)
				{
					_xmlReader.Read();
					result = false;
				}
				return result2;
			}).Then(() => result);
		}

		private WorkItem<bool> TryLoadFallbackElement(QualifiedNameInfo elementName, int currentChildIndex, AlternateContentStatus alternateContentStatus)
		{
			if (alternateContentStatus != AlternateContentStatus.InAlternateContentPendingAcceptableChoice)
			{
				_xmlReader.Skip();
				return WorkItem.FromResult(result: false);
			}
			bool isEmptyElement = _xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
			ReadAttributesAndValue(elementName, includeNamespaceDeclarations: false);
			CurrentElementName = elementName;
			CurrentElementIndex = currentChildIndex;
			return Async.If(!isEmptyElement, () => LoadChildElementsHelper(_loadChildContextStack.Count)).Then(() => true);
		}
	}
	internal struct ST_AdjAngle
	{
		private readonly ST_Angle? _value1;

		private readonly ST_GeomGuideName? _value2;

		internal ST_GeomGuideName? GuideName => _value2;

		internal ST_Angle? Angle => _value1;

		internal ST_AdjAngle(string guideName)
		{
			_value1 = null;
			_value2 = new ST_GeomGuideName(guideName);
		}

		internal ST_AdjAngle(ST_Angle angle)
		{
			_value1 = angle;
			_value2 = null;
		}

		internal static ST_AdjAngle Parse(string value)
		{
			ST_Angle? sT_Angle = ST_Angle.TryParse(value);
			if (sT_Angle.HasValue)
			{
				return new ST_AdjAngle(sT_Angle.Value);
			}
			return new ST_AdjAngle(value);
		}

		internal static string ToString(ST_AdjAngle instance)
		{
			if (instance.Angle.HasValue)
			{
				return instance.Angle.Value.ToString();
			}
			if (instance.GuideName.HasValue)
			{
				return instance.GuideName.Value.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal struct ST_AdjCoordinate
	{
		private readonly ST_Coordinate? _value1;

		private readonly ST_GeomGuideName? _value2;

		internal ST_GeomGuideName? GuideName => _value2;

		internal ST_Coordinate? Coordinate => _value1;

		internal ST_AdjCoordinate(string guideName)
		{
			_value1 = null;
			_value2 = new ST_GeomGuideName(guideName);
		}

		internal ST_AdjCoordinate(ST_Coordinate coordinate)
		{
			_value1 = coordinate;
			_value2 = null;
		}

		internal static ST_AdjCoordinate Parse(string value)
		{
			ST_Coordinate? sT_Coordinate = ST_Coordinate.TryParse(value);
			if (sT_Coordinate.HasValue)
			{
				return new ST_AdjCoordinate(sT_Coordinate.Value);
			}
			return new ST_AdjCoordinate(value);
		}

		internal static string ToString(ST_AdjCoordinate instance)
		{
			if (instance.Coordinate.HasValue)
			{
				return instance.Coordinate.Value.ToString();
			}
			if (instance.GuideName.HasValue)
			{
				return instance.GuideName.Value.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent
	{
		private readonly bool _isDecimal;

		private readonly ST_Percentage _value;

		public ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent(ST_Percentage value, bool isDecimal = false)
		{
			_isDecimal = isDecimal;
			_value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent? sT_DecimalNumberOrPercent = obj as ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent?;
			if (sT_DecimalNumberOrPercent.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_DecimalNumberOrPercent.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(ST_ConformanceClass.transitional);
		}

		public string ToString(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (_isDecimal)
			{
				return ((double)_value).ToString();
			}
			return _value.ToString(conformance);
		}

		public double GetDoubleValue(out bool isDecimal)
		{
			isDecimal = _isDecimal;
			return _value;
		}

		public static ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent? TryParse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			ST_DecimalNumber? sT_DecimalNumber = ST_DecimalNumber.TryParse(value);
			if (sT_DecimalNumber.HasValue)
			{
				return new ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent(new ST_Percentage((int)sT_DecimalNumber.GetValueOrDefault()), isDecimal: true);
			}
			ST_Percentage? sT_Percentage = ST_Percentage.TryParse(value, conformance);
			if (sT_Percentage.HasValue)
			{
				return new ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent(sT_Percentage.GetValueOrDefault());
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent a, ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent b)
		{
			return a._value == b._value;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent a, ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

	internal struct ST_HexColor
	{
		private readonly ST_HexColorRGB? _value1;

		private readonly ST_HexColorAuto? _value2;

		public bool IsAuto => _value2.HasValue;

		public bool IsRGB => _value1.HasValue;

		public ST_HexColor(ST_HexColorRGB value)
		{
			_value1 = value;
			_value2 = null;
		}

		public ST_HexColor(ST_HexColorAuto value)
		{
			_value1 = null;
			_value2 = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_HexColor? sT_HexColor = obj as ST_HexColor?;
			if (sT_HexColor.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_HexColor.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static ST_HexColor Parse(string value)
		{
			ST_HexColor? sT_HexColor = TryParse(value);
			if (sT_HexColor.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_HexColor.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_HexColor>(value);
		}

		public static ST_HexColor? TryParse(string value)
		{
			return ((ST_HexColor?)ST_HexColorAuto.TryParse(value)) ?? ((ST_HexColor?)ST_HexColorRGB.TryParse(value));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().ToString();
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_HexColor a, ST_HexColor b)
		{
			if (a._value1 == b._value1)
			{
				ST_HexColorAuto? value = a._value2;
				ST_HexColorAuto? value2 = b._value2;
				if (value.HasValue != value2.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!value.HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return value.GetValueOrDefault() == value2.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_HexColor a, ST_HexColor b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		{
			return new ST_HexColor(value);
		}

		public static explicit operator ST_HexColorRGB(ST_HexColor value)
		{
			return value._value1.Value;
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_HexColor(ST_HexColorAuto value)
		{
			return new ST_HexColor(value);
		}

	internal struct ST_HexColorRGB
	{
		internal static readonly ST_HexColorRGB Empty;

		private readonly byte _r;

		private readonly byte _g;

		private readonly byte _b;

		public Color Color => Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, _r, _g, _b);

		public ST_HexColorRGB(Color color)
			: this(color.R, color.G, color.B)
		{
		}

		public ST_HexColorRGB(byte r, byte g, byte b)
		{
			_r = r;
			_g = g;
			_b = b;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_HexColorRGB? sT_HexColorRGB = obj as ST_HexColorRGB?;
			if (sT_HexColorRGB.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_HexColorRGB.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (_r << 16) | (_g << 8) | _b;
		}

		public static ST_HexColorRGB Parse(string value)
		{
			ST_HexColorRGB? sT_HexColorRGB = TryParse(value);
			if (sT_HexColorRGB.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_HexColorRGB.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_HexColorRGB>(value);
		}

		public static ST_HexColorRGB? TryParse(string value)
		{
			if (!int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte r = (byte)((result & 0xFF0000) >> 16);
			byte g = (byte)((result & 0xFF00) >> 8);
			byte b = (byte)(result & 0xFF);
			return new ST_HexColorRGB(r, g, b);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _r.ToString("X2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + _g.ToString("X2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + _b.ToString("X2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_HexColorRGB a, ST_HexColorRGB b)
		{
			if (a._b == b._b && a._g == b._g)
			{
				return a._r == b._r;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_HexColorRGB a, ST_HexColorRGB b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator Color(ST_HexColorRGB value)
		{
			return value.Color;
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_HexColorRGB(Color value)
		{
			return new ST_HexColorRGB(value.R, value.G, value.B);
		}

		public string ToXLSX()
		{
			return ToString();
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_MeasurementOrPercent
	{
		private readonly ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent? _value1;

		private readonly ST_UniversalMeasure? _value2;

		public bool IsUniversalMeasure => _value2.HasValue;

		public ST_MeasurementOrPercent(ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent value)
		{
			_value1 = value;
			_value2 = null;
		}

		public ST_MeasurementOrPercent(ST_UniversalMeasure value)
		{
			_value1 = null;
			_value2 = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_MeasurementOrPercent? sT_MeasurementOrPercent = obj as ST_MeasurementOrPercent?;
			if (sT_MeasurementOrPercent.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_MeasurementOrPercent.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().GetHashCode();
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().GetHashCode() << 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(ST_ConformanceClass.strict);
		}

		public string ToString(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().ToString(conformance);
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public double? GetDoubleValue(out bool isDecimal)
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.GetValueOrDefault().GetDoubleValue(out isDecimal);
			}
			isDecimal = true;
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.GetValueOrDefault().GetDoubleValue();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static ST_MeasurementOrPercent Parse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent? sT_DecimalNumberOrPercent = ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent.TryParse(value, conformance);
			if (sT_DecimalNumberOrPercent.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_DecimalNumberOrPercent.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			ST_UniversalMeasure? sT_UniversalMeasure = ST_UniversalMeasure.TryParse(value);
			if (sT_UniversalMeasure.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_UniversalMeasure.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_MeasurementOrPercent>(value);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_MeasurementOrPercent a, ST_MeasurementOrPercent b)
		{
			if (a._value1 != b._value1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!a._value2.HasValue)
			{
				return !b._value2.HasValue;
			}
			if (!b._value2.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ST_UniversalMeasure.AreEqual(a._value2.Value, b._value2.Value);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_MeasurementOrPercent a, ST_MeasurementOrPercent b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_MeasurementOrPercent(ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent value)
		{
			return new ST_MeasurementOrPercent(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_MeasurementOrPercent(ST_UniversalMeasure value)
		{
			return new ST_MeasurementOrPercent(value);
		}
	}

	{
		internal static readonly ST_OnOff False = new ST_OnOff(value: false);

		internal static readonly ST_OnOff True = new ST_OnOff(value: true);

		private readonly bool _value;

		public ST_OnOff(bool value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public static bool ParseBool(string value)
		{
			if (!(value == "1"))
			{
				if (value == "0")
				{
					return false;
				}
				return bool.Parse(value);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!_value)
			{
				return "0";
			}
			return "1";
		}

		public static string ToString(bool value)
		{
			if (!value)
			{
				return "0";
			}
			return "1";
		}

		public static ST_OnOff FromBool(bool value)
		{
			if (!value)
			{
				return False;
			}
			return True;
		}

		public bool ToBool()
		{
			return _value;
		}
	}
	internal class ST_Panose
	{
		private readonly byte[] _value;

		public ST_Panose(byte[] value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Concat(_value.Select((byte v) => v.ToString("X2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).ToArray());
		}

		public static ST_Panose Parse(string value)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[value.Length / 2];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = value[i * 2];
				char c2 = value[i * 2 + 1];
				array[i] = (byte)((Utilities.GetHexValue(c) << 4) | Utilities.GetHexValue(c2));
			}
			return new ST_Panose(array);
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_Percentage
	{
		private readonly double _value;

		public ST_Percentage(double value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ST_Percentage? sT_Percentage = obj as ST_Percentage?;
			if (sT_Percentage.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == sT_Percentage.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(ST_ConformanceClass.strict);
		}

		public string ToString(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional || conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.strict)
			{
				return ((int)Utilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(_value * 1000.0)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return _value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "%";
		}

		public static ST_Percentage Parse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			ST_Percentage? sT_Percentage = TryParse(value, conformance);
			if (sT_Percentage.HasValue)
			{
				return sT_Percentage.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_Percentage>(value);
		}

		public static ST_Percentage? TryParse(string value, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (conformance == ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
			{
				goto IL_001e;
			}
			if (conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.strict)
			{
				return null;
			}
			goto IL_0061;
			IL_001e:
			if (value[value.Length - 1] != '%')
			{
				if (!int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new ST_Percentage((double)result / 1000.0);
			}
			goto IL_0061;
			IL_0061:
			if (value[value.Length - 1] == '%')
			{
				if (!double.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1), NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result2))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return result2;
			}
			goto IL_001e;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ST_Percentage a, ST_Percentage b)
		{
			return a._value == b._value;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ST_Percentage a, ST_Percentage b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_Percentage(double value)
		{
			return new ST_Percentage(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator double(ST_Percentage value)
		{
			return value._value;
		}

		public static double ToFraction(ST_Percentage value)
		{
			return value._value / 100.0;
		}

		public static ST_Percentage FromFraction(double fraction)
		{
			return new ST_Percentage(fraction * 100.0);
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_SignedHpsMeasure
	{
		private readonly int? _value1;

		private readonly ST_UniversalMeasure? _value2;

		public ST_SignedHpsMeasure(double points)
		{
			_value1 = (int)(points * 2.0);
			_value2 = null;
		}

		public ST_SignedHpsMeasure(ST_UniversalMeasure value)
		{
			_value1 = null;
			_value2 = value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public double GetTwips()
		{
			if (_value1.HasValue)
			{
				return _value1.Value * 10;
			}
			if (_value2.HasValue)
			{
				return _value2.Value.GetTwips();
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public static ST_SignedHpsMeasure Parse(string value)
		{
			if (int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return new ST_SignedHpsMeasure(result / 2);
			}
			ST_UniversalMeasure? sT_UniversalMeasure = ST_UniversalMeasure.TryParse(value);
			if (sT_UniversalMeasure.HasValue)
			{
				return new ST_SignedHpsMeasure(sT_UniversalMeasure.Value);
			}
			throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_SignedHpsMeasure>(value);
		}
	}

	internal struct ST_TrueFalse
	{
		internal static readonly ST_TrueFalse False = new ST_TrueFalse(value: false);

		internal static readonly ST_TrueFalse True = new ST_TrueFalse(value: true);

		private readonly bool _value;

		public ST_TrueFalse(bool value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public static ST_TrueFalse Parse(string value)
		{
			if (!(value == "t"))
			{
				if (value == "f")
				{
					return false;
				}
				return bool.Parse(value);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!_value)
			{
				return "f";
			}
			return "t";
		}

		public static string ToString(ST_TrueFalse value)
		{
			return value.ToString();
		}

		public static implicit operator bool(ST_TrueFalse value)
		{
			return value._value;
		}

		public static implicit operator ST_TrueFalse(bool value)
		{
			return new ST_TrueFalse(value);
		}
	}
	internal struct ST_TrueFalseBlank
	{
		public static readonly ST_TrueFalseBlank False = new ST_TrueFalseBlank(value: false);

		public static readonly ST_TrueFalseBlank True = new ST_TrueFalseBlank(value: true);

		private readonly bool _value;

		public ST_TrueFalseBlank(bool value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public static bool ParseBool(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (value)
			{
			case "t":
			case "True":
				return true;
			case "f":
			case "False":
				return false;
			default:
				throw Utilities.CreateFormatException<ST_TrueFalseBlank>(value);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_value)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return "False";
		}

		public static string ToString(ST_TrueFalseBlank value)
		{
			return value.ToString();
		}

		public static string ToString(bool value)
		{
			return (value ? True : False).ToString();
		}
	}
