	internal class XmlWriteManager
	{
		private readonly OfficeDocumentManager _documentManager;

		private readonly List<string> _ignorablePrefixes;

		private readonly XmlPartManagerBase _partManager;

		private readonly XmlWriter _writer;

		public XmlWriteManager(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			_ignorablePrefixes = new List<string>();
			_documentManager = partManager.DocumentManager;
			_partManager = partManager;
			_writer = writer;
		}

		public string LookupPrefix(XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase namespaceDefinition)
		{
			return _writer.LookupPrefix(namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(_documentManager.Conformance));
		}

		private void ParseQualifiedName(string strictQualifiedName, out string prefix, out string localName, out string namespaceName)
		{
			int num = strictQualifiedName.LastIndexOf('/');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				localName = strictQualifiedName;
				namespaceName = "";
				prefix = string.Empty;
				return;
			}
			localName = strictQualifiedName.Substring(num + 1);
			namespaceName = strictQualifiedName.Substring(0, num);
			if (_documentManager.Conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.strict)
			{
				XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase namespaceDefinition = _documentManager.GetNamespaceDefinition(namespaceName);
				if (namespaceDefinition != null)
				{
					namespaceName = namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(_documentManager.Conformance);
				}
			}
			prefix = _writer.LookupPrefix(namespaceName);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
			{
				string text = namespaceName + "/";
				prefix = _writer.LookupPrefix(text);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
				{
					namespaceName = text;
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIgnorableAttribute()
		{
			if (_ignorablePrefixes.Count != 0)
			{
				WriteNamespaceDeclaration(MarkupCompatibility2006.Instance);
				WriteAttribute("http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Ignorable", string.Join(" ", _ignorablePrefixes));
				_ignorablePrefixes.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void WriteAlternateContentElement(IEnumerable<AlternateContentChoice> choices, Action fallbackContent = null, bool closeElement = true)
		{
			if (choices != null)
			{
				HashSet<XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase> hashSet = new HashSet<XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase>();
				foreach (AlternateContentChoice choice in choices)
				{
					foreach (XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase item in choice.RequiredNamespaces.Where((XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase n) => LookupPrefix(n) == null))
					{
						hashSet.Add(item);
					}
				}
				MarkupCompatibility2006.WriteAlternateContentElement(_partManager);
				foreach (XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase item2 in hashSet)
				{
					WriteNamespaceDeclaration(item2);
				}
				foreach (AlternateContentChoice choice2 in choices)
				{
					MarkupCompatibility2006.WriteChoiceElement(_partManager, choice2.RequiredNamespaces);
					choice2.ChoiceContent();
					WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
			if (fallbackContent != null)
			{
				MarkupCompatibility2006.WriteFallbackElement(_partManager);
				fallbackContent();
				WriteEndElement();
			}
			if (closeElement)
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string strictAttributeName, string value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				ParseQualifiedName(strictAttributeName, out var prefix, out var localName, out var namespaceName);
				WriteAttribute(prefix, localName, namespaceName, value);
			}
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string prefix, string localName, string namespaceUri, string value)
		{
			_writer.WriteAttributeString(prefix, localName, namespaceUri, value);
		}

		public void WriteAttributeLocal(string localName, string value)
		{
			_writer.WriteAttributeString(localName, value);
		}

		public void WriteEndElement()
		{
			VerifyIgnorableAttribute();
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public void WriteStartElement(string strictAttributeName)
		{
			WriteStartElement(strictAttributeName, null);
		}

		public void WriteStartElement(string strictElementName, string defaultPrefix)
		{
			ParseQualifiedName(strictElementName, out var prefix, out var localName, out var namespaceName);
			WriteStartElement(prefix ?? defaultPrefix, localName, namespaceName);
		}

		public void WriteStartElement(string prefix, string localName, string namespaceUri)
		{
			VerifyIgnorableAttribute();
			_writer.WriteStartElement(prefix, localName, namespaceUri);
		}

		public void WriteStartElementLocal(string localName)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(localName);
		}

		public void WriteNamespaceDeclaration(XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase namespaceDefinition, bool isIgnorable = false)
		{
			WriteNamespaceDeclaration(namespaceDefinition.NamespacePrefix, namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(_documentManager.Conformance), isIgnorable);
		}

		private void WriteNamespaceDeclaration(string namespacePrefix, string strictNamespaceUri, bool isIgnorable = false)
		{
			string value = strictNamespaceUri;
			if (_documentManager.Conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.strict)
			{
				XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase namespaceDefinition = _documentManager.GetNamespaceDefinition(strictNamespaceUri);
				if (namespaceDefinition != null)
				{
					value = namespaceDefinition.GetNamespaceUri(_documentManager.Conformance);
				}
			}
			_writer.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", namespacePrefix, "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/", value);
			if (isIgnorable)
			{
				_ignorablePrefixes.Add(namespacePrefix);
			}
		}

		public void WriteRawXml(string xml)
		{
			VerifyIgnorableAttribute();
			_writer.WriteRaw(xml);
		}

		public void WriteUnknownStructure(UnknownStructure unknownStructure)
		{
			VerifyIgnorableAttribute();
			Stack<UnknownElementCache> ancestorStack = new Stack<UnknownElementCache>();
			WriteUnknownElement(unknownStructure.RootElement, ancestorStack);
		}

		private void WriteUnknownElement(UnknownElementCache elementData, Stack<UnknownElementCache> ancestorStack)
		{
			switch (_partManager.TryOverwriteRoundTripData(elementData, ancestorStack))
			{
			default:
			{
				QualifiedNameInfo qualifiedNameInfo = elementData.ElementName.ToCurrentConformance(_documentManager);
				WriteStartElement(qualifiedNameInfo.Prefix, qualifiedNameInfo.LocalName, qualifiedNameInfo.NamespaceURI);
				if (elementData.HasAttributes)
				{
					foreach (AttributeValue attribute in elementData.Attributes)
					{
						QualifiedNameInfo qualifiedNameInfo2 = attribute.AttributeName.ToCurrentConformance(_documentManager);
						WriteAttribute(qualifiedNameInfo2.Prefix, qualifiedNameInfo2.LocalName, qualifiedNameInfo2.NamespaceURI, attribute.Value);
					}
				}
				if (elementData.Value != null)
				{
					WriteValue(elementData.Value);
				}
				break;
			}
			case OverwriteRoundTripDataResult.ElementStartWritten:
				break;
			case OverwriteRoundTripDataResult.ElementAndDescendantsWritten:
				return;
			}
			if (elementData.HasChildren)
			{
				ancestorStack.Push(elementData);
				foreach (UnknownElementCache child in elementData.Children)
				{
					WriteUnknownElement(child, ancestorStack);
				}
				ancestorStack.Pop();
			}
			WriteEndElement();
		}

		public void WriteValue(string value)
		{
			VerifyIgnorableAttribute();
			_writer.WriteString(value);
		}

		public void WriteXmlDeclaration(string version, string encoding, string standalone)
		{
			VerifyIgnorableAttribute();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("version=\"" + version + "\"");
			if (encoding.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" encoding=\"");
				stringBuilder.Append(encoding);
				stringBuilder.Append("\"");
			}
			if (standalone.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" standalone=\"");
				stringBuilder.Append(standalone);
				stringBuilder.Append("\"");
			}
			string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			_writer.WriteProcessingInstruction("xml", text);
		}
	}
	internal interface ISaveToXLSX
	{
		string ElementName { get; }

		void Save(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, XmlWriteManager writer, string elementName, object saveManager = null);
	}
	internal interface ISupportSetProperty
	{
		void SetProperty(ElementPropertyIds propId, object value);
	}

	internal sealed class BmpPartManager : ImagePartManagerBase
	{
		public const string ContentTypeValue = "image/bmp";

		public const string BaseExcelPartNameValue = "/xl/media/image.bmp";

		public const string BasePowerPointPartNameValue = "/ppt/media/image.bmp";

		public const string BaseWordPartNameValue = "/word/media/image.bmp";

		public const string BaseDibExcelPartNameValue = "/xl/media/image.dib";

		public const string BaseDibPowerPointPartNameValue = "/ppt/media/image.dib";

		public const string BaseDibWordPartNameValue = "/word/media/image.dib";

		public static readonly BmpPartManager BmpInstance = new BmpPartManager(isDib: false);

		public static readonly BmpPartManager DibInstance = new BmpPartManager(isDib: true);

		private readonly bool _isDib;

		public override string BaseExcelPartName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isDib)
				{
					return "/xl/media/image.bmp";
				}
				return "/xl/media/image.dib";
			}
		}

		public override string BasePowerPointPartName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isDib)
				{
					return "/ppt/media/image.bmp";
				}
				return "/ppt/media/image.dib";
			}
		}

		public override string BaseWordPartName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isDib)
				{
					return "/word/media/image.bmp";
				}
				return "/word/media/image.dib";
			}
		}

		public sealed override string ContentType => "image/bmp";

		private BmpPartManager(bool isDib)
		{
			_isDib = isDib;
		}

		public override ImageFormat GetFormat(string partFileName)
		{
			string extension = Path.GetExtension(partFileName);
			if (extension.ToLowerInvariant() == ".dib")
			{
				return ImageFormat.Dib;
			}
			return ImageFormat.Bmp;
		}
	}

		private static void ApplyColoChoiceToCurrent(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, EG_ColorChoice colorChoice)
		{
			CT_Color cT_Color = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_Color>();
			if (cT_Color != null)
			{
				cT_Color.Value = colorChoice;
				return;
			}
			CT_SolidFillProperties cT_SolidFillProperties = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_SolidFillProperties>();
			if (cT_SolidFillProperties != null)
			{
				cT_SolidFillProperties.Value = colorChoice;
				return;
			}
			CT_StyleMatrixReference cT_StyleMatrixReference = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_StyleMatrixReference>();
			if (cT_StyleMatrixReference != null)
			{
				cT_StyleMatrixReference.Color = colorChoice;
				return;
			}
			CT_FontReference cT_FontReference = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_FontReference>();
			if (cT_FontReference != null)
			{
				cT_FontReference.Color = colorChoice;
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyFillOrLineFillProperties<T>(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, T fillProperties) where T : IEG_FillProperties, IEG_LineFillProperties
		{
			if (partManager.ContextStack.Current is CT_LineProperties cT_LineProperties)
			{
				cT_LineProperties.Fill = fillProperties;
			}
			else if (partManager.ContextStack.Current is CT_ShapePropertiesBase cT_ShapePropertiesBase)
			{
				cT_ShapePropertiesBase.Fill = fillProperties;
			}
			else if (partManager.ContextStack.Current is CT_TextCharacterProperties cT_TextCharacterProperties)
			{
				cT_TextCharacterProperties.Fill = fillProperties;
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyFillProperties<T>(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, T fillProperties) where T : IEG_FillProperties
		{
			if (partManager.ContextStack.Current is CT_ShapePropertiesBase cT_ShapePropertiesBase)
			{
				cT_ShapePropertiesBase.Fill = fillProperties;
			}
		}

		private static void LoadBlipFillElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			CT_Picture cT_Picture = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_Picture>();
			if (cT_Picture != null)
			{
				partManager.DocumentManager.DrawingPropertiesNamespace.ReadBlipFillElement(partManager, out var dpiValue, out var rotWithShapeValue);
				CT_BlipFillProperties context = (cT_Picture.BlipFill = new CT_BlipFillProperties
				{
					Dpi = dpiValue,
					RotWithShape = rotWithShapeValue
				});
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(context);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawingMLMain.ReadBlipFillElement(partManager, out var dpiValue2, out var rotWithShapeValue2);
				CT_BlipFillProperties cT_BlipFillProperties2 = new CT_BlipFillProperties
				{
					Dpi = dpiValue2,
					RotWithShape = rotWithShapeValue2
				};
				ApplyFillProperties(partManager, cT_BlipFillProperties2);
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(cT_BlipFillProperties2);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadBodyPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			CT_TextBody cT_TextBody = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_TextBody>();
			if (cT_TextBody != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.ReadBodyPrElement(partManager, out var rotValue, out var spcFirstLastParaValue, out var vertOverflowValue, out var horzOverflowValue, out var vertValue, out var wrapValue, out var lInsValue, out var tInsValue, out var rInsValue, out var bInsValue, out var numColValue, out var spcColValue, out var rtlColValue, out var fromWordArtValue, out var anchorValue, out var anchorCtrValue, out var forceAAValue, out var uprightValue, out var compatLnSpcValue);
				cT_TextBody.BodyProperties = new CT_TextBodyProperties
				{
					Rotation = rotValue,
					ParagraphSpacing = spcFirstLastParaValue,
					TextVerticalOverflow = vertOverflowValue,
					TextHorizontalOverflow = horzOverflowValue,
					VerticalText = vertValue,
					TextWrappingType = wrapValue,
					LeftInset = lInsValue,
					TopInset = tInsValue,
					RightInset = rInsValue,
					BottomInset = bInsValue,
					NumberOfColumns = numColValue,
					SpaceBetweenColumns = spcColValue,
					ColumnsRightToLeft = rtlColValue,
					FromWordArt = fromWordArtValue,
					Anchor = anchorValue,
					AnchorCenter = anchorCtrValue,
					ForceAntiAlias = forceAAValue,
					TextUpright = uprightValue,
					CompatibleLineSpacing = compatLnSpcValue
				};
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(cT_TextBody.BodyProperties);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadChartElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			CT_GraphicalObjectData cT_GraphicalObjectData = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_GraphicalObjectData>();
			if (cT_GraphicalObjectData != null)
			{
				DrawingMLChart.ReadChartElement(partManager, out var idValue);
				string item = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/chart/chart";
				if (cT_GraphicalObjectData.Uri == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2014/chartex")
				{
					item = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2014/chartex/chart";
				}
				cT_GraphicalObjectData.ContentByStrictElementName.Add(Tuple.Create(item, (object)new CT_RelId
				{
					Id = idValue
				}));
			}
		}

		private static void LoadChartElementEx(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)

			CT_GraphicalObjectData cT_GraphicalObjectData = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_GraphicalObjectData>();

				DrawingMLChart2014.ReadChartElement(partManager, out var idValue);
				cT_GraphicalObjectData.ContentByStrictElementName.Add(Tuple.Create("http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2014/chartex/chart", (object)new CT_RelId
				{
					Id = idValue
				}));
			}
		}

		private static void LoadGdElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			CT_GeomGuideList cT_GeomGuideList = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_GeomGuideList>();
			if (cT_GeomGuideList != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.ReadGdElement(partManager, out var nameValue, out var fmlaValue);
				CT_GeomGuide cT_GeomGuide = new CT_GeomGuide
				{
					Name = nameValue,
					Fmla = fmlaValue

		}

			if (cT_ShapeProperties != null || cT_TextCharacterProperties != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.ReadLnElement(partManager, out var wValue, out var capValue, out var cmpdValue, out var algnValue);
				CT_LineProperties cT_LineProperties = new CT_LineProperties
				{
					W = wValue,
					Cap = capValue,
					Cmpd = cmpdValue,
					Algn = algnValue
				};
				if (cT_ShapeProperties != null)
				{
					cT_ShapeProperties.Ln = cT_LineProperties;
				}
				else
				{
					cT_TextCharacterProperties.Ln = cT_LineProperties;
				}
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(cT_LineProperties);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadSpElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			IShapesOwner shapesOwner = partManager.ContextStack.Get<IShapesOwner>();
			partManager.DocumentManager.DrawingPropertiesNamespace.ReadSpElement(partManager, out var macroValue, out var textlinkValue, out var fLocksTextValue, out var fPublishedValue);
			CT_Shape cT_Shape = new CT_Shape
			{
				Macro = macroValue,
				Textlink = textlinkValue,
				FLocksText = fLocksTextValue,
				FPublished = fPublishedValue
			};
			shapesOwner?.AddShape(partManager.DocumentManager, cT_Shape);
			partManager.ContextStack.Push(cT_Shape);
		}

		private static void LoadXfrmElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			CT_GraphicalObjectFrame cT_GraphicalObjectFrame = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_GraphicalObjectFrame>();
			ST_Angle rotValue;
			bool flipHValue;
			bool flipVValue;
			if (cT_GraphicalObjectFrame != null)
			{
				partManager.DocumentManager.DrawingPropertiesNamespace.ReadXfrmElement(partManager, out rotValue, out flipHValue, out flipVValue);
				CT_Transform2D context = (cT_GraphicalObjectFrame.Xfrm = new CT_Transform2D
				{
					Rotation = rotValue,
					HorizontalFlip = flipHValue,
					VerticalFlip = flipVValue
				});
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(context);
				return;
			}
			DrawingMLMain.ReadXfrmElement(partManager, out rotValue, out flipHValue, out flipVValue);
			CT_ShapeProperties cT_ShapeProperties = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_ShapeProperties>();
			if (cT_ShapeProperties != null)
			{
				CT_Transform2D context2 = (cT_ShapeProperties.Xfrm = new CT_Transform2D
				{
					Rotation = rotValue,
					HorizontalFlip = flipHValue,
					VerticalFlip = flipVValue
				});
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(context2);
				return;
			}
			CT_GroupShapeProperties cT_GroupShapeProperties = partManager.ContextStack.Get<CT_GroupShapeProperties>();
			if (cT_GroupShapeProperties != null)
			{
				CT_GroupTransform2D context3 = (cT_GroupShapeProperties.Xfrm = new CT_GroupTransform2D
				{
					Rotation = rotValue,
					HorizontalFlip = flipHValue,
					VerticalFlip = flipVValue
				});
				partManager.ContextStack.Push(context3);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveAlphaElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ColorTransform_Alpha alpha)
		{
			if (alpha != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.WriteAlphaElement(partManager, alpha.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveAlphaModElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ColorTransform_AlphaMod alphaMod)
		{
			if (alphaMod != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.WriteAlphaModElement(partManager, alphaMod.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveAlphaOffElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ColorTransform_AlphaOff alphaOff)
		{
			if (alphaOff != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.WriteAlphaOffElement(partManager, alphaOff.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveAlternateContentElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, AlternateGraphicalObjectContent alternateContent)
		{
			if (alternateContent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAlternateContentElement(alternateContent.ChoicesByRequiredNamespaces.Select((Tuple<XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase[], IGraphicalObjectContent> c) => new AlternateContentChoice(c.Item1, delegate
			{
				c.Item2.Accept(DrawingSerializationHelper.Instance, partManager);
			})), (alternateContent.FallbackContent == null) ? null : ((Action)delegate
			{
				alternateContent.FallbackContent.Accept(DrawingSerializationHelper.Instance, partManager);
			}));
		}

		private static void SaveAvLstElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_GeomGuideList geomGuideList)
		{
			if (geomGuideList != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.WriteAvLstElement(partManager);
				geomGuideList.Gd.ForEach(partManager.SaveGdElement);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveBlipElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_Blip blip)
		{
			if (blip == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DrawingMLMain.WriteBlipElement(partManager, blip.Embed, blip.Link, blip.CState);
			if (blip.ClrFrom != null || blip.ClrTo != null)
			{
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/clrChange");
				if (blip.ClrFrom != null && blip.ClrFrom.Value != null)
				{
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/clrFrom");
					blip.ClrFrom.Value.Accept(DrawingSerializationHelper.Instance, partManager);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (blip.ClrTo != null && blip.ClrTo.Value != null)
				{
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/clrTo");
					blip.ClrTo.Value.Accept(DrawingSerializationHelper.Instance, partManager);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void SaveBlipFillElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_BlipFillProperties blipFillProperties, bool isForCT_Picture = false)
		{
			if (blipFillProperties != null)
			{
				if (isForCT_Picture)
				{
					partManager.DocumentManager.DrawingPropertiesNamespace.WriteBlipFillElement(partManager, (blipFillProperties.Dpi == 0) ? ((uint?)null) : blipFillProperties.Dpi, (blipFillProperties.RotWithShape == false) ? ((bool?)null) : blipFillProperties.RotWithShape);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawingMLMain.WriteBlipFillElement(partManager, (blipFillProperties.Dpi == 0) ? ((uint?)null) : blipFillProperties.Dpi, (blipFillProperties.RotWithShape == false) ? ((bool?)null) : blipFillProperties.RotWithShape);
				}
				partManager.SaveBlipElement(blipFillProperties.Blip);
				partManager.SaveSrcRectElement(blipFillProperties.SrcRect);
				if (blipFillProperties.FillMode != null)
				{
					blipFillProperties.FillMode.Accept(DrawingSerializationHelper.Instance, partManager);
				}
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		public static void SaveGraphicDataContent(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, Tuple<string, object> contentByStrictElementName)
		{
			if (contentByStrictElementName.Item2 is IGraphicalObjectContent graphicalObjectContent)
			{
				graphicalObjectContent.Accept(DrawingSerializationHelper.Instance, partManager);
			}
			else if (contentByStrictElementName.Item2 is CT_RelId cT_RelId)
			{
				string item = contentByStrictElementName.Item1;
				if (!(item == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/chart/chart"))
				{
					if (item == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2014/chartex/chart")
					{
						DrawingMLChart2014.WriteChartElement(partManager, cT_RelId.Id);
						partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DrawingMLChart.WriteChartElement(partManager, cT_RelId.Id);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
			else if (contentByStrictElementName.Item2 is CT_Slicer cT_Slicer)
			{
				string item = contentByStrictElementName.Item1;
				if (item == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2010/slicer/slicer")
				{
					Drawing2010Slicer.WriteSlicerElement(partManager, cT_Slicer.Name);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SaveGraphicDataElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_GraphicalObjectData graphicalObjectData)
		{
			if (graphicalObjectData != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.WriteGraphicDataElement(partManager, graphicalObjectData.Uri);
				graphicalObjectData.ContentByStrictElementName.ForEach(partManager.SaveGraphicDataContent);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveTxBodyElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_TextBody textBody)
		{
			if (textBody != null)
			{
				partManager.DocumentManager.DrawingPropertiesNamespace.WriteTxBodyElement(partManager);
				partManager.SaveBodyPrElement(textBody.BodyProperties);
				textBody.P.ForEach(partManager.SavePElement);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveXfrmElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_Transform2D transform2D, Action<XmlPartManagerBase, ST_Angle, bool, bool> writeElementCallback)
		{
			if (transform2D != null)
			{
				writeElementCallback(partManager, transform2D.GetRotationResolved(), transform2D.GetHorizontalFlipResolved(), transform2D.GetVerticalFlipResolved());
				partManager.SaveOffElement(transform2D.Offset);
				partManager.SaveExtElement(transform2D.Extents);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveXfrmElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_GroupTransform2D groupTransform2D)
		{
			if (groupTransform2D != null)
			{
				DrawingMLMain.WriteXfrmElement(partManager, groupTransform2D.GetRotationResolved(), groupTransform2D.GetHorizontalFlipResolved(), groupTransform2D.GetVerticalFlipResolved());
				partManager.SaveOffElement(groupTransform2D.Offset);
				partManager.SaveExtElement(groupTransform2D.Extents);
				partManager.SaveChOffElement(groupTransform2D.ChildOffset);
				partManager.SaveChExtElement(groupTransform2D.ChildExtents);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class OfficeExtensibilityPartManagerBase : XmlPartManagerBase
	{
		public const string ContentTypeValue = "application/xml";

		public sealed override string ContentType => "application/xml";

		public sealed override bool IsNumbered => false;

		protected abstract RoundTripControlData ExtensibilityInfo { get; set; }

		internal override PartManagerBase GetPreferredPartManager(IPackagePart part, IPackageRelationship relationship)
		{
			Uri targetPartPath = PackageUtilities.GetTargetPartPath(relationship);
			return new RoundTripDataPartManager(part.ContentType, targetPartPath.ToString(), relationship.RelationshipType, base.DocumentManager);
		}

		public override WorkItem<object> Load()
		{
			RoundTripControlData result = (ExtensibilityInfo = RoundTripDataPartManager.Load(base.DocumentManager, base.PartStream, ContentType));
			return WorkItem.FromResult((object)result);
		}

		public override WorkItem Save(object context)
		{
			RoundTripControlData extensibilityInfo = ExtensibilityInfo;
			if (extensibilityInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return RoundTripDataPartManager.Save(extensibilityInfo, base.DocumentManager, base.PartStream, useRoundTripPartManager: true);
		}

		protected override WorkItem SaveCore(object context)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	internal abstract class ImagePartManagerBase : PartManagerBase
	{
		private const string RelationshipTypeValueTransitional = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image";

		private const string RelationshipTypeValueStrict = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/image";

		public sealed override bool IsNumbered => true;

		public sealed override bool NumberedPartsConsiderExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness => false;

		public abstract string BaseExcelPartName { get; }

		public abstract string BasePowerPointPartName { get; }

		public abstract string BaseWordPartName { get; }

		public sealed override string GetPartName(OfficeApplication application)
		{
			return application switch
			{
				OfficeApplication.Excel => BaseExcelPartName, 
				OfficeApplication.Word => BaseWordPartName, 
				OfficeApplication.PowerPoint => BasePowerPointPartName, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public sealed override string GetRelationshipType(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return GetImageRelationshipType(conformance);
		}

		public sealed override WorkItem<object> Load()
		{
			return WorkItem.FromResult((object)new ImageData(GetFormat(base.DocumentManager.ActivePart.Uri.ToString()), base.PartStream));
		}

		public sealed override WorkItem Save(object context)
		{
			if (context is ImageData imageData)
			{
				imageData.Save(base.PartStream);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public abstract ImageFormat GetFormat(string partFileName);

		public static string GetImageRelationshipType(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/image", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image", 
			};
		}
	}

	internal abstract class PartManagerBase
	{
		private OfficeDocumentManager _documentManager;

		private Stream _partStream;

		public abstract string ContentType { get; }

		public OfficeDocumentManager DocumentManager => _documentManager;

		public abstract bool IsNumbered { get; }

		public virtual bool NumberedPartsConsiderExtensionWhenDeterminingUniqueness => true;

		public Stream PartStream
		{
			get
			{
				return _partStream;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_partStream = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract WorkItem<object> Load();

		public abstract WorkItem Save(object context);

		public PartManagerBase CloneForSerialization(OfficeDocumentManager documentManager, Stream partStream)
		{
			PartManagerBase partManagerBase = (PartManagerBase)MemberwiseClone();
			partManagerBase._partStream = partStream;
			partManagerBase._documentManager = documentManager;
			partManagerBase.InitializeForSerialization();
			return partManagerBase;
		}

		public virtual Dictionary<PartManagerBase, int> CreateTargetLoadPriorityDictionary()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public abstract string GetPartName(OfficeApplication application);

		internal virtual PartManagerBase GetPreferredPartManager(IPackagePart part, IPackageRelationship relationship)
		{

	internal class RoundTripDataPartManager : PartManagerBase
	{
		private readonly string _contentType;

		private readonly string _partName;

		private readonly string _relationType;

		private OfficeDocumentManager _documentManager;

		public override string ContentType => _contentType;

		public override bool IsNumbered => false;

		internal RoundTripDataPartManager(string contentType, string partName, string relationType, OfficeDocumentManager documentManager)
		{
			_contentType = contentType;
			_partName = partName;
			_relationType = relationType;
			_documentManager = documentManager;
		}

		public override WorkItem<object> Load()
		{
			return WorkItem.FromResult((object)new BinaryData(Utilities.StreamToArray(base.PartStream)));
		}

		public override WorkItem Save(object context)
		{
			if (!(context is BinaryData binaryData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			base.PartStream.Write(binaryData.Buffer, 0, binaryData.Buffer.Length);
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetPartName(OfficeApplication application)
		{
			return _partName;
		}

		public override string GetRelationshipType(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return _documentManager.GetTargetRelationshipType(conformance, _relationType);
		}

		public static RoundTripControlData Load(OfficeDocumentManager manager, Stream contentTypeStream, string contentType)
		{
			RoundTripControlData roundTripControlData = new RoundTripControlData(contentType, manager.ActivePart.Uri.ToString(), Utilities.StreamToArray(contentTypeStream));
			foreach (IPackageRelationship relationship in manager.ActivePart.GetRelationships())
			{
				if (relationship.TargetMode == RelationshipTargetMode.Internal && manager.GetPartData(relationship) is BinaryData data)
				{
					Uri targetPartPath = PackageUtilities.GetTargetPartPath(relationship);
					IPackagePart part = manager.GetPart(targetPartPath);
					string text = PackageUtilities.GetTargetPartPath(relationship).ToString();
					roundTripControlData.Relationships.Add(new RoundTripPartData
					{
						ContentType = part.ContentType,
						RelationshipId = relationship.Id,
						Data = data,
						RelationshipType = relationship.RelationshipType,
						PartPath = targetPartPath.ToString()
					});
				}
			}
			return roundTripControlData;
		}

		public static WorkItem Save(RoundTripControlData data, OfficeDocumentManager manager, Stream contentTypeStream, bool useRoundTripPartManager = false)
		{
			return Async.ForEach(data.Relationships, delegate(RoundTripPartData partData)
			{
				if (useRoundTripPartManager)
				{
					string relationType = manager.GetTargetRelationshipType(manager.Conformance, partData.RelationshipType) ?? partData.RelationshipType;
					RoundTripDataPartManager partManagerPrototype = new RoundTripDataPartManager(partData.ContentType, partData.PartPath, relationType, manager);
					return manager.CreatePart(partManagerPrototype, partData.Data, partData.RelationshipId);
				}
				return manager.CreatePart(partData.ContentType, partData.PartPath, partData.Data, partData.RelationshipId).Then(delegate
				{
				});
			}).Then((Action)delegate
			{
				contentTypeStream.Write(data.XmlData, 0, data.XmlData.Length);
			}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class XmlPartManagerBase : PartManagerBase
	{
		public const string NamespaceDeclarationPrefix = "xmlns";

		public const string NamespaceDeclarationNamespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/";

		public const string NamespaceSeparator = "/";

		public const char NamespaceSeparatorChar = '/';

		private ContextStack _contextStack;

		private Dictionary<string, ElementLoadCallbacks> _elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName;

		private int _isInUnsupportedContentRegionCount;

		private XmlReadManager _xmlReadManager;

		private XmlWriteManager _xmlWriteManager;

		public ContextStack ContextStack => _contextStack;

		public object LoadedData { get; set; }

		public bool HaveCreatedRunInUnsupportedContentRegion { get; set; }

		public bool IsInUnsupportedContentRegion => _isInUnsupportedContentRegionCount != 0;

		protected virtual bool ShouldWriteXmlDeclaration => true;

		public XmlReadManager XmlReadManager => _xmlReadManager;

		public XmlWriteManager XmlWriteManager => _xmlWriteManager;

		public XmlPartManagerBase()
		{
			_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName = new Dictionary<string, ElementLoadCallbacks>();
		}

		protected override void InitializeForSerialization()
		{
			base.InitializeForSerialization();
			_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName = new Dictionary<string, ElementLoadCallbacks>(_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName);
		}

		public override WorkItem<object> Load()
		{
			return Async.Try(delegate
			{
				_contextStack = new ContextStack();
				return LoadCore();
			}, delegate
			{
				_contextStack = null;
				_xmlReadManager = null;
			});
		}

		public override WorkItem Save(object context)
		{
			_contextStack = new ContextStack();
			if (context != null)
			{
				_contextStack.Push(context);
			}
			return Async.Using(CreateXmlWriter(), delegate(XmlWriter xmlWriter)
			{
				_xmlWriteManager = new XmlWriteManager(this, xmlWriter);
				if (ShouldWriteXmlDeclaration)
				{
					_xmlWriteManager.WriteXmlDeclaration("1.0", "UTF-8", "yes");
				}
				return SaveCore(context);
			});
		}

		public void EnterUnsupportedContentRegion()
		{
			_isInUnsupportedContentRegionCount++;
		}

		public void ExitUnsupportedContentRegion()
		{
			_isInUnsupportedContentRegionCount--;
			if (_isInUnsupportedContentRegionCount == 0)
			{
				HaveCreatedRunInUnsupportedContentRegion = false;
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public void DebugAssertCanIgnoreChildren(string message)
		{
		}

		public ElementLoadCallbacks GetElementLoadCallbacks(QualifiedNameInfo elementName)
		{
			return GetElementLoadCallbacks(elementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(base.DocumentManager));
		}

		public ElementLoadCallbacks GetElementLoadCallbacks(string strictQualifiedName)
		{
			_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName.TryGetValue(strictQualifiedName, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public virtual UnknownElementAction GetUnknownElementAction(string strictElementName)
		{
			base.DocumentManager.OnUnsupportedContentDetected();
			return UnknownElementAction.Ignore;
		}

		public virtual void OnUnknownStructureElementAndChildrenLoaded(UnknownElementCache unknownElement)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnUnknownStructureLoaded(UnknownStructure unknownStructure)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnUnknownXmlLoaded(string strictElementName, string xml)
		{
		}

		public void RegisterOnChildrenLoadedCallback(string strictElementName, Action<XmlPartManagerBase> onChildrenLoaded, bool checkForPreviousRegistration = true)
		{
			switch (strictElementName)
			{
			case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Choice":
				return;
			case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Fallback":
				return;
			}
			if (_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName.TryGetValue(strictElementName, out var value) && checkForPreviousRegistration && value.OnChildrenLoaded != null && onChildrenLoaded != null)
			{
				IsSameCallback(value.OnChildrenLoaded, onChildrenLoaded);
			}
			_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName[strictElementName] = new ElementLoadCallbacks(value.OnElementLoaded, onChildrenLoaded);
		}

		private static bool IsSameCallback(Action<XmlPartManagerBase> callback1, Action<XmlPartManagerBase> callback2)
		{
			if (callback1 == null || callback2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (callback1.Method == null || callback2.Method == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string arg = ((callback1.Target != null) ? callback1.Target.ToString() : "Null");
			string arg2 = ((callback2.Target != null) ? callback2.Target.ToString() : "Null");
			string a = $"{arg}.{callback1.Method.Name}";
			string b = $"{arg2}.{callback2.Method.Name}";
			return string.Equals(a, b);
		}

		public void RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback(string strictElementName, Action<XmlPartManagerBase> onElementLoaded, bool checkForPreviousRegistration = true)
		{
			switch (strictElementName)
			{
			case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Choice":
				return;
			case "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006/Fallback":
				return;
			}
			if (_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName.TryGetValue(strictElementName, out var value) && checkForPreviousRegistration && value.OnElementLoaded != null && onElementLoaded != null)
			{
				IsSameCallback(value.OnElementLoaded, onElementLoaded);
			}
			_elementLoadCallbacksByStrictName[strictElementName] = new ElementLoadCallbacks(onElementLoaded, value.OnChildrenLoaded);
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldLoadAlternateContentChoice(string requiresAttributeValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(requiresAttributeValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			string[] array = requiresAttributeValue.Split(' ');
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string prefix in array2)
			{
				string text = _xmlReadManager.LookupNamespace(prefix);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !base.DocumentManager.IsNamespaceRecognized(text))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldLoadChildren(string strictElementName)
		{
			return !ContextStack.ShouldIgnoreChildren;
		}

		public virtual OverwriteRoundTripDataResult TryOverwriteRoundTripData(UnknownElementCache elementData, Stack<UnknownElementCache> ancestorStack)
		{
			return OverwriteRoundTripDataResult.NothingWritten;
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public void VerifyCurrentElementName(string strictElementName)
		{
			string strictQualifiedName = _xmlReadManager.CurrentElementName.GetStrictQualifiedName(base.DocumentManager);
		}

		protected virtual XmlReader CreateXmlReader()
		{
			return new XmlTextReader(base.PartStream);
		}

		protected virtual XmlWriter CreateXmlWriter()
		{
			return new XmlTextWriter(new BufferedStream(base.PartStream, 65536), Encoding.UTF8);
		}

		protected virtual WorkItem<object> LoadCore()
		{
			return Async.Using(CreateXmlReader(), (XmlReader xmlReader) => Async.If(xmlReader.Read(), delegate
			{
				_xmlReadManager = new XmlReadManager(this, xmlReader);
				return _xmlReadManager.LoadChildElements();
			})).Then(() => LoadedData);
		}

		protected abstract WorkItem SaveCore(object context);
	}
}

	internal sealed class CoreProperties : XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase
	{
		private const string Namespace = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties";

		private const string _NamespacePrefix = "cp";

		public const string category = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/category";

		public const string contentStatus = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/contentStatus";

		public const string coreProperties = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/coreProperties";

		public const string keywords = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/keywords";

		public const string lastModifiedBy = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/lastModifiedBy";

		public const string revision = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/revision";

		public const string version = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/version";

		public static readonly CoreProperties Instance = new CoreProperties();

		public override string NamespacePrefix => "cp";

		private CoreProperties()
		{
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
			{
				_ = 1;
			}
			return "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties";
		}

		public static void ReadCategoryElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string value)
		{
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ReadXmlStringElement(partManager, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/category", out value, PreserveSpaceMode.HonorBoth);
		}

		public static void WriteCategoryElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string value)
		{
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.WriteXmlStringElement(partManager, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/category", "cp", value, null, PreserveSpaceMode.HonorBoth);
		}

		public static void ReadContentStatusElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string value)
		{
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ReadXmlStringElement(partManager, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/contentStatus", out value, PreserveSpaceMode.HonorBoth);
		}

		public static void WriteContentStatusElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string value)
		{
			XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.WriteXmlStringElement(partManager, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/contentStatus", "cp", value, null, PreserveSpaceMode.HonorBoth);
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadCorePropertiesElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCorePropertiesElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties/coreProperties", "cp");
			ST_ConformanceClass conformance = partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(Instance);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(DcElements.Instance);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(DcTerms.Instance);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(DcDcmiType.Instance);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(XmlSchemaInstance.Instance);
		}

		public static void ReadKeywordsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string langValue, out string value)
		{
			langValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{

		public static readonly DrawingMLMain Instance = new DrawingMLMain();

		public override string NamespacePrefix => "a";

		private DrawingMLMain()
		{
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main", 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main", 
				_ => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main", 
			};
		}

		private static void ReadCT_AngleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_Angle valValue)
		{
			valValue = ST_Angle.FromDegrees(0f);
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "val")
				{
					valValue = ST_Angle.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_AngleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_Angle valValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
			string value = valValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("val", value);
		}

		private static void ReadCT_ColorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_ColorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
		}

		private static void ReadCT_LineEndPropertiesElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_LineEndType? typeValue, out ST_LineEndWidth? wValue, out ST_LineEndLength? lenValue)
		{
			typeValue = null;
			wValue = null;
			lenValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "type":
					typeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_LineEndType.none);
					break;
				case "w":
					wValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_LineEndWidth.sm);
					break;
				case "len":
					lenValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_LineEndLength.sm);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_LineEndPropertiesElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_LineEndType? typeValue, ST_LineEndWidth? wValue, ST_LineEndLength? lenValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
			if (typeValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(typeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("type", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (wValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(wValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("w", enumAttributeString);
			}
			if (lenValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(lenValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("len", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCT_NonVisualDrawingPropsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_DrawingElementId idValue, out string nameValue, out string descrValue, out bool hiddenValue, out string titleValue)
		{
			idValue = default(ST_DrawingElementId);
			nameValue = null;
			descrValue = null;
			hiddenValue = false;
			titleValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "id":
					idValue = ST_DrawingElementId.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "name":
					nameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "descr":
					descrValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "hidden":
					hiddenValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "title":
					titleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteCT_NonVisualDrawingPropsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_DrawingElementId idValue, string nameValue, string descrValue, bool hiddenValue, string titleValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
			string value = idValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("id", value);
			value = nameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("name", value);
			value = descrValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("descr", value);
			if (hiddenValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(hiddenValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("hidden", value);
			}
			value = titleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("title", value);
		}

		public static void ReadCT_Point2DElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_Coordinate xValue, out ST_Coordinate yValue)
		{
			xValue = default(ST_Coordinate);
			yValue = default(ST_Coordinate);
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "x"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "y")
					{
						yValue = ST_Coordinate.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					xValue = ST_Coordinate.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
			string value = xValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("x", value);
			value = yValue.ToString();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("y", value);
		}

		private static void ReadCT_RelativeRectElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ST_Percentage lValue, out ST_Percentage tValue, out ST_Percentage rValue, out ST_Percentage bValue)
		{
			lValue = 0.0;
			tValue = 0.0;
			rValue = 0.0;
			bValue = 0.0;
			ST_ConformanceClass conformance = partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "l":
					lValue = ST_Percentage.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, conformance);
					break;
				case "t":
					tValue = ST_Percentage.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, conformance);
					break;
				case "r":
					rValue = ST_Percentage.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, conformance);
					break;
				case "b":
					bValue = ST_Percentage.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, conformance);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_RelativeRectElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, ST_Percentage lValue, ST_Percentage tValue, ST_Percentage rValue, ST_Percentage bValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
			ST_ConformanceClass conformance = partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance;
			if (lValue != 0.0)
			{
				string value = lValue.ToString(conformance);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("l", value);
			}
			if (tValue != 0.0)
			{
				string value = tValue.ToString(conformance);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("t", value);
			}
			if (rValue != 0.0)
			{
				string value = rValue.ToString(conformance);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("r", value);
			}
			if (bValue != 0.0)
			{
				string value = bValue.ToString(conformance);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("b", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadCT_TextFontElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out string typefaceValue, out ST_Panose panoseValue, out sbyte? pitchFamilyValue, out sbyte? charsetValue, bool resolve = true)
		{
			typefaceValue = null;
			panoseValue = null;
			pitchFamilyValue = null;
			charsetValue = null;
			sbyte value = 1;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "typeface":
					typefaceValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "panose":
					panoseValue = ST_Panose.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "pitchFamily":
					pitchFamilyValue = sbyte.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "charset":
					charsetValue = sbyte.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (resolve && !charsetValue.HasValue)
			{
				charsetValue = value;
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCT_TextFontElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string typefaceValue, ST_Panose panoseValue, sbyte? pitchFamilyValue, sbyte charsetValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, "a");
			string value = typefaceValue ?? "";
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("typeface", value);
			if (panoseValue != null)
			{
				value = panoseValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("panose", value);
			}
			if (pitchFamilyValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = pitchFamilyValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("pitchFamily", value);
			}
			if (charsetValue != 1)
			{
				value = charsetValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("charset", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadBlipElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string embedValue, out string linkValue, out ST_BlipCompression? cstateValue, bool resolve = true)
		{
			embedValue = null;
			linkValue = null;
			if (resolve)
			{
				cstateValue = ST_BlipCompression.none;
			}
			else
			{
				cstateValue = null;
			}
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/embed":
					embedValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/link":
					linkValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "cstate":
					cstateValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_BlipCompression.none);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteBlipElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string embedValue, string linkValue, ST_BlipCompression? cstateValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/blip", "a");
			string value = embedValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/embed", value);
			value = linkValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/link", value);
			if (cstateValue.HasValue && cstateValue.Value != ST_BlipCompression.none)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(cstateValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cstate", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadBlipFillElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out uint? dpiValue, out bool? rotWithShapeValue)
		{
			dpiValue = null;
			rotWithShapeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "dpi"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "rotWithShape")
					{
						rotWithShapeValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dpiValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteBlipFillElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, uint? dpiValue = null, bool? rotWithShapeValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/blipFill", "a");

		}

		public static void ReadBodyPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out int? rotValue, out bool? spcFirstLastParaValue, out ST_TextVertOverflowType? vertOverflowValue, out ST_TextHorzOverflowType? horzOverflowValue, out ST_TextVerticalType? vertValue, out ST_TextWrappingType? wrapValue, out ST_Coordinate32? lInsValue, out ST_Coordinate32? tInsValue, out ST_Coordinate32? rInsValue, out ST_Coordinate32? bInsValue, out int? numColValue, out int? spcColValue, out bool? rtlColValue, out bool? fromWordArtValue, out ST_TextAnchoringType? anchorValue, out bool? anchorCtrValue, out bool? forceAAValue, out bool uprightValue, out bool? compatLnSpcValue)
		{
			rotValue = null;
			spcFirstLastParaValue = null;
			vertOverflowValue = null;
			horzOverflowValue = null;
			vertValue = null;
			wrapValue = null;
			lInsValue = null;
			tInsValue = null;
			rInsValue = null;
			bInsValue = null;
			numColValue = null;
			spcColValue = null;
			rtlColValue = null;
			fromWordArtValue = null;
			anchorValue = null;
			anchorCtrValue = null;
			forceAAValue = null;
			uprightValue = false;
			compatLnSpcValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "rot":
					rotValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "spcFirstLastPara":
					spcFirstLastParaValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "vertOverflow":
					vertOverflowValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextVertOverflowType.overflow);
					break;
				case "horzOverflow":
					horzOverflowValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextHorzOverflowType.overflow);
					break;
				case "vert":
					vertValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextVerticalType.horz);
					break;
				case "wrap":
					wrapValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextWrappingType.none);
					break;
				case "lIns":
					lInsValue = ST_Coordinate32.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "tIns":
					tInsValue = ST_Coordinate32.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "rIns":
					rInsValue = ST_Coordinate32.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "bIns":
					bInsValue = ST_Coordinate32.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "numCol":
					numColValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "spcCol":
					spcColValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "rtlCol":
					rtlColValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "fromWordArt":
					fromWordArtValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "anchor":
					anchorValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextAnchoringType.t);
					break;
				case "anchorCtr":
					anchorCtrValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "forceAA":
					forceAAValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "upright":
					uprightValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "compatLnSpc":
					compatLnSpcValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteBodyPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, int? rotValue = null, bool? spcFirstLastParaValue = null, ST_TextVertOverflowType? vertOverflowValue = null, ST_TextHorzOverflowType? horzOverflowValue = null, ST_TextVerticalType? vertValue = null, ST_TextWrappingType? wrapValue = null, ST_Coordinate32? lInsValue = null, ST_Coordinate32? tInsValue = null, ST_Coordinate32? rInsValue = null, ST_Coordinate32? bInsValue = null, int? numColValue = null, int? spcColValue = null, bool? rtlColValue = null, bool? fromWordArtValue = null, ST_TextAnchoringType? anchorValue = null, bool? anchorCtrValue = null, bool? forceAAValue = null, bool uprightValue = false, bool? compatLnSpcValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/bodyPr", "a");
			if (rotValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rotValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rot", value);
			}
			if (spcFirstLastParaValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(spcFirstLastParaValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("spcFirstLastPara", value);
			}
			if (vertOverflowValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(vertOverflowValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("vertOverflow", value);
			}
			if (horzOverflowValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(horzOverflowValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("horzOverflow", value);
			}
			if (vertValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(vertValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("vert", value);
			}
			if (wrapValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(wrapValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("wrap", value);
			}
			if (lInsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = lInsValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("lIns", value);
			}
			if (tInsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = tInsValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tIns", value);
			}
			if (rInsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = rInsValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rIns", value);
			}
			if (bInsValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = bInsValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("bIns", value);
			}
			if (numColValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = numColValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("numCol", value);
			}
			if (spcColValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = spcColValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("spcCol", value);
			}
			if (rtlColValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(rtlColValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rtlCol", value);
			}
			if (fromWordArtValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fromWordArtValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fromWordArt", value);
			}
			if (anchorValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(anchorValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("anchor", value);
			}
			if (anchorCtrValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(anchorCtrValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("anchorCtr", value);
			}
			if (forceAAValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(forceAAValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("forceAA", value);
			}
			if (uprightValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(uprightValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("upright", value);
			}
			if (compatLnSpcValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(compatLnSpcValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("compatLnSpc", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadFontElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string scriptValue, out string typefaceValue)
		{
			scriptValue = null;
			typefaceValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "script"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "typeface")
					{
						typefaceValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					scriptValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteFontElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string scriptValue, string typefaceValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/font", "a");
			string value = scriptValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("script", value);
			value = typefaceValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("typeface", value);
		}

		public static void ReadFontRefElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_FontCollectionIndex idxValue)
		{
			idxValue = ST_FontCollectionIndex.major;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "idx")
				{
					idxValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, idxValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadHlinkClickElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string idValue, out string invalidUrlValue, out string actionValue, out string tgtFrameValue, out string tooltipValue, out bool historyValue, out bool highlightClickValue, out bool endSndValue)
		{
			idValue = null;
			invalidUrlValue = "";
			actionValue = "";
			tgtFrameValue = "";
			tooltipValue = "";
			historyValue = true;
			highlightClickValue = false;
			endSndValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "invalidUrl":
					invalidUrlValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "action":
					actionValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "tgtFrame":
					tgtFrameValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "tooltip":
					tooltipValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "history":
					historyValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "highlightClick":
					highlightClickValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "endSnd":
					endSndValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteHlinkClickElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string idValue = null, string invalidUrlValue = "", string actionValue = "", string tgtFrameValue = "", string tooltipValue = "", bool historyValue = true, bool highlightClickValue = false, bool endSndValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/hlinkClick", "a");
			string value = idValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/id", value);
			value = invalidUrlValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("invalidUrl", value);
			value = actionValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("action", value);
			value = tgtFrameValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tgtFrame", value);
			value = tooltipValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("tooltip", value);
			if (!historyValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(historyValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("history", value);
			}
			if (highlightClickValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(highlightClickValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("highlightClick", value);
			}
			if (endSndValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(endSndValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("endSnd", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadLnElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_LineWidth? wValue, out ST_LineCap? capValue, out ST_CompoundLine? cmpdValue, out ST_PenAlignment? algnValue)
		{
			wValue = null;
			capValue = null;
			cmpdValue = null;
			algnValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "w":
					wValue = ST_LineWidth.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "cap":
					capValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_LineCap.rnd);
					break;
				case "cmpd":
					cmpdValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_CompoundLine.sng);
					break;
				case "algn":
					algnValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_PenAlignment.ctr);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteLnElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_LineWidth? wValue, ST_LineCap? capValue, ST_CompoundLine? cmpdValue, ST_PenAlignment? algnValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/ln", "a");
			if (wValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = wValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("w", value);
			}
			if (capValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(capValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cap", value);
			}
			if (cmpdValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(cmpdValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cmpd", value);
			}
			if (algnValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(algnValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("algn", value);
			}
		}

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noChangeShapeType", value);
			}
			if (noCropValue)

				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noCropValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noCrop", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadPPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_TextMargin? marLValue, out ST_TextMargin? marRValue, out ST_TextIndentLevelType? lvlValue, out ST_TextIndent? indentValue, out ST_TextAlignType? algnValue, out ST_Coordinate32? defTabSzValue, out bool? rtlValue, out bool? eaLnBrkValue, out ST_TextFontAlignType? fontAlgnValue, out bool? latinLnBrkValue, out bool? hangingPunctValue)
		{
			marLValue = null;
			marRValue = null;
			lvlValue = null;
			indentValue = null;
			algnValue = null;
			defTabSzValue = null;
			rtlValue = null;
			eaLnBrkValue = null;
			fontAlgnValue = null;
			latinLnBrkValue = null;
			hangingPunctValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "marL":
					marLValue = ST_TextMargin.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "marR":
					marRValue = ST_TextMargin.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "lvl":
					lvlValue = ST_TextIndentLevelType.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "indent":
					indentValue = ST_TextIndent.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "algn":
					algnValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextAlignType.l);
					break;
				case "defTabSz":
					defTabSzValue = ST_Coordinate32.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "rtl":
					rtlValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "eaLnBrk":
					eaLnBrkValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "fontAlgn":
					fontAlgnValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextFontAlignType.auto);
					break;
				case "latinLnBrk":
					latinLnBrkValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "hangingPunct":
					hangingPunctValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
