		public static void ReadRPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool? kumimojiValue, out string langValue, out string altLangValue, out ST_TextFontSize? szValue, out bool? bValue, out bool? iValue, out ST_TextUnderlineType? uValue, out ST_TextStrikeType? strikeValue, out int? kernValue, out ST_TextCapsType? capValue, out ST_TextPoint? spcValue, out bool? normalizeHValue, out ST_Percentage? baselineValue, out bool? noProofValue, out bool? dirtyValue, out bool? errValue, out bool? smtCleanValue, out uint? smtIdValue, out string bmkValue, string elementName = "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/rPr", bool resolve = true)
		{
			kumimojiValue = null;
			langValue = null;
			altLangValue = null;
			szValue = null;
			bValue = null;
			iValue = null;
			uValue = null;
			strikeValue = null;
			kernValue = null;
			capValue = null;
			spcValue = null;
			normalizeHValue = null;
			baselineValue = null;
			noProofValue = null;
			dirtyValue = null;
			errValue = null;
			smtCleanValue = null;
			smtIdValue = null;
			bmkValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "kumimoji":
					kumimojiValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "lang":
					langValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "altLang":
					altLangValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "sz":
					szValue = ST_TextFontSize.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "b":
					bValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "i":
					iValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "u":
					uValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextUnderlineType.none);
					break;
				case "strike":
					strikeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextStrikeType.noStrike);
					break;
				case "kern":
					kernValue = int.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "cap":
					capValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_TextCapsType.none);
					break;
				case "spc":
					spcValue = ST_TextPoint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "normalizeH":
					normalizeHValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "baseline":
					baselineValue = ST_Percentage.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance);
					break;
				case "noProof":
					noProofValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "dirty":
					dirtyValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "err":
					errValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "smtClean":
					smtCleanValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "smtId":
					smtIdValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case "bmk":
					bmkValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				}
				if (resolve)
				{
					if (!dirtyValue.HasValue)
					{
						dirtyValue = true;
					}
					if (!errValue.HasValue)
					{
						errValue = false;
					}
					if (!smtCleanValue.HasValue)
					{
						smtCleanValue = true;
					}
					if (!smtIdValue.HasValue)
					{
						smtIdValue = 0u;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteRPrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool? kumimojiValue = null, string langValue = null, string altLangValue = null, ST_TextFontSize? szValue = null, bool? bValue = null, bool? iValue = null, ST_TextUnderlineType? uValue = null, ST_TextStrikeType? strikeValue = null, int? kernValue = null, ST_TextCapsType? capValue = null, ST_TextPoint? spcValue = null, bool? normalizeHValue = null, ST_Percentage? baselineValue = null, bool? noProofValue = null, bool? dirtyValue = true, bool? errValue = false, bool? smtCleanValue = true, uint? smtIdValue = 0u, string bmkValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/rPr", "a");
			string value;
			if (kumimojiValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(kumimojiValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("kumimoji", value);
			}
			value = langValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("lang", value);
			value = altLangValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("altLang", value);
			if (szValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = szValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("sz", value);
			}
			if (bValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(bValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("b", value);
			}
			if (iValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(iValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("i", value);
			}
			if (uValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(uValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("u", value);
			}
			if (strikeValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(strikeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("strike", value);
			}
			if (kernValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = kernValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("kern", value);
			}
			if (capValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(capValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("cap", value);
			}
			if (spcValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = spcValue.Value.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("spc", value);
			}
			if (normalizeHValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(normalizeHValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("normalizeH", value);
			}
			if (baselineValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = baselineValue.Value.ToString(partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("baseline", value);
			}
			if (noProofValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noProofValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noProof", value);
			}
			if (dirtyValue.HasValue && dirtyValue != true)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(dirtyValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("dirty", value);
			}
			if (errValue.HasValue && errValue != false)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(errValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("err", value);
			}
			if (smtCleanValue.HasValue && smtCleanValue != true)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(smtCleanValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("smtClean", value);
			}
			if (smtIdValue.HasValue && smtIdValue != 0)
			{
				value = smtIdValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("smtId", value);
			}
			value = bmkValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("bmk", value);
		}

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noChangeArrowheads", value);

			if (noChangeShapeTypeValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noChangeShapeTypeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noChangeShapeType", value);
			}
			if (noTextEditValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noTextEditValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noTextEdit", value);
			}
		}

		public static void ReadSysClrElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_SystemColorVal valValue, out ST_HexColorRGB lastClrValue)
		{
			valValue = ST_SystemColorVal.activeBorder;
			lastClrValue = ST_HexColorRGB.Empty;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "val"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "lastClr")
					{
						lastClrValue = ST_HexColorRGB.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					valValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, valValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ReadXfrmElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Angle rotValue, out bool flipHValue, out bool flipVValue)
		{
			rotValue = ST_Angle.FromDegrees(0f);
			flipHValue = false;
			flipVValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "rot":
					rotValue = ST_Angle.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "flipH":
					flipHValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "flipV":
					flipVValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteXfrmElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Angle rotValue = default(ST_Angle), bool flipHValue = false, bool flipVValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/drawingml/main/xfrm", "a");
			if (rotValue.ToDegrees() != 0f)
			{
				string value = rotValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rot", value);
			}
			if (flipHValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(flipHValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("flipH", value);
			}
			if (flipVValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(flipVValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("flipV", value);
			}
		}
	}

	{

		protected DrawingNamespaceDefinitionBase(string NamespaceStrict, string NamespaceTransitional)
		{
			this.NamespaceStrict = NamespaceStrict;
			this.NamespaceTransitional = NamespaceTransitional;
			blipFill = NamespaceStrict + "/blipFill";
			cNvCxnSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/cNvCxnSpPr";
			cNvGraphicFramePr = NamespaceStrict + "/cNvGraphicFramePr";
			cNvGrpSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/cNvGrpSpPr";
			cNvPicPr = NamespaceStrict + "/cNvPicPr";
			cNvPr = NamespaceStrict + "/cNvPr";
			cNvSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/cNvSpPr";
			cxnSp = NamespaceStrict + "/cxnSp";
			cxnSpLocks = NamespaceStrict + "/cxnSpLocks";
			endCxn = NamespaceStrict + "/endCxn";
			graphicFrame = NamespaceStrict + "/graphicFrame";
			grpSp = NamespaceStrict + "/grpSp";
			grpSpLocks = NamespaceStrict + "/grpSpLocks";
			grpSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/grpSpPr";
			nvCxnSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/nvCxnSpPr";
			nvGraphicFramePr = NamespaceStrict + "/nvGraphicFramePr";
			nvGrpSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/nvGrpSpPr";
			nvPicPr = NamespaceStrict + "/nvPicPr";
			nvSpPr = NamespaceStrict + "/nvSpPr";
			pic = NamespaceStrict + "/pic";
			sp = NamespaceStrict + "/sp";
			spPr = NamespaceStrict + "/spPr";
			stCxn = NamespaceStrict + "/stCxn";
			style = NamespaceStrict + "/style";
			txBody = NamespaceStrict + "/txBody";
			xfrm = NamespaceStrict + "/xfrm";
		}

		public sealed override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return conformance switch
			{
				ST_ConformanceClass.transitional => NamespaceTransitional, 
				ST_ConformanceClass.strict => NamespaceStrict, 
				_ => NamespaceTransitional, 
			};
		}

		private void ReadCT_ConnectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out uint idValue, out uint idxValue)
		{
			idValue = 0u;
			idxValue = 0u;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "id"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "idx")
					{
						idxValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					idValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
		}

		private void WriteCT_ConnectionElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, uint idValue = 0u, uint idxValue = 0u)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, NamespacePrefix);
			if (idValue != 0)
			{
				string value = idValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("id", value);
			}
			if (idxValue != 0)
			{
				string value = idxValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("idx", value);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteMacroAttribute(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				WriteMacroAttribute(partManager, value);
			}
		}

						rotWithShapeValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);

				}
			}
		}

		{
			macroValue = null;
			fPublishedValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "macro"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "fPublished")
					{
						fPublishedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					}
				}

				{
					macroValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
		}

			string value = macroValue;
			WriteMacroAttribute(partManager, value);
			if (fPublishedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fPublishedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fPublished", value);
			}
		}

		public void ReadCxnSpLocksElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out bool noGrpValue, out bool noSelectValue, out bool noRotValue, out bool noChangeAspectValue, out bool noMoveValue, out bool noResizeValue, out bool noEditPointsValue, out bool noAdjustHandlesValue, out bool noChangeArrowheadsValue, out bool noChangeShapeTypeValue)
		{
			noGrpValue = false;
			noSelectValue = false;
			noRotValue = false;
			noChangeAspectValue = false;
			noMoveValue = false;
			noResizeValue = false;
			noEditPointsValue = false;
			noAdjustHandlesValue = false;
			noChangeArrowheadsValue = false;
			noChangeShapeTypeValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "noGrp":
					noGrpValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noSelect":
					noSelectValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noRot":
					noRotValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noChangeAspect":
					noChangeAspectValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noMove":
					noMoveValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noResize":
					noResizeValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noEditPoints":
					noEditPointsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noAdjustHandles":
					noAdjustHandlesValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noChangeArrowheads":
					noChangeArrowheadsValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "noChangeShapeType":
					noChangeShapeTypeValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteCxnSpLocksElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, bool noGrpValue = false, bool noSelectValue = false, bool noRotValue = false, bool noChangeAspectValue = false, bool noMoveValue = false, bool noResizeValue = false, bool noEditPointsValue = false, bool noAdjustHandlesValue = false, bool noChangeArrowheadsValue = false, bool noChangeShapeTypeValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(cxnSpLocks, NamespacePrefix);
			if (noGrpValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noGrpValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noGrp", value);
			}
			if (noSelectValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noSelectValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noSelect", value);
			}
			if (noRotValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noRotValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noRot", value);
			}
			if (noChangeAspectValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noChangeAspectValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noChangeAspect", value);
			}
			if (noMoveValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noMoveValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noMove", value);
			}
			if (noResizeValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noResizeValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noResize", value);
			}
			if (noEditPointsValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(noEditPointsValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("noEditPoints", value);
			}
			if (noAdjustHandlesValue)
			{

		public void ReadSpElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string macroValue, out string textlinkValue, out bool fLocksTextValue, out bool fPublishedValue)
		{
			macroValue = null;
			textlinkValue = null;
			fLocksTextValue = true;
			fPublishedValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "macro":
					macroValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "textlink":
					textlinkValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "fLocksText":
					fLocksTextValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "fPublished":
					fPublishedValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteSpElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string macroValue = null, string textlinkValue = null, bool fLocksTextValue = true, bool fPublishedValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(sp, NamespacePrefix);
			string value = macroValue;
			WriteMacroAttribute(partManager, value);
			value = textlinkValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("textlink", value);
			if (!fLocksTextValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fLocksTextValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fLocksText", value);
			}
			if (fPublishedValue)
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ToString(fPublishedValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("fPublished", value);
			}
		}

		public void ReadXfrmElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Angle rotValue, out bool flipHValue, out bool flipVValue)
		{
			rotValue = ST_Angle.FromDegrees(0f);
			flipHValue = false;
			flipVValue = false;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "rot":
					rotValue = ST_Angle.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "flipH":
					flipHValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "flipV":
					flipVValue = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteXfrmElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Angle rotValue = default(ST_Angle), bool flipHValue = false, bool flipVValue = false)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(xfrm, NamespacePrefix);
			if (rotValue.ToDegrees() != 0f)
			{
				string value = rotValue.ToString();
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("rot", value);
			}
			if (flipHValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(flipHValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("flipH", value);
			}
			if (flipVValue)
			{
				string value = ST_OnOff.ToString(flipVValue);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("flipV", value);
			}
		}

		public const string xml = "xml";

		public override string NamespacePrefix => string.Empty;

		private EmptyNamespace()
		{
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadXmlElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteXmlElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, decimal? startAngleValue = null, decimal? endAngleValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("xml");
			ST_ConformanceClass conformance = partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(VmlNamespace.Instance);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteNamespaceDeclaration(OfficeNamespace.Instance);
		}
	}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void ReadVariantElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteVariantElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/variant", "vt");
		}

		public static void ReadVectorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_VectorBaseType baseTypeValue, out uint sizeValue)
		{
			baseTypeValue = ST_VectorBaseType.variant;
			sizeValue = 0u;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "baseType"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "size")
					{
						sizeValue = uint.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					baseTypeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, baseTypeValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteVectorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_VectorBaseType baseTypeValue, uint sizeValue)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/vector", "vt");
			string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(baseTypeValue);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("baseType", enumAttributeString);
			enumAttributeString = sizeValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("size", enumAttributeString);
		}

		{

			CT_Vector context = new CT_Vector((int)sizeValue, baseTypeValue);
			partManager.ContextStack.Push(context);
		}

		public static void RegisterVariantElementCallbacks(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/cy", LoadCyElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/decimal", LoadDecimalElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/i1", LoadI1Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/i2", LoadI2Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/i4", LoadI4Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/i8", LoadI8Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/int", LoadIntElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/lpstr", LoadLpstrElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/lpwstr", LoadLpwstrElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/r4", LoadR4Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/r8", LoadR8Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/ui1", LoadUI1Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/ui2", LoadUI2Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/ui4", LoadUI4Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/ui8", LoadUI8Element);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/uint", LoadUIntElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/variant", LoadVariantElement);
			partManager.RegisterOnElementLoadedCallback("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/docPropsVTypes/vector", LoadVectorElement);
		}

		public static void SaveValue(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, object value)
		{
			if (value is string value2)
			{
				WriteLpstrElement(partManager, value2);
			}
			else if (value is int)
			{
				WriteI4Element(partManager, (int)value);
			}
			else if (value is sbyte)
			{
				WriteI1Element(partManager, (sbyte)value);
			}
			else if (value is short)
			{
				WriteI2Element(partManager, (short)value);
			}
			else if (value is long)
			{
				WriteI8Element(partManager, (long)value);
			}
			else if (value is byte)
			{
				WriteUI1Element(partManager, (byte)value);
			}
			else if (value is ushort)
			{
				WriteUI2Element(partManager, (ushort)value);
			}
			else if (value is uint)
			{
				WriteUI4Element(partManager, (uint)value);
			}
			else if (value is ulong)
			{
				WriteUI8Element(partManager, (ulong)value);
			}
			else if (value is float)
			{
				WriteR4Element(partManager, (float)value);
			}
			else if (value is double)
			{
				WriteR8Element(partManager, (double)value);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(value is decimal))
				{
					return;
				}
				WriteDecimalElement(partManager, (decimal)value);
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void SaveVariant(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, object value)
		{
			WriteVariantElement(partManager);
			SaveValue(partManager, value);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void SaveVector(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, CT_Vector vector)
		{
			WriteVectorElement(partManager, vector.BaseType, (uint)vector.Elements.Length);
			if (vector.BaseType == ST_VectorBaseType.variant)
			{
				vector.Elements.ForEach(delegate(object e)
				{
					SaveVariant(partManager, e);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				vector.Elements.ForEach(delegate(object e)
				{
					SaveValue(partManager, e);
				});
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}
	}
	internal class CT_Vector : IVariantValueContainer
	{
		public readonly ST_VectorBaseType BaseType;

		public readonly object[] Elements;

		public CT_Vector(int size, ST_VectorBaseType baseType = ST_VectorBaseType.variant)
		{
			BaseType = baseType;
			Elements = new object[size];
		}

		public CT_Vector(List<object> elements, ST_VectorBaseType baseType = ST_VectorBaseType.variant)
		{
			BaseType = baseType;
			Elements = elements.ToArray();
		}

		void IVariantValueContainer.SetValue(object value, int index)
		{
			Elements[index] = value;
		}
	}
	internal interface IVariantValueContainer
	{
		void SetValue(object value, int index);
	}

		public static void ReadIdmapElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Ext? extValue, out string dataValue)
		{
			extValue = null;
			dataValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml/ext"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "data")
					{
						dataValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					extValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Ext.view);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteIdmapElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Ext? extValue = null, string dataValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/idmap", "o");
			string enumAttributeString;
			if (extValue.HasValue)
			{
				enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(extValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml/ext", enumAttributeString);
			}
			enumAttributeString = dataValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("data", enumAttributeString);
		}

		public static void ReadLockElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Ext? extValue, out bool? positionValue, out bool? selectionValue, out bool? groupingValue, out bool? ungroupingValue, out bool? rotationValue, out bool? croppingValue, out bool? verticiesValue, out bool? adjusthandlesValue, out bool? textValue, out bool? aspectratioValue, out bool? shapetypeValue)
		{
			extValue = null;
			positionValue = null;
			selectionValue = null;
			groupingValue = null;
			ungroupingValue = null;
			rotationValue = null;
			croppingValue = null;
			verticiesValue = null;
			adjusthandlesValue = null;
			textValue = null;
			aspectratioValue = null;
			shapetypeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml/ext":
					extValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Ext.view);
					break;
				case "position":
					positionValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "selection":
					selectionValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "grouping":
					groupingValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "ungrouping":
					ungroupingValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "rotation":
					rotationValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "cropping":
					croppingValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "verticies":
					verticiesValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "adjusthandles":
					adjusthandlesValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "text":
					textValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "aspectratio":
					aspectratioValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "shapetype":
					shapetypeValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

			if (croppingValue.HasValue)

			}
		}

		public static void ReadShapelayoutElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out ST_Ext? extValue)
		{
			extValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml/ext")
				{
					extValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_Ext.view);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteShapelayoutElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ST_Ext? extValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/shapelayout", "o");
			if (extValue.HasValue)
			{
				string enumAttributeString = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(extValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml/ext", enumAttributeString);
			}
		}
	}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{

		public static void ReadArcElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out decimal? startAngleValue, out decimal? endAngleValue)
		{
			startAngleValue = null;
			endAngleValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (!(strictQualifiedName == "startAngle"))
				{
					if (strictQualifiedName == "endAngle")
					{
						endAngleValue = decimal.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					startAngleValue = decimal.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteArcElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, decimal? startAngleValue = null, decimal? endAngleValue = null)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml/arc", "v");
			if (startAngleValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = startAngleValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("startAngle", value);
			}
			if (endAngleValue.HasValue)
			{
				string value = endAngleValue.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("endAngle", value);
			}
		}

					break;

					break;

					break;
				case "alignshape":

					break;

				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/forcedash", value);
			}
			if (oleiconValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_TrueFalse.ToString(oleiconValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/oleicon", value);
			}
			if (oleValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_TrueFalseBlank.ToString(oleValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/ole", value);
			}
			if (preferrelativeValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_TrueFalse.ToString(preferrelativeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/preferrelative", value);
			}
			if (cliptowrapValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_TrueFalse.ToString(cliptowrapValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/cliptowrap", value);
			}
			if (clipValue.HasValue)
			{
				value = ST_TrueFalse.ToString(clipValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/clip", value);
			}
			value = adjValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("adj", value);
			value = pathValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("path", value);
			value = masterValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("master", value);
		}

		public static void ReadStrokeElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string idValue, out bool? onValue, out string weightValue, out string colorValue, out string opacityValue, out ST_StrokeLineStyle? linestyleValue, out decimal? miterlimitValue, out ST_StrokeJoinStyle? joinstyleValue, out ST_StrokeEndCap? endcapValue, out string dashstyleValue, out ST_FillType? filltypeValue, out string srcValue, out ST_ImageAspect? imageaspectValue, out string imagesizeValue, out bool? imagealignshapeValue, out string color2Value, out ST_StrokeArrowType? startarrowValue, out ST_StrokeArrowWidth? startarrowwidthValue, out ST_StrokeArrowLength? startarrowlengthValue, out ST_StrokeArrowType? endarrowValue, out ST_StrokeArrowWidth? endarrowwidthValue, out ST_StrokeArrowLength? endarrowlengthValue, out string hrefValue, out string althrefValue, out string titleValue, out bool? forcedashValue, out string idValue_Relationships, out bool? insetpenValue, out string relidValue)

					break;

		public static void ReadTextboxElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, out string idValue, out string styleValue, out string insetValue, out bool? singleclickValue, out ST_InsetMode? insetmodeValue)
		{
			idValue = null;
			styleValue = null;
			insetValue = null;
			singleclickValue = null;
			insetmodeValue = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				switch (currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager))
				{
				case "id":
					idValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "style":
					styleValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "inset":
					insetValue = currentElementAttribute.Value;
					break;
				case "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/singleclick":
					singleclickValue = ST_TrueFalse.Parse(currentElementAttribute.Value);
					break;
				case "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/insetmode":
					insetmodeValue = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.ParseAttributeEnumValue(currentElementAttribute.Value, ST_InsetMode.auto);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteTextboxElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string idValue = null, string styleValue = null, string insetValue = null, bool? singleclickValue = null, ST_InsetMode? insetmodeValue = null)

			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("id", value);
			value = styleValue;
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("style", value);
			value = insetValue;

			{
				value = ST_TrueFalse.ToString(singleclickValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/singleclick", value);

			{
				value = XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase.GetEnumAttributeString(insetmodeValue.Value);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office/insetmode", value);
			}
		}

	internal sealed class XmlNamespace : XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase
	{
		private const string Namespace = "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace";

		private const string _NamespacePrefix = "xml";

		public const string lang = "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace/lang";

		public const string space = "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace/space";

		public static readonly XmlNamespace Instance = new XmlNamespace();

		public override string NamespacePrefix => "xml";

		private XmlNamespace()
		{
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
			{
				_ = 1;
			}
			return "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace";
		}

		public static void WriteSpacePreserveAttribute(XmlWriteManager writeManager)
		{
			writeManager.WriteAttribute("xml", "space", "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace", "preserve");
		}
	}
	internal abstract class XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase
	{
		[Flags]
		protected enum PreserveSpaceMode : byte
		{
			None = 0,
			HonorLeadingWhitespace = 2,
			HonorTrailingWhitespace = 4,
			HonorBoth = 6
		}

		private static readonly char[] WhiteSpaceCharacters = new char[4] { ' ', '\r', '\n', '\t' };

		public abstract string NamespacePrefix { get; }

		public abstract string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance);

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		protected static void AssertUnknownAttributeAllowed(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, AttributeValue attribute)
		{
		}

		public static string GetEnumAttributeString<T>(T value, T defaultValue, bool valueIsRequired)
		{
			if (!valueIsRequired && EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(value, defaultValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetEnumAttributeString(value);
		}

		public static string GetEnumAttributeString<T>(T value_)
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			if (typeFromHandle == typeof(ST_FillMethod) && object.Equals(value_, ST_FillMethod.linearsigma))
			{
				return "linear sigma";
			}
			string text = value_.ToString();
			if (text[0] == '_')
			{
				return text.Substring(1);
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected static string GetLocalName(string fullyQualifiedName)
		{
			int num = fullyQualifiedName.LastIndexOf('/');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return fullyQualifiedName;
			}
			return fullyQualifiedName.Substring(num + 1);
		}

		public static T ParseAttributeEnumValue<T>(string value, T defaultValue = default(T)) where T : struct
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			switch (value)
			{
			case "continue":
			case "decimal":
			case "default":
			case "double":
			case "fixed":
			case "long":
			case "short":
			case "base":
				flag = true;
				break;
			case "linear sigma":
				value = ST_FillMethod.linearsigma.ToString();
				break;
			default:
				if ('0' <= value[0] && value[0] <= '9')
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (!flag && Enum.TryParse<T>(value, ignoreCase: false, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (Enum.TryParse<T>("_" + value, ignoreCase: false, out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static T ParseAttributeValue<T>(AttributeValue value, T defaultValue, Func<string, T> parseMethod) where T : struct
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.Value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return parseMethod(value.Value);
		}

		public static List<T> ParseList<T>(string value, Func<string, T> parseItem)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (value[i])
				{
				case '\t':
				case '\n':
				case '\r':
				case ' ':
					if (num != -1)
					{
						list.Add(parseItem(value.Substring(num, i - num)));
						num = -1;
					}
					break;
				default:
					if (num == -1)
					{
						num = i;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				list.Add(parseItem(value.Substring(num)));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlBooleanElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out bool value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			if (!bool.TryParse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, out value))
			{
				value = ST_OnOff.ParseBool(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue);
			}
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlBooleanElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, bool value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString().ToLowerInvariant());
		}

		{

			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = sbyte.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlDateTimeElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out DateTime value)
		{
			string text = null;
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance/type")
				{
					text = partManager.XmlReadManager.ResolveRawEntityName(currentElementAttribute.Value);
				}
			}
			value = PackageUtilities.ParseW3CDTFValue(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlDateTimeElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, DateTime value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			QualifiedNameInfo qualifiedNameInfo = new QualifiedNameInfo(DcTerms.Instance.NamespacePrefix, DcTerms.Instance.GetNamespaceUri(partManager.DocumentManager.Conformance), GetLocalName("http://purl.org/dc/terms/W3CDTF"));
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteAttribute("http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance/type", qualifiedNameInfo.ToString());
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(PackageUtilities.DateTimeToW3CDTFValue(value));
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlLongElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out long value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = long.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlLongElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, long value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlShortElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out short value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = short.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlShortElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, short value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		private static bool IsWhiteSpace(char c)
		{
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\t':
			case '\n':
			case '\r':
			case ' ':
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlStringElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out string value, PreserveSpaceMode defaultPreserveSpaceMode = PreserveSpaceMode.None)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				string strictQualifiedName = currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
				if (strictQualifiedName == "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace/space" && currentElementAttribute.Value == "preserve")
				{
					defaultPreserveSpaceMode = PreserveSpaceMode.HonorBoth;
				}
			}
			value = partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue;
			if (value != null)
			{
				if ((defaultPreserveSpaceMode & PreserveSpaceMode.HonorLeadingWhitespace) == 0)
				{
					value = value.TrimStart(WhiteSpaceCharacters);
				}
				if ((defaultPreserveSpaceMode & PreserveSpaceMode.HonorTrailingWhitespace) == 0 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					value = value.TrimEnd(WhiteSpaceCharacters);
				}
			}
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlStringElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, string value, Action beforeWriteValueCallback = null, PreserveSpaceMode defaultPreserveSpaceMode = PreserveSpaceMode.None)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			if (defaultPreserveSpaceMode != PreserveSpaceMode.HonorBoth && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && ((IsWhiteSpace(value[0]) && (defaultPreserveSpaceMode & PreserveSpaceMode.HonorLeadingWhitespace) == 0) || (IsWhiteSpace(value[value.Length - 1]) && (defaultPreserveSpaceMode & PreserveSpaceMode.HonorTrailingWhitespace) == 0)))
			{
				XmlNamespace.WriteSpacePreserveAttribute(partManager.XmlWriteManager);
			}
			beforeWriteValueCallback?.Invoke();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value);
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlUnsignedByteElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out byte value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = byte.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlUnsignedByteElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, byte value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlUnsignedIntElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out uint value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = uint.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlUnsignedIntElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, uint value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlUnsignedLongElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ulong value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = ulong.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlUnsignedLongElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, ulong value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		protected static void ReadXmlUnsignedShortElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, out ushort value)
		{
			foreach (AttributeValue currentElementAttribute in partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementAttributes)
			{
				currentElementAttribute.AttributeName.GetStrictQualifiedName(partManager.DocumentManager);
			}
			value = ushort.Parse(partManager.XmlReadManager.CurrentElementValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected static void WriteXmlUnsignedShortElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, string elementName, string defaultPrefix, ushort value)
		{
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteStartElement(elementName, defaultPrefix);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteValue(value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class XmlSchemaInstance : XmlNamespaceDefinitionBase
	{
		private const string Namespace = "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance";

		private const string _NamespacePrefix = "xsi";

		public const string type = "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance/type";

		public static readonly XmlSchemaInstance Instance = new XmlSchemaInstance();

		public override string NamespacePrefix => "xsi";

		private XmlSchemaInstance()
		{
		}

		public override string GetNamespaceUri(ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
		{
			if (conformance != ST_ConformanceClass.transitional)
			{
				_ = 1;
			}
			return "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance";
		}
	}

	internal static class Async
	{
		private class ForHelper
		{
			private readonly int _exclusiveMax;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _executeNextCallback;

			private readonly int _increment;

			private readonly Func<int, WorkItem> _statement;

			private int _value;

			public ForHelper(int initialValue, int exclusiveMax, int increment, Func<int, WorkItem> statement)
			{
				_value = initialValue;
				_exclusiveMax = exclusiveMax;
				_increment = increment;
				_statement = statement;
				_executeNextCallback = ExecuteNext;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				if (_exclusiveMax <= _value)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _statement(_value).Then(_executeNextCallback);
			}

			private WorkItem ExecuteNext()
			{
				_value += _increment;
				return Execute();
			}
		}

		private class ForSliceHelper
		{
			private readonly int _exclusiveMax;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _executeCallback;

			private readonly int _increment;

			private readonly Func<int, bool> _statement;

			private int _value;

			public ForSliceHelper(int initialValue, int exclusiveMax, int increment, Func<int, bool> statement)
			{
				_value = initialValue;
				_exclusiveMax = exclusiveMax;
				_increment = increment;
				_statement = statement;
				_executeCallback = Execute;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				while (_value < _exclusiveMax)
				{
					bool flag = _statement(_value);
					_value += _increment;
					if (!flag)
					{
						return WorkItem.Create(_executeCallback, WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class ForEachHelper<T>
		{
			private readonly IEnumerator<T> _enumerator;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _executeNextCallback;

			private readonly Func<T, WorkItem> _itemAction;

			public ForEachHelper(IEnumerator<T> enumerator, Func<T, WorkItem> itemAction)
			{
				_enumerator = enumerator;
				_itemAction = itemAction;
				_executeNextCallback = ExecuteNext;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				return Try(_executeNextCallback, delegate
				{
					if (_enumerator != null)
					{
						_enumerator.Dispose();
					}
				});
			}

			private WorkItem ExecuteNext()
			{
				if (!_enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _itemAction(_enumerator.Current).Then(_executeNextCallback);
			}
		}

		private class ForEachSliceHelper<T>
		{
			private readonly IEnumerator<T> _enumerator;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _executeNextCallback;

			private readonly Func<T, bool> _itemAction;

			public ForEachSliceHelper(IEnumerator<T> enumerator, Func<T, bool> itemAction)
			{
				_enumerator = enumerator;
				_itemAction = itemAction;
				_executeNextCallback = ExecuteNext;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				return Try(_executeNextCallback, delegate
				{
					if (_enumerator != null)
					{
						_enumerator.Dispose();
					}
				});
			}

			private WorkItem ExecuteNext()
			{
				while (_enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (!_itemAction(_enumerator.Current))
					{
						return WorkItem.Create(_executeNextCallback, WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class UsingHelper<T> where T : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly T _resource;

			private readonly Func<T, WorkItem> _statement;

			public UsingHelper(T resource, Func<T, WorkItem> statement)
			{
				_resource = resource;
				_statement = statement;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				return Try(() => _statement(_resource), delegate
				{
					if (_resource != null)
					{
						_resource.Dispose();
					}
				});
			}
		}

		private class UsingHelper<T, TResult> where T : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly T _resource;

			private readonly Func<T, WorkItem<TResult>> _statement;

			public UsingHelper(T resource, Func<T, WorkItem<TResult>> statement)
			{
				_resource = resource;
				_statement = statement;
			}

			public WorkItem<TResult> Execute()
			{
				return Try(() => _statement(_resource), delegate
				{
					if (_resource != null)
					{
						_resource.Dispose();
					}
				});
			}
		}

		private class WhileHelper
		{
			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _executeCallback;

			private readonly Func<bool> _condition;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _statement;

			public WhileHelper(Func<bool> condition, Func<WorkItem> statement)
			{
				_condition = condition;
				_statement = statement;
				_executeCallback = Execute;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				if (!_condition())
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _statement().Then(_executeCallback);
			}
		}

		private class WhileSliceHelper
		{
			private readonly Func<bool> _condition;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _executeCallback;

			private readonly Func<bool> _statement;

			public WhileSliceHelper(Func<bool> condition, Func<bool> statement)
			{
				_condition = condition;
				_statement = statement;
				_executeCallback = Execute;
			}

			public WorkItem Execute()
			{
				while (_condition())
				{
					if (!_statement())
					{
						return WorkItem.Create(_executeCallback, WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem For(int initialValue, int exclusiveMax, int increment, Func<int, WorkItem> statement)
		{
			return new ForHelper(initialValue, exclusiveMax, increment, statement).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem ForSlice(int initialValue, int exclusiveMax, int increment, Func<int, bool> statement)
		{
			return new ForSliceHelper(initialValue, exclusiveMax, increment, statement).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem ForEach<T>(IEnumerable<T> collection, Func<T, WorkItem> itemAction)
		{
			return new ForEachHelper<T>(collection.GetEnumerator(), itemAction).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem ForEachSlice<T>(IEnumerable<T> collection, Func<T, bool> itemAction)
		{
			return new ForEachSliceHelper<T>(collection.GetEnumerator(), itemAction).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem If(bool condition, Func<WorkItem> statement, Func<WorkItem> elseStatement = null)
		{
			if (condition)
			{
				return statement();
			}
			return elseStatement?.Invoke();
		}

		public static WorkItem Try(Func<WorkItem> @try, Action @finally)
		{
			try
			{
				return @try().Finally(@finally);
			}
			catch
			{
				@finally();
				throw;
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem<TResult> Try<TResult>(Func<WorkItem<TResult>> @try, Action @finally)
		{
			try
			{
				TResult result = default(TResult);
				return @try().Then(delegate(WorkItem<TResult> t)
				{
					result = t.GetResult();
				}).Finally(@finally).Then(() => result);
			}
			catch
			{
				@finally();
				throw;
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem Try<TException>(Func<WorkItem> @try, Action<TException> @catch, Action @finally = null) where TException : Exception
		{
			try
			{
				return @try().Catch(@catch).Finally(@finally);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				try
				{
					if (ex is TException obj)
					{
						@catch(obj);
						return null;
					}
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (@finally != null)
					{
						Action action = @finally;
						@finally = null;
						action();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem<TResult> Try<TException, TResult>(Func<WorkItem<TResult>> @try, Action<TException> @catch, Action @finally = null) where TException : Exception
		{
			try
			{
				TResult result = default(TResult);
				return @try().Then(delegate(WorkItem<TResult> t)
				{
					result = t.GetResult();
				}).Catch(@catch).Finally(@finally)
					.Then(() => result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				try
				{
					if (ex is TException obj)
					{
						@catch(obj);
						return null;
					}
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (@finally != null)
					{
						Action action = @finally;
						@finally = null;
						action();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem Try<TException1, TException2>(Func<WorkItem> @try, Action<TException1> catch1, Action<TException2> catch2, Action @finally = null) where TException1 : Exception where TException2 : Exception
		{
			try
			{
				return @try().Catch(catch1).Catch(catch2, isSubsequentCatch: true).Finally(@finally);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				try
				{
					if (ex is TException1 obj)
					{
						catch1(obj);
						return null;
					}
					if (ex is TException2 obj2)
					{
						catch2(obj2);
						return null;
					}
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (@finally != null)
					{
						Action action = @finally;
						@finally = null;
						action();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem Try<TException1, TException2, TException3>(Func<WorkItem> @try, Action<TException1> catch1, Action<TException2> catch2, Action<TException3> catch3, Action @finally = null) where TException1 : Exception where TException2 : Exception where TException3 : Exception
		{
			try
			{
				return @try().Catch(catch1).Catch(catch2, isSubsequentCatch: true).Catch(catch3, isSubsequentCatch: true)
					.Finally(@finally);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				try
				{
					if (ex is TException1 obj)
					{
						catch1(obj);
						return null;
					}
					if (ex is TException2 obj2)
					{
						catch2(obj2);
						return null;
					}
					if (ex is TException3 obj3)
					{
						catch3(obj3);
						return null;
					}
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (@finally != null)
					{
						Action action = @finally;
						@finally = null;
						action();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static WorkItem Catch<TException>(this WorkItem @this, Action<TException> action, bool isSubsequentCatch = false) where TException : Exception
		{
			return new WorkItem.WorkItemCatch<TException>(action, @this, isSubsequentCatch);
		}

		private static WorkItem Finally(this WorkItem @this, Action action)
		{
			if (action == null)
			{
				return @this;
			}
			return new WorkItem.WorkItemSync(action, WorkItemContinuationType.Synchronous, @this, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: false);
		}

		public static WorkItem Using<T>(WorkItem<T> resource, Func<T, WorkItem> statement) where T : IDisposable
		{
			return resource.Then((WorkItem<T> t) => new UsingHelper<T>(t.GetResult(), statement).Execute());
		}

		public static WorkItem Using<T>(T resource, Func<T, WorkItem> statement) where T : IDisposable
		{
			return new UsingHelper<T>(resource, statement).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem<TResult> Using<T, TResult>(T resource, Func<T, WorkItem<TResult>> statement) where T : IDisposable
		{
			return new UsingHelper<T, TResult>(resource, statement).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem<TResult> Using<T, TResult>(WorkItem<T> resource, Func<T, WorkItem<TResult>> statement) where T : IDisposable
		{
			return resource.Then((WorkItem<T> t) => new UsingHelper<T, TResult>(t.GetResult(), statement).Execute());
		}

		public static WorkItem While(Func<bool> condition, Func<WorkItem> statement)
		{
			return new WhileHelper(condition, statement).Execute();
		}

		public static WorkItem WhileSlice(Func<bool> condition, Func<bool> statement)
		{
			return new WhileSliceHelper(condition, statement).Execute();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class WorkItem
	{
		protected class ExceptionInfo
		{
			private readonly Exception _exception;

			private static readonly Func<Exception, object> TryCaptureExceptionDispatchInfo = CreateTryCaptureExceptionDispatchInfoFunc();

			private static readonly Action<object> TryThrowExceptionDispatchInfo = CreateTryThrowExceptionDispatchInfoAction();

			private readonly object _exceptionDispatchInfo;

			public Exception Exception => _exception;

			public ExceptionInfo(Exception e)
			{
				_exception = e;
				_exceptionDispatchInfo = TryCaptureExceptionDispatchInfo(e);
			}

			public void Rethrow()
			{
				TryThrowExceptionDispatchInfo(_exceptionDispatchInfo);
				throw _exception;
			}

			private static Func<Exception, object> CreateTryCaptureExceptionDispatchInfoFunc()
			{
				try
				{
					Type type = typeof(object).Assembly.GetType("System.Runtime.ExceptionServices.ExceptionDispatchInfo");
					if (type == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("Capture", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
					DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("TryCaptureExceptionDispatchInfo", type, new Type[1] { typeof(Exception) });
					ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, method);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
					return (Func<Exception, object>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<Exception, object>));
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
			}

			private static Action<object> CreateTryThrowExceptionDispatchInfoAction()
			{
				try
				{
					Type type = Utilities.GetAssemblyFromType(typeof(object)).GetType("System.Runtime.ExceptionServices.ExceptionDispatchInfo");
					if (type == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("Throw", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
					DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("TryThrowExceptionDispatchInfo", null, new Type[1] { typeof(object) });
					ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
					Label label = iLGenerator.DefineLabel();
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Brfalse_S, label);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Castclass, type);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Callvirt, method);
					iLGenerator.MarkLabel(label);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
					return (Action<object>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<object>));
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal class WorkItemSync : WorkItem
		{
			private readonly Action _action;

			public WorkItemSync(Action action, WorkItemContinuationType type, WorkItem previous = null, bool onlyRunOnNotFaulted = true)
				: base(type, previous, onlyRunOnNotFaulted)
			{
				_action = action;
			}

			protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
			{
				_action();
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class WorkItemSync<TResult> : WorkItem<TResult>
		{
			private readonly Func<TResult> _action;

			public WorkItemSync(Func<TResult> action, WorkItemContinuationType type, WorkItem previous = null, bool onlyRunOnNotFaulted = true)
				: base(type, previous, onlyRunOnNotFaulted)
			{
				_action = action;
			}

			protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
			{
				base.ResultInternal = _action();
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class WorkItemAsync : WorkItem
		{
			private bool _preformedAction;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem> _asyncAction;

			public WorkItemAsync(Func<WorkItem> asyncAction, WorkItemContinuationType type, WorkItem previous = null, bool onlyRunOnNotFaulted = true)
				: base(type, previous, onlyRunOnNotFaulted)
			{
				_asyncAction = asyncAction;
			}

			protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
			{
				if (!_preformedAction)
				{
					_preformedAction = true;
					return ExecuteCoreAsyncHelper(_asyncAction(), scheduler);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class WorkItemAsync<TResult> : WorkItem<TResult>
		{
			private bool _preformedAction;

			private readonly Func<WorkItem<TResult>> _asyncAction;

			public WorkItem<TResult> PendingResultWorkItem { get; set; }

			public WorkItemAsync(Func<WorkItem<TResult>> asyncAction, WorkItemContinuationType type, WorkItem previous = null, bool onlyRunOnNotFaulted = true)
				: base(type, previous, onlyRunOnNotFaulted)
			{
				_asyncAction = asyncAction;
			}

			protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
			{
				if (!_preformedAction)
				{
					_preformedAction = true;
					WorkItem<TResult> workItem = (PendingResultWorkItem = _asyncAction());
					return ExecuteCoreAsyncHelper(workItem, scheduler);
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected override void OnPreviousWorkCompleted(WorkItem previous)
			{
				if (PendingResultWorkItem != null)
				{
					if (PendingResultWorkItem.Exception == null)
					{
						base.ResultInternal = PendingResultWorkItem.GetResult();
					}
					PendingResultWorkItem = null;
				}
				base.OnPreviousWorkCompleted(previous);
			}
		}

		internal class WorkItemCatch<TException> : WorkItem where TException : Exception
		{
			private readonly Action<TException> _action;

			private readonly bool _isSubsequentCatch;

			protected override bool IsSubsequentCatch => _isSubsequentCatch;

			public WorkItemCatch(Action<TException> action, WorkItem previous, bool isSubsequentCatch)
				: base(WorkItemContinuationType.Synchronous, previous)
			{
				_action = action;
				_isSubsequentCatch = isSubsequentCatch;
			}

			protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
			{
				return true;
			}

			protected override bool TryHandleException(ref ExceptionInfo info)
			{
				if (info.Exception is TException obj)
				{
					try
					{
						_action(obj);
						info = null;
					}
					catch (Exception e)
					{
						info = new ExceptionInfo(e);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Action NoOpAction = delegate
		{
		};

		private ExceptionInfo _exceptionInfo;

		private bool _isComplete;

		private readonly bool _onlyRunOnNotFaulted;

		private WorkItem _next;

		private WorkItem _rootItem;

		private WorkItemContinuationType _type;

		public Exception Exception
		{
			get
			{
				if (_exceptionInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _exceptionInfo.Exception;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSubsequentCatch => false;

		public bool IsComplete
		{
			get
			{
				return _isComplete;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_isComplete = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsWaitingOnExternalEvent => false;

		internal WorkItem RootItem => _rootItem ?? this;

		public WorkItemContinuationType Type => _type;

		protected WorkItem(WorkItemContinuationType type, WorkItem previous, bool onlyRunOnNotFaulted = true)
		{
			_type = type;
			_onlyRunOnNotFaulted = onlyRunOnNotFaulted;
			previous?.SetNext(this);
		}

		public static WorkItem Create(Action action, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItemSync(action, type);
		}

		public static WorkItem Create(Func<WorkItem> asyncAction, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItemAsync(asyncAction, type);
		}

		public static WorkItem<TResult> Create<TResult>(Func<TResult> action, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItemSync<TResult>(action, type);
		}

		public static WorkItem<TResult> Create<TResult>(Func<WorkItem<TResult>> asyncAction, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItemAsync<TResult>(asyncAction, type);
		}

		internal void Execute(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
		{
			try
			{
				if (IsComplete)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_exceptionInfo != null && _onlyRunOnNotFaulted)
				{
					if (TryHandleException(ref _exceptionInfo))
					{
						SkipSubsequentCatchHandlers();
					}
					IsComplete = true;
				}
				else if (ExecuteCore(scheduler))
				{
					IsComplete = true;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception e)
			{
				_exceptionInfo = new ExceptionInfo(e);
				IsComplete = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (IsComplete)
				{
					RunNextWorkItem(scheduler);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler);

		private bool ExecuteCoreAsyncHelper(WorkItem workItem, WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
		{
			if (workItem == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			workItem.SetNext(this);
			if (!workItem.IsWaitingOnExternalEvent)
			{
				scheduler.QueueWorkItem(workItem);
			}
			else
			{
				workItem.Execute(scheduler);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static WorkItem<T> FromResult<T>(T result)
		{
			return new WorkItemSync<T>(() => result, WorkItemContinuationType.Synchronous);
		}

		public static WorkItem<T> FromResultCompleted<T>(T result)
		{
			WorkItem<T> workItem = FromResult(result);
			workItem.Execute(WorkItemScheduler.Synchronous());
			return workItem;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPreviousWorkCompleted(WorkItem previous)
		{
			previous.SetNext(null);
			_exceptionInfo = previous._exceptionInfo;
		}

		public void RethrowIfExceptional()
		{
			if (_exceptionInfo != null)
			{
				_exceptionInfo.Rethrow();
			}
		}

		private void RunNextWorkItem(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
		{
			WorkItem next = _next;
			if (next != null)
			{
				next.OnPreviousWorkCompleted(this);
				if (!next.IsWaitingOnExternalEvent)
				{
					scheduler.QueueWorkItem(next);
				}
				else
				{
					next.Execute(scheduler);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RethrowIfExceptional();
			}
		}

		protected void SetExceptionInfo(ExceptionInfo exceptionInfo)
		{
			_exceptionInfo = exceptionInfo;
		}

		private void SetNext(WorkItem newValue)
		{
			if (_next == newValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				_next._rootItem = null;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_next != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This work item has other work already scheduled after it.");
				}
				newValue._rootItem = RootItem;
			}
			_next = newValue;
		}

		private void SkipSubsequentCatchHandlers()
		{
			WorkItem previous = this;
			WorkItem next = _next;
			while (next != null && next.IsSubsequentCatch)
			{
				next.OnPreviousWorkCompleted(previous);
				next.IsComplete = true;
				previous = next;
				next = next._next;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool TryHandleException(ref ExceptionInfo info)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class WorkItem<TResult> : WorkItem

		public TResult ResultInternal { get; protected set; }

		protected WorkItem(WorkItemContinuationType type, WorkItem previous, bool onlyRunOnNotFaulted = true)
			: base(type, previous, onlyRunOnNotFaulted)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class ExternalEventWorkItem : WorkItem
	{
		private bool _eventOccurred;

		private WorkItemScheduler _scheduler;

		public override bool IsWaitingOnExternalEvent => !_eventOccurred;

		public ExternalEventWorkItem()
			: base(WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous, null, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: false)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
		{
			if (_eventOccurred)
			{
				return true;
			}
			_scheduler = scheduler;
			return false;
		}

		public void Signal(Exception exception = null)
		{
			if (exception != null)
			{
				SetExceptionInfo(new ExceptionInfo(exception));
			}
			_eventOccurred = true;
			if (_scheduler != null)
			{
				_scheduler.QueueWorkItem(this);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ExternalEventWorkItem<T> : WorkItem<T>
	{
		private bool _eventOccurred;

		private WorkItemScheduler _scheduler;

		public override bool IsWaitingOnExternalEvent => !_eventOccurred;

		public ExternalEventWorkItem()
			: base(WorkItemContinuationType.Asynchronous, (WorkItem)null, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: false)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ExecuteCore(WorkItemScheduler scheduler)
		{
			if (_eventOccurred)
			{
				return true;
			}
			_scheduler = scheduler;
			return false;
		}

		public void Signal(T result, Exception exception = null)
		{
			base.ResultInternal = result;
			if (exception != null)
			{
				SetExceptionInfo(new ExceptionInfo(exception));
			}
			_eventOccurred = true;
			if (_scheduler != null)
			{
				_scheduler.QueueWorkItem(this);
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum WorkItemContinuationType : byte
	{
		Default,
		Synchronous,
		Asynchronous
	}
	internal abstract class WorkItemScheduler
	{
		private class SynchronousImpl : WorkItemScheduler
		{
			private readonly Queue<WorkItem> _workItems;

			public SynchronousImpl()
			{
				_workItems = new Queue<WorkItem>();
			}

			public override void Execute(WorkItem workItem)
			{
				if (workItem != null)
				{
					QueueWorkItem(workItem);
					while (_workItems.Count != 0)
					{
						_workItems.Dequeue()?.Execute(this);
					}
				}
			}

			public override void QueueWorkItem(WorkItem workItem)
			{
				_workItems.Enqueue(workItem.RootItem);
			}
		}

		public abstract void Execute(WorkItem workItem);

		public abstract void QueueWorkItem(WorkItem workItem);

		public static WorkItemScheduler Default()
		{
			return Synchronous();
		}

		public static WorkItemScheduler Synchronous()
		{
			return new SynchronousImpl();
		}
	}

		private class WorkItemCompleted<T> : WorkItem<T>
		{
			public static readonly WorkItemCompleted<T> Instance = new WorkItemCompleted<T>();

			private WorkItemCompleted()
				: base(WorkItemContinuationType.Synchronous, (WorkItem)null, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: true)
			{
				base.IsComplete = true;

		public static void ExecuteSynchronously(this WorkItem @this)
		{
			WorkItemScheduler.Synchronous().Execute(@this);
		}

		public static void ExecuteWithDefaultScheduler(this WorkItem @this)
		{
			WorkItemScheduler.Default().Execute(@this.Then(delegate(WorkItem t)
			{
				t.RethrowIfExceptional();
			}, WorkItemContinuationType.Synchronous));
		}

		public static TResult GetResult<TResult>(this WorkItem<TResult> @this)
		{
			if (@this == null)
			{
				return default(TResult);
			}
			if (!@this.IsComplete)
			{
				WorkItemScheduler.Synchronous().Execute(@this);
			}
			@this.RethrowIfExceptional();
			return @this.ResultInternal;
		}

		public static WorkItem Then(this WorkItem @this, Action action, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItem.WorkItemSync(action, type, @this);
		}

		public static WorkItem Then(this WorkItem @this, Action<WorkItem> action, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItem.WorkItemSync(delegate
			{
				action(@this ?? WorkItemCompleted.Instance);
			}, type, @this, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: false);
		}

		public static WorkItem Then<T>(this WorkItem<T> @this, Action<WorkItem<T>> action, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)

			return new WorkItem.WorkItemSync(delegate
			{
				action(@this ?? WorkItemCompleted<T>.Instance);
			}, type, @this, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: false);

		{
			return new WorkItem.WorkItemAsync(asyncAction, type, @this);
		}

		public static WorkItem Then(this WorkItem @this, Func<WorkItem, WorkItem> asyncAction, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
		{
			return new WorkItem.WorkItemAsync(() => asyncAction(@this ?? WorkItemCompleted.Instance), type, @this, onlyRunOnNotFaulted: false);
		}

		public static WorkItem Then<T>(this WorkItem<T> @this, Func<WorkItem<T>, WorkItem> asyncAction, WorkItemContinuationType type = WorkItemContinuationType.Default)
