	internal class ContextStack
	{
		private List<object> contexts;

		private bool _shouldIgnoreChildren;

		public int Count => contexts.Count;

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (contexts.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return contexts[contexts.Count - 1];
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldIgnoreChildren => _shouldIgnoreChildren;

		public ContextStack()
		{
			contexts = new List<object>();
		}

		public void ClearToCount(int newCount)
		{
			while (Count > newCount)
			{
				Pop();
			}
		}

		public void ClearToCountOrCurrent(int newCount, object newCurrent)
		{
			while (Count > newCount && Current != newCurrent)
			{
				Pop();
			}
		}

		public T Get<T>()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			bool flag = typeFromHandle == typeof(object);
			for (int num = contexts.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = contexts[num];
				if (obj == null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						return default(T);
					}
				}
				else if (typeFromHandle.IsInstanceOfType(obj))
				{
					return (T)obj;
				}
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		public void ReplaceItem(object instance, object replacement)
		{
			int num = contexts.LastIndexOf(instance);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				contexts[num] = replacement;
			}
		}

		public object Pop()
		{
			object current = Current;
			contexts.RemoveAt(contexts.Count - 1);
			if (_shouldIgnoreChildren && current == IgnoreChildrenMarker.Instance)
			{
				_shouldIgnoreChildren = Get<IgnoreChildrenMarker>() != null;
			}
			return current;
		}

		public void Push(object context)
		{
			contexts.Add(context);
			if (!_shouldIgnoreChildren && context == IgnoreChildrenMarker.Instance)
			{
				_shouldIgnoreChildren = true;
			}
		}

		public object Get(Func<object, bool> callback)
		{
			for (int num = contexts.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = contexts[num];
				if (obj != null && callback(obj))
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Remove(object item)
		{
			if (contexts == null || contexts.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = contexts.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = contexts[num];
				if (item == obj)
				{
					contexts.RemoveAt(num);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private Dictionary<string, string> CustomizedStrings
		{
			get
			{
				if (customizedStrings == null)
				{
					customizedStrings = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				}
				return customizedStrings;
			}
		}

		public string GetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			if (CustomizedStrings.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return CustomizedStrings[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void ResetAllCustomizedStrings()
		{
			if (customizedStrings != null)
			{
				customizedStrings.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void ResetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			SetCustomizedString(name, null);
		}

		public void SetCustomizedString(string name, string customizedText)
		{
			if (CustomizedStrings.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				CustomizedStrings.Remove(name);
			}
			if (customizedText != null)
			{
				CustomizedStrings.Add(name, customizedText);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SeekableBufferedStream : Stream
	{
		private const int MaxBufferLength = 10240;

		private Stream baseStream;

		private long length;

		private long position;

		private byte[] buffer;

		private int bufferLength;

		private int bufferPosition;

		private bool bytesWrittenToBuffer;

		private int baseStreamPositionInBuffer;

		public override bool CanRead => baseStream.CanRead;

		public override bool CanSeek => baseStream.CanSeek;

		public override bool CanWrite => baseStream.CanWrite;

		public override long Length => length;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (position != value)
				{
					Seek(value - position, SeekOrigin.Current);
				}
			}
		}

		public SeekableBufferedStream(Stream baseStream)
		{
			this.baseStream = baseStream;
			buffer = new byte[10240];
			length = baseStream.Length;
			position = baseStream.Position;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					Flush();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			if (bytesWrittenToBuffer)
			{
				bytesWrittenToBuffer = false;
				if (baseStreamPositionInBuffer > 0)
				{
					baseStream.Seek(-baseStreamPositionInBuffer, SeekOrigin.Current);
				}
				baseStream.Write(buffer, 0, bufferLength);
			}
			baseStream.Position = position;
			bufferPosition = 0;
			bufferLength = 0;
			baseStreamPositionInBuffer = 0;
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] array, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = count - (bufferLength - bufferPosition);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (bufferLength + num <= 10240)
				{
					if (baseStreamPositionInBuffer != bufferLength)
					{
						baseStream.Seek(bufferLength - baseStreamPositionInBuffer, SeekOrigin.Current);
					}
					int num2 = baseStream.Read(buffer, bufferLength, 10240 - bufferLength);
					bufferLength += num2;
					baseStreamPositionInBuffer = bufferLength;
					num -= num2;
				}
				else
				{
					Flush();
					if (count > 10240)
					{
						int num3 = baseStream.Read(array, offset, count);
						position += num3;
						return num3;
					}
					bufferLength = baseStream.Read(buffer, 0, 10240);
					baseStreamPositionInBuffer = bufferLength;
					num = count - bufferLength;
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			int num4 = count - num;
			Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, bufferPosition, array, offset, num4);
			bufferPosition += num4;
			position += num4;
			return num4;
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			if (origin != SeekOrigin.Current)
			{
				switch (origin)
				{
				case SeekOrigin.Begin:
					Position = offset;
					break;
				case SeekOrigin.End:
					Position = length + offset;
					break;
				}
				return position;
			}
			if (offset == 0L)
			{
				return position;
			}
			position += offset;
			if (int.MinValue <= offset && offset <= int.MaxValue)
			{
				bufferPosition += (int)offset;
				if (bufferPosition >= 0)
				{
					if (bufferPosition <= bufferLength)
					{
						return position;
					}
					if (bufferPosition <= 10240)
					{
						if (baseStream.Length - baseStream.Position <= bufferLength - baseStreamPositionInBuffer)
						{
							return position;
						}
						if (baseStreamPositionInBuffer != bufferLength)
						{
							baseStream.Seek(bufferLength - baseStreamPositionInBuffer, SeekOrigin.Current);
						}
						int num = baseStream.Read(buffer, bufferLength, 10240 - bufferLength);
						bufferLength += num;
						baseStreamPositionInBuffer = bufferLength;
						return position;
					}
				}
			}
			Flush();
			return position;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			Flush();
			baseStream.SetLength(value);
			length = baseStream.Length;
			position = baseStream.Position;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] array, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = count - (bufferLength - bufferPosition);
			if (num > 0 && 10240 < bufferLength + num)
			{
				Flush();
				if (10240 < count)
				{
					baseStream.Write(array, offset, count);
					position += count;
					if (length < position)
					{
						length = position;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			bytesWrittenToBuffer = true;
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array, offset, buffer, bufferPosition, count);
			bufferPosition += count;
			position += count;
			if (bufferLength < bufferPosition)
			{
				bufferLength = bufferPosition;
			}
			if (length < position)
			{
				length = position;
			}
		}
	}

		internal static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(List<T> list, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			T[] array = list.ToArray();
			SortMergeGeneric(array, null, comparer);
			list.Clear();
			list.AddRange(array);
		}

		internal static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(T[] arr, T[] tmpArr, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			SortMergeGeneric(arr, tmpArr, comparer, 0, arr.Length - 1);
		}

		internal static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(T[] arr, T[] tmpArr, IComparer<T> comparer, int si, int ei)
		{
			if (arr == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("arr");
			}
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("comparer");
			}
			if (tmpArr == null)
			{
				tmpArr = (T[])arr.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Copy(arr, tmpArr, arr.Length);
			}
			SortMergeHelper(arr, tmpArr, comparer, si, ei);
		}

		private static void SortMergeHelper<T>(T[] arr, T[] tmpArr, IComparer<T> comparer, int si, int ei)
		{
			T val = default(T);
			T val2 = default(T);
			int i;
			int num;
			if (ei - si < 6)
			{
				for (i = 1 + si; i <= ei; i++)
				{
					val = arr[i];
					for (num = i; num > si; num--)
					{
						val2 = arr[num - 1];
						if (comparer.Compare(val, val2) >= 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						arr[num] = val2;
					}
					if (i != num)
					{
						arr[num] = val;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			int num2 = (si + ei) / 2;
			SortMergeHelper(tmpArr, arr, comparer, si, num2);
			SortMergeHelper(tmpArr, arr, comparer, 1 + num2, ei);
			i = si;
			num = 1 + num2;
			for (int j = si; j <= ei; j++)
			{
				if (i <= num2)
				{
					val = tmpArr[i];
				}
				if (num <= ei)
				{
					val2 = tmpArr[num];
				}
				if (num > ei || (i <= num2 && comparer.Compare(val, val2) <= 0))
				{
					arr[j] = val;
					i++;
				}
				else
				{
					arr[j] = val2;
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class ValueTuple
	{
		public static ValueTuple<T1, T2> Create<T1, T2>(T1 item1, T2 item2)
		{
			return new ValueTuple<T1, T2>(item1, item2);
		}
	}
	internal struct ValueTuple<T1, T2> : IEquatable<ValueTuple<T1, T2>>
	{
		private static readonly EqualityComparer<T1> comparer1 = EqualityComparer<T1>.Default;

		private static readonly EqualityComparer<T2> comparer2 = EqualityComparer<T2>.Default;

		public readonly T1 Item1;

		public readonly T2 Item2;

		private readonly int _hashCode;

		public ValueTuple(T1 item1, T2 item2)
		{
			Item1 = item1;
			Item2 = item2;
			_hashCode = (comparer1.GetHashCode(Item1) << 5) ^ comparer2.GetHashCode(Item2);
		}

		public bool Equals(ValueTuple<T1, T2> other)
		{
			if (comparer1.Equals(Item1, other.Item1))
			{
				return comparer2.Equals(Item2, other.Item2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ValueTuple<T1, T2>? valueTuple = obj as ValueTuple<T1, T2>?;
			if (valueTuple.HasValue)
			{
				return Equals(valueTuple.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _hashCode;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ValueTuple<T1, T2> left, ValueTuple<T1, T2> right)
		{
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ValueTuple<T1, T2> left, ValueTuple<T1, T2> right)
		{
			return !left.Equals(right);
		}
	}

	internal static class VariantUtilities
	{
		internal static VariantType GetVariantType(object variant)
		{
			if (variant is Array array)
			{
				VariantType variantType = GetVariantType(array.GetValue(0));
				for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					VariantType variantType2 = GetVariantType(array.GetValue(i));
					if (variantType2 != variantType)
					{
						variantType = VariantType.Variant;
						break;
					}
				}
				return VariantType.Vector | variantType;
			}
			if (variant is bool)
			{
				return VariantType.Bool;
			}
			if (variant is decimal)
			{
				return VariantType.Decimal;
			}
			if (variant is DateTime)
			{
				return VariantType.FileTime;
			}
			if (variant is int)
			{
				return VariantType.I4;
			}
			if (variant is sbyte)
			{
				return VariantType.I1;
			}
			if (variant is short)
			{
				return VariantType.I2;
			}
			if (variant is long)
			{
				return VariantType.I8;
			}
			if (variant is float)
			{
				return VariantType.R4;
			}
			if (variant is double)
			{
				return VariantType.R8;
			}
			if (variant is byte)
			{
				return VariantType.UI1;
			}
			if (variant is ushort)
			{
				return VariantType.UI2;
			}
			if (variant is uint)
			{
				return VariantType.UI4;
			}
			if (variant is ulong)
			{
				return VariantType.UI8;
			}
			if (variant is string)
			{
				return VariantType.LPSTR;
			}
			if (variant == null)
			{
				return VariantType.Null;
			}
			return VariantType.Unknown;
		}

		private static string ReadString(BinaryReader reader, Encoding encoding, bool isSingleByte)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (!isSingleByte)
			{
				num += num % 2;
				num *= 2;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[num];
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				byte b = reader.ReadByte();
				if (b == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				array[i] = b;
				if (!isSingleByte)
				{
					i++;
					array[i] = reader.ReadByte();
				}
			}
			for (int j = i + 1; j < num; j++)
			{
				byte b2 = reader.ReadByte();
			}
			return encoding.GetString(array, 0, i);
		}

		internal static object ReadVariant(BinaryReader reader, Encoding encoding)
		{
			VariantType type = (VariantType)reader.ReadInt32();
			return ReadVariantType(reader, type, encoding);
		}

		internal static object ReadVariantType(BinaryReader reader, VariantType type, Encoding encoding)
		{
			if ((type & VariantType.Vector) == VariantType.Vector)
			{
				VariantType type2 = type & (VariantType)(-4097);
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				object[] array = new object[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					array[i] = ReadVariantType(reader, type2, encoding);
				}
				return array;
			}
			switch (type)
			{
			case VariantType.BLOB:
			{
				int count = reader.ReadInt32();
				return reader.ReadBytes(count);
			}
			case VariantType.Bool:
				return reader.ReadBoolean();
			case VariantType.CLSID:
				return new Guid(reader.ReadBytes(16));
			case VariantType.Decimal:
				return reader.ReadDecimal();
			case VariantType.Empty:
				return null;
			case VariantType.FileTime:
				return DateTime.FromFileTime(reader.ReadInt64());
			case VariantType.I1:
				return reader.ReadSByte();
			case VariantType.I2:
				return reader.ReadInt16();
			case VariantType.I4:
			case VariantType.INT:
				return reader.ReadInt32();
			case VariantType.I8:
				return reader.ReadInt64();
			case VariantType.LPSTR:
				return ReadString(reader, encoding, !encoding.Equals(Encoding.Unicode));
			case VariantType.LPWSTR:
				return ReadString(reader, Encoding.Unicode, isSingleByte: false);
			case VariantType.Null:
				return null;
			case VariantType.R4:
				return reader.ReadSingle();
			case VariantType.R8:
				return reader.ReadDouble();
			case VariantType.UI1:
				return reader.ReadByte();
			case VariantType.UI2:
				return reader.ReadUInt16();
			case VariantType.UI4:
			case VariantType.UINT:
				return reader.ReadUInt32();
			case VariantType.UI8:
				return reader.ReadUInt64();
			case VariantType.Variant:
				return ReadVariant(reader, encoding);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static void WriteString(BinaryWriter writer, Encoding encoding, string value, bool alignStringLengthBy4Bytes)
		{
			byte[] bytes = encoding.GetBytes(value);
			int value2 = bytes.Length + 1;
			if (alignStringLengthBy4Bytes)
			{
				value2 = Utilities.RoundUpToMultiple(value2, 4);
			}
			writer.Write(value2);
			writer.Write(bytes);
			writer.Write((byte)0);
		}

		internal static void WriteVariant(BinaryWriter writer, Encoding encoding, object value)
		{
			WriteVariant(writer, encoding, value, alignBy4Bytes: true);
		}

		internal static void WriteVariant(BinaryWriter writer, Encoding encoding, object value, bool alignBy4Bytes)
		{
			VariantType variantType = GetVariantType(value);
			writer.Write((int)variantType);
			WriteVariantType(writer, variantType, encoding, value, alignBy4Bytes);
			if (alignBy4Bytes && (variantType & VariantType.Vector) == 0)
			{
				while (writer.BaseStream.Position % 4 != 0L)
				{
					writer.Write((byte)0);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void WriteVariantType(BinaryWriter writer, VariantType type, Encoding encoding, object value, bool alignStringLengthBy4Bytes)
		{
			if ((type & VariantType.Vector) == VariantType.Vector)
			{
				VariantType type2 = type & (VariantType)(-4097);
				Array array = (Array)value;
				int length = array.Length;
				writer.Write(length);
				for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
				{
					WriteVariantType(writer, type2, encoding, array.GetValue(i), alignStringLengthBy4Bytes: false);
				}
			}
			else if (type <= VariantType.Vector)
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				default:
					_ = 4096;
					break;
				case VariantType.Bool:
					writer.Write((bool)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.Decimal:
					writer.Write((decimal)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.Empty:
					writer.Write(0);
					break;
				case VariantType.FileTime:
					writer.Write(((DateTime)value).ToFileTime());
					break;
				case VariantType.I1:
					writer.Write((sbyte)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.I2:
					writer.Write((short)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.I4:
				case VariantType.INT:
					writer.Write((int)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.I8:
					writer.Write((long)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.LPSTR:
					WriteString(writer, encoding, (string)value, alignStringLengthBy4Bytes);
					break;
				case VariantType.LPWSTR:
					WriteString(writer, Encoding.Unicode, (string)value, alignStringLengthBy4Bytes);
					break;
				case VariantType.Null:
					writer.Write(0);
					break;
				case VariantType.R4:
					writer.Write((float)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.R8:
					writer.Write((double)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.UI1:
					writer.Write((byte)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.UI2:
					writer.Write((ushort)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.UI4:
				case VariantType.UINT:
					writer.Write((uint)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.UI8:
					writer.Write((ulong)value);
					break;
				case VariantType.Variant:
					WriteVariant(writer, encoding, value, alignStringLengthBy4Bytes);
					break;
				case VariantType.CY:
				case VariantType.Date:
				case VariantType.Bstr:
				case VariantType.Dispatch:
				case VariantType.Error:
				case VariantType.Unknown:
				case (VariantType)15:
				case VariantType.VOID:
				case VariantType.Hresult:
				case VariantType.PTR:
				case VariantType.SafeArray:
				case VariantType.CARRAY:
				case VariantType.UserDefined:
				case (VariantType)32:
				case (VariantType)33:
				case (VariantType)34:
				case (VariantType)35:
				case (VariantType)36:
				case (VariantType)37:
				case (VariantType)38:
				case (VariantType)39:
				case (VariantType)40:
				case (VariantType)41:
				case (VariantType)42:
				case (VariantType)43:
				case (VariantType)44:
				case (VariantType)45:
				case (VariantType)46:
				case (VariantType)47:
				case (VariantType)48:
				case (VariantType)49:
				case (VariantType)50:
				case (VariantType)51:
				case (VariantType)52:
				case (VariantType)53:
				case (VariantType)54:
				case (VariantType)55:
				case (VariantType)56:
				case (VariantType)57:
				case (VariantType)58:
				case (VariantType)59:
				case (VariantType)60:
				case (VariantType)61:
				case (VariantType)62:
				case (VariantType)63:
				case VariantType.BLOB:
				case VariantType.Stream:
				case VariantType.Storage:
				case VariantType.StreamedObject:
				case VariantType.BLOBObject:
				case VariantType.CF:
				case VariantType.CLSID:
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (type != VariantType.Array && type != VariantType.ByRef)
			{
				_ = 32768;
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.Sgml
{
	internal enum LiteralType
	{
		CDATA,
		SDATA,
		PI
	}
	internal class Entity
	{
		public const char EOF = '\uffff';

		public string Proxy;

		public string Name;

		public bool Internal;

		public string PublicId;

		public string Uri;

		public string Literal;

		public LiteralType LiteralType;

		public Entity Parent;

		public bool Html;

		public int Line;

		public char Lastchar;

		public bool IsWhitespace;

		private Encoding encoding;

		private Uri resolvedUri;

		private TextReader stm;

		private bool weOwnTheStream;

		private int lineStart;

		private int absolutePos;

		private static int[] CtrlMap = new int[32]
		{
			8364, 129, 8218, 402, 8222, 8230, 8224, 8225, 710, 8240,
			352, 8249, 338, 141, 381, 143, 144, 8216, 8217, 8220,
			8221, 8226, 8211, 8212, 732, 8482, 353, 8250, 339, 157,
			382, 376
		};

		public Uri ResolvedUri
		{
			get
			{
				if (resolvedUri != null)
				{
					return resolvedUri;
				}
				if (Parent != null)
				{
					return Parent.ResolvedUri;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public int LinePosition => absolutePos - lineStart + 1;

		public Entity(string name, string pubid, string uri, string proxy)
		{
			Name = name;
			PublicId = pubid;
			Uri = uri;
			Proxy = proxy;
			Html = name != null && StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "html");
		}

		public Entity(string name, string literal)
		{
			Name = name;
			Literal = literal;
			Internal = true;
		}

		public Entity(string name, Uri baseUri, TextReader stm, string proxy)
		{
			Name = name;
			Internal = true;
			this.stm = stm;
			resolvedUri = baseUri;
			Proxy = proxy;
			Html = string.Compare(name, "html", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0;
		}

		public char ReadChar()
		{
			char c = (char)stm.Read();
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				c = ' ';
			}
			absolutePos++;
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\n':
				IsWhitespace = true;
				lineStart = absolutePos + 1;
				Line++;
				break;
			case '\t':
			case ' ':
				IsWhitespace = true;
				if (Lastchar == '\r')
				{
					lineStart = absolutePos;
					Line++;
				}
				break;
			case '\r':
				IsWhitespace = true;
				break;
			default:
				IsWhitespace = false;
				if (Lastchar == '\r')
				{
					Line++;
					lineStart = absolutePos;
				}
				break;
			}
			Lastchar = c;
			return c;
		}

		public void Open(Entity parent, Uri baseUri)
		{
			Parent = parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				Html = parent.Html;
			}
			Line = 1;
			if (Internal)
			{
				if (Literal != null)
				{
					stm = new StringReader(Literal);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (Uri == null)
			{
				Error("Unresolvable entity '{0}'", Name);
				return;
			}
			if (baseUri != null)
			{
				resolvedUri = new Uri(baseUri, Uri);
			}
			else
			{
				resolvedUri = new Uri(Uri);
			}
			Stream stream = null;
			Encoding defaultEncoding = Encoding.Default;
			string scheme = resolvedUri.Scheme;
			if (scheme == "file")
			{
				string localPath = resolvedUri.LocalPath;
				stream = new FileStream(localPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			}
			else
			{
				HttpWebRequest httpWebRequest = (HttpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create(ResolvedUri);
				httpWebRequest.UserAgent = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible;);";
				httpWebRequest.Timeout = 10000;
				if (Proxy != null)
				{
					httpWebRequest.Proxy = new WebProxy(Proxy);
				}
				httpWebRequest.PreAuthenticate = false;
				httpWebRequest.Credentials = CredentialCache.DefaultCredentials;
				WebResponse response = httpWebRequest.GetResponse();
				Uri responseUri = response.ResponseUri;
				if (responseUri.AbsoluteUri != resolvedUri.AbsoluteUri)
				{
					resolvedUri = responseUri;
				}
				string text = response.ContentType.ToLower();
				string a = text;
				int num = text.IndexOf(';');
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					a = text.Substring(0, num);
				}
				if (StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(a, "text/html"))
				{
					Html = true;
				}
				num = text.IndexOf("charset");
				defaultEncoding = Encoding.Default;
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					int num2 = text.IndexOf("=", num);
					int num3 = text.IndexOf(";", num2);
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						num3 = text.Length;
					}
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						num2++;
						string name = text.Substring(num2, num3 - num2).Trim();
						try
						{
							defaultEncoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(name);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
				}
				stream = response.GetResponseStream();
			}
			weOwnTheStream = true;
			HtmlStream htmlStream = new HtmlStream(stream, defaultEncoding);
			encoding = htmlStream.Encoding;
			stm = htmlStream;
		}

		public Encoding GetEncoding()
		{
			return encoding;
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			if (weOwnTheStream)
			{
				stm.Close();
			}
		}

		public char SkipWhitespace()
		{
			char c = Lastchar;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\t':
				case '\n':
				case '\r':
				case ' ':
					break;
				default:
					return c;
				}
				c = ReadChar();
			}
		}

		public string ScanToken(StringBuilder sb, string term, bool nmtoken)
		{
			sb.Length = 0;
			char c = Lastchar;
			if (nmtoken && c != '_' && !char.IsLetter(c))
			{
				throw new Exception($"Invalid name start character '{c}'");
			}
			while (c != '\uffff' && term.IndexOf(c) < 0)
			{
				if (!nmtoken || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '-' || c == ':' || char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
				{
					sb.Append(c);
					c = ReadChar();
					continue;
				}
				throw new Exception($"Invalid name character '{c}'");
			}
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		public string ScanLiteral(StringBuilder sb, char quote)
		{
			sb.Length = 0;
			char c = ReadChar();
			while (c != '\uffff' && c != quote)
			{
				if (c == '&')
				{
					c = ReadChar();
					if (c == '#')
					{
						string value = ExpandCharEntity();
						sb.Append(value);
						c = Lastchar;
					}
					else
					{
						sb.Append('&');
						sb.Append(c);
						c = ReadChar();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					sb.Append(c);
					c = ReadChar();
				}
			}
			ReadChar();
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		public string ScanToEnd(StringBuilder sb, string type, string terminators)
		{
			if (sb != null)
			{
				sb.Length = 0;
			}
			int line = Line;
			char c = ReadChar();
			int num = 0;
			char c2 = terminators[num];
			while (c != '\uffff')
			{
				if (c == c2)
				{
					num++;
					if (num >= terminators.Length)
					{
						break;
					}
					c2 = terminators[num];
				}
				else if (num > 0)
				{
					int num2 = num - 1;
					int num3 = 0;
					while (num2 >= 0 && num3 == 0)
					{
						if (terminators[num2] == c)
						{
							int i;
							for (i = 1; num2 - i >= 0 && terminators[num2 - i] == terminators[num - i]; i++)
							{
							}
							if (i > num2)
							{
								num3 = num2 + 1;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							num2--;
						}
					}
					if (sb != null)
					{
						num2 = ((num2 < 0) ? 1 : 0);
						for (int j = 0; j <= num - num3 - num2; j++)
						{
							sb.Append(terminators[j]);
						}
						if (num2 > 0)
						{
							sb.Append(c);
						}
					}
					num = num3;
					c2 = terminators[num3];
				}
				else
				{
					sb?.Append(c);
				}
				c = ReadChar();
			}
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				Error(type + " starting on line {0} was never closed", line);
			}
			ReadChar();
			if (sb != null)
			{
				return sb.ToString();
			}
			return "";
		}

		public string ExpandCharEntity()
		{
			char c = ReadChar();
			int num = 0;
			if (c == 'x')
			{
				c = ReadChar();
				while (c != '\uffff' && c != ';')
				{
					int num2 = 0;
					if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
					{
						num2 = c - 48;
					}
					else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
					{
						num2 = c - 97 + 10;
					}
					else
					{
						if (c < 'A' || c > 'F')
						{
							break;
						}
						num2 = c - 65 + 10;
					}
					num = num * 16 + num2;
					c = ReadChar();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				while (c != '\uffff' && c != ';' && c >= '0' && c <= '9')
				{
					num = num * 10 + (c - 48);
					c = ReadChar();
				}
			}
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\0':
				Error("Premature {0} parsing entity reference", c);
				break;
			case ';':
				ReadChar();
				break;
			}
			if (Html && num >= 128 && num <= 159)
			{
				int num3 = CtrlMap.Length;
				int num4 = num - 128;
				int value = CtrlMap[num4];
				return Convert.ToChar(value).ToString();
			}
			return Convert.ToChar(num).ToString();
		}

		public void Error(string msg)
		{
			throw new Exception(msg);
		}

		public void Error(string msg, char ch)
		{
			string arg = ((ch == '\uffff') ? "EOF" : char.ToString(ch));
			throw new Exception(string.Format(msg, arg));
		}

		public void Error(string msg, int x)
		{
			throw new Exception(string.Format(msg, x));
		}

		public void Error(string msg, string arg)
		{
			throw new Exception(string.Format(msg, arg));
		}

		public string Context()
		{
			Entity entity = this;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			while (entity != null)
			{
				string value = ((!entity.Internal) ? $"\nReferenced on line {entity.Line}, position {entity.LinePosition} of '{entity.Name}' entity at [{entity.ResolvedUri.AbsolutePath}]" : $"\nReferenced on line {entity.Line}, position {entity.LinePosition} of internal entity '{entity.Name}'");
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
				entity = entity.Parent;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static bool IsLiteralType(string token)
		{
			if (!(token == "CDATA") && !(token == "SDATA"))
			{
				return token == "PI";
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void SetLiteralType(string token)
		{
			switch (token)
			{
			case "CDATA":
				LiteralType = LiteralType.CDATA;
				break;
			case "SDATA":
				LiteralType = LiteralType.SDATA;
				break;
			case "PI":
				LiteralType = LiteralType.PI;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class HtmlStream : TextReader
	{
		private Stream stm;

		private byte[] rawBuffer;

		private int rawPos;

		private int rawUsed;

		private Encoding encoding;

		private Decoder decoder;

		private char[] buffer;

		private int used;

		private int pos;

		private const int BUFSIZE = 16384;

		private const int EOF = -1;

		public Encoding Encoding => encoding;

		public HtmlStream(Stream stm, Encoding defaultEncoding)
		{
			if (defaultEncoding == null)
			{
				defaultEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;
			}
			if (!stm.CanSeek)
			{
				stm = CopyToMemoryStream(stm);
			}
			this.stm = stm;
			rawBuffer = new byte[16384];
			rawUsed = stm.Read(rawBuffer, 0, 4);
			buffer = new char[16384];
			this.decoder = AutoDetectEncoding(rawBuffer, ref rawPos, rawUsed);
			int num = rawPos;
			if (this.decoder == null)
			{
				this.decoder = defaultEncoding.GetDecoder();
				rawUsed += stm.Read(rawBuffer, 4, 16380);
				DecodeBlock();
				Decoder decoder = SniffEncoding();
				if (decoder != null)
				{
					this.decoder = decoder;
				}
			}
			this.stm.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			pos = (used = 0);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				stm.Read(rawBuffer, 0, num);
			}
			rawPos = (rawUsed = 0);
		}

		private Stream CopyToMemoryStream(Stream s)
		{
			int num = 100000;
			byte[] array = new byte[num];
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			int count;
			while ((count = s.Read(array, 0, num)) > 0)
			{
				memoryStream.Write(array, 0, count);
			}
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			s.Dispose();
			return memoryStream;
		}

		internal void DecodeBlock()
		{
			if (pos > 0)
			{
				if (pos < used)
				{
					Array.Copy(buffer, pos, buffer, 0, used - pos);
				}
				used -= pos;
				pos = 0;
			}
			int charCount = decoder.GetCharCount(rawBuffer, rawPos, rawUsed - rawPos);
			int num = buffer.Length - used;
			if (num < charCount)
			{
				char[] destinationArray = new char[buffer.Length + charCount];
				Array.Copy(buffer, pos, destinationArray, 0, used - pos);
				buffer = destinationArray;
			}
			used = pos + decoder.GetChars(rawBuffer, rawPos, rawUsed - rawPos, buffer, pos);
			rawPos = rawUsed;
		}

		internal static Decoder AutoDetectEncoding(byte[] buffer, ref int index, int length)
		{
			if (4 <= length - index)
			{
				uint num = (uint)((buffer[index] << 24) | (buffer[index + 1] << 16) | (buffer[index + 2] << 8) | buffer[index + 3]);
				switch (num)
				{
				case 4278189823u:
				case 1006632960u:
					index += 4;
					return new Ucs4DecoderBigEngian();
				case 4294901758u:
				case 60u:
					index += 4;
					return new Ucs4DecoderLittleEndian();
				}
				num >>= 8;
				if (num == 15711167)
				{
					index += 3;
					return Encoding.UTF8.GetDecoder();
				}
				switch (num >> 8)
				{
				case 15360u:
				case 65279u:
					index += 2;
					return Encoding.BigEndianUnicode.GetDecoder();
				case 60u:
				case 65534u:
					index += 2;
					return new UnicodeEncoding(bigEndian: false, byteOrderMark: false).GetDecoder();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int ReadChar()
		{
			if (pos < used)
			{
				return buffer[pos++];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int PeekChar()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num != -1)
			{
				pos--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool SniffPattern(string pattern)
		{
			int num = PeekChar();
			if (num != pattern[0])
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			int length = pattern.Length;
			while (num != -1 && num2 < length)
			{
				num = ReadChar();
				char c = pattern[num2];
				if (num != c)
				{
					return false;
				}
				num2++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SniffWhitespace()
		{
			char c = (char)PeekChar();
			while (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n')
			{
				int num = pos;
				c = (char)ReadChar();
				if (c != ' ' && c != '\t' && c != '\r' && c != '\n')
				{
					pos = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private string SniffLiteral()
		{
			int num = PeekChar();
			if (num == 39 || num == 34)
			{
				ReadChar();
				int num2 = pos;
				int num3 = ReadChar();
				while (num3 != -1 && num3 != num)
				{
					num3 = ReadChar();
				}
				if (pos <= num2)
				{
					return "";
				}
				return new string(buffer, num2, pos - num2 - 1);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string SniffAttribute(string name)
		{
			SniffWhitespace();
			string text = SniffName();
			if (name == text)
			{
				SniffWhitespace();
				if (SniffPattern("="))
				{
					SniffWhitespace();
					return SniffLiteral();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string SniffAttribute(out string name)
		{
			SniffWhitespace();
			name = SniffName();
			if (name != null)
			{
				SniffWhitespace();
				if (SniffPattern("="))
				{
					SniffWhitespace();
					return SniffLiteral();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SniffTerminator(string term)
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			int num2 = 0;
			int length = term.Length;
			while (num2 < length && num != -1)
			{
				if (term[num2] == num)
				{
					num2++;
					if (num2 == length)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				num = ReadChar();
			}
		}

		internal Decoder SniffEncoding()
		{
			Decoder decoder = null;
			if (SniffPattern("<?xml"))
			{
				string text = SniffAttribute("version");
				if (text != null)
				{
					string text2 = SniffAttribute("encoding");
					if (text2 != null)
					{
						try
						{
							Encoding encoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(text2);
							if (encoding != null)
							{
								this.encoding = encoding;
								return encoding.GetDecoder();
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					SniffTerminator(">");
				}
			}
			if (decoder == null)
			{
				return SniffMeta();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Decoder SniffMeta()
		{
			for (int num = ReadChar(); num != -1; num = ReadChar())
			{
				char c = (char)num;
				if (c == '<')
				{
					string name = SniffName();
					if (name != null && StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "meta"))
					{
						string text = null;
						string text2 = null;
						while (true)
						{
							string text3 = SniffAttribute(out name);
							if (name == null)
							{
								break;
							}
							if (StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "http-equiv"))
							{
								text = text3;
							}
							else if (StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "content"))
							{
								text2 = text3;
							}
						}
						if (text != null && StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(text, "content-type") && text2 != null)
						{
							int num2 = text2.IndexOf("charset");
							if (num2 >= 0)
							{
								num2 = text2.IndexOf("=", num2);
								if (num2 >= 0)
								{
									num2++;
									int num3 = text2.IndexOf(";", num2);
									if (num3 < 0)
									{
										num3 = text2.Length;
									}
									string name2 = text2.Substring(num2, num3 - num2).Trim();
									try
									{
										return (encoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(name2)).GetDecoder();
									}
									catch
									{
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal string SniffName()
		{
			int num = PeekChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			char c = (char)num;
			int num2 = pos;
			while (pos < used - 1 && (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == ':'))
			{
				c = buffer[++pos];
			}
			if (num2 == pos)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new string(buffer, num2, pos - num2);
		}

		internal void SkipWhitespace()
		{
			char c = (char)PeekChar();
			while (pos < used - 1 && (c == ' ' || c == '\r' || c == '\n'))
			{
				c = buffer[++pos];
			}
		}

		internal void SkipTo(char what)
		{
			char c = (char)PeekChar();
			while (pos < used - 1 && c != what)
			{
				c = buffer[++pos];
			}
		}

		internal string ParseAttribute()
		{
			SkipTo('=');
			if (pos < used)
			{
				pos++;
				SkipWhitespace();
				if (pos < used)
				{
					char what = buffer[pos];
					pos++;
					int num = pos;
					SkipTo(what);
					if (pos < used)
					{
						string result = new string(buffer, num, pos - num);
						pos++;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override int Peek()
		{
			int num = Read();
			if (num != -1)
			{
				pos--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override int Read()
		{
			if (pos == used)
			{
				rawUsed = stm.Read(rawBuffer, 0, rawBuffer.Length);
				rawPos = 0;
				if (rawUsed == 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				DecodeBlock();
			}
			if (pos < used)
			{
				return buffer[pos++];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public override int Read(char[] buffer, int start, int length)
		{
			if (pos == used)
			{
				rawUsed = stm.Read(rawBuffer, 0, rawBuffer.Length);
				rawPos = 0;
				if (rawUsed == 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				DecodeBlock();
			}
			if (pos < used)
			{
				length = Math.Min(used - pos, length);
				Array.Copy(this.buffer, pos, buffer, start, length);
				pos += length;
				return length;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override int ReadBlock(char[] buffer, int index, int count)
		{
			return Read(buffer, index, count);
		}

		public int ReadLine(char[] buffer, int start, int length)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int num2 = ReadChar(); num2 != -1; num2 = ReadChar())
			{
				buffer[num + start] = (char)num2;
				num++;
				if (num + start == length)
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (num2)
				{
				case 13:
					if (PeekChar() == 10)
					{
						num2 = ReadChar();
						buffer[num + start] = (char)num2;
						num++;
					}
					break;
				default:
					continue;
				case 10:
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ReadToEnd()
		{
			char[] array = new char[100000];
			int num = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			while ((num = Read(array, 0, array.Length)) > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(array, 0, num);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				stm.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class Ucs4Decoder : Decoder
	{
		internal byte[] temp = new byte[4];

		internal int tempBytes;

		public override int GetCharCount(byte[] bytes, int index, int count)
		{
			return (count + tempBytes) / 4;
		}

		internal abstract int GetFullChars(byte[] bytes, int byteIndex, int byteCount, char[] chars, int charIndex);

		public override int GetChars(byte[] bytes, int byteIndex, int byteCount, char[] chars, int charIndex)
		{
			int i = tempBytes;
			if (tempBytes > 0)
			{
				for (; i < 4; i++)
				{
					temp[i] = bytes[byteIndex];
					byteIndex++;
					byteCount--;
				}
				i = 1;
				GetFullChars(temp, 0, 4, chars, charIndex);
				charIndex++;
			}
			else
			{
				i = 0;
			}
			i = GetFullChars(bytes, byteIndex, byteCount, chars, charIndex) + i;
			int num = (tempBytes + byteCount) % 4;
			byteCount += byteIndex;
			byteIndex = byteCount - num;
			tempBytes = 0;
			if (byteIndex >= 0)
			{
				while (byteIndex < byteCount)
				{
					temp[tempBytes] = bytes[byteIndex];
					tempBytes++;
					byteIndex++;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		internal char UnicodeToUTF16(uint code)
		{
			byte b = (byte)(55232 + (code >> 10));
			byte b2 = (byte)(0xDC00 | (code & 0x3FF));
			return (char)((b2 << 8) | b);
		}
	}
	internal class Ucs4DecoderBigEngian : Ucs4Decoder
	{
		internal override int GetFullChars(byte[] bytes, int byteIndex, int byteCount, char[] chars, int charIndex)
		{
			byteCount += byteIndex;
			int i = byteIndex;
			int num = charIndex;
			for (; i + 3 < byteCount; i += 4)
			{
				uint num2 = (uint)((bytes[i + 3] << 24) | (bytes[i + 2] << 16) | (bytes[i + 1] << 8) | bytes[i]);
				if (num2 > 1114111)
				{
					throw new Exception("Invalid character 0x" + num2.ToString("x") + " in encoding");
				}
				if (num2 > 65535)
				{
					chars[num] = UnicodeToUTF16(num2);
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					if (num2 >= 55296 && num2 <= 57343)
					{
						throw new Exception("Invalid character 0x" + num2.ToString("x") + " in encoding");
					}
					chars[num] = (char)num2;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return num - charIndex;
		}
	}
	internal class Ucs4DecoderLittleEndian : Ucs4Decoder
	{
		internal override int GetFullChars(byte[] bytes, int byteIndex, int byteCount, char[] chars, int charIndex)
		{
			byteCount += byteIndex;
			int i = byteIndex;
			int num = charIndex;
			for (; i + 3 < byteCount; i += 4)
			{
				uint num2 = (uint)((bytes[i] << 24) | (bytes[i + 1] << 16) | (bytes[i + 2] << 8) | bytes[i + 3]);
				if (num2 > 1114111)
				{
					throw new Exception("Invalid character 0x" + num2.ToString("x") + " in encoding");
				}
				if (num2 > 65535)
				{
					chars[num] = UnicodeToUTF16(num2);
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					if (num2 >= 55296 && num2 <= 57343)
					{
						throw new Exception("Invalid character 0x" + num2.ToString("x") + " in encoding");
					}
					chars[num] = (char)num2;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return num - charIndex;
		}
	}
	internal class ElementDecl
	{
		public string Name;

		public bool StartTagOptional;

		public bool EndTagOptional;

		public ContentModel ContentModel;

		public string[] Inclusions;

		public string[] Exclusions;

		public AttList AttList;

		public ElementDecl(string name, bool sto, bool eto, ContentModel cm, string[] inclusions, string[] exclusions)
		{
			Name = name;
			StartTagOptional = sto;
			EndTagOptional = eto;
			ContentModel = cm;
			Inclusions = inclusions;
			Exclusions = exclusions;
		}

		public AttDef FindAttribute(string name)
		{
			return AttList[name.ToUpper()];
		}

		public void AddAttDefs(AttList list)
		{
			if (AttList == null)
			{
				AttList = list;
				return;
			}
			foreach (AttDef item in list)
			{
				if (AttList[item.Name] == null)
				{
					AttList.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool CanContain(string name, SgmlDtd dtd)
		{
			if (Exclusions != null)
			{
				string[] exclusions = Exclusions;
				foreach (string text in exclusions)
				{
					if ((object)text == name)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (Inclusions != null)
			{
				string[] inclusions = Inclusions;
				foreach (string text2 in inclusions)
				{
					if ((object)text2 == name)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return ContentModel.CanContain(name, dtd);
		}
	}
	internal enum DeclaredContent
	{
		Default,
		CDATA,
		RCDATA,
		EMPTY
	}
	internal class ContentModel
	{
		public DeclaredContent DeclaredContent;

		public int CurrentDepth;

		public Group Model;

		public ContentModel()
		{
			Model = new Group(null);
		}

		public void PushGroup()
		{
			Model = new Group(Model);
			CurrentDepth++;
		}

		public int PopGroup()
		{
			if (CurrentDepth == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			CurrentDepth--;
			Model.Parent.AddGroup(Model);
			Model = Model.Parent;
			return CurrentDepth;
		}

		public void AddSymbol(string sym)
		{
			Model.AddSymbol(sym);
		}

		public void AddConnector(char c)
		{
			Model.AddConnector(c);
		}

		public void AddOccurrence(char c)
		{
			Model.AddOccurrence(c);
		}

		public void SetDeclaredContent(string dc)
		{
			switch (dc)
			{
			case "EMPTY":
				DeclaredContent = DeclaredContent.EMPTY;
				break;
			case "RCDATA":
				DeclaredContent = DeclaredContent.RCDATA;
				break;
			case "CDATA":
				DeclaredContent = DeclaredContent.CDATA;
				break;
			default:
				throw new Exception($"Declared content type '{dc}' is not supported");
			}
		}

		public bool CanContain(string name, SgmlDtd dtd)
		{
			if (DeclaredContent != DeclaredContent.Default)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Model.CanContain(name, dtd);
		}
	}
	internal enum GroupType
	{
		None,
		And,
		Or,
		Sequence
	}
	internal enum Occurrence
	{
		Required,
		Optional,
		ZeroOrMore,
		OneOrMore
	}
	internal class Group
	{
		public Group Parent;

		public List<object> Members;

		public GroupType GroupType;

		public Occurrence Occurrence;

		public bool Mixed;

		public bool TextOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (Mixed)
				{
					return Members.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Group(Group parent)
		{
			Parent = parent;
			Members = new List<object>();
			GroupType = GroupType.None;
			Occurrence = Occurrence.Required;
		}

		public void AddGroup(Group g)
		{
			Members.Add(g);
		}

		public void AddSymbol(string sym)
		{
			if (sym == "#PCDATA")
			{
				Mixed = true;
			}
			else
			{
				Members.Add(sym);
			}
		}

		public void AddConnector(char c)
		{
			if (!Mixed && Members.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new Exception($"Missing token before connector '{c}'.");
			}
			GroupType groupType = GroupType.None;
			switch (c)
			{
			case ',':
				groupType = GroupType.Sequence;
				break;
			case '|':
				groupType = GroupType.Or;
				break;
			case '&':
				groupType = GroupType.And;
				break;
			}
			if (GroupType != GroupType.None && GroupType != groupType)
			{
				throw new Exception($"Connector '{c}' is inconsistent with {GroupType.ToString()} group.");
			}
			GroupType = groupType;
		}

		public void AddOccurrence(char c)
		{
			Occurrence occurrence = Occurrence.Required;
			switch (c)
			{
			case '?':
				occurrence = Occurrence.Optional;
				break;
			case '+':
				occurrence = Occurrence.OneOrMore;
				break;
			case '*':
				occurrence = Occurrence.ZeroOrMore;
				break;
			}
			Occurrence = occurrence;
		}

		public bool CanContain(string name, SgmlDtd dtd)
		{
			foreach (object member in Members)
			{
				if (member is string && member == name)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (object member2 in Members)
			{
				if (member2 is string)
				{
					string name2 = (string)member2;
					ElementDecl elementDecl = dtd.FindElement(name2);
					if (elementDecl != null && elementDecl.StartTagOptional && elementDecl.CanContain(name, dtd))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Group obj = (Group)member2;
					if (obj.CanContain(name, dtd))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum AttributeType
	{
		DEFAULT,
		CDATA,
		ENTITY,
		ENTITIES,
		ID,
		IDREF,
		IDREFS,
		NAME,
		NAMES,
		NMTOKEN,
		NMTOKENS,
		NUMBER,
		NUMBERS,
		NUTOKEN,
		NUTOKENS,
		NOTATION,
		ENUMERATION
	}
	internal enum AttributePresence
	{
		DEFAULT,
		FIXED,
		REQUIRED,
		IMPLIED
	}
	internal class AttDef
	{
		public string Name;

		public AttributeType Type;

		public string[] EnumValues;

		public string Default;

		public AttributePresence Presence;

		public AttDef(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}

		public void SetType(string type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case "CDATA":
				Type = AttributeType.CDATA;
				break;
			case "ENTITY":
				Type = AttributeType.ENTITY;
				break;
			case "ENTITIES":
				Type = AttributeType.ENTITIES;
				break;
			case "ID":
				Type = AttributeType.ID;
				break;
			case "IDREF":
				Type = AttributeType.IDREF;
				break;
			case "IDREFS":
				Type = AttributeType.IDREFS;
				break;
			case "NAME":
				Type = AttributeType.NAME;
				break;
			case "NAMES":
				Type = AttributeType.NAMES;
				break;
			case "NMTOKEN":
				Type = AttributeType.NMTOKEN;
				break;
			case "NMTOKENS":
				Type = AttributeType.NMTOKENS;
				break;
			case "NUMBER":
				Type = AttributeType.NUMBER;
				break;
			case "NUMBERS":
				Type = AttributeType.NUMBERS;
				break;
			case "NUTOKEN":
				Type = AttributeType.NUTOKEN;
				break;
			case "NUTOKENS":
				Type = AttributeType.NUTOKENS;
				break;
			default:
				throw new Exception("Attribute type '" + type + "' is not supported");
			}
		}

		public bool SetPresence(string token)
		{
			bool result = true;
			switch (token)
			{
			case "FIXED":
				Presence = AttributePresence.FIXED;
				break;
			case "REQUIRED":
				Presence = AttributePresence.REQUIRED;
				result = false;
				break;
			case "IMPLIED":
				Presence = AttributePresence.IMPLIED;
				result = false;
				break;
			default:
				throw new Exception($"Attribute value '{token}' not supported");
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class AttList : IEnumerable
	{
		private Dictionary<string, AttDef> AttDefs;

		public AttDef this[string name] => AttDefs[name];

		public AttList()
		{
			AttDefs = new Dictionary<string, AttDef>();
		}

		public void Add(AttDef a)
		{
			AttDefs.Add(a.Name, a);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return AttDefs.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class SgmlDtd
	{
		public string Name;

		private Dictionary<string, ElementDecl> elements;

		private Dictionary<string, Entity> pentities;

		private Dictionary<string, Entity> entities;

		private StringBuilder sb;

		private Entity current;

		private XmlNameTable nameTable;

		private static string WhiteSpace = " \r\n\t";

		private static string ngterm = " \r\n\t|,)";

		private static string dcterm = " \r\n\t>";

		private static string cmterm = " \r\n\t,&|()?+*";

		private static string peterm = " \t\r\n>";

		public XmlNameTable NameTable => nameTable;

		public SgmlDtd(string name, XmlNameTable nt)
		{
			nameTable = nt;
			Name = name;
			elements = new Dictionary<string, ElementDecl>();
			pentities = new Dictionary<string, Entity>();
			entities = new Dictionary<string, Entity>();
			sb = new StringBuilder();
		}

		public static SgmlDtd Parse(Uri baseUri, string name, string pubid, string url, string subset, string proxy, XmlNameTable nt)
		{
			SgmlDtd sgmlDtd = new SgmlDtd(name, nt);
			if (url != null && url != "")
			{
				sgmlDtd.PushEntity(baseUri, new Entity(sgmlDtd.Name, pubid, url, proxy));
			}
			if (subset != null && subset != "")
			{
				sgmlDtd.PushEntity(baseUri, new Entity(name, subset));
			}
			try
			{
				sgmlDtd.Parse();
				return sgmlDtd;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				throw new Exception(ex.Message + sgmlDtd.current.Context());
			}
		}

		public static SgmlDtd Parse(Uri baseUri, string name, string pubid, TextReader input, string subset, string proxy, XmlNameTable nt)
		{
			SgmlDtd sgmlDtd = new SgmlDtd(name, nt);
			sgmlDtd.PushEntity(baseUri, new Entity(sgmlDtd.Name, baseUri, input, proxy));
			if (subset != null && subset != "")
			{
				sgmlDtd.PushEntity(baseUri, new Entity(name, subset));
			}
			try
			{
				sgmlDtd.Parse();
				return sgmlDtd;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				throw new Exception(ex.Message + sgmlDtd.current.Context());
			}
		}

		public Entity FindEntity(string name)
		{
			return entities[name];
		}

		public ElementDecl FindElement(string name)
		{
			return elements[name.ToUpper()];
		}

		private void PushEntity(Uri baseUri, Entity e)
		{
			e.Open(current, baseUri);
			current = e;
			current.ReadChar();
		}

		private void PopEntity()
		{
			if (current != null)
			{
				current.Close();
			}
			if (current.Parent != null)
			{
				current = current.Parent;
			}
			else
			{
				current = null;
			}
		}

		private void Parse()
		{
			char c = current.Lastchar;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\uffff':
					PopEntity();
					if (current == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					c = current.Lastchar;
					break;
				case '\t':
				case '\n':
				case '\r':
				case ' ':
					c = current.ReadChar();
					break;
				case '<':
					ParseMarkup();
					c = current.ReadChar();
					break;
				case '%':
				{
					Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(WhiteSpace);
					try
					{
						PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					c = current.Lastchar;
					break;
				}
				default:
					current.Error("Unexpected character '{0}'", c);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseMarkup()
		{
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			if (c != '!')
			{
				current.Error("Found '{0}', but expecing declaration starting with '<!'");
				return;
			}
			switch (current.ReadChar())
			{
			case '-':
				c = current.ReadChar();
				if (c != '-')
				{
					current.Error("Expecting comment '<!--' but found {0}", c);
				}
				current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Comment", "-->");
				return;
			case '[':
				ParseMarkedSection();
				return;
			}
			string text = current.ScanToken(sb, WhiteSpace, nmtoken: true);
			switch (text)
			{
			case "ENTITY":
				ParseEntity();
				break;
			case "ELEMENT":
				ParseElementDecl();
				break;
			case "ATTLIST":
				ParseAttList();
				break;
			default:
				current.Error("Invalid declaration '<!{0}'.  Expecting 'ENTITY', 'ELEMENT' or 'ATTLIST'.", text);
				break;
			}
		}

		private char ParseDeclComments()
		{
			char c;
			for (c = current.Lastchar; c == '-'; c = ParseDeclComment(full: true))
			{
			}
			return c;
		}

		private char ParseDeclComment(bool full)
		{
			int line = current.Line;
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			if (full && c != '-')
			{
				current.Error("Expecting comment delimiter '--' but found {0}", c);
			}
			current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Markup Comment", "--");
			return current.SkipWhitespace();
		}

		private void ParseMarkedSection()
		{
			current.ReadChar();
			string text = ScanName("[");
			if (text == "INCLUDE")
			{
				ParseIncludeSection();
			}
			else if (text == "IGNORE")
			{
				ParseIgnoreSection();
			}
			else
			{
				current.Error("Unsupported marked section type '{0}'", text);
			}
		}

		private void ParseIncludeSection()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException("Include Section");
		}

		private void ParseIgnoreSection()
		{
			int line = current.Line;
			char c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (c != '[')
			{
				current.Error("Expecting '[' but found {0}", c);
			}
			current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Conditional Section", "]]>");
		}

		private string ScanName(string term)
		{
			char c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (c == '%')
			{
				Entity entity = ParseParameterEntity(term);
				c = current.Lastchar;
				if (!entity.Internal)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("External parameter entity resolution");
				}
				return entity.Literal.Trim();
			}
			return current.ScanToken(sb, term, nmtoken: true);
		}

		private Entity ParseParameterEntity(string term)
		{
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			string array = current.ScanToken(sb, ";" + term, nmtoken: false);
			array = nameTable.Add(array);
			if (current.Lastchar == ';')
			{
				current.ReadChar();
			}
			return GetParameterEntity(array);
		}

		private Entity GetParameterEntity(string name)
		{
			Entity entity = pentities[name];
			if (entity == null)
			{
				current.Error("Reference to undefined parameter entity '{0}'", name);
			}
			return entity;
		}

		private void ParseEntity()
		{
			char c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			bool flag = c == '%';
			if (flag)
			{
				current.ReadChar();
				c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			}
			string array = current.ScanToken(sb, WhiteSpace, nmtoken: true);
			array = nameTable.Add(array);
			c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			Entity entity = null;
			if (c == '"' || c == '\'')
			{
				string literal = current.ScanLiteral(sb, c);
				entity = new Entity(array, literal);
			}
			else
			{
				string pubid = null;
				string text = null;
				string text2 = current.ScanToken(sb, WhiteSpace, nmtoken: true);
				if (Entity.IsLiteralType(text2))
				{
					c = current.SkipWhitespace();
					string literal2 = current.ScanLiteral(sb, c);
					entity = new Entity(array, literal2);
					entity.SetLiteralType(text2);
				}
				else
				{
					text = text2;
					if (text == "PUBLIC")
					{
						c = current.SkipWhitespace();
						if (c == '"' || c == '\'')
						{
							pubid = current.ScanLiteral(sb, c);
						}
						else
						{
							current.Error("Expecting public identifier literal but found '{0}'", c);
						}
					}
					else if (text != "SYSTEM")
					{
						current.Error("Invalid external identifier '{0}'.  Expecing 'PUBLIC' or 'SYSTEM'.", text);
					}
					string uri = null;
					c = current.SkipWhitespace();
					switch (c)
					{
					case '"':
					case '\'':
						uri = current.ScanLiteral(sb, c);
						break;
					default:
						current.Error("Expecting system identifier literal but found '{0}'", c);
						break;
					case '>':
						break;
					}
					entity = new Entity(array, pubid, uri, current.Proxy);
				}
			}
			c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (c == '-')
			{
				c = ParseDeclComments();
			}
			if (c != '>')
			{
				current.Error("Expecting end of entity declaration '>' but found '{0}'", c);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				pentities.Add(entity.Name, entity);
			}
			else
			{
				entities.Add(entity.Name, entity);
			}
		}

		private void ParseElementDecl()
		{
			char ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			string[] array = ParseNameGroup(ch, nmtokens: true);
			ch = char.ToUpper(current.SkipWhitespace());
			bool sto = false;
			bool eto = false;
			if (ch == 'O' || ch == '-')
			{
				sto = ch == 'O';
				current.ReadChar();
				ch = char.ToUpper(current.SkipWhitespace());
				if (ch == 'O' || ch == '-')
				{
					eto = ch == 'O';
					ch = current.ReadChar();
				}
			}
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			ContentModel cm = ParseContentModel(ch);
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			string[] exclusions = null;
			string[] inclusions = null;
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				ch = current.ReadChar();
				switch (ch)
				{
				case '(':
					exclusions = ParseNameGroup(ch, nmtokens: true);
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
					break;
				case '-':
					ch = ParseDeclComment(full: false);
					break;
				default:
					current.Error("Invalid syntax at '{0}'", ch);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				ch = ParseDeclComments();
			}
			if (ch == '+')
			{
				ch = current.ReadChar();
				if (ch != '(')
				{
					current.Error("Expecting inclusions name group", ch);
				}
				inclusions = ParseNameGroup(ch, nmtokens: true);
				ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			}
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				ch = ParseDeclComments();
			}
			if (ch != '>')
			{
				current.Error("Expecting end of ELEMENT declaration '>' but found '{0}'", ch);
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				string text2 = text.ToUpper();
				text2 = nameTable.Add(text);
				elements.Add(text2, new ElementDecl(text2, sto, eto, cm, inclusions, exclusions));
			}
		}

		private string[] ParseNameGroup(char ch, bool nmtokens)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (ch == '(')
			{
				ch = current.ReadChar();
				ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
				while (ch != ')')
				{
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
					if (ch == '%')
					{
						Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(ngterm);
						PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
						ParseNameList(list, nmtokens);
						PopEntity();
						ch = current.Lastchar;
					}
					else
					{
						string text = current.ScanToken(sb, ngterm, nmtokens);
						text = text.ToUpper();
						string item = nameTable.Add(text);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
					if (ch == '|' || ch == ',')
					{
						ch = current.ReadChar();
					}
				}
				current.ReadChar();
			}
			else
			{
				string text2 = current.ScanToken(sb, WhiteSpace, nmtokens);
				text2 = text2.ToUpper();
				text2 = nameTable.Add(text2);
				list.Add(text2);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void ParseNameList(List<string> names, bool nmtokens)
		{
			char lastchar = current.Lastchar;
			lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
			while (true)
			{
				switch (lastchar)
				{
				case '%':
				{
					Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(ngterm);
					PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
					ParseNameList(names, nmtokens);
					PopEntity();
					lastchar = current.Lastchar;
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					string text = current.ScanToken(sb, ngterm, nmtoken: true);
					text = text.ToUpper();
					text = nameTable.Add(text);
					names.Add(text);
					break;
				}
				case '\uffff':
					return;
				}
				lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
				if (lastchar == '|')
				{
					lastchar = current.ReadChar();
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
				}
			}
		}

		private ContentModel ParseContentModel(char ch)
		{
			ContentModel contentModel = new ContentModel();
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '(':
				current.ReadChar();
				ParseModel(')', contentModel);
				ch = current.ReadChar();
				if (ch == '?' || ch == '+' || ch == '*')
				{
					contentModel.AddOccurrence(ch);
					current.ReadChar();
				}
				break;
			case '%':
			{
				Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(dcterm);
				PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
				contentModel = ParseContentModel(current.Lastchar);
				PopEntity();
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				string declaredContent = ScanName(dcterm);
				contentModel.SetDeclaredContent(declaredContent);
				break;
			}
			}
			return contentModel;
		}

		private void ParseModel(char cmt, ContentModel cm)
		{
			int currentDepth = cm.CurrentDepth;
			char lastchar = current.Lastchar;
			lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
			while (lastchar != cmt || cm.CurrentDepth > currentDepth)
			{
				if (lastchar == '\uffff')
				{
					current.Error("Content Model was not closed");
				}
				string text;
				switch (lastchar)
				{
				case '%':
				{
					Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(cmterm);
					PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
					ParseModel('\uffff', cm);
					PopEntity();
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
					continue;
				}
				case '(':
					cm.PushGroup();
					current.ReadChar();
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
					continue;
				case ')':
					lastchar = current.ReadChar();
					if (lastchar == '*' || lastchar == '+' || lastchar == '?')
					{
						cm.AddOccurrence(lastchar);
						lastchar = current.ReadChar();
					}
					if (cm.PopGroup() < currentDepth)
					{
						current.Error("Parameter entity cannot close a paren outside it's own scope");
					}
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
					continue;
				case '&':
				case ',':
				case '|':
					cm.AddConnector(lastchar);
					current.ReadChar();
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
					continue;
				case '#':
					lastchar = current.ReadChar();
					text = "#" + current.ScanToken(sb, cmterm, nmtoken: true);
					break;
				default:
					text = current.ScanToken(sb, cmterm, nmtoken: true);
					break;
				}
				text = text.ToUpper();
				text = nameTable.Add(text);
				lastchar = current.Lastchar;
				if (lastchar == '?' || lastchar == '+' || lastchar == '*')
				{
					cm.PushGroup();
					cm.AddSymbol(text);
					cm.AddOccurrence(lastchar);
					cm.PopGroup();
					current.ReadChar();
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
				}
				else
				{
					cm.AddSymbol(text);
					lastchar = current.SkipWhitespace();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseAttList()
		{
			char ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			string[] array = ParseNameGroup(ch, nmtokens: true);
			AttList list = new AttList();
			ParseAttList(list, '>');
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				ElementDecl elementDecl = elements[text];
				if (elementDecl == null)
				{
					current.Error("ATTLIST references undefined ELEMENT {0}", text);
				}
				elementDecl.AddAttDefs(list);
			}
		}

		private void ParseAttList(AttList list, char term)
		{
			for (char c = current.SkipWhitespace(); c != term; c = current.SkipWhitespace())
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case '%':
				{
					Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(peterm);
					PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
					ParseAttList(list, '\uffff');
					PopEntity();
					c = current.SkipWhitespace();
					break;
				}
				case '-':
					c = ParseDeclComments();
					break;
				default:
				{
					AttDef a = ParseAttDef(c);
					list.Add(a);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		private AttDef ParseAttDef(char ch)
		{
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			string text = ScanName(WhiteSpace);
			text = text.ToUpper();
			text = nameTable.Add(text);
			AttDef attDef = new AttDef(text);
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				ch = ParseDeclComments();
			}
			ParseAttType(ch, attDef);
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				ch = ParseDeclComments();
			}
			ParseAttDefault(ch, attDef);
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				ch = ParseDeclComments();
			}
			return attDef;
		}

		private void ParseAttType(char ch, AttDef attdef)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '%':
			{
				Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(WhiteSpace);
				PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
				ParseAttType(current.Lastchar, attdef);
				PopEntity();
				ch = current.Lastchar;
				return;
			}
			case '(':
				attdef.EnumValues = ParseNameGroup(ch, nmtokens: false);
				attdef.Type = AttributeType.ENUMERATION;
				return;
			}
			string text = ScanName(WhiteSpace);
			if (text == "NOTATION")
			{
				ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
				if (ch != '(')
				{
					current.Error("Expecting name group '(', but found '{0}'", ch);
				}
				attdef.Type = AttributeType.NOTATION;
				attdef.EnumValues = ParseNameGroup(ch, nmtokens: true);
			}
			else
			{
				attdef.SetType(text);
			}
		}

		private void ParseAttDefault(char ch, AttDef attdef)
		{
			if (ch == '%')
			{
				Entity e = ParseParameterEntity(WhiteSpace);
				PushEntity(current.ResolvedUri, e);
				ParseAttDefault(current.Lastchar, attdef);
				PopEntity();
				ch = current.Lastchar;
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (ch == '#')
			{
				current.ReadChar();
				string presence = current.ScanToken(sb, WhiteSpace, nmtoken: true);
				flag = attdef.SetPresence(presence);
				ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (ch == '\'' || ch == '"')
				{
					string text = current.ScanLiteral(sb, ch);
					attdef.Default = text;
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
				}
				else
				{
					string text2 = current.ScanToken(sb, WhiteSpace, nmtoken: false);
					text2 = text2.ToUpper();
					text2 = nameTable.Add(text2);
					attdef.Default = text2;
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class StringUtilitiesSgml
	{
		public static bool EqualsIgnoreCase(string a, string b)
		{
			return string.Compare(a, b, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0;
		}
	}
	internal enum CaseFolding
	{
		None,
		ToUpper,
		ToLower
	}
	internal class HWStack
	{
		private object[] items;

		private int size;

		private int count;

		private int growth;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				return count;
			}
			set
			{
				count = value;
			}
		}

		public int Size => size;

		public object this[int i]
		{
			get
			{
				if (i < 0 || i >= size)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return items[i];
			}
			set
			{
				items[i] = value;
			}
		}

		public HWStack(int growth)
		{
			this.growth = growth;
		}

		public object Pop()
		{
			count--;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				return items[count - 1];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object Push()
		{
			if (count == size)
			{
				int num = size + growth;
				object[] destinationArray = new object[num];
				if (items != null)
				{
					Array.Copy(items, destinationArray, size);
				}
				size = num;
				items = destinationArray;
			}
			return items[count++];
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int i)
		{
			items[i] = null;
			Array.Copy(items, i + 1, items, i, count - i - 1);
			count--;
		}
	}
	internal class Attribute
	{
		internal string Name;

		internal AttDef DtdType;

		internal char QuoteChar;

		internal string literalValue;

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (literalValue != null)
				{
					return literalValue;
				}
				if (DtdType != null)
				{
					return DtdType.Default;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				literalValue = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault => literalValue == null;

		public void Reset(string name, string value, char quote)
		{
			Name = name;
			literalValue = value;
			QuoteChar = quote;
			DtdType = null;
		}
	}
	internal class Node
	{
		internal XmlNodeType NodeType;

		internal string Value;

		internal XmlSpace Space;

		internal string XmlLang;

		internal bool IsEmpty;

		internal string Name;

		internal ElementDecl DtdType;

		internal State CurrentState;

		internal bool Simulated;

		private HWStack attributes = new HWStack(10);

		public int AttributeCount => attributes.Count;

		public void Reset(string name, XmlNodeType nt, string value)
		{
			Value = value;
			Name = name;
			NodeType = nt;
			Space = XmlSpace.None;
			XmlLang = null;
			IsEmpty = true;
			attributes.Count = 0;
			DtdType = null;
		}

		public Attribute AddAttribute(string name, string value, char quotechar, bool caseInsensitive)
		{
			int i = 0;
			Attribute attribute;
			for (int count = attributes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				attribute = (Attribute)attributes[i];
				if (caseInsensitive && string.Compare(attribute.Name, name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if ((object)attribute.Name == name)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			attribute = (Attribute)attributes.Push();
			if (attribute == null)
			{
				attribute = new Attribute();
				attributes[attributes.Count - 1] = attribute;
			}
			attribute.Reset(name, value, quotechar);
			return attribute;
		}

		public void RemoveAttribute(string name)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = attributes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				Attribute attribute = (Attribute)attributes[i];
				if (attribute.Name == name)
				{
					attributes.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopyAttributes(Node n)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = n.attributes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				Attribute attribute = (Attribute)n.attributes[i];
				Attribute attribute2 = AddAttribute(attribute.Name, attribute.Value, attribute.QuoteChar, caseInsensitive: false);
				attribute2.DtdType = attribute.DtdType;
			}
		}

		public int GetAttribute(string name)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = attributes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				Attribute attribute = (Attribute)attributes[i];
				if (attribute.Name == name)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public Attribute GetAttribute(int i)
		{
			if (i >= 0 && i < attributes.Count)
			{
				return (Attribute)attributes[i];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal enum State
	{
		Initial,
		Markup,
		EndTag,
		Attr,
		AttrValue,
		Text,
		PartialTag,
		AutoClose,
		CData,
		PartialText,
		PseudoStartTag,
		Eof
	}
	internal class SgmlReader : XmlReader
	{
		private SgmlDtd dtd;

		private Entity current;

		private State state;

		private XmlNameTable nametable;

		private char partial;

		private object endTag;

		private HWStack stack;

		private Node node;

		private Attribute a;

		private int apos;

		private Uri baseUri;

		private StringBuilder sb;

		private StringBuilder name;

		private TextWriter log;

		private bool foundRoot;

		private Node newnode;

		private int poptodepth;

		private int rootCount;

		private bool isHtml;

		private string rootElementName;

		private string href;

		private Entity lastError;

		private string proxy;

		private TextReader inputStream;

		private string syslit;

		private string pubid;

		private string subset;

		private string docType;

		private WhitespaceHandling whitespaceHandling;

		private CaseFolding folding;

		private bool stripDocType = true;

		private XmlNamespaceManager namespaceManager;

		private static string declterm = " \t\r\n><";

		private static string tagterm = " \t\r\n=/><";

		private static string aterm = " \t\r\n='\"/>";

		private static string avterm = " \t\r\n>";

		private static string cdataterm = "\t\r\n[<>";

		private static string dtterm = " \t\r\n>";

		private static string piterm = " \t\r\n?";

		public SgmlDtd Dtd
		{
			get
			{
				LazyLoadDtd(baseUri);
				return dtd;
			}
			set
			{
				dtd = value;
			}
		}

		public string DocType
		{
			get
			{
				return docType;
			}
			set
			{
				docType = value;
			}
		}

		public string PublicIdentifier
		{
			get
			{
				return pubid;
			}
			set
			{
				pubid = value;
			}
		}

		public string SystemLiteral
		{
			get
			{
				return syslit;
			}
			set
			{
				syslit = value;
			}
		}

		public string InternalSubset
		{
			get
			{
				return subset;
			}
			set
			{
				subset = value;
			}
		}

		public TextReader InputStream
		{
			get
			{
				return inputStream;
			}
			set
			{
				inputStream = value;
				Init();
			}
		}

		public string WebProxy
		{
			get
			{
				return proxy;
			}
			set
			{
				proxy = value;
			}
		}

		public string Href
		{
			get
			{
				return href;
			}
			set
			{
				href = value;
				Init();
				if (baseUri == null)
				{
					if (href.IndexOf("://") > 0)
					{
						baseUri = new Uri(href);
					}
					else
					{
						baseUri = new Uri("file:///" + System.IO.Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() + "//");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool StripDocType
		{
			get
			{
				return stripDocType;
			}
			set
			{
				stripDocType = value;
			}
		}

		public CaseFolding CaseFolding
		{
			get
			{
				return folding;
			}
			set
			{
				folding = value;
			}
		}

		public TextWriter ErrorLog
		{
			get
			{
				return log;
			}
			set
			{
				log = value;
			}
		}

		public override XmlNodeType NodeType
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr)
				{
					return XmlNodeType.Attribute;
				}
				if (state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return XmlNodeType.Text;
				}
				if (state == State.EndTag || state == State.AutoClose)
				{
					return XmlNodeType.EndElement;
				}
				return node.NodeType;
			}
		}

		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				string text = null;
				if (state == State.Attr)
				{
					return a.Name;
				}
				if (state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return node.Name;
			}
		}

		public override string LocalName
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Name;
				string prefix = Prefix;
				if (prefix.Length != 0)
				{
					return text.Substring(prefix.Length + 1);
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public override string NamespaceURI
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr && StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(a.Name, "xmlns"))
				{
					return "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/";
				}
				string prefix = Prefix;
				switch (prefix)
				{
				default:
					if (prefix.Length != 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					return string.Empty;
				case "xmlns":
					return "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/";
				case "xml":
					return "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace";
				case null:
					break;
				}
				return LookupNamespace(prefix);
			}
		}

		public override string Prefix
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Name;
				if (text == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num = text.IndexOf(':');
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return text.Substring(0, num);
			}
		}

		public override bool HasValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr || state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return node.Value != null;
			}
		}

		public override string Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr || state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return a.Value;
				}
				return node.Value;
			}
		}

		public override int Depth
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr)
				{
					return stack.Count;
				}
				if (state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return stack.Count + 1;
				}
				return stack.Count - 1;
			}
		}

		public override string BaseURI
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(baseUri == null))
				{
					return baseUri.AbsoluteUri;
				}
				return "";
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEmptyElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Markup || state == State.Attr || state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return node.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr || state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return a.IsDefault;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override char QuoteChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (a != null)
				{
					return a.QuoteChar;
				}
				return '\0';
			}
		}

		public override XmlSpace XmlSpace
		{
			get
			{
				for (int num = stack.Count - 1; num > 1; num--)
				{
					Node node = (Node)stack[num];
					XmlSpace space = node.Space;
					if (space != XmlSpace.None)
					{
						return space;
					}
				}
				return XmlSpace.None;
			}
		}

		public override string XmlLang
		{
			get
			{
				for (int num = stack.Count - 1; num > 1; num--)
				{
					Node node = (Node)stack[num];
					string xmlLang = node.XmlLang;
					if (xmlLang != null)
					{
						return xmlLang;
					}
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public WhitespaceHandling WhitespaceHandling
		{
			get
			{
				return whitespaceHandling;
			}
			set
			{
				whitespaceHandling = value;
			}
		}

		public override int AttributeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Attr || state == State.AttrValue)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (node.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element || node.NodeType == XmlNodeType.DocumentType)
				{
					return node.AttributeCount;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public override string this[int i] => GetAttribute(i);

		public override string this[string name] => GetAttribute(name);

		public override string this[string name, string namespaceURI] => GetAttribute(name, namespaceURI);

		private bool IsHtml => isHtml;

		public override bool EOF => state == State.Eof;

		public override ReadState ReadState
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == State.Initial)
				{
					return ReadState.Initial;
				}
				if (state == State.Eof)
				{
					return ReadState.EndOfFile;
				}
				return ReadState.Interactive;
			}
		}

		public override XmlNameTable NameTable => nametable;

		public SgmlReader()
		{
			Init();
			nametable = new NameTable();
			namespaceManager = new XmlNamespaceManager(nametable);
		}

		private void LazyLoadDtd(Uri baseUri)
		{
			if (dtd != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (syslit == null || syslit == "")
			{
				if (docType != null && StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(docType, "html"))
				{
					Assembly assembly = typeof(SgmlReader).Assembly;
					string text = assembly.FullName.Split(',')[0] + ".Html.dtd";
					Stream manifestResourceStream = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(text);
					if (manifestResourceStream != null)
					{
						StreamReader input = new StreamReader(manifestResourceStream);
						dtd = SgmlDtd.Parse(baseUri, "HTML", null, input, null, proxy, nametable);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				baseUri = ((baseUri != null) ? new Uri(baseUri, syslit) : ((!(this.baseUri != null)) ? new Uri(new Uri(System.IO.Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() + "\\"), syslit) : new Uri(this.baseUri, syslit)));
				dtd = SgmlDtd.Parse(baseUri, docType, pubid, baseUri.AbsoluteUri, subset, proxy, nametable);
			}
			if (dtd != null && dtd.Name != null)
			{
				switch (CaseFolding)
				{
				case CaseFolding.ToUpper:
					rootElementName = dtd.Name.ToUpper();
					break;
				case CaseFolding.ToLower:
					rootElementName = dtd.Name.ToLower();
					break;
				default:
					rootElementName = dtd.Name;
					break;
				}
