				isHtml = StringUtilitiesSgml.EqualsIgnoreCase(dtd.Name, "html");
			}
		}

		public void SetBaseUri(string uri)
		{
			baseUri = new Uri(uri);
		}

		private void Log(string msg, params string[] args)
		{
			if (ErrorLog == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Format(msg, args);
			if (lastError != current)
			{
				text = text + "    " + current.Context();
				lastError = current;
				ErrorLog.WriteLine("### Error:" + text);
				return;
			}
			string text2 = "";
			if (current.ResolvedUri != null)
			{
				text2 = current.ResolvedUri.AbsolutePath;
			}
			ErrorLog.WriteLine("### Error in " + text2 + "#" + current.Name + ", line " + current.Line + ", position " + current.LinePosition + ": " + text);
		}

		private void Log(string msg, char ch)
		{
			Log(msg, ch.ToString());
		}

		private void Init()
		{
			state = State.Initial;
			stack = new HWStack(10);
			node = Push(null, XmlNodeType.Document, null);
			node.IsEmpty = false;
			sb = new StringBuilder();
			name = new StringBuilder();
			poptodepth = 0;
			current = null;
			partial = '\0';
			endTag = null;
			a = null;
			apos = 0;
			newnode = null;
			rootCount = 0;
			foundRoot = false;
		}

		private Node Push(string name, XmlNodeType nt, string value)
		{
			Node node = (Node)stack.Push();
			if (node == null)
			{
				node = new Node();
				stack[stack.Count - 1] = node;
			}
			node.Reset(name, nt, value);
			this.node = node;
			return node;
		}

		private void SwapTopNodes()
		{
			int num = stack.Count - 1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				Node value = (Node)stack[num - 1];
				stack[num - 1] = stack[num];
				stack[num] = value;
			}
		}

		private Node Push(Node n)
		{
			Node node = Push(n.Name, n.NodeType, n.Value);
			node.DtdType = n.DtdType;
			node.IsEmpty = n.IsEmpty;
			node.Space = n.Space;
			node.XmlLang = n.XmlLang;
			node.CurrentState = n.CurrentState;
			node.CopyAttributes(n);
			this.node = node;
			return node;
		}

		private void Pop()
		{
			if (stack.Count > 1)
			{
				node = (Node)stack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private Node Top()
		{
			int num = stack.Count - 1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return (Node)stack[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetAttribute(string name)
		{
			if (state != State.Attr && state != State.AttrValue)
			{
				int attribute = node.GetAttribute(name);
				if (attribute >= 0)
				{
					return GetAttribute(attribute);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetAttribute(string name, string namespaceURI)
		{
			return GetAttribute(name);
		}

		public override string GetAttribute(int i)
		{
			if (state != State.Attr && state != State.AttrValue)
			{
				Attribute attribute = node.GetAttribute(i);
				if (attribute != null)
				{
					return attribute.Value;
				}
			}
			throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
		}

		public override bool MoveToAttribute(string name)
		{
			int attribute = node.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute >= 0)
			{
				MoveToAttribute(attribute);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool MoveToAttribute(string name, string ns)
		{
			return MoveToAttribute(name);
		}

		public override void MoveToAttribute(int i)
		{
			Attribute attribute = node.GetAttribute(i);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				apos = i;
				a = attribute;
				if (state != State.Attr)
				{
					node.CurrentState = state;
				}
				state = State.Attr;
				return;
			}
			throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
		}

		public override bool MoveToFirstAttribute()
		{
			if (node.AttributeCount > 0)
			{
				MoveToAttribute(0);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool MoveToNextAttribute()
		{
			if (state != State.Attr && state != State.AttrValue)
			{
				return MoveToFirstAttribute();
			}
			if (apos < node.AttributeCount - 1)
			{
				MoveToAttribute(apos + 1);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool MoveToElement()
		{
			if (state == State.Attr || state == State.AttrValue)
			{
				state = node.CurrentState;
				a = null;
				return true;
			}
			return node.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element;
		}

		public Encoding GetEncoding()
		{
			if (current == null)
			{
				OpenInput();
			}
			return current.GetEncoding();
		}

		private void OpenInput()
		{
			LazyLoadDtd(baseUri);
			if (Href != null)
			{
				current = new Entity("#document", null, href, proxy);
			}
			else
			{
				if (inputStream == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("You must specify input either via Href or InputStream properties");
				}
				current = new Entity("#document", null, inputStream, proxy);
			}
			current.Html = IsHtml;
			current.Open(null, baseUri);
			if (current.ResolvedUri != null)
			{
				baseUri = current.ResolvedUri;
			}
			if (current.Html && dtd == null)
			{
				docType = "HTML";
				LazyLoadDtd(baseUri);
			}
		}

		public override bool Read()
		{
			if (current == null)
			{
				OpenInput();
			}
			State state = this.state;
			if (this.node.Simulated)
			{
				this.node.Simulated = false;
				this.node = Top();
				this.state = this.node.CurrentState;
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			while (!flag)
			{
				switch (this.state)
				{
				case State.Initial:
					this.state = State.Markup;
					current.ReadChar();
					goto case State.Markup;
				case State.Eof:
					if (current.Parent != null)
					{
						current.Close();
						current = current.Parent;
						break;
					}
					return false;
				case State.EndTag:
					if (endTag == this.node.Name)
					{
						Pop();
						this.state = State.Markup;
						goto case State.Markup;
					}
					Pop();
					flag = true;
					break;
				case State.Markup:
				{
					if (this.node.IsEmpty)
					{
						Pop();
					}
					Node node = this.node;
					flag = ParseMarkup();
					break;
				}
				case State.PartialTag:
					Pop();
					this.state = State.Markup;
					flag = ParseTag(partial);
					break;
				case State.PseudoStartTag:
					flag = ParseStartTag('<');
					break;
				case State.AutoClose:
					Pop();
					if (stack.Count <= poptodepth)
					{
						this.state = State.Markup;
						if (newnode != null)
						{
							Push(newnode);
							newnode = null;
							this.state = State.Markup;
						}
						else if (this.node.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Document)
						{
							this.state = State.Eof;
							goto case State.Eof;
						}
					}
					flag = true;
					break;
				case State.CData:
					flag = ParseCData();
					break;
				case State.Attr:
				case State.AttrValue:
					this.state = State.Markup;
					goto case State.Markup;
				case State.Text:
					Pop();
					goto case State.Markup;
				case State.PartialText:
					if (ParseText(current.Lastchar, newtext: false))
					{
						this.node.NodeType = XmlNodeType.Whitespace;
					}
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				if (flag && this.node.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace && whitespaceHandling == WhitespaceHandling.None)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (!flag && this.state == State.Eof && stack.Count > 1)
				{
					poptodepth = 1;
					this.state = State.AutoClose;
					this.node = Top();
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (!foundRoot && (NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element || NodeType == XmlNodeType.Text || NodeType == XmlNodeType.CDATA))
			{
				foundRoot = true;
				if (IsHtml && (NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || string.Compare(LocalName, "html", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != 0))
				{
					this.node.CurrentState = this.state;
					Node node2 = Push("html", XmlNodeType.Element, null);
					SwapTopNodes();
					this.node = node2;
					node2.Simulated = true;
					node2.IsEmpty = false;
					this.state = State.Markup;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseMarkup()
		{
			char lastchar = current.Lastchar;
			switch (lastchar)
			{
			case '<':
				lastchar = current.ReadChar();
				return ParseTag(lastchar);
			default:
				if (node.DtdType != null && node.DtdType.ContentModel.DeclaredContent == DeclaredContent.CDATA)
				{
					partial = '\0';
					state = State.CData;
					return false;
				}
				if (ParseText(lastchar, newtext: true))
				{
					node.NodeType = XmlNodeType.Whitespace;
				}
				return true;
			case '\uffff':
				state = State.Eof;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ParseTag(char ch)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '%':
				return ParseAspNet();
			case '!':
			{
				ch = current.ReadChar();
				switch (ch)
				{
				case '-':
					return ParseComment();
				case '[':
					return ParseConditionalBlock();
				default:
					if (!char.IsLetter(ch))
					{
						string text = current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Recovering", ">");
						Log("Ignoring invalid markup '<!" + text + ">");
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case '_':
					break;
				}
				string text2 = current.ScanToken(sb, declterm, nmtoken: false);
				if (text2 == "DOCTYPE")
				{
					ParseDocType();
					if (GetAttribute("SYSTEM") == null && GetAttribute("PUBLIC") != null)
					{
						node.AddAttribute("SYSTEM", "", '"', folding == CaseFolding.None);
					}
					if (stripDocType)
					{
						return false;
					}
					node.NodeType = XmlNodeType.DocumentType;
					return true;
				}
				Log("Invalid declaration '<!{0}...'.  Expecting '<!DOCTYPE' only.", text2);
				current.ScanToEnd(null, "Recovering", ">");
				return false;
			}
			case '?':
				current.ReadChar();
				return ParsePI();
			case '/':
				return ParseEndTag();
			default:
				return ParseStartTag(ch);
			}
		}

		private string ScanName(string terminators)
		{
			string text = current.ScanToken(sb, terminators, nmtoken: false);
			switch (folding)
			{
			case CaseFolding.ToUpper:
				text = text.ToUpper();
				break;
			case CaseFolding.ToLower:
				text = text.ToLower();
				break;
			}
			return nametable.Add(text);
		}

		private bool ParseStartTag(char ch)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (state != State.PseudoStartTag)
			{
				if (tagterm.IndexOf(ch) >= 0)
				{
					sb.Length = 0;
					sb.Append('<');
					state = State.PartialText;
					return false;
				}
				text = ScanName(tagterm);
			}
			else
			{
				state = State.Markup;
			}
			Node node = Push(text, XmlNodeType.Element, null);
			node.IsEmpty = false;
			Validate(node);
			ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
			namespaceManager.PushScope();
			while (true)
			{
				switch (ch)
				{
				case '/':
					namespaceManager.PopScope();
					node.IsEmpty = true;
					ch = current.ReadChar();
					if (ch != '>')
					{
						Log("Expected empty start tag '/>' sequence instead of '{0}'", ch);
						current.ScanToEnd(null, "Recovering", ">");
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case '<':
					Log("Start tag '{0}' is missing '>'", text);
					break;
				default:
				{
					string text2 = ScanName(aterm);
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
					switch (text2)
					{
					case ",":
					case "=":
					case ":":
					case ";":
						continue;
					}
					string value = null;
					char quotechar = '\0';
					if (ch == '=' || ch == '"' || ch == '\'')
					{
						if (ch == '=')
						{
							current.ReadChar();
							ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
						}
						switch (ch)
						{
						case '"':
						case '\'':
							quotechar = ch;
							value = ScanLiteral(sb, ch);
							break;
						default:
						{
							string term = avterm;
							value = current.ScanToken(sb, term, nmtoken: false);
							break;
						}
						case '>':
							break;
						}
					}
					if (text2.Length > 0)
					{
						Attribute attribute = node.AddAttribute(text2, value, quotechar, folding == CaseFolding.None);
						if (attribute == null)
						{
							Log("Duplicate attribute '{0}' ignored", text2);
						}
						else
						{
							ValidateAttribute(node, attribute);
							if (attribute.Name.StartsWith("xmlns:", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								string prefix = attribute.Name.Substring(6);
								namespaceManager.AddNamespace(prefix, attribute.Value);
							}
						}
					}
					ch = current.SkipWhitespace();
					continue;
				}
				case '>':
				case '\uffff':
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '\uffff':
				current.Error("Unexpected EOF parsing start tag '{0}'", text);
				break;
			case '>':
				current.ReadChar();
				break;
			}
			if (Depth == 1)
			{
				if (rootCount == 1)
				{
					state = State.Eof;
					return false;
				}
				rootCount++;
			}
			ValidateContent(node);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseEndTag()
		{
			namespaceManager.PopScope();
			state = State.EndTag;
			current.ReadChar();
			string text = ScanName(tagterm);
			char c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (c != '>')
			{
				Log("Expected empty start tag '/>' sequence instead of '{0}'", c);
				current.ScanToEnd(null, "Recovering", ">");
			}
			current.ReadChar();
			endTag = text;
			bool flag = folding == CaseFolding.None;
			this.node = (Node)stack[stack.Count - 1];
			for (int num = stack.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				Node node = (Node)stack[num];
				if (flag && string.Compare(node.Name, text, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					endTag = node.Name;
					return true;
				}
				if ((object)node.Name == text)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			Log("No matching start tag for '</{0}>'", text);
			state = State.Markup;
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseAspNet()
		{
			string value = "<%" + current.ScanToEnd(sb, "AspNet", "%>") + "%>";
			Push(null, XmlNodeType.CDATA, value);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseComment()
		{
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			if (c != '-')
			{
				Log("Expecting comment '<!--' but found {0}", c);
				current.ScanToEnd(null, "Comment", ">");
				return false;
			}
			string text = current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Comment", "-->");
			for (int num = text.IndexOf("--"); num >= 0; num = text.IndexOf("--"))
			{
				int i;
				for (i = num + 2; i < text.Length && text[i] == '-'; i++)
				{
				}
				text = ((num <= 0) ? ("-" + text.Substring(i)) : (text.Substring(0, num - 1) + "-" + text.Substring(i)));
			}
			if (text.Length > 0 && text[text.Length - 1] == '-')
			{
				text += " ";
			}
			Push(null, XmlNodeType.Comment, text);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseConditionalBlock()
		{
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			string text = current.ScanToken(sb, cdataterm, nmtoken: false);
			if (text != "CDATA")
			{
				Log("Expecting CDATA but found '{0}'", text);
				current.ScanToEnd(null, "CDATA", ">");
				return false;
			}
			c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (c != '[')
			{
				Log("Expecting '[' but found '{0}'", c);
				current.ScanToEnd(null, "CDATA", ">");
				return false;
			}
			string value = current.ScanToEnd(sb, "CDATA", "]]>");
			Push(null, XmlNodeType.CDATA, value);
			return true;
		}

		private void ParseDocType()
		{
			char c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			string text = ScanName(dtterm);
			Push(text, XmlNodeType.DocumentType, null);
			c = current.SkipWhitespace();
			if (c != '>')
			{
				string value = "";
				string value2 = "";
				string value3 = "";
				if (c != '[')
				{
					string text2 = current.ScanToken(sb, dtterm, nmtoken: false);
					if (text2 == "PUBLIC")
					{
						c = current.SkipWhitespace();
						if (c == '"' || c == '\'')
						{
							value2 = current.ScanLiteral(sb, c);
							node.AddAttribute(text2, value2, c, folding == CaseFolding.None);
						}
					}
					else if (text2 != "SYSTEM")
					{
						Log("Unexpected token in DOCTYPE '{0}'", text2);
						current.ScanToEnd(null, "DOCTYPE", ">");
					}
					c = current.SkipWhitespace();
					if (c == '"' || c == '\'')
					{
						text2 = nametable.Add("SYSTEM");
						value3 = current.ScanLiteral(sb, c);
						node.AddAttribute(text2, value3, c, folding == CaseFolding.None);
					}
					c = current.SkipWhitespace();
				}
				if (c == '[')
				{
					value = current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Internal Subset", "]");
					node.Value = value;
				}
				c = current.SkipWhitespace();
				if (c != '>')
				{
					Log("Expecting end of DOCTYPE tag, but found '{0}'", c);
					current.ScanToEnd(null, "DOCTYPE", ">");
				}
				if (dtd == null)
				{
					docType = text;
					pubid = value2;
					syslit = value3;
					subset = value;
					LazyLoadDtd(current.ResolvedUri);
				}
			}
			current.ReadChar();
		}

		private bool ParsePI()
		{
			string text = current.ScanToken(sb, piterm, nmtoken: false);
			string text2 = null;
			text2 = ((current.Lastchar == '?') ? current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Processing Instruction", ">") : current.ScanToEnd(sb, "Processing Instruction", ">"));
			if (text != "xml")
			{
				Push(nametable.Add(text), XmlNodeType.ProcessingInstruction, text2);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseText(char ch, bool newtext)
		{
			bool result = !newtext || current.IsWhitespace;
			if (newtext)
			{
				sb.Length = 0;
			}
			state = State.Text;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (ch)
				{
				case '<':
					ch = current.ReadChar();
					if (ch == '/' || ch == '!' || ch == '?' || char.IsLetter(ch))
					{
						state = State.PartialTag;
						partial = ch;
						break;
					}
					sb.Append('<');
					sb.Append(ch);
					result = false;
					ch = current.ReadChar();
					continue;
				case '&':
					ExpandEntity(sb, '<');
					result = false;
					ch = current.Lastchar;
					continue;
				default:
					if (!current.IsWhitespace)
					{
						result = false;
					}
					sb.Append(ch);
					ch = current.ReadChar();
					continue;
				case '\uffff':
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			string value = sb.ToString();
			Push(null, XmlNodeType.Text, value);
			return result;
		}

		public string ScanLiteral(StringBuilder sb, char quote)
		{
			sb.Length = 0;
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			while (c != '\uffff' && c != quote)
			{
				if (c == '&')
				{
					ExpandEntity(this.sb, quote);
					c = current.Lastchar;
				}
				else
				{
					sb.Append(c);
					c = current.ReadChar();
				}
			}
			current.ReadChar();
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		private bool ParseCData()
		{
			bool flag = current.IsWhitespace;
			sb.Length = 0;
			char c = current.Lastchar;
			if (partial != 0)
			{
				Pop();
				switch (partial)
				{
				case '!':
					partial = ' ';
					return ParseComment();
				case '?':
					partial = ' ';
					return ParsePI();
				case '/':
					state = State.EndTag;
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				c = current.ReadChar();
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case '<':
					c = current.ReadChar();
					switch (c)
					{
					case '!':
						c = current.ReadChar();
						if (c == '-')
						{
							if (flag)
							{
								partial = ' ';
								return ParseComment();
							}
							partial = '!';
							break;
						}
						sb.Append('<');
						sb.Append('!');
						sb.Append(c);
						flag = false;
						goto IL_0230;
					case '?':
						current.ReadChar();
						if (flag)
						{
							partial = ' ';
							return ParsePI();
						}
						partial = '?';
						break;
					case '/':
					{
						string text = sb.ToString();
						if (ParseEndTag() && endTag == node.Name)
						{
							if (flag || text == "")
							{
								return true;
							}
							partial = '/';
							sb.Length = 0;
							sb.Append(text);
							state = State.CData;
							break;
						}
						sb.Length = 0;
						sb.Append(text);
						sb.Append(string.Concat("</", endTag, ">"));
						flag = false;
						goto IL_0230;
					}
					default:
						sb.Append('<');
						sb.Append(c);
						flag = false;
						goto IL_0230;
					}
					break;
				default:
					if (!current.IsWhitespace && flag)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					sb.Append(c);
					goto IL_0230;
				case '\uffff':
					break;
				}
				break;
				IL_0230:
				c = current.ReadChar();
			}
			string value = sb.ToString();
			Push(null, XmlNodeType.CDATA, value);
			if (partial == '\0')
			{
				partial = ' ';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ExpandEntity(StringBuilder sb, char terminator)
		{
			char c = current.ReadChar();
			if (c == '#')
			{
				string value = current.ExpandCharEntity();
				sb.Append(value);
				c = current.Lastchar;
				return;
			}
			name.Length = 0;
			while (c != '\uffff' && (char.IsLetter(c) || c == '_' || c == '-'))
			{
				name.Append(c);
				c = current.ReadChar();
			}
			string text = name.ToString();
			if (dtd != null && text != "")
			{
				Entity entity = dtd.FindEntity(text);
				if (entity != null)
				{
					if (entity.Internal)
					{
						sb.Append(entity.Literal);
						if (c != terminator)
						{
							c = current.ReadChar();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Entity entity2 = new Entity(text, entity.PublicId, entity.Uri, current.Proxy);
						entity.Open(current, new Uri(entity.Uri));
						current = entity2;
						current.ReadChar();
					}
					return;
				}
				Log("Undefined entity '{0}'", text);
			}
			sb.Append("&");
			sb.Append(text);
			if (c != terminator)
			{
				sb.Append(c);
				c = current.ReadChar();
			}
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (current != null)
				{
					current.Close();
					current = null;
				}
				if (log != null)
				{
					log.Close();
					log = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ReadString()
		{
			if (node.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element)
			{
				sb.Length = 0;
				while (Read())
				{
					switch (NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Text:
					case XmlNodeType.CDATA:
					case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
					case XmlNodeType.SignificantWhitespace:
						break;
					default:
						return sb.ToString();
					}
					sb.Append(node.Value);
				}
				return sb.ToString();
			}
			return node.Value;
		}

		public override string ReadInnerXml()
		{
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			using (XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(stringWriter))
			{
				xmlWriter.Settings.Indent = true;
				switch (NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					Read();
					while (!EOF && NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
					{
						xmlWriter.WriteNode(this, defattr: true);
					}
					Read();
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.Attribute:
					stringWriter.Write(Value);
					break;
				}
			}
			return stringWriter.ToString();
		}

		public override string ReadOuterXml()
		{
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			using (XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(stringWriter))
			{
				xmlWriter.Settings.Indent = true;
				xmlWriter.WriteNode(this, defattr: true);
			}
			return stringWriter.ToString();
		}

		public override string LookupNamespace(string prefix)
		{
			return namespaceManager.LookupNamespace(prefix);
		}

		public override void ResolveEntity()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Not on an entity reference.");
		}

		public override bool ReadAttributeValue()
		{
			if (state == State.Attr)
			{
				state = State.AttrValue;
				return true;
			}
			if (state == State.AttrValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Not on an attribute.");
		}

		private void Validate(Node node)
		{
			if (dtd == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ElementDecl elementDecl = dtd.FindElement(node.Name);
			if (elementDecl != null)
			{
				node.DtdType = elementDecl;
				if (elementDecl.ContentModel.DeclaredContent == DeclaredContent.EMPTY)
				{
					node.IsEmpty = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateAttribute(Node node, Attribute a)
		{
			ElementDecl dtdType = node.DtdType;
			if (dtdType != null)
			{
				AttDef attDef = dtdType.FindAttribute(a.Name);
				if (attDef != null)
				{
					a.DtdType = attDef;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateContent(Node node)
		{
			if (dtd == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = nametable.Add(node.Name.ToUpper());
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = stack.Count - 2;
			if (node.DtdType != null)
			{
				for (num = num2; num > 0; num--)
				{
					Node node2 = (Node)stack[num];
					if (!node2.IsEmpty)
					{
						ElementDecl dtdType = node2.DtdType;
						if (dtdType == null || dtdType.Name == dtd.Name || dtdType.CanContain(text, dtd) || !dtdType.EndTagOptional)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == 0 || num >= num2)
			{
				return;
			}
			Node node3 = (Node)stack[num2];
			if (num != num2 - 1 || !(text == node3.Name))
			{
				string text2 = "";
				for (int num3 = num2; num3 >= num + 1; num3--)
				{
					if (text2 != "")
					{
						text2 += ",";
					}
					Node node4 = (Node)stack[num3];
					text2 = text2 + "<" + node4.Name + ">";
				}
				Log("Element '{0}' not allowed inside '{1}', closing {2}.", text, node3.Name, text2);
			}
			state = State.AutoClose;
			newnode = node;
			Pop();
			poptodepth = num + 1;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.StructuredStorage
{
	internal class Directory : DirectoryEntry
	{
		private List<DirectoryEntry> children;

		public List<DirectoryEntry> Children => children;

		internal Directory(string name, DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode node)
			: base(name, node)
		{
			children = new List<DirectoryEntry>();
		}

		public File AddFile(string fileName, DirectoryStream directoryStream)
		{
			DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode directoryEntryNode = new DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode();
			DirectoryEntry directoryEntry = null;
			int num = fileName.IndexOf('\\');
			File file2;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Children.Count; i++)
				{
					if (Children[i] is File file && file.Name == fileName)
					{
						return file;
					}
				}
				file2 = new File(fileName, directoryEntryNode);
				directoryEntry = file2;
			}
			else
			{
				string text = fileName.Substring(0, num);
				for (int j = 0; j < Children.Count; j++)
				{
					if (Children[j] is Directory directory && directory.Name == text)
					{
						return directory.AddFile(fileName.Substring(num + 1), directoryStream);
					}
				}
				Directory directory2 = new Directory(text, directoryEntryNode);
				file2 = directory2.AddFile(fileName.Substring(num + 1), directoryStream);
				directoryEntry = directory2;
			}
			directoryEntry.FirstSectorId = -2;
			directoryEntry.TimeStampCreation = BitConverter.GetBytes(DateTime.Now.ToFileTime());
			directoryEntry.TimeStampModification = directoryEntry.TimeStampCreation;
			directoryEntryNode.childProperty = -1;
			directoryEntryNode.leftSiblingProperty = -1;
			directoryEntryNode.rightSiblingProperty = -1;
			directoryEntryNode.color = DirectoryStream.NodeColor.Red;
			directoryEntryNode.entry = directoryEntry;
			directoryEntry.Parent = this;
			int k;
			for (k = 0; k < Children.Count && DirectoryEntry.EntryNameComparer.Compare(directoryEntry, Children[k]) >= 0; k++)
			{
			}
			Children.Insert(k, directoryEntry);
			directoryStream.DirectoryEntryNodes.Add(directoryEntryNode);
			return file2;
		}

		public File GetFile(string currentPath, string fileName)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Count; i++)
			{
				DirectoryEntry directoryEntry = children[i];
				string text = currentPath + directoryEntry.Name;
				if (directoryEntry is Directory directory)
				{
					if (fileName.StartsWith(text, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						return directory.GetFile(text + "\\", fileName);
					}
				}
				else if (string.Equals(text, fileName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return (File)directoryEntry;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class DirectoryEntry
	{
		private class NameComparer : IComparer<DirectoryEntry>
		{
			public int Compare(DirectoryEntry x, DirectoryEntry y)
			{
				if (x.Name.Length < y.Name.Length)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (x.Name.Length == y.Name.Length)
				{
					return string.Compare(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		private int firstSectorId;

		private string name;

		private int size;

		private byte[] timeStampCreation;

		private byte[] timeStampModification;

		private byte[] uniqueIdentifier;

		private byte[] userFlags;

		private Directory parent;

		private DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode node;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static IComparer<DirectoryEntry> entryNameComparer;

		public int FirstSectorId
		{
			get
			{
				return firstSectorId;
			}
			set
			{
				firstSectorId = value;
			}
		}

		public string Name => name;

		internal DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode Node => node;

		public Directory Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return parent;
			}
			set
			{
				parent = value;
			}
		}

		public int Size
		{
			get
			{
				return size;
			}
			set
			{
				size = value;
			}
		}

		public byte[] TimeStampCreation
		{
			get
			{
				if (timeStampCreation == null)
				{
					timeStampCreation = new byte[8];
				}
				return timeStampCreation;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifySize(value, 8);
				timeStampCreation = value;
			}
		}

		public byte[] TimeStampModification
		{
			get
			{
				if (timeStampModification == null)
				{
					timeStampModification = new byte[8];
				}
				return timeStampModification;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifySize(value, 8);
				timeStampModification = value;
			}
		}

		public byte[] UniqueIdentifier
		{
			get
			{
				if (uniqueIdentifier == null)
				{
					uniqueIdentifier = new byte[16];
				}
				return uniqueIdentifier;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifySize(value, 16);
				uniqueIdentifier = value;
			}
		}

		public byte[] UserFlags
		{
			get
			{
				if (userFlags == null)
				{
					userFlags = new byte[4];
				}
				return userFlags;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifySize(value, 4);
				userFlags = value;
			}
		}

		public static IComparer<DirectoryEntry> EntryNameComparer
		{
			get
			{
				if (entryNameComparer == null)
				{
					entryNameComparer = new NameComparer();
				}
				return entryNameComparer;
			}
		}

		internal DirectoryEntry(string name, DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode node)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.node = node;
		}

		private static void VerifySize(byte[] newValue, int requiredLength)
		{
			_ = newValue.Length;
		}
	}
	internal class DirectoryEntryStream : StructuredStorageStream
	{
		private DirectoryEntry directoryEntry;

		private bool isDirty;

		public DirectoryEntryStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, DirectoryEntry directoryEntry)
			: this(structuredStorage, directoryEntry, isShortStream: false)
		{
		}

		public DirectoryEntryStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, DirectoryEntry directoryEntry, bool isShortStream)
			: base(structuredStorage, directoryEntry.FirstSectorId, directoryEntry.Size, isShortStream)
		{
			this.directoryEntry = directoryEntry;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing && isDirty)
				{
					directoryEntry.TimeStampModification = BitConverter.GetBytes(DateTime.Now.ToFileTime());
					isDirty = false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetFirstSectorId(int firstSectorId)
		{
			base.SetFirstSectorId(firstSectorId);
			directoryEntry.FirstSectorId = firstSectorId;
		}

		internal override void SetLengthInternal(int value)
		{
			base.SetLengthInternal(value);
			directoryEntry.Size = value;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			base.Write(buffer, offset, count);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				isDirty = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DirectoryStream : StructuredStorageStream
	{
		internal class DirectoryEntryNode
		{
			public DirectoryEntry entry;

			public int leftSiblingProperty;

			public int rightSiblingProperty;

			public int childProperty;

			public NodeColor color;
		}

		internal enum NodeColor : byte
		{
			Red,
			Black
		}

		internal enum PropertyType : byte
		{
			Empty = 0,
			Ole2Storage = 1,
			Ole2Stream = 2,
			RootEntry = 5
		}

		private const int DirectoryEntryHeaderLength = 128;

		private const int DirectoryEntryTitleLength = 32;

		private Directory rootEntry;

		private List<DirectoryEntryNode> directoryEntryNodes;

		private readonly int EntriesPerSector;

		internal List<DirectoryEntryNode> DirectoryEntryNodes => directoryEntryNodes;

		internal Directory RootEntry => rootEntry;

		public DirectoryStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage)
			: this(structuredStorage, structuredStorage.AllocateNewSector(-1, isShortStream: false, StreamType.Normal))
		{
			DirectoryEntryNode directoryEntryNode = new DirectoryEntryNode();
			rootEntry = new Directory("Root Entry", directoryEntryNode);
			rootEntry.FirstSectorId = -2;
			rootEntry.TimeStampCreation = BitConverter.GetBytes(DateTime.Now.ToFileTime());
			rootEntry.TimeStampModification = rootEntry.TimeStampCreation;
			directoryEntryNode.childProperty = -1;
			directoryEntryNode.leftSiblingProperty = -1;
			directoryEntryNode.rightSiblingProperty = -1;
			directoryEntryNode.entry = rootEntry;
			directoryEntryNode.color = NodeColor.Red;
			directoryEntryNodes.Add(directoryEntryNode);
			SetLengthInternal(sectorSize);
		}

		public DirectoryStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstSectorId)
			: base(structuredStorage, firstSectorId, 0)
		{
			directoryEntryNodes = new List<DirectoryEntryNode>();
			EntriesPerSector = sectorSize / 128;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing && base.StorageManager.IsDirty)
				{
					Position = 0L;
					AssignIndexNumbers();
					int i;
					for (i = 0; i < directoryEntryNodes.Count; i++)
					{
						WriteDirectoryEntryHeader(directoryEntryNodes[i]);
					}
					for (; i % EntriesPerSector != 0; i++)
					{
						WriteDirectoryEntryHeader(null);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public File AddFile(string fileName)
		{
			File file = rootEntry.AddFile(fileName, this);
			if (file == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return file;
		}

		internal void AssignIndexNumbers()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < directoryEntryNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				DirectoryEntryNode directoryEntryNode = directoryEntryNodes[i];
				if (directoryEntryNode.entry is Directory directory && directory.Children.Count > 0)
				{
					int index = directory.Children.Count / 2;
					DirectoryEntry directoryEntry = directory.Children[index];
					directoryEntryNode.childProperty = directoryEntryNodes.IndexOf(directoryEntry.Node);
					AssignSiblingIndexNumbers(directoryEntry, directory.Children, 0, directory.Children.Count - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AssignSiblingIndexNumbers(DirectoryEntry currentSiblingEntry, List<DirectoryEntry> siblings, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			int num = siblings.IndexOf(currentSiblingEntry);
			if (startIndex < num)
			{
				int index = (startIndex + num) / 2;
				DirectoryEntry directoryEntry = siblings[index];
				currentSiblingEntry.Node.leftSiblingProperty = directoryEntryNodes.IndexOf(directoryEntry.Node);
				AssignSiblingIndexNumbers(directoryEntry, siblings, startIndex, num - 1);
			}
			if (num < endIndex)
			{
				int index2 = (endIndex + num + 1) / 2;
				DirectoryEntry directoryEntry2 = siblings[index2];
				currentSiblingEntry.Node.rightSiblingProperty = directoryEntryNodes.IndexOf(directoryEntry2.Node);
				AssignSiblingIndexNumbers(directoryEntry2, siblings, num + 1, endIndex);
			}
		}

		public void ReadDirectoryEntryHeaders()
		{
			int nextSectorId = base.FirstSectorId;
			while (nextSectorId >= 0)
			{
				int steps = 1;
				nextSectorId = GetNextSectorId(nextSectorId, ref steps);
				SetLengthInternal((int)(Length + sectorSize));
			}
			Position = 0L;
			while (Position < Length)
			{
				ReadNextDirectoryEntryHeader();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < directoryEntryNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				DirectoryEntryNode directoryEntryNode = directoryEntryNodes[i];
				if (directoryEntryNode.childProperty >= 0)
				{
					StoreChildEntries((Directory)directoryEntryNode.entry, directoryEntryNode.childProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReadNextDirectoryEntryHeader()
		{
			char[] array = new char[32];
			int num = 0;
			while (num < 32)
			{
				array[num++] = (char)ReadUInt16();
			}
			int num2 = ReadInt16();
			int num3 = num2 / 2 - 1;
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			string name = new string(array, 0, num3);
			DirectoryEntryNode directoryEntryNode = new DirectoryEntryNode();
			PropertyType propertyType = (PropertyType)ReadByte();
			directoryEntryNode.color = (NodeColor)ReadByte();
			directoryEntryNode.leftSiblingProperty = ReadInt32();
			directoryEntryNode.rightSiblingProperty = ReadInt32();
			directoryEntryNode.childProperty = ReadInt32();
			byte[] uniqueIdentifier = ReadBytes(16);
			byte[] userFlags = ReadBytes(4);
			byte[] timeStampCreation = ReadBytes(8);
			byte[] timeStampModification = ReadBytes(8);
			int num4 = ReadInt32();
			int size = ReadInt32();
			ReadBytes(4);
			switch (propertyType)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case PropertyType.RootEntry:
				rootEntry = new Directory(name, directoryEntryNode);
				directoryEntryNode.entry = rootEntry;
				break;
			case PropertyType.Ole2Storage:
				directoryEntryNode.entry = new Directory(name, directoryEntryNode);
				break;
			case PropertyType.Ole2Stream:
				directoryEntryNode.entry = new File(name, directoryEntryNode);
				break;
			}
			directoryEntryNode.entry.Size = size;
			directoryEntryNode.entry.FirstSectorId = num4;
			directoryEntryNode.entry.TimeStampCreation = timeStampCreation;
			directoryEntryNode.entry.TimeStampModification = timeStampModification;
			directoryEntryNode.entry.UniqueIdentifier = uniqueIdentifier;
			directoryEntryNode.entry.UserFlags = userFlags;
			directoryEntryNodes.Add(directoryEntryNode);
		}

		private void StoreChildEntries(Directory dirctory, int childNodeIndex)
		{
			DirectoryEntryNode directoryEntryNode = directoryEntryNodes[childNodeIndex];
			if (directoryEntryNode.leftSiblingProperty >= 0)
			{
				StoreChildEntries(dirctory, directoryEntryNode.leftSiblingProperty);
			}
			directoryEntryNode.entry.Parent = dirctory;
			dirctory.Children.Add(directoryEntryNode.entry);
			if (directoryEntryNode.rightSiblingProperty >= 0)
			{
				StoreChildEntries(dirctory, directoryEntryNode.rightSiblingProperty);
			}
		}

		private void WriteDirectoryEntryHeader(DirectoryEntryNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[68];
				Write(array, 0, array.Length);
				WriteInt32(-1);
				WriteInt32(-1);
				WriteInt32(-1);
				byte[] array2 = new byte[48];
				Write(array2, 0, array2.Length);
				return;
			}
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(node.entry.Name);
			byte[] array3 = new byte[64 - bytes.Length];
			Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			Write(array3, 0, array3.Length);
			WriteInt16((short)(bytes.Length + 2));
			PropertyType value = PropertyType.Empty;
			if (node.entry == rootEntry)
			{
				value = PropertyType.RootEntry;
			}
			else if (node.entry is File)
			{
				value = PropertyType.Ole2Stream;
			}
			else if (node.entry is Directory)
			{
				value = PropertyType.Ole2Storage;
			}
			WriteByte((byte)value);
			WriteByte((byte)node.color);
			WriteInt32(node.leftSiblingProperty);
			WriteInt32(node.rightSiblingProperty);
			WriteInt32(node.childProperty);
			Write(node.entry.UniqueIdentifier, 0, 16);
			Write(node.entry.UserFlags, 0, 4);
			Write(node.entry.TimeStampCreation, 0, 8);
			Write(node.entry.TimeStampModification, 0, 8);
			WriteInt32(node.entry.FirstSectorId);
			WriteInt32(node.entry.Size);
			WriteInt32(0);
		}
	}
	internal class File : DirectoryEntry
	{
		internal File(string name, DirectoryStream.DirectoryEntryNode node)
			: base(name, node)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MasterSATStream : StructuredStorageStream
	{
		private readonly int masterSATEntriesPerSector;

		private int[] headerMasterSAT;

		private List<int> cachedMasterSAT;

		private List<int> masterSATSectorIds;

		private Dictionary<int, int> headerMasterSATLookupTable;

		private Dictionary<int, int> cachedMasterSATLookupTable;

		protected override StreamType Type => StreamType.MasterSAT;

		public int[] HeaderMasterSAT => headerMasterSAT;

		public MasterSATStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstMasterSATSectorId, int numberOfMasterSATSectors, int[] headerMasterSAT)
			: base(structuredStorage, firstMasterSATSectorId, numberOfMasterSATSectors * structuredStorage.GetSectorSize(isShortStream: false))
		{
			this.headerMasterSAT = headerMasterSAT;
			headerMasterSATLookupTable = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < headerMasterSAT.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = headerMasterSAT[i];
				if (0 <= num)
				{
					headerMasterSATLookupTable.Add(num, i);
				}
			}
			masterSATEntriesPerSector = sectorSize / 4 - 1;
			masterSATSectorIds = new List<int>();
			cachedMasterSAT = new List<int>();
			cachedMasterSATLookupTable = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			for (int num2 = firstMasterSATSectorId; num2 >= 0; num2 = ReadInt32())
			{
				base.StorageManager.SeekToSector(num2, isShortSector: false);
				masterSATSectorIds.Add(num2);
				for (int j = 0; j < sectorSize - 4; j += 4)
				{
					int num3 = ReadInt32();
					cachedMasterSAT.Add(num3);
					if (0 <= num3)
					{
						cachedMasterSATLookupTable.Add(num3, cachedMasterSAT.Count - 1);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override int AllocateNewSector(int lastSectorId)
		{
			int num = base.AllocateNewSector(lastSectorId);
			masterSATSectorIds.Add(num);
			return num;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!disposing || !base.StorageManager.IsDirty)
				{
					return;
				}
				Position = 0L;
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < masterSATSectorIds.Count; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < masterSATEntriesPerSector; j++)
					{
						WriteInt32(cachedMasterSAT[num]);
						num++;
					}
					if (i == masterSATSectorIds.Count - 1)
					{
						WriteInt32(-1);
					}
					else
					{
						WriteInt32(masterSATSectorIds[i + 1]);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		internal override int GetNextSectorId(int lastSectorId, ref int steps)
		{
			if (steps < 0)
			{
				int count = masterSATSectorIds.Count;
				while (steps < 0)
				{
					if (masterSATSectorIds[0] == lastSectorId)
					{
						return -2;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					for (count = 1; count < masterSATSectorIds.Count; count++)
					{
						if (masterSATSectorIds[count] == lastSectorId)
						{
							lastSectorId = masterSATSectorIds[count - 1];
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (lastSectorId < 0 || !flag)
					{
						return -2;
					}
					steps++;
				}
				if (steps == 0)
				{
					return lastSectorId;
				}
				return -2;
			}
			int count2 = masterSATSectorIds.Count;
			while (steps > 0)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (count2 = 0; count2 < masterSATSectorIds.Count - 1; count2++)
				{
					if (masterSATSectorIds[count2] == lastSectorId)
					{
						lastSectorId = masterSATSectorIds[count2 + 1];
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (lastSectorId < 0 || !flag2)
				{
					return -2;
				}
				steps--;
			}
			if (steps == 0)
			{
				return lastSectorId;
			}
			return -2;
		}

		internal void AddNewSATEntry(int SATSectorId)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < headerMasterSAT.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = headerMasterSAT[i];
				if (num < 0)
				{
					headerMasterSAT[i] = SATSectorId;
					headerMasterSATLookupTable.Add(SATSectorId, i);
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < cachedMasterSAT.Count; j++)
			{
				int num2 = cachedMasterSAT[j];
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					cachedMasterSAT[j] = SATSectorId;
					cachedMasterSATLookupTable.Add(SATSectorId, j);
					return;
				}
			}
			cachedMasterSAT.Add(SATSectorId);
			cachedMasterSATLookupTable.Add(SATSectorId, cachedMasterSAT.Count - 1);
			for (int k = 1; k < masterSATEntriesPerSector; k++)
			{
				cachedMasterSAT.Add(-1);
			}
			SetLength(Length + sectorSize);
		}

		internal int GetNextSATSector(int lastSectorId)
		{
			if (headerMasterSATLookupTable.TryGetValue(lastSectorId, out var value))
			{
				if (value == headerMasterSAT.Length - 1)
				{
					if (cachedMasterSAT.Count == 0)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return cachedMasterSAT[0];
				}
				return headerMasterSAT[value + 1];
			}
			if (cachedMasterSATLookupTable.TryGetValue(lastSectorId, out var value2))
			{
				if (value2 == cachedMasterSAT.Count - 1)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return cachedMasterSAT[value2 + 1];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal int GetPreviousSATSector(int lastSectorId)
		{
			if (headerMasterSATLookupTable.TryGetValue(lastSectorId, out var value))
			{
				if (value == 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return headerMasterSAT[value - 1];
			}
			if (cachedMasterSATLookupTable.TryGetValue(lastSectorId, out var value2) && 1 <= value2)
			{
				if (value2 == 0)
				{
					return headerMasterSAT[headerMasterSAT.Length - 1];
				}
				return cachedMasterSAT[value2 - 1];
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SATStream : SATStreamBase
	{
		private MasterSATStream masterSATStream;

		protected override StreamType Type => StreamType.SAT;

		public MasterSATStream MasterSATStream => masterSATStream;

		public SATStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, MasterSATStream masterSATStream)
			: base(structuredStorage, 0, 1)
		{
			this.masterSATStream = masterSATStream;
			List<SATEntry> list = new List<SATEntry>
			{
				new SATEntry(-2, -3)
			};
			for (int i = 1; i < SATEntriesPerSector; i++)
			{
				list.Add(SATEntry.FreeEntry);
			}
			SetSATContents(list);
		}

		public SATStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstSATSectorId, int numberOfSATSectors, MasterSATStream masterSATStream)
			: base(structuredStorage, firstSATSectorId, numberOfSATSectors)
		{
			this.masterSATStream = masterSATStream;
			ReadSATContents(firstSATSectorId, numberOfSATSectors);
		}

		protected override int AllocateNewSector(int lastSectorId)
		{
			int num = base.AllocateNewSector(lastSectorId);
			masterSATStream.AddNewSATEntry(num);
			return num;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				masterSATStream.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal override int GetNextSectorId(int lastSectorId, ref int steps)
		{
			while (steps < 0)
			{
				lastSectorId = masterSATStream.GetPreviousSATSector(lastSectorId);
				if (lastSectorId < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				steps++;
			}
			while (steps > 0)
			{
				lastSectorId = masterSATStream.GetNextSATSector(lastSectorId);
				if (lastSectorId < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				steps--;
			}
			return lastSectorId;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SATStreamBase : StructuredStorageStream
	{
		[DebuggerDisplay("Previous: {PreviousSector}, Next: {NextSector}")]
		public class SATEntry
		{
			public int PreviousSector;

			public int NextSector;

			public static SATEntry FreeEntry => new SATEntry(-2, -1);

			public SATEntry(int previousSector, int nextSector)
			{
				PreviousSector = previousSector;
				NextSector = nextSector;
			}
		}

		protected readonly int SATEntriesPerSector;

		private List<SATEntry> cachedSAT;

		private List<int> freeSectorIds;

		public SATStreamBase(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstSATSectorId, int numberOfSATSectors)
			: base(structuredStorage, firstSATSectorId, numberOfSATSectors * structuredStorage.GetSectorSize(isShortStream: false))
		{
			SATEntriesPerSector = structuredStorage.GetSectorSize(isShortStream: false) / 4;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing && base.StorageManager.IsDirty)
				{
					Position = 0L;
					for (int i = 0; i < cachedSAT.Count; i++)
					{
						WriteInt32(cachedSAT[i].NextSector);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		internal int AllocateNewSectorForStream(int lastSectorId, StreamType streamType)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int i = Math.Max(0, lastSectorId);
			if (freeSectorIds.Count > 0)
			{
				flag = true;
				i = freeSectorIds[0];
				freeSectorIds.RemoveAt(0);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < SATEntriesPerSector; j++)
				{
					freeSectorIds.Add(cachedSAT.Count);
					cachedSAT.Add(SATEntry.FreeEntry);
				}
				SetLength(Length + sectorSize);
				for (; i < cachedSAT.Count; i++)
				{
					int nextSector = cachedSAT[i].NextSector;
					if (nextSector == -1)
					{
						freeSectorIds.Remove(i);
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return AllocateNewSectorForStream(lastSectorId, streamType);
				}
			}
			if (lastSectorId >= 0 && streamType == StreamType.Normal)
			{
				cachedSAT[lastSectorId].NextSector = i;
				cachedSAT[i].PreviousSector = lastSectorId;
			}
			switch (streamType)
			{
			case StreamType.MasterSAT:
				cachedSAT[i].NextSector = -4;
				break;
			case StreamType.Normal:
				cachedSAT[i].NextSector = -2;
				break;
			case StreamType.SAT:
				cachedSAT[i].NextSector = -3;
				break;
			}
			return i;
		}

		public int GetNextSectorIdInSAT(int lastSectorId, ref int steps)
		{
			while (steps < 0)
			{
				lastSectorId = cachedSAT[lastSectorId].PreviousSector;
				if (lastSectorId < 0)
				{
					return -2;
				}
				steps++;
			}
			while (steps > 0)
			{
				lastSectorId = cachedSAT[lastSectorId].NextSector;
				if (lastSectorId < 0)
				{
					return -2;
				}
				steps--;
			}
			return lastSectorId;
		}

		protected void ReadSATContents(int firstSATSectorId, int numberOfSATSectors)
		{
			int num = numberOfSATSectors * SATEntriesPerSector;
			cachedSAT = new List<SATEntry>(num);
			freeSectorIds = new List<int>();
			if (firstSATSectorId < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				cachedSAT.Add(new SATEntry(-2, ReadInt32()));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < cachedSAT.Count; j++)
			{
				SATEntry sATEntry = cachedSAT[j];
				if (sATEntry.NextSector >= 0 && sATEntry.NextSector < cachedSAT.Count)
				{
					cachedSAT[sATEntry.NextSector].PreviousSector = j;
				}
				else if (sATEntry.NextSector == -1)
				{
					freeSectorIds.Add(j);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveStream(StructuredStorageStream stream)
		{
			int num = stream.FirstSectorId;
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				int steps = 1;
				int nextSectorId = stream.GetNextSectorId(num, ref steps);
				cachedSAT[num].NextSector = -1;
				int num2 = freeSectorIds.BinarySearch(num);
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					freeSectorIds.Insert(~num2, num);
				}
				num = nextSectorId;
			}
		}

		protected void SetSATContents(List<SATEntry> SAT)
		{
			cachedSAT = SAT;
			freeSectorIds = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < cachedSAT.Count; i++)
			{
				if (cachedSAT[i].NextSector == -1)
				{
					freeSectorIds.Add(i);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ShortSATStream : SATStreamBase
	{
		public ShortSATStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstShortSATSectorId, int numberOfShortSATSectors)
			: base(structuredStorage, firstShortSATSectorId, numberOfShortSATSectors)
		{
			ReadSATContents(firstShortSATSectorId, numberOfShortSATSectors);
		}
	}
	internal class StructuredStorageManager : IDisposable
	{
		private const uint FileTypeIDLow = 3759263696u;

		private const uint FileTypeIDHigh = 3776623009u;

		private const ushort LittleEndianFormat = 65534;

		private const int HeaderLength = 512;

		internal const int FreeSectorId = -1;

		internal const int EndOfStreamSectorId = -2;

		internal const int SATSectorId = -3;

		internal const int MasterSATSectorId = -4;

		internal const int HeaderMasterSATLength = 109;

		internal const int HeaderMasterSATPosition = 436;

		private Guid id;

		private ushort revisionNumberOfFileFormat = 62;

		private ushort versionNumberOfFileFormat = 3;

		private int sectorSize = 512;

		private int shortSectorSize = 64;

		private int minimumSizeForNormalStreams = 4096;

		private Stream stream;

		private DirectoryEntryStream shortStreamContainerStream;

		private SATStream SATStream;

		private ShortSATStream shortSATStream;

		private DirectoryStream directoryStream;

		private bool isOpen;

		private bool isDirty;

		public bool IsDirty
		{
			get
			{
				return isDirty;
			}
			set
			{
				isDirty = value;
			}
		}

		public Directory RootDirectory => directoryStream.RootEntry;

		public StructuredStorageManager(Stream stream, bool containsValidData)
		{
			this.stream = new SeekableBufferedStream(stream);
			if (containsValidData)
			{
				BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(this.stream);
				uint num = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
				uint num2 = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
				if (num != 3759263696u || num2 != 3776623009u)
				{
					return;
				}
				id = new Guid(binaryReader.ReadBytes(16));
				revisionNumberOfFileFormat = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
				versionNumberOfFileFormat = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
				ushort num3 = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
				sectorSize = 1 << (int)binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
				shortSectorSize = 1 << (int)binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
				binaryReader.ReadBytes(10);
				int numberOfSATSectors = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int firstSectorId = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
				minimumSizeForNormalStreams = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int firstShortSATSectorId = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int numberOfShortSATSectors = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int firstMasterSATSectorId = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int numberOfMasterSATSectors = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int[] array = new int[109];
				for (int i = 0; i < 109; i++)
				{
					array[i] = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				}
				MasterSATStream masterSATStream = new MasterSATStream(this, firstMasterSATSectorId, numberOfMasterSATSectors, array);
				SATStream = new SATStream(this, array[0], numberOfSATSectors, masterSATStream);
				shortSATStream = new ShortSATStream(this, firstShortSATSectorId, numberOfShortSATSectors);
				directoryStream = new DirectoryStream(this, firstSectorId);
				directoryStream.ReadDirectoryEntryHeaders();
				shortStreamContainerStream = new DirectoryEntryStream(this, directoryStream.RootEntry);
			}
			else
			{
				int[] array2 = new int[109];
				array2[0] = 0;
				for (int j = 1; j < 109; j++)
				{
					array2[j] = -1;
				}
				MasterSATStream masterSATStream2 = new MasterSATStream(this, -2, 0, array2);
				SATStream = new SATStream(this, masterSATStream2);
				shortSATStream = new ShortSATStream(this, -2, 0);
				directoryStream = new DirectoryStream(this);
				shortStreamContainerStream = new DirectoryEntryStream(this, directoryStream.RootEntry);
			}
			isOpen = true;
		}

		~StructuredStorageManager()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public Stream AddFile(string fileName)
		{
			File file = directoryStream.AddFile(fileName);
			if (file == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			isDirty = true;
			return new UserFileStream(this, file);
		}

		public Stream GetFileStream(string fileName)
		{
			if (!isOpen)
			{
				return null;
			}
			File file = directoryStream.RootEntry.GetFile(string.Empty, fileName);
			if (file == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new UserFileStream(this, file);
		}

		public static bool IsStructuredStorageStream(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream.Length < 8)
			{
				return false;
			}
			stream.Position = 0L;
			try
			{
				BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(stream);
				uint num = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
				uint num2 = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
				return num == 3759263696u && num2 == 3776623009u;
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Position = 0L;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!isOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (disposing && isDirty)
			{
				directoryStream.Dispose();
				shortStreamContainerStream.Dispose();
				shortSATStream.Dispose();
				SATStream.Dispose();
				stream.Position = 0L;
				BinaryWriter binaryWriter = new BinaryWriter(stream);
				binaryWriter.Write(3759263696u);
				binaryWriter.Write(3776623009u);
				binaryWriter.Write(id.ToByteArray());
				binaryWriter.Write(revisionNumberOfFileFormat);
				binaryWriter.Write(versionNumberOfFileFormat);
				binaryWriter.Write((ushort)65534);
				ushort value = (ushort)Math.Round(Math.Log(sectorSize, 2.0));
				binaryWriter.Write(value);
				ushort value2 = (ushort)Math.Round(Math.Log(shortSectorSize, 2.0));
				binaryWriter.Write(value2);
				binaryWriter.Write(new byte[10]);
				binaryWriter.Write((int)((SATStream.Length - 1) / sectorSize + 1));
				binaryWriter.Write(directoryStream.FirstSectorId);
				binaryWriter.Write(new byte[4]);
				binaryWriter.Write(minimumSizeForNormalStreams);
				binaryWriter.Write(shortSATStream.FirstSectorId);
				if (shortSATStream.Length == 0L)
				{
					binaryWriter.Write(0);
				}
				else
				{
					binaryWriter.Write((int)((shortSATStream.Length - 1) / sectorSize + 1));
				}
				binaryWriter.Write(SATStream.MasterSATStream.FirstSectorId);
				if (SATStream.MasterSATStream.Length == 0L)
				{
					binaryWriter.Write(0);
				}
				else
				{
					binaryWriter.Write((int)((SATStream.MasterSATStream.Length - 1) / sectorSize + 1));
				}
				int[] headerMasterSAT = SATStream.MasterSATStream.HeaderMasterSAT;
				for (int i = 0; i < headerMasterSAT.Length; i++)
				{
					binaryWriter.Write(headerMasterSAT[i]);
				}
				stream.Flush();
				stream.Position = stream.Length;
			}
			directoryStream = null;
			shortStreamContainerStream = null;
			shortSATStream = null;
			SATStream = null;
			stream = null;
			isDirty = false;
			isOpen = false;
		}

		internal int AllocateNewSector(int lastSectorId, bool isShortStream, StructuredStorageStream.StreamType streamType)
		{
			if (isShortStream)
			{
				return shortSATStream.AllocateNewSectorForStream(lastSectorId, streamType);
			}
			return SATStream.AllocateNewSectorForStream(lastSectorId, streamType);
		}

		internal long GetSectorPosition(int sectorId, int offsetInSector, bool isShortSector)
		{
			if (isShortSector)
			{
				return sectorId * shortSectorSize + offsetInSector;
			}
			return 512 + (long)sectorId * (long)sectorSize + offsetInSector;
		}

		internal Stream GetStreamContainerStream(bool isShortStream)
		{
			if (isShortStream)
			{
				return shortStreamContainerStream;
			}
			return stream;
		}

		internal int GetNextSectorId(int lastSectorId, ref int steps, bool isShortStream)
		{
			if (isShortStream)
			{
				return shortSATStream.GetNextSectorIdInSAT(lastSectorId, ref steps);
			}
			return SATStream.GetNextSectorIdInSAT(lastSectorId, ref steps);
		}

		internal int GetSectorSize(bool isShortStream)
		{
			if (isShortStream)
			{
				return shortSectorSize;
			}
			return sectorSize;
		}

		internal bool IsShortStream(int streamLength)
		{
			return streamLength < minimumSizeForNormalStreams;
		}

		internal long SeekToSector(int sectorId, bool isShortSector)
		{
			return SeekToSector(sectorId, 0, isShortSector);
		}

		internal long SeekToSector(int sectorId, int offsetInSector, bool isShortStream)
		{
			long sectorPosition = GetSectorPosition(sectorId, offsetInSector, isShortStream);
			GetStreamContainerStream(isShortStream).Position = sectorPosition;
			return sectorPosition;
		}

		internal void RemoveStream(UserFileStream stream)
		{
			if (stream.IsShortStream)
			{
				shortSATStream.RemoveStream(stream);
			}
			else
			{
				SATStream.RemoveStream(stream);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class StructuredStorageStream : Stream
	{
		public enum StreamType
		{
			Normal,
			SAT,
			MasterSAT
		}

		private StructuredStorageManager storageManager;

		private Stream containerStream;

		private int firstSectorId;

		protected int sectorSize;

		protected bool isShortStreamX;

		private int length;

		private int position;

		private int currentSectorId;

		private int currentSectorIndex;

		private int positionInCurrentSector;

		private long cachedContainerStreamPosition;

		private byte[] readBuffer;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => true;

		public override bool CanWrite => true;

		public override long Length => length;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (position == value || value < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = (int)(value - position);
				int num2 = positionInCurrentSector + num;
				position = (int)value;
				if (0 <= num2 && num2 < sectorSize && cachedContainerStreamPosition == containerStream.Position)
				{
					positionInCurrentSector = num2;
					cachedContainerStreamPosition += num;
					containerStream.Position = cachedContainerStreamPosition;
					return;
				}
				int num3 = currentSectorIndex;
				int num4 = currentSectorId;
				int num5 = positionInCurrentSector;
				SyncPositionMembers();
				if (currentSectorId >= 0)
				{
					cachedContainerStreamPosition = storageManager.GetSectorPosition(currentSectorId, positionInCurrentSector, isShortStreamX);
					return;
				}
				currentSectorIndex = num3;
				currentSectorId = num4;
				positionInCurrentSector = num5;
				cachedContainerStreamPosition = -1L;
			}
		}

		internal int FirstSectorId => firstSectorId;

		public StructuredStorageManager StorageManager => storageManager;

		protected virtual StreamType Type => StreamType.Normal;

		public StructuredStorageStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstSectorId, int length)
			: this(structuredStorage, firstSectorId, length, isShortStream: false)
		{
		}

		public StructuredStorageStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, int firstSectorId, int length, bool isShortStream)
		{
			readBuffer = new byte[8];
			storageManager = structuredStorage;
			this.firstSectorId = firstSectorId;
			this.length = length;
			isShortStreamX = isShortStream;
			ResetCache();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && storageManager != null && storageManager.IsDirty)
			{
				long num = Length % sectorSize;
				if (num != 0L)
				{
					Position = Length;
					int num2 = (int)(sectorSize - num);
					byte[] array = new byte[num2];
					WriteToCurrentSector(array, 0, array.Length);
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (offset + count > buffer.Length)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(count, length - position);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int i;
			int num2;
			for (i = 0; i < num; i += num2)
			{
				num2 = ReadFromCurrentSector(buffer, offset + i, num - i);
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			switch (origin)
			{
			case SeekOrigin.Begin:
				Position = offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.Current:
				Position = position + offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.End:
				Position = length + offset;
				break;
			}
			return position;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			if (value == length || value < length)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (firstSectorId < 0)
			{
				SetFirstSectorId(AllocateNewSector(-1));
			}
			int num = (int)((value - 1) / sectorSize + 1);
			int i = currentSectorIndex;
			int num2 = currentSectorId;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				i = 0;
				num2 = firstSectorId;
			}
			for (; num > i + 1; i++)
			{
				int steps = 1;
				int nextSectorId = GetNextSectorId(num2, ref steps);
				if (nextSectorId < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 = nextSectorId;
			}
			for (; i < num - 1; i++)
			{
				num2 = AllocateNewSector(num2);
			}
			SetLengthInternal((int)value);
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer != null && offset >= 0 && count >= 0 && offset + count <= buffer.Length)
			{
				int i = 0;
				long num = position + count;
				if (num > length)
				{
					SetLength(num);
				}
				for (; i < count; i += WriteToCurrentSector(buffer, offset + i, count - i))
				{
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual int AllocateNewSector(int lastSectorId)
		{
			return storageManager.AllocateNewSector(lastSectorId, isShortStreamX, Type);
		}

		internal virtual int GetNextSectorId(int lastSectorId, ref int steps)
		{
			return storageManager.GetNextSectorId(lastSectorId, ref steps, isShortStreamX);
		}

		public byte[] ReadBytes(int count)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[count];
			int num = Read(array, 0, array.Length);
			if (num == count)
			{
				return array;
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[num];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array2, 0, num);
			return array2;
		}

		private int ReadFromCurrentSector(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			SyncContainerStreamPosition();
			if (positionInCurrentSector == sectorSize)
			{
				int steps = 1;
				currentSectorId = GetNextSectorId(currentSectorId, ref steps);
				currentSectorIndex++;
				positionInCurrentSector = 0;
				if (currentSectorId < 0)
				{
					currentSectorIndex = -1;
					cachedContainerStreamPosition = -1L;
					return 0;
				}
				cachedContainerStreamPosition = storageManager.SeekToSector(currentSectorId, isShortStreamX);
			}
			int count2 = Math.Min(count, sectorSize - positionInCurrentSector);
			int num = containerStream.Read(buffer, offset, count2);
			position += num;
			positionInCurrentSector += num;
			cachedContainerStreamPosition += num;
			return num;
		}

		public short ReadInt16()
		{
			if (Read(readBuffer, 0, 2) != 2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return BitConverter.ToInt16(readBuffer, 0);
		}

		public int ReadInt32()
		{
			if (Read(readBuffer, 0, 4) != 4)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return BitConverter.ToInt32(readBuffer, 0);
		}

		public ushort ReadUInt16()
		{
			if (Read(readBuffer, 0, 2) != 2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return BitConverter.ToUInt16(readBuffer, 0);
		}

		protected void ResetCache()
		{
			currentSectorId = -1;
			currentSectorIndex = -1;
			positionInCurrentSector = -1;
			cachedContainerStreamPosition = -1L;
			sectorSize = storageManager.GetSectorSize(isShortStreamX);
			containerStream = storageManager.GetStreamContainerStream(isShortStreamX);
		}

		protected virtual void SetFirstSectorId(int firstSectorId)
		{
			this.firstSectorId = firstSectorId;
		}

		internal virtual void SetLengthInternal(int value)
		{
			length = value;
		}

		private void SyncContainerStreamPosition()
		{
			if (cachedContainerStreamPosition != containerStream.Position)
			{
				SyncPositionMembers();
				cachedContainerStreamPosition = storageManager.SeekToSector(currentSectorId, positionInCurrentSector, isShortStreamX);
			}
		}

		private void SyncPositionMembers()
		{
			if (currentSectorId < 0 || currentSectorIndex < 0)
			{
				currentSectorId = firstSectorId;
				currentSectorIndex = 0;
			}
			positionInCurrentSector = position % sectorSize;
			int num = position / sectorSize;
			int steps = num - currentSectorIndex;
			currentSectorId = GetNextSectorId(currentSectorId, ref steps);
			currentSectorIndex = num;
			if (currentSectorId < 0)
			{
				currentSectorIndex = -1;
				currentSectorId = -1;
				positionInCurrentSector = -1;
				cachedContainerStreamPosition = -1L;
			}
		}

		public void WriteInt16(short value)
		{
			Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 2);
		}

		public void WriteInt32(int value)
		{
			Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 4);
		}

		private int WriteToCurrentSector(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			SyncContainerStreamPosition();
			if (positionInCurrentSector == sectorSize)
			{
				int steps = 1;
				int nextSectorId = GetNextSectorId(currentSectorId, ref steps);
				if (nextSectorId < 0)
				{
					currentSectorId = AllocateNewSector(currentSectorId);
				}
				else
				{
					currentSectorId = nextSectorId;
				}
				currentSectorIndex++;
				positionInCurrentSector = 0;
				cachedContainerStreamPosition = storageManager.SeekToSector(currentSectorId, isShortStreamX);
			}
			int count2 = Math.Min(count, sectorSize - positionInCurrentSector);
			containerStream.Write(buffer, offset, count2);
			int num = (int)(containerStream.Position - cachedContainerStreamPosition);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				storageManager.IsDirty = true;
			}
			position += num;
			positionInCurrentSector += num;
			cachedContainerStreamPosition += num;
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal class UserFileStream : DirectoryEntryStream
	{
		private File file;

		public bool IsShortStream => isShortStreamX;

		public UserFileStream(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorage, File file)
			: base(structuredStorage, file, structuredStorage.IsShortStream(file.Size))
		{
			this.file = file;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			if (IsShortStream && !base.StorageManager.IsShortStream((int)value))
			{
				long num = Position;
				byte[] array = new byte[Length];
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					Position = 0L;
					Read(array, 0, array.Length);
					SetLengthInternal(0);
				}
				base.StorageManager.RemoveStream(this);
				isShortStreamX = false;
				ResetCache();
				SetFirstSectorId(base.StorageManager.AllocateNewSector(-1, IsShortStream, Type));
				file.FirstSectorId = base.FirstSectorId;
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					Position = 0L;
					Write(array, 0, array.Length);
					Position = num;
				}
			}
			base.SetLength(value);
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.StructuredStorage.FileTypes

	internal class DocumentSummaryInformation : InformationBase
	{
		public class DocumentSummaryInformationProperties
		{
			private DocumentSummaryInformation documentSummaryInformation;

			public object this[DocumentSummaryPropertyType type]
			{
				get
				{
					if (!documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties.ContainsKey((int)type))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties[(int)type];
				}
				set
				{
					Array array = value as Array;
					if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(value) || (array != null && array.Length == 0))
					{
						if (documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties.ContainsKey((int)type))
						{
							documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties.Remove((int)type);
						}
					}
					else if (VerifyPropertyType(type, value.GetType()) && (array == null || array.Rank == 1))
					{
						if (documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties.ContainsKey((int)type))
						{
							documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties[(int)type] = value;
						}
						else
						{
							documentSummaryInformation.DefaultProperties.Add((int)type, value);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public object this[UserDefinedPropertyType type]
			{
				get
				{
					if (!documentSummaryInformation.UserDefinedProperties.ContainsKey(type))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return documentSummaryInformation.UserDefinedProperties[type];
				}
				set
				{
					Array array = value as Array;
					if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(value) || (array != null && array.Length == 0))
					{
						if (documentSummaryInformation.UserDefinedProperties.ContainsKey(type))
						{
							documentSummaryInformation.UserDefinedProperties.Remove(type);
						}
					}
					else if (VerifyPropertyType(type, value.GetType()) && (array == null || array.Rank == 1))
					{
						documentSummaryInformation.UserDefinedProperties[type] = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public DocumentSummaryInformationProperties(DocumentSummaryInformation summaryInformation)
			{
				documentSummaryInformation = summaryInformation;
			}

			private static bool VerifyPropertyType(DocumentSummaryPropertyType propertyType, Type valueType)
			{
				if ((DocumentSummaryPropertyType)1 == propertyType)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (propertyType)
				{
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Category:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.PresentationTarget:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Manager:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Company:
					return valueType == typeof(string);
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Bytes:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Lines:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Paragraphs:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Slides:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.Notes:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.HiddenSlides:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.MMClips:
					return valueType == typeof(int);
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.ScaleCrop:
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.LinksUpToData:
					return valueType == typeof(bool);
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.HeadingPairs:
					return valueType == typeof(object[]);
				case DocumentSummaryPropertyType.TitlesOfParts:
					return valueType == typeof(string[]);
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}

			private static bool VerifyPropertyType(UserDefinedPropertyType propertyType, Type valueType)
			{
				if ((UserDefinedPropertyType)1 == propertyType)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return propertyType switch
				{
					UserDefinedPropertyType.SelfDefStructure => valueType == typeof(string), 
					UserDefinedPropertyType.StructureInstance => true, 
					_ => true, 
				};
			}
		}

		private const int FirstUserPropertyType = 2;

		private const string UserSectionId = "d5cdd5052e9c101b939708002b2cf9ae";

		private const int LinkTargetIdentifier = 16777216;

		private DocumentSummaryInformationProperties properties;

		private Dictionary<UserDefinedPropertyType, object> userDefinedProperties;

		private List<string> userDefinedNames;

		private Dictionary<string, object> userDefinedPropertiesRaw;

		private Encoding userSectionEncoding = Utilities.EncodingDefault;

		protected override string DefaultSectionId => "d5cdd5022e9c101b939708002b2cf9ae";

		public DocumentSummaryInformationProperties Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties == null)
				{
					properties = new DocumentSummaryInformationProperties(this);
				}
				return properties;
			}
