		private Dictionary<UserDefinedPropertyType, object> UserDefinedProperties => userDefinedProperties;

		public DocumentSummaryInformation()
		{
			userDefinedNames = new List<string>();
			userDefinedPropertiesRaw = new Dictionary<string, object>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			userDefinedProperties = new Dictionary<UserDefinedPropertyType, object>();
		}

		protected override void PopuplateSectionDefinitions(List<PropertySectionDefinition> sectionDefinitions)
		{
			base.PopuplateSectionDefinitions(sectionDefinitions);
			if (userDefinedPropertiesRaw.Count > 0)
			{
				PropertySectionDefinition propertySectionDefinition = new PropertySectionDefinition();
				propertySectionDefinition.sectionType = new Guid("d5cdd5052e9c101b939708002b2cf9ae");
				sectionDefinitions.Add(propertySectionDefinition);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReadSectionProperties(BinaryReader reader, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			string text = sectionDefintion.sectionType.ToString("N");
			if (text == "d5cdd5052e9c101b939708002b2cf9ae")
			{
				userSectionEncoding = ReadSectionCodePage(reader, sectionDefintion);
				for (int i = 0; i < sectionDefintion.propertyCount; i++)
				{
					PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions[i];
					if (propertyDefinition.type != 1)
					{
						ReadUserDefinedProperty(reader, propertyDefinition);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReadSectionProperties(reader, sectionDefintion);
			}
		}

		protected override void VeridyEncoding()
		{
			base.VeridyEncoding();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in userDefinedPropertiesRaw.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			foreach (object value in userDefinedPropertiesRaw.Values)
			{
				if (value is string item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			userSectionEncoding = InformationBase.GetRequiredEncoding(list);
		}

		protected override void WriteSectionProperties(BinaryWriter writer, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			string text = sectionDefintion.sectionType.ToString("N");
			if (text == "d5cdd5052e9c101b939708002b2cf9ae")
			{
				sectionDefintion.propertyCount = userDefinedPropertiesRaw.Count + 3;
				sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions = new List<PropertyDefinition>();
				writer.BaseStream.Position += sectionDefintion.propertyCount * 8;
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = new PropertyDefinition();
				propertyDefinition.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
				propertyDefinition.type = 0;
				WriteUserDefinedProperty(writer, propertyDefinition);
				sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition);
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition2 = new PropertyDefinition();
				propertyDefinition2.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
				propertyDefinition2.type = 1;
				VariantUtilities.WriteVariant(writer, userSectionEncoding, (short)Utilities.EncodingGetCodePage(userSectionEncoding));
				sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition2);
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition3 = new PropertyDefinition();
				propertyDefinition3.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
				propertyDefinition3.type = int.MinValue;
				WriteUserDefinedProperty(writer, propertyDefinition3);
				sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition3);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<UserDefinedPropertyType, object> userDefinedProperty in UserDefinedProperties)
				{
					PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition4 = new PropertyDefinition();
					propertyDefinition4.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
					propertyDefinition4.type = (int)userDefinedProperty.Key;
					VariantUtilities.WriteVariant(writer, userSectionEncoding, userDefinedProperty.Value);
					sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition4);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < userDefinedNames.Count; i++)
				{
					PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition5 = new PropertyDefinition();
					propertyDefinition5.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
					propertyDefinition5.type = i + 2;
					WriteUserDefinedProperty(writer, propertyDefinition5);
					sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition5);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.WriteSectionProperties(writer, sectionDefintion);
			}
		}

		protected void ReadUserDefinedProperty(BinaryReader reader, PropertyDefinition definition)
		{
			reader.BaseStream.Position = definition.positionOfValue;
			switch ((UserDefinedPropertyType)definition.type)
			{
			case UserDefinedPropertyType.Dictionary:
			{
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				userDefinedNames = new List<string>(num);
				userDefinedPropertiesRaw = new Dictionary<string, object>(num, StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				for (int i = 0; i < userDefinedNames.Capacity; i++)
				{
					userDefinedNames.Add(null);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
					userDefinedNames[num2 - 2] = (string)VariantUtilities.ReadVariantType(reader, VariantType.LPSTR, userSectionEncoding);
				}
				break;
			}
			case UserDefinedPropertyType.SelfDefStructure:
			case UserDefinedPropertyType.StructureInstance:
				UserDefinedProperties.Add((UserDefinedPropertyType)definition.type, VariantUtilities.ReadVariant(reader, userSectionEncoding));
				break;
			case UserDefinedPropertyType.Locale:
				VariantUtilities.ReadVariant(reader, userSectionEncoding);
				break;
			default:
				if ((definition.type & 0x1000000) == 16777216)
				{
					UserDefinedProperties.Add((UserDefinedPropertyType)definition.type, VariantUtilities.ReadVariant(reader, userSectionEncoding));
				}
				else if (definition.type - 2 >= 0 && definition.type - 2 < userDefinedNames.Count)
				{
					userDefinedPropertiesRaw.Add(userDefinedNames[definition.type - 2], VariantUtilities.ReadVariant(reader, userSectionEncoding));
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void WriteUserDefinedProperty(BinaryWriter writer, PropertyDefinition definition)
		{
			if (definition.type == int.MinValue)
			{
				VariantUtilities.WriteVariant(writer, userSectionEncoding, (uint)Utilities.CurrentCultureInfoLCID, alignBy4Bytes: true);
			}
			else if (definition.type == 0)
			{
				writer.Write(userDefinedNames.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < userDefinedNames.Count; i++)
				{
					writer.Write(i + 2);
					VariantUtilities.WriteVariantType(writer, VariantType.LPSTR, userSectionEncoding, userDefinedNames[i], alignStringLengthBy4Bytes: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				object value = userDefinedPropertiesRaw[userDefinedNames[definition.type - 2]];
				VariantUtilities.WriteVariant(writer, userSectionEncoding, value);
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class InformationBase
	{
		protected class PropertyDefinition
		{
			public int type;

			public int positionOfValue;
		}

		protected class PropertySectionDefinition
		{
			public Guid sectionType;

			public int sectionLength;

			public int positionOfSection;

			public int propertyCount;

			public List<PropertyDefinition> propertyDefinitions;
		}

		protected const int CodePagePropertyType = 1;

		private const ushort HeaderValue = 65534;

		private Dictionary<int, object> defaultProperties;

		private Encoding encoding = Utilities.EncodingDefault;

		private Guid id;

		protected Dictionary<int, object> DefaultProperties => defaultProperties;

		protected abstract string DefaultSectionId { get; }

		public InformationBase()
		{
			defaultProperties = new Dictionary<int, object>();
		}

		protected static Encoding GetRequiredEncoding(List<string> stringValues)
		{
			Encoding encodingDefault = Utilities.EncodingDefault;
			for (int i = 0; i < stringValues.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = stringValues[i];
				if (text != encodingDefault.GetString(encodingDefault.GetBytes(text)))
				{
					return Encoding.UTF8;
				}
			}
			return encodingDefault;
		}

		public void Load(Stream stream)
		{
			BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(stream);
			ushort num = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			if (num != 65534)
			{
				stream.Position = 0L;
				return;
			}
			ushort num2 = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			binaryReader.ReadInt32();
			id = new Guid(binaryReader.ReadBytes(16));
			List<PropertySectionDefinition> list = new List<PropertySectionDefinition>();
			int num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
			for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
			{
				PropertySectionDefinition propertySectionDefinition = new PropertySectionDefinition();
				propertySectionDefinition.sectionType = new Guid(binaryReader.ReadBytes(16));
				propertySectionDefinition.positionOfSection = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				list.Add(propertySectionDefinition);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				ReadSection(binaryReader, list[j]);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PopuplateSectionDefinitions(List<PropertySectionDefinition> sectionDefinitions)
		{
			PropertySectionDefinition propertySectionDefinition = new PropertySectionDefinition();
			propertySectionDefinition.sectionType = new Guid(DefaultSectionId);
			sectionDefinitions.Add(propertySectionDefinition);
		}

		protected object ReadProperty(BinaryReader reader, PropertyDefinition definition)
		{
			reader.BaseStream.Position = definition.positionOfValue;
			return VariantUtilities.ReadVariant(reader, encoding);
		}

		protected void ReadSection(BinaryReader reader, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			reader.BaseStream.Position = sectionDefintion.positionOfSection;
			sectionDefintion.sectionLength = reader.ReadInt32();
			sectionDefintion.propertyCount = reader.ReadInt32();
			sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions = new List<PropertyDefinition>(sectionDefintion.propertyCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionDefintion.propertyCount; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = new PropertyDefinition();
				propertyDefinition.type = reader.ReadInt32();
				propertyDefinition.positionOfValue = sectionDefintion.positionOfSection + reader.ReadInt32();
				sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition);
			}
			ReadSectionProperties(reader, sectionDefintion);
		}

		protected Encoding ReadSectionCodePage(BinaryReader reader, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionDefintion.propertyCount; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions[i];
				if (propertyDefinition.type == 1)
				{
					return Utilities.EncodingGetEncoding((ushort)(short)ReadProperty(reader, propertyDefinition));
				}
			}
			return Utilities.EncodingDefault;
		}

		protected virtual void ReadSectionProperties(BinaryReader reader, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			string text = sectionDefintion.sectionType.ToString("N");
			if (!(text == DefaultSectionId))
			{
				return;
			}
			defaultProperties = new Dictionary<int, object>();
			encoding = ReadSectionCodePage(reader, sectionDefintion);
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionDefintion.propertyCount; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions[i];
				if (reader.BaseStream.Length >= propertyDefinition.positionOfValue + 4 && propertyDefinition.type != 1)
				{
					defaultProperties.Add(propertyDefinition.type, ReadProperty(reader, propertyDefinition));
				}
			}
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream)
		{
			VeridyEncoding();
			BinaryWriter binaryWriter = new BinaryWriter(stream);
			binaryWriter.Write((ushort)65534);
			binaryWriter.Write((ushort)0);
			int value = 0;
			binaryWriter.Write(value);
			binaryWriter.Write(id.ToByteArray());
			List<PropertySectionDefinition> list = new List<PropertySectionDefinition>();
			PopuplateSectionDefinitions(list);
			stream.Position += 4 + 20 * list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				PropertySectionDefinition propertySectionDefinition = list[i];
				propertySectionDefinition.positionOfSection = (int)stream.Position;
				WriteSection(binaryWriter, propertySectionDefinition);
			}
			stream.Position = 24L;
			binaryWriter.Write(list.Count);
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				PropertySectionDefinition propertySectionDefinition2 = list[j];
				binaryWriter.Write(propertySectionDefinition2.sectionType.ToByteArray());
				binaryWriter.Write(propertySectionDefinition2.positionOfSection);
			}
			stream.Position = stream.Length;
		}

		protected virtual void VeridyEncoding()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (object value in defaultProperties.Values)
			{
				if (value is string item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(value is Array array))
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (array.GetValue(i) is string item2)
						{
							list.Add(item2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			encoding = GetRequiredEncoding(list);
		}

		protected void WriteSection(BinaryWriter writer, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			writer.BaseStream.Position += 8L;
			WriteSectionProperties(writer, sectionDefintion);
			while (writer.BaseStream.Position % 4 != 0L)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)0);
			}
			sectionDefintion.sectionLength = (int)(writer.BaseStream.Position - sectionDefintion.positionOfSection);
			writer.BaseStream.Position = sectionDefintion.positionOfSection;
			writer.Write(sectionDefintion.sectionLength);
			writer.Write(sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Count; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions[i];
				writer.Write(propertyDefinition.type);
				writer.Write(propertyDefinition.positionOfValue - sectionDefintion.positionOfSection);
			}
			writer.BaseStream.Position = sectionDefintion.positionOfSection + sectionDefintion.sectionLength;
		}

		protected virtual void WriteSectionProperties(BinaryWriter writer, PropertySectionDefinition sectionDefintion)
		{
			string text = sectionDefintion.sectionType.ToString("N");
			if (!(text == DefaultSectionId))
			{
				return;
			}
			sectionDefintion.propertyCount = defaultProperties.Count + 1;
			sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions = new List<PropertyDefinition>();
			writer.BaseStream.Position += sectionDefintion.propertyCount * 8;
			PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = new PropertyDefinition();
			propertyDefinition.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
			propertyDefinition.type = 1;
			VariantUtilities.WriteVariant(writer, encoding, (short)Utilities.EncodingGetCodePage(encoding));
			sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, object> defaultProperty in defaultProperties)
			{
				PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition2 = new PropertyDefinition();
				propertyDefinition2.positionOfValue = (int)writer.BaseStream.Position;
				propertyDefinition2.type = defaultProperty.Key;
				VariantUtilities.WriteVariant(writer, encoding, defaultProperty.Value);
				sectionDefintion.propertyDefinitions.Add(propertyDefinition2);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SummaryInformation : InformationBase
	{
		public class SummaryInformationProperties
		{
			private SummaryInformation summaryInformation;

			public object this[SummaryPropertyType type]
			{
				get
				{
					if (!summaryInformation.DefaultProperties.ContainsKey((int)type))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return summaryInformation.DefaultProperties[(int)type];
				}
				set
				{
					if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(value))
					{
						if (summaryInformation.DefaultProperties.ContainsKey((int)type))
						{
							summaryInformation.DefaultProperties.Remove((int)type);
						}
					}
					else if (VerifyPropertyType(type, value.GetType()))
					{
						if (summaryInformation.DefaultProperties.ContainsKey((int)type))
						{
							summaryInformation.DefaultProperties[(int)type] = value;
						}
						else
						{
							summaryInformation.DefaultProperties.Add((int)type, value);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public SummaryInformationProperties(SummaryInformation summaryInformation)
			{
				this.summaryInformation = summaryInformation;
			}

			private static bool VerifyPropertyType(SummaryPropertyType propertyType, Type valueType)
			{
				if ((SummaryPropertyType)1 == propertyType)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (propertyType)
				{
				case SummaryPropertyType.Title:
				case SummaryPropertyType.Subject:
				case SummaryPropertyType.Author:
				case SummaryPropertyType.Keywords:
				case SummaryPropertyType.Comments:
				case SummaryPropertyType.Template:
				case SummaryPropertyType.LastSavedBy:
				case SummaryPropertyType.RevisionNumber:
				case SummaryPropertyType.NameOfCreatingApplication:
					return valueType == typeof(string);
				case SummaryPropertyType.TotalEditingTime:
				case SummaryPropertyType.LastPrinted:
				case SummaryPropertyType.CreatedDateTime:
				case SummaryPropertyType.LastSavedDateTime:
					return valueType == typeof(DateTime);
				case SummaryPropertyType.NumberOfPages:
				case SummaryPropertyType.NumberOfWords:
				case SummaryPropertyType.NumberOfCharacters:
				case SummaryPropertyType.Security:
					return valueType == typeof(int);
				case SummaryPropertyType.Thumbnail:
					return false;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		private SummaryInformationProperties properties;

		protected override string DefaultSectionId => "f29f85e04ff91068ab9108002b27b3d9";

		public SummaryInformationProperties Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties == null)
				{
					properties = new SummaryInformationProperties(this);
				}
				return properties;
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.MsoCrypto
{
	internal class AgileEncryptedStream : Stream
	{
		private ICipherProvider cipher;

		private Stream dataStream;

		private byte[] contentBuffer = new byte[4096];

		private long contentPosition;

		private long contentLength;

		private bool isLengthDirty;

		private bool isBufferDirty;

		public override bool CanRead => dataStream.CanRead;

		public override bool CanSeek => dataStream.CanSeek;

		public override bool CanWrite => dataStream.CanWrite;

		public override long Length => contentLength;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return contentPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				MoveToOffset(value, forceRefresh: false);
			}
		}

		public AgileEncryptedStream(ICipherProvider cipher, Stream dataStream)
		{
			this.cipher = cipher;
			this.dataStream = dataStream;
			if (dataStream.Length > 0)
			{
				dataStream.Position = 0L;
				contentLength = dataStream.ReadInt64();
				MoveToOffset(0L, forceRefresh: true);
			}
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			long length = ToRealOffset(RoundToBlock(value));
			dataStream.SetLength(length);
			SetContentLength(value);
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			return origin switch
			{
				SeekOrigin.Begin => Position = offset, 
				SeekOrigin.Current => Position += offset, 
				SeekOrigin.End => Position = Length + offset, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(), 
			};
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			int num = offset;
			long val = Math.Max(0L, Length - Position);
			count = (int)Math.Min(count, val);
			int num2 = (int)(Position % contentBuffer.Length);
			while (count > 0)
			{
				int num3 = Math.Min(contentBuffer.Length - num2, count);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(contentBuffer, num2, buffer, offset, num3);
				MoveToOffset(Position + num3, forceRefresh: false);
				offset += num3;
				count -= num3;
				num2 = 0;
			}
			return offset - num;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			int num = (int)(Position % contentBuffer.Length);
			while (count > 0)
			{
				int num2 = Math.Min(contentBuffer.Length - num, count);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, contentBuffer, num, num2);
				isBufferDirty = true;
				MoveToOffset(Position + num2, forceRefresh: false);
				offset += num2;
				count -= num2;
				num = 0;
			}
			if (Position > Length)
			{
				SetContentLength(Position);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Flush();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			if (isBufferDirty)
			{
				MoveToOffset(Position, forceRefresh: true);
			}
			if (isLengthDirty)
			{
				if (Length > 0)
				{
					long offset = RoundToBlock(Length);
					dataStream.SetLength(ToRealOffset(offset));
					dataStream.Position = 0L;
					dataStream.WriteInt64(Length);
				}
				else
				{
					dataStream.SetLength(0L);
				}
				isLengthDirty = false;
			}
			dataStream.Flush();
		}

		private void SetContentLength(long newLength)
		{
			if (Length != newLength)
			{
				isLengthDirty = true;
				contentLength = newLength;
			}
		}

		private long ToRealOffset(long offset)
		{
			return offset + 8;
		}

		private long RoundToBlock(long value)
		{
			return (value + cipher.BlockBytes - 1) / cipher.BlockBytes * cipher.BlockBytes;
		}

		private void MoveToOffset(long newPosition, bool forceRefresh)
		{
			long num = Position / contentBuffer.Length;
			long num2 = newPosition / contentBuffer.Length;
			if (num != num2 || forceRefresh)
			{
				if (isBufferDirty)
				{
					ICryptoTransform encryptor = cipher.GetEncryptor((int)num, 0);
					using (encryptor)
					{
						encryptor.TransformInPlace(contentBuffer, 0, contentBuffer.Length);
					}
					dataStream.Position = ToRealOffset(num * contentBuffer.Length);
					dataStream.Write(contentBuffer, 0, contentBuffer.Length);
					isBufferDirty = false;
				}
				dataStream.Position = ToRealOffset(num2 * contentBuffer.Length);
				int num3 = dataStream.Read(contentBuffer, 0, contentBuffer.Length);
				if (num3 < contentBuffer.Length)
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[contentBuffer.Length - num3];
					new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
					Array.Copy(array, 0, contentBuffer, num3, array.Length);
				}
				ICryptoTransform decryptor = cipher.GetDecryptor((int)num2, 0);
				using (decryptor)
				{
					decryptor.TransformInPlace(contentBuffer, 0, num3);
				}
			}
			contentPosition = newPosition;
		}
	}
	internal class AgileEncryptionConfig
	{
		public CipherConfig CipherConfig { get; set; }

		public HashConfig HashConfig { get; set; }

		public PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig { get; set; }

		public int SaltSize { get; set; }
	}
	internal class CipherConfig
	{
		public int BlockBits { get; set; }

		public int KeyBits { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string Mode { get; set; }

		public CipherConfig Copy()
		{
			return (CipherConfig)MemberwiseClone();
		}

		public SymmetricAlgorithm GetAlg()
		{
			SymmetricAlgorithm symmetricAlgorithm = SymmetricAlgorithm.Create(Name);
			symmetricAlgorithm.BlockSize = BlockBits;
			symmetricAlgorithm.KeySize = KeyBits;
			symmetricAlgorithm.Padding = PaddingMode.None;
			if (Mode == "ChainingModeCBC")
			{
				symmetricAlgorithm.Mode = CipherMode.CBC;
			}
			else if (Mode == "ChainingModeCFB")
			{
				symmetricAlgorithm.Mode = CipherMode.CFB;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(Mode == "ChainingModeECB"))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected chaining mode");
				}
				symmetricAlgorithm.Mode = CipherMode.ECB;
			}
			return symmetricAlgorithm;
		}
	}
	internal class HashConfig
	{
		public int HashBits { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public HashConfig Copy()
		{
			return (HashConfig)MemberwiseClone();
		}

		public HashAlgorithm GetAlg()
		{
			HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm = CryptoUtilities.CreateHashAlgorithm(Name);
			if (hashAlgorithm.HashSize != HashBits)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected hash size");
			}
			hashAlgorithm.Initialize();
			return hashAlgorithm;
		}

		public HMAC GetHMAC(byte[] hmacKey)
		{
			switch (Name)
			{
			case "SHA256":
				return new HMACSHA256(hmacKey);
			case "SHA384":
				return new HMACSHA384(hmacKey);
			case "SHA512":
				return new HMACSHA512(hmacKey);
			case "SHA1":
				return new HMACSHA1(hmacKey);
			default:
			{
				HMAC hMAC = HMAC.Create();
				hMAC.HashName = Name;
				hMAC.Key = hmacKey;
				return hMAC;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig
	{
		public HashConfig HashConfig { get; set; }

		public CipherConfig CipherConfig { get; set; }

		public int SaltSize { get; set; }

		public int SpinCount { get; set; }
	}
	internal class HmacData
	{
		public byte[] EncryptedKey { get; set; }

		public byte[] EncryptedValue { get; set; }

		public HmacData Copy()
		{
			HmacData hmacData = new HmacData();
			hmacData.EncryptedKey = (byte[])EncryptedKey.Clone();
			hmacData.EncryptedValue = (byte[])EncryptedValue.Clone();
			return hmacData;
		}
	}
	internal class EncryptionData
	{
		private static string rootUri = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/encryption";

		public byte[] SaltValue { get; set; }

		public HmacData HmacData { get; set; }

		public PasswordKeyEncryptorData PasswordEncryptorData { get; set; }

		public static EncryptionData LoadFromStream(Stream infoStream, bool useHmac, out AgileEncryptionConfig config)
		{
			int num = infoStream.ReadInt32();
			XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(infoStream);
			using (xmlReader)
			{
				return LoadFromXml(xmlReader, useHmac, out config);
			}
		}

		private static EncryptionData LoadFromXml(XmlReader reader, bool useHmac, out AgileEncryptionConfig configOut)
		{
			AgileEncryptionConfig config = new AgileEncryptionConfig();
			config.CipherConfig = new CipherConfig();
			config.HashConfig = new HashConfig();
			EncryptionData data = new EncryptionData();
			data.HmacData = new HmacData();
			reader.MoveToStartElement(rootUri, "encryption");
			reader.ParseAttributes(0, (XmlNameToken nameToken, string value) => false);
			reader.MoveToStartElement(rootUri, "keyData");
			reader.ParseAttributes(8, delegate(XmlNameToken nameToken, string value)
			{
				switch (nameToken)
				{
				case XmlNameToken.blockSize:
					config.CipherConfig.BlockBits = int.Parse(value) * 8;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.keyBits:
					config.CipherConfig.KeyBits = int.Parse(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.hashSize:
					config.HashConfig.HashBits = int.Parse(value) * 8;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.cipherAlgorithm:
					config.CipherConfig.Name = value;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.cipherChaining:
					config.CipherConfig.Mode = value;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.hashAlgorithm:
					config.HashConfig.Name = value;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.saltSize:
					config.SaltSize = int.Parse(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.saltValue:
					data.SaltValue = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			});
			if (config.SaltSize != data.SaltValue.Length)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid salt size/data found");
			}
			reader.MoveToEndElement();
			if (useHmac)
			{
				reader.MoveToStartElement(rootUri, "dataIntegrity");
				reader.ParseAttributes(2, delegate(XmlNameToken nameToken, string value)
				{
					switch (nameToken)
					{
					case XmlNameToken.encryptedHmacKey:
						data.HmacData.EncryptedKey = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
						return true;
					case XmlNameToken.encryptedHmacValue:
						data.HmacData.EncryptedValue = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
						return true;
					default:
						return false;
					}
				});
				reader.MoveToEndElement();
			}
			reader.MoveToStartElement(rootUri, "keyEncryptors");
			reader.ParseAttributes(0, (XmlNameToken nameToken, string value) => false);
			reader.MoveToStartElement(rootUri, "keyEncryptor");
			do
			{
				string encryptorUri = string.Empty;
				reader.ParseAttributes(1, delegate(XmlNameToken nameToken, string value)
				{
					if (nameToken == XmlNameToken.uri)
					{
						encryptorUri = value;
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				});
				if (encryptorUri.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Found empty Uri");
				}
				if (encryptorUri == PasswordKeyEncryptorData.RootUri)
				{
					data.PasswordEncryptorData = PasswordKeyEncryptorData.LoadFromXml(reader, out var configOut2);
					config.PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig = configOut2;
				}
				else
				{
					string namespaceURI = reader.NamespaceURI;
					do
					{
						reader.MoveToNextContent();
					}
					while (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement || !(reader.Name == "keyEncryptor") || !(reader.NamespaceURI == namespaceURI));
				}
				reader.MoveToNextContent();
			}
			while (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement);
			reader.MoveToNextContent();
			configOut = config;
			return data;
		}

		public static void WriteToStream(Stream stream, AgileEncryptionConfig config, EncryptionData data)
		{
			stream.WriteInt32(64);
			XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(stream, new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				Encoding = Encoding.UTF8
			});
			using (xmlWriter)
			{
				WriteToXml(xmlWriter, config, data);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteToXml(XmlWriter writer, AgileEncryptionConfig config, EncryptionData data)
		{
			writer.WriteStartDocument();
			writer.WriteStartElement("encryption", rootUri);
			writer.WriteStartElement("keyData", rootUri);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.blockSize.ToString(), (config.CipherConfig.BlockBits / 8).ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.saltSize.ToString(), config.SaltSize.ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.keyBits.ToString(), config.CipherConfig.KeyBits.ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.hashSize.ToString(), (config.HashConfig.HashBits / 8).ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.cipherAlgorithm.ToString(), config.CipherConfig.Name);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.cipherChaining.ToString(), config.CipherConfig.Mode);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.hashAlgorithm.ToString(), config.HashConfig.Name);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.saltValue.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.SaltValue));
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			if (data.HmacData != null)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("dataIntegrity", rootUri);
				writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.encryptedHmacKey.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.HmacData.EncryptedKey));
				writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.encryptedHmacValue.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.HmacData.EncryptedValue));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement("keyEncryptors", rootUri);
			writer.WriteStartElement("keyEncryptor", rootUri);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.uri.ToString(), PasswordKeyEncryptorData.RootUri);
			PasswordKeyEncryptorData.WriteToXml(writer, config.PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig, data.PasswordEncryptorData);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndDocument();
			writer.Flush();
		}
	}
	internal class PasswordKeyEncryptorData
	{
		private static string rootUri = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/keyEncryptor/password";

		public static string RootUri => rootUri;

		public byte[] EncryptedHashInput { get; set; }

		public byte[] EncryptedHashValue { get; set; }

		public byte[] EncryptedKeyValue { get; set; }

		public byte[] SaltValue { get; set; }

		public byte[] SecretKey { get; set; }

		internal static PasswordKeyEncryptorData LoadFromXml(XmlReader reader, out PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig configOut)
		{
			PasswordKeyEncryptorData data = new PasswordKeyEncryptorData();
			PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config = new PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig();
			config.CipherConfig = new CipherConfig();
			config.HashConfig = new HashConfig();
			reader.MoveToStartElement(rootUri, "encryptedKey");
			reader.ParseAttributes(12, delegate(XmlNameToken nameToken, string value)
			{
				switch (nameToken)
				{
				case XmlNameToken.spinCount:
					config.SpinCount = int.Parse(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.saltSize:
					config.SaltSize = int.Parse(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.blockSize:
					config.CipherConfig.BlockBits = int.Parse(value) * 8;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.keyBits:
					config.CipherConfig.KeyBits = int.Parse(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.hashSize:
					config.HashConfig.HashBits = int.Parse(value) * 8;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.cipherAlgorithm:
					config.CipherConfig.Name = value;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.cipherChaining:
					config.CipherConfig.Mode = value;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.hashAlgorithm:
					config.HashConfig.Name = value;
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.saltValue:
					data.SaltValue = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.encryptedVerifierHashInput:
					data.EncryptedHashInput = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.encryptedVerifierHashValue:
					data.EncryptedHashValue = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
					return true;
				case XmlNameToken.encryptedKeyValue:
					data.EncryptedKeyValue = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			});
			if (config.SaltSize != data.SaltValue.Length)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid salt size/data found");
			}
			if (!reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				reader.MoveToNextContent();
			}
			reader.MoveToNextContent();
			configOut = config;
			return data;
		}

		public static void WriteToXml(XmlWriter writer, PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config, PasswordKeyEncryptorData data)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("encryptedKey", rootUri);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.spinCount.ToString(), config.SpinCount.ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.saltSize.ToString(), config.SaltSize.ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.blockSize.ToString(), (config.CipherConfig.BlockBits / 8).ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.keyBits.ToString(), config.CipherConfig.KeyBits.ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.cipherAlgorithm.ToString(), config.CipherConfig.Name);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.cipherChaining.ToString(), config.CipherConfig.Mode);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.hashAlgorithm.ToString(), config.HashConfig.Name);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.hashSize.ToString(), (config.HashConfig.HashBits / 8).ToString());
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.saltValue.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.SaltValue));
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.encryptedVerifierHashInput.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.EncryptedHashInput));
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.encryptedVerifierHashValue.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.EncryptedHashValue));
			writer.WriteAttributeString(XmlNameToken.encryptedKeyValue.ToString(), CryptoUtilities.ToBase64String(data.EncryptedKeyValue));
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}
	}
	internal enum XmlNameToken
	{
		blockSize,
		keyBits,
		hashSize,
		saltSize,
		saltValue,
		cipherAlgorithm,
		cipherChaining,
		hashAlgorithm,
		encryptedHmacKey,
		encryptedHmacValue,
		uri,
		spinCount,
		encryptedVerifierHashInput,
		encryptedVerifierHashValue,
		encryptedKeyValue
	}
	internal class AgileEncryptionSession
	{
		private HashConfig hashConfig;

		private CipherConfig cipherConfig;

		private byte[] saltValue;

		private KeyManager keyManager;

		private PrimaryCipher primaryCipher;

		private HmacData hmacData;

		public bool IsUnlocked => keyManager.IsUnlocked;

		public int CipherBlockBytes => cipherConfig.BlockBits / 8;

		public static AgileEncryptionSession LoadFromStream(Stream stream, bool useHmac)
		{
			AgileEncryptionConfig config;
			EncryptionData data = EncryptionData.LoadFromStream(stream, useHmac, out config);
			return new AgileEncryptionSession(config, data);
		}

		public static AgileEncryptionSession LoadFromStream(Stream stream)
		{
			return LoadFromStream(stream, useHmac: true);
		}

		public AgileEncryptionSession(AgileEncryptionConfig config)
		{
			cipherConfig = config.CipherConfig.Copy();
			hashConfig = config.HashConfig.Copy();
			saltValue = new byte[config.SaltSize];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(saltValue);
			keyManager = new KeyManager(config);
		}

		internal AgileEncryptionSession(AgileEncryptionConfig config, EncryptionData data)
		{
			cipherConfig = config.CipherConfig.Copy();
			hashConfig = config.HashConfig.Copy();
			saltValue = data.SaltValue;
			keyManager = new KeyManager(config, data.PasswordEncryptorData);
			hmacData = data.HmacData;
			if (keyManager.SecretKey != null)
			{
				primaryCipher = new PrimaryCipher(hashConfig, cipherConfig, saltValue, keyManager.SecretKey);
			}
		}

		public void SetPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode)
		{
			keyManager.SetPassword(passwordUnicode);
			primaryCipher = new PrimaryCipher(hashConfig, cipherConfig, saltValue, keyManager.SecretKey);
		}

		public bool UnlockWithPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode)
		{
			if (primaryCipher != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Already unlocked");
			}
			if (!keyManager.UnlockWithPassword(passwordUnicode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			primaryCipher = new PrimaryCipher(hashConfig, cipherConfig, saltValue, keyManager.SecretKey);
			return true;
		}

		public void WriteToStream(Stream stream)
		{
			AgileEncryptionConfig agileEncryptionConfig = new AgileEncryptionConfig();
			agileEncryptionConfig.CipherConfig = cipherConfig.Copy();
			agileEncryptionConfig.HashConfig = hashConfig.Copy();
			agileEncryptionConfig.SaltSize = saltValue.Length;
			EncryptionData encryptionData = new EncryptionData();
			if (hmacData != null && hmacData.EncryptedKey != null && hmacData.EncryptedValue != null)
			{
				encryptionData.HmacData = hmacData.Copy();
			}
			encryptionData.SaltValue = saltValue;
			keyManager.Save(agileEncryptionConfig, encryptionData);
			EncryptionData.WriteToStream(stream, agileEncryptionConfig, encryptionData);
		}

		public AgileEncryptedStream GetEncryptedStream(Stream stream)
		{
			if (primaryCipher == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Not unlocked");
			}
			return new AgileEncryptedStream(primaryCipher, stream);
		}

		public void AddIntegrityCheck(Stream stream)
		{
			if (primaryCipher == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Not unlocked");
			}
			hmacData = Hmac.GetHmac(primaryCipher, hashConfig, stream);
		}

		public bool DoIntegrityCheck(Stream stream)
		{
			if (primaryCipher == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Not unlocked");
			}
			if (hmacData == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Hmac.CheckStream(primaryCipher, hashConfig, hmacData, stream);
		}
	}
	internal static class CryptoUtilities
	{
		public static Aes CreateAes()
		{
			return Aes.Create();
		}

		public static HashAlgorithm CreateHashAlgorithm(string name)
		{
			return name switch
			{
				"SHA256" => new SHA256CryptoServiceProvider(), 
				"SHA384" => new SHA384CryptoServiceProvider(), 
				"SHA512" => new SHA512CryptoServiceProvider(), 
				_ => HashAlgorithm.Create(name), 
			};
		}

		public static SHA1 CreateSHA1()
		{
			return SHA1.Create();
		}

		public static void SetAll<T>(this T[] arr, T value)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				arr[i] = value;
			}
		}

		public static string ToBase64String(byte[] data)
		{
			return Convert.ToBase64String(data, Base64FormattingOptions.None);
		}

		public static string ReadUnicodeLpP4(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
			byte[] array = reader.ReadBytes((int)num);
			for (; num % 4 != 0; num++)
			{
				reader.ReadByte();
			}
			return Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array, 0, array.Length);
		}

		public static void WriteUnicodeLpP4(string value, BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(value);
			writer.Write((uint)bytes.Length);
			writer.Write(bytes);
			for (int i = bytes.Length; i % 4 != 0; i++)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)0);
			}
		}

		public static string ReadUTF8LpP4(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
			switch (num)
			{
			case 0u:
				return null;
			case 4u:
				return string.Empty;
			default:
			{
				byte[] bytes = reader.ReadBytes((int)num);
				for (; num % 4 != 0; num++)
				{
					reader.ReadByte();
				}
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
			}
			}
		}

		public static void WriteUTF8LpP4(string value, BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				writer.Write(0u);
				return;
			}
			if (value.Length == 0)
			{
				writer.Write(4u);
				return;
			}
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value);
			writer.Write((uint)bytes.Length);
			writer.Write(bytes);
			for (int i = bytes.Length; i % 4 != 0; i++)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)0);
			}
		}

		public static void WriteUInt16(this Stream stream, ushort value)
		{
			stream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 2);
		}

		public static void WriteUInt32(this Stream stream, uint value)
		{
			stream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 4);
		}

		public static byte[] ReadBytes(Stream stream, int bytesToRead)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[bytesToRead];
			if (stream.Read(array, 0, array.Length) != bytesToRead)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Not enough stream data");
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static short ReadInt16(this Stream stream)
		{
			return BitConverter.ToInt16(ReadBytes(stream, 2), 0);
		}

		public static int ReadInt32(this Stream stream)
		{
			return BitConverter.ToInt32(ReadBytes(stream, 4), 0);
		}

		public static long ReadInt64(this Stream stream)
		{
			return BitConverter.ToInt64(ReadBytes(stream, 8), 0);
		}

		public static void WriteInt16(this Stream stream, short value)
		{
			stream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 2);
		}

		public static void WriteInt32(this Stream stream, int value)
		{
			stream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 4);
		}

		public static void WriteInt64(this Stream stream, long value)
		{
			stream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(value), 0, 8);
		}

		public static int RoundUp(int value, int round)
		{
			if (round == 0)
			{
				return round;
			}
			return (value + round - 1) / round * round;
		}

		public static byte[] CloneToFit(this byte[] input, int size)
		{
			return input.CloneToFit(size, 54);
		}

		public static byte[] CloneToFit(this byte[] input, int size, byte pad)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[size];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(input, 0, array, 0, Math.Min(input.Length, array.Length));
			for (int i = input.Length; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = pad;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static ICryptoTransform GetCryptoTransform(this ICipherProvider cipher, int key1, int key2, bool isEncryption)
		{
			if (key2 == 0)
			{
				return cipher.GetCryptoTransform(BitConverter.GetBytes(key1), isEncryption);
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(key2), 0, array, 0, 4);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(key1), 0, array, 4, 4);
			return cipher.GetCryptoTransform(array, isEncryption);
		}

		public static ICryptoTransform GetEncryptor(this ICipherProvider cipher, int key1, int key2)
		{
			return cipher.GetCryptoTransform(key1, key2, isEncryption: true);
		}

		public static ICryptoTransform GetEncryptor(this ICipherProvider cipher, byte[] blockKey)
		{
			return cipher.GetCryptoTransform(blockKey, isEncryption: true);
		}

		public static ICryptoTransform GetDecryptor(this ICipherProvider cipher, int key1, int key2)
		{
			return cipher.GetCryptoTransform(key1, key2, isEncryption: false);
		}

		public static ICryptoTransform GetDecryptor(this ICipherProvider cipher, byte[] blockKey)
		{
			return cipher.GetCryptoTransform(blockKey, isEncryption: false);
		}

		public static void TransformInPlace(this ICryptoTransform transform, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (count != 0)
			{
				int num = transform.TransformBlock(buffer, offset, count, buffer, offset);
				if (count != num)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool EqualBytes(this byte[] arr1, byte[] arr2)
		{
			if (arr1.Length != arr2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < arr1.Length; i++)
			{
				if (arr1[i] != arr2[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void CheckNode(this XmlReader reader, string namespaceUri, string localName)
		{
			if (reader.LocalName != localName)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (reader.NamespaceURI != namespaceUri)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		internal static void MoveToStartElement(this XmlReader reader)
		{
			reader.MoveToNextContent();
			if (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		internal static void MoveToNextContent(this XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!reader.Read())
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			reader.MoveToContent();
		}

		internal static void MoveToStartElement(this XmlReader reader, string namespaceUri, string localName)
		{
			reader.MoveToStartElement();
			reader.CheckNode(namespaceUri, localName);
		}

		internal static void MoveToEndElement(this XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				reader.MoveToNextContent();
				if (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ParseAttributes(this XmlReader reader, int attributeMax, Func<XmlNameToken, string, bool> action)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (reader.MoveToFirstAttribute())
			{
				do
				{
					if (!reader.IsXmlnsAttribute())
					{
						if (!Enum.TryParse<XmlNameToken>(reader.LocalName, out var result))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException();
						}
						if (reader.NamespaceURI.Length != 0)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException();
						}
						if (!action(result, reader.Value))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException();
						}
						num++;
					}
				}
				while (reader.MoveToNextAttribute());
			}
			if (num != attributeMax)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			reader.MoveToElement();
		}

		internal static bool IsXmlnsAttribute(this XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Attribute)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reader.Prefix == "xmlns")
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (reader.Prefix.Length == 0 && reader.LocalName == "xmlns")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal struct EncryptionHeader
	{
		public const int AlgIdAES128 = 26126;

		public const int AlgIdAES192 = 26127;

		public const int AlgIdAES256 = 26128;

		public const int AlgIdRC4 = 26625;

		public const int AlgIdHashSHA1 = 32772;

		public EncryptionHeaderFlags Flags;

		public uint SizeExtra;

		public int AlgId;

		public int AlgIdHash;

		public uint KeySize;

		public uint ProviderType;

		public string CSPName;

		public HashAlgorithm CreateHashAlgorithm(Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException = null)
		{
			int algIdHash = AlgIdHash;
			if (algIdHash == 32772)
			{
				return CryptoUtilities.CreateSHA1();
			}
			throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException?.Invoke();
			return null;
		}

		public SymmetricAlgorithm CreateEncryptionAlgorithm(Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException = null)
		{
			switch (AlgId)
			{
			case 26126:
			{
				Aes aes2 = CryptoUtilities.CreateAes();
				aes2.KeySize = 128;
				return aes2;
			}
			case 26127:
			{
				Aes aes3 = CryptoUtilities.CreateAes();
				aes3.KeySize = 192;
				return aes3;
			}
			case 26128:
			{
				Aes aes = CryptoUtilities.CreateAes();
				aes.KeySize = 256;
				return aes;
			}
			case 26625:
			{
				RC4Algorithm rC4Algorithm = new RC4Algorithm();
				rC4Algorithm.KeySize = (int)((KeySize == 40) ? 128 : KeySize);
				return rC4Algorithm;
			}
			default:
				throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException?.Invoke();
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static EncryptionHeader Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			EncryptionHeader result = default(EncryptionHeader);
			result.Flags = reader.ReadUInt32();
			result.SizeExtra = reader.ReadUInt32();
			result.AlgId = reader.ReadInt32();
			result.AlgIdHash = reader.ReadInt32();
			result.KeySize = reader.ReadUInt32();
			result.ProviderType = reader.ReadUInt32();
			uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
			uint num2 = reader.ReadUInt32();
			result.CSPName = reader.ReadNullTerminatedUnicodeString();
			return result;
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(Flags.ValuesRaw);
			writer.Write(SizeExtra);
			writer.Write(AlgId);
			writer.Write(AlgIdHash);
			writer.Write(KeySize);
			writer.Write(ProviderType);
			writer.Write(0);
			writer.Write(0);
			writer.WriteNullTerminatedUnicodeString(CSPName);
		}
	}
	internal struct EncryptionHeaderFlags
	{
		private enum Values : uint
		{
			fCryptoAPI = 4u,
			fDocProps = 8u,
			fExternal = 0x10u,
			fAES = 0x20u
		}

		private Values _values;

		public bool fCryptoAPI
		{
			get
			{
				return _values.HasFlag(Values.fCryptoAPI);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlags(Values.fCryptoAPI, value);
			}
		}

		public bool fDocProps
		{
			get
			{
				return _values.HasFlag(Values.fDocProps);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlags(Values.fDocProps, value);
			}
		}

		public bool fExternal
		{
			get
			{
				return _values.HasFlag(Values.fExternal);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlags(Values.fExternal, value);
			}
		}

		public bool fAES
		{
			get
			{
				return _values.HasFlag(Values.fAES);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlags(Values.fAES, value);
			}
		}

		public uint ValuesRaw => (uint)_values;

		public EncryptionHeaderFlags(uint values)
		{
			_values = (Values)values;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			EncryptionHeaderFlags? encryptionHeaderFlags = obj as EncryptionHeaderFlags?;
			if (encryptionHeaderFlags.HasValue)
			{
				return _values == encryptionHeaderFlags.Value._values;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetFlags(Values value, bool set)
		{
			if (set)
			{
				_values |= value;
			}
			else
			{
				_values &= ~value;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _values.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(EncryptionHeaderFlags a, EncryptionHeaderFlags b)
		{
			return a._values == b._values;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(EncryptionHeaderFlags a, EncryptionHeaderFlags b)
		{
			return a._values != b._values;
		}

		public static implicit operator EncryptionHeaderFlags(uint values)
		{
			return new EncryptionHeaderFlags(values);
		}
	}

	internal static class Hmac
	{
		private static readonly byte[] hmacSaltBlockKey = new byte[8] { 95, 178, 173, 1, 12, 185, 225, 246 };

		private static readonly byte[] hmacValueBlockKey = new byte[8] { 160, 103, 127, 2, 178, 44, 132, 51 };

		public static HmacData GetHmac(ICipherProvider cipher, HashConfig hashInfo, Stream stream)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[hashInfo.HashBits / 8];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
			array = array.CloneToFit(CryptoUtilities.RoundUp(array.Length, cipher.BlockBytes), 0);
			HMAC hMAC = hashInfo.GetHMAC(array);
			hMAC.Initialize();
			stream.Position = 0L;
			byte[] array2 = hMAC.ComputeHash(stream);
			array2 = array2.CloneToFit(CryptoUtilities.RoundUp(array2.Length, cipher.BlockBytes), 0);
			ICryptoTransform encryptor = cipher.GetEncryptor(hmacSaltBlockKey);
			using (encryptor)
			{
				encryptor.TransformInPlace(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			encryptor = cipher.GetEncryptor(hmacValueBlockKey);
			using (encryptor)
			{
				encryptor.TransformInPlace(array2, 0, array2.Length);
			}
			HmacData hmacData = new HmacData();
			hmacData.EncryptedKey = array;
			hmacData.EncryptedValue = array2;
			return hmacData;
		}

		public static bool CheckStream(ICipherProvider cipher, HashConfig hashInfo, HmacData hmacInfo, Stream stream)
		{
			byte[] array = (byte[])hmacInfo.EncryptedKey.Clone();
			ICryptoTransform decryptor = cipher.GetDecryptor(hmacSaltBlockKey);
			using (decryptor)
			{
				decryptor.TransformInPlace(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			byte[] array2 = (byte[])hmacInfo.EncryptedValue.Clone();
			decryptor = cipher.GetDecryptor(hmacValueBlockKey);
			using (decryptor)
			{
				decryptor.TransformInPlace(array2, 0, array2.Length);
			}
			if (array.All((byte b) => b == 0) && array2.All((byte b) => b == 0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			byte[] array3 = new byte[hashInfo.HashBits / 8];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array3, 0, array3.Length);
			for (int num = array3.Length; num < array.Length; num++)
			{
				if (array[num] != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			HMAC hMAC = hashInfo.GetHMAC(array3);
			hMAC.Initialize();
			byte[] array4 = new byte[hashInfo.HashBits / 8];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array2, 0, array4, 0, array4.Length);
			for (int num2 = array2.Length; num2 < array2.Length; num2++)
			{
				if (array2[num2] != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			byte[] arr = hMAC.ComputeHash(stream);
			return arr.EqualBytes(array4);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform : InPlaceTransform
	{
		private const int RC4Alignment = 1024;

		private int _currentRC4Block = -1;

		private int _currentPositionInRC4Block = -1;

		private readonly uint _keyLength;

		private readonly HashAlgorithm _hashAlgorithm;

		private readonly byte[] _passwordUnicode;

		private readonly byte[] _salt;

		private readonly RC4 _rc4;

		public InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform(HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm, byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] salt, uint keyLength)
		{
			_hashAlgorithm = hashAlgorithm;
			_passwordUnicode = passwordUnicode;
			_salt = salt;
			_keyLength = keyLength;
			_rc4 = new RC4();
		}

		protected override void TransformCore(long streamPosition, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			while (count > 0)
			{
				int rc4Block = (int)(streamPosition / 1024);
				int num = (int)(streamPosition % 1024);
				VerifyPosition(rc4Block, num);
				int num2 = Math.Min(count, 1024 - num);
				_rc4.ConvertData(buffer, offset, num2);
				_currentPositionInRC4Block += num2;
				streamPosition += num2;
				offset += num2;
				count -= num2;
			}
		}

		public void Transform(byte[] data, uint block)
		{
			RC4 rC = new RC4();
			InitializeRC4(rC, _passwordUnicode, _salt, block, _hashAlgorithm, _keyLength);
			rC.ConvertData(data);
		}

		private void VerifyPosition(int rc4Block, int positionInRC4Block)
		{
			if (_currentRC4Block != rc4Block || _currentPositionInRC4Block != positionInRC4Block)
			{
				if (_currentRC4Block != rc4Block || _currentPositionInRC4Block > positionInRC4Block)
				{
					InitializeRC4(_rc4, _passwordUnicode, _salt, (uint)rc4Block, _hashAlgorithm, _keyLength);
					_currentRC4Block = rc4Block;
					_currentPositionInRC4Block = 0;
				}
				if (_currentPositionInRC4Block != positionInRC4Block)
				{
					_rc4.AdvanceState(positionInRC4Block - _currentPositionInRC4Block);
					_currentPositionInRC4Block = positionInRC4Block;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void InitializeRC4(RC4 rc4, byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] salt, uint block, HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm, uint keyLength)
		{
			rc4.InitializeState(HashPassword(passwordUnicode, salt, block, hashAlgorithm, keyLength));
		}

		private static byte[] HashPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] salt, uint block, HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm, uint keyLength)
		{
			hashAlgorithm.Initialize();
			hashAlgorithm.TransformBlock(salt, 0, salt.Length, null, 0);
			hashAlgorithm.TransformFinalBlock(passwordUnicode, 0, passwordUnicode.Length);
			byte[] hash = hashAlgorithm.Hash;
			hashAlgorithm.Initialize();

			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[keyLength / 8];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(hash2, 0, array2, 0, array2.Length);
			return array2;
		}

		public static InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform VerifyPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] salt, SymmetricAlgorithm encryptionAlgorithm, HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm, uint keyLength, byte[] encryptedVerifier, byte[] encryptedVerifierHash)

	internal sealed class InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform : InPlaceTransform
	{
		private const int RC4Alignment = 1024;

		private int _currentRC4Block = -1;

		private int _currentPositionInRC4Block = -1;

		private readonly byte[] _hashedPassword;

		private readonly RC4 _rc4;

		private InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform(byte[] hashedPassword)
		{
			_hashedPassword = hashedPassword;
			_rc4 = new RC4();
		}

		protected override void TransformCore(long streamPosition, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			while (count > 0)
			{
				int rc4Block = (int)(streamPosition / 1024);
				int num = (int)(streamPosition % 1024);
				VerifyPosition(rc4Block, num);
				int num2 = Math.Min(count, 1024 - num);
				_rc4.ConvertData(buffer, offset, num2);
				_currentPositionInRC4Block += num2;
				streamPosition += num2;
				offset += num2;
				count -= num2;
			}
		}

		public static InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform Create(byte[] passwordUnicode, out byte[] salt, out byte[] encryptedVerifier, out byte[] encryptedVerifierHash)
		{
			salt = new byte[16];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(salt);
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
			byte[] hashedPassword = HashPassword(passwordUnicode, salt);
			RC4 rC = new RC4();
			InitializeRC4(rC, hashedPassword, 0);
			byte[] array2 = MD5.Create().ComputeHash(array);
			rC.ConvertData(array);
			rC.ConvertData(array2);
			encryptedVerifier = array;
			encryptedVerifierHash = array2;
			return new InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform(hashedPassword);
		}

		public static InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform VerifyPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] salt, byte[] encryptedVerifier, byte[] encryptedVerifierHash)
		{
			byte[] hashedPassword = HashPassword(passwordUnicode, salt);
			RC4 rC = new RC4();
			InitializeRC4(rC, hashedPassword, 0);
			rC.ConvertData(encryptedVerifier);
			rC.ConvertData(encryptedVerifierHash);
			byte[] second = Utilities.ComputeMD5Hash(encryptedVerifier);
			if (!encryptedVerifierHash.SequenceEqual(second))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform(hashedPassword);
		}

		private static byte[] HashPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] salt)
		{
			byte[] src = Utilities.ComputeMD5Hash(passwordUnicode);
			byte[] array = new byte[5];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(src, 0, array, 0, 5);
			byte[] array2 = new byte[336];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
			{
				Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array2, num, array.Length);
				num += array.Length;
				Buffer.BlockCopy(salt, 0, array2, num, salt.Length);
				num += salt.Length;
			}
			return Utilities.ComputeMD5Hash(array2);
		}

		private void VerifyPosition(int rc4Block, int positionInRC4Block)
		{
			if (_currentRC4Block != rc4Block || _currentPositionInRC4Block != positionInRC4Block)
			{
				if (_currentRC4Block != rc4Block || _currentPositionInRC4Block > positionInRC4Block)
				{
					InitializeRC4(_rc4, _hashedPassword, rc4Block);
					_currentRC4Block = rc4Block;
					_currentPositionInRC4Block = 0;
				}
				if (_currentPositionInRC4Block != positionInRC4Block)
				{
					_rc4.AdvanceState(positionInRC4Block - _currentPositionInRC4Block);
					_currentPositionInRC4Block = positionInRC4Block;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void InitializeRC4(RC4 rc4, byte[] hashedPassword, int rc4Block)
		{
			MD5 mD = MD5.Create();
			mD.Initialize();
			mD.TransformBlock(hashedPassword, 0, 5, null, 0);
			mD.TransformFinalBlock(BitConverter.GetBytes(rc4Block), 0, 4);
			byte[] hash = mD.Hash;
			rc4.InitializeState(hash);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class InPlaceTransform
	{
		private sealed class NoTransformImpl : InPlaceTransform
		{
			protected override void TransformCore(long streamPosition, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
			{
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static InPlaceTransform _noTransform;

		private int _suspendEncryptionCount;

		public static InPlaceTransform NoTransform
		{
			get
			{
				if (_noTransform == null)
				{
					_noTransform = new NoTransformImpl();
				}
				return _noTransform;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEncryptionSuspended => _suspendEncryptionCount > 0;

		public virtual bool SupportsPostProcessingBlocks => false;

		public virtual void OnPostProcessComplete()
		{
		}

		public void PostProcessBlock(Stream stream, int blockLength)
		{
			if (!IsEncryptionSuspended)
			{
				PostProcessBlockCore(stream, blockLength);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PostProcessBlockCore(Stream stream, int blockLength)
		{
		}

		public void ResumeTransformations()
		{
			if (_suspendEncryptionCount != 0)
			{
				_suspendEncryptionCount--;
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetCurrentBlockLength(int blockLength)
		{
		}

		public void SuspendTransformations()
		{
			_suspendEncryptionCount++;
		}

		public void Transform(long streamPosition, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (!IsEncryptionSuspended)
			{
				TransformCore(streamPosition, buffer, offset, count);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void TransformCore(long streamPosition, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count);
	}

			{

		private static byte[] CreateXorArray(byte[] passwordAnsi)
		{

				num2--;
				num3--;

			}

		{
			ushort num = InitialCode[passwordAnsi.Length - 1];

					}

			}

		private static ushort CreateXorPasswordHash(byte[] passwordAnsi)
		{
			ushort num = 0;
			ushort num2 = (ushort)passwordAnsi.Length;
			for (int num3 = num2 - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{

				num ^= passwordAnsi[num3];
			}
			num = (ushort)(((num >> 14) & 1) | ((num << 1) & 0x7FFF));
			num ^= num2;
			return (ushort)(num ^ 0xCE4B);
		}

		{
			string s = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(passwordUnicode);
			return Utilities.EncodingDefault.GetBytes(s);
		}

		private static byte RotateLeft5Bits(byte b)
		{
			return (byte)(((b << 5) | (b >> 3)) & 0xFF);
		}

		private static byte RotateRight(int b)
		{
			return (byte)(((b >> 1) | (b << 7)) & 0xFF);
		}

		private static byte RotateRight5Bits(byte b)
		{
			return (byte)(((b << 3) | (b >> 5)) & 0xFF);
		}

		private static byte XorRor(byte b1, byte b2)
		{
			return RotateRight(b1 ^ b2);
		}

		}

		{
			passwordKeyEncryptor = new PasswordKeyEncryptor(config.PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig, data);

				CryptoVersion updaterVersion = CryptoVersion.Read(reader);
				CryptoVersion writerVersion = CryptoVersion.Read(reader);
				return new DataSpaceVersionsInfo(featureIdentifier, readerVersion, updaterVersion, writerVersion);
			}

			public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
			{
				CryptoUtilities.WriteUnicodeLpP4(FeatureIdentifier, writer);
				ReaderVersion.Write(writer);
				UpdaterVersion.Write(writer);
				WriterVersion.Write(writer);
			}
		}

		private class EncryptionTransformInfo
		{
			public readonly string EncryptionName;

			public readonly uint EncryptionBlockSize;

			public readonly uint CipherMode;

			public EncryptionTransformInfo(string encryptionName, uint encryptionBlockSize, uint cipherMode)
			{
				EncryptionName = encryptionName;
				EncryptionBlockSize = encryptionBlockSize;
				CipherMode = cipherMode;
			}

			public static EncryptionTransformInfo Read(BinaryReader reader, IRMDSTransformInfo transformInfo)
			{
				string text = CryptoUtilities.ReadUTF8LpP4(reader);
				uint encryptionBlockSize = 0u;
				uint cipherMode = 0u;
				if (text != null)
				{
					encryptionBlockSize = reader.ReadUInt32();
					cipherMode = reader.ReadUInt32();
				}
				uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
				return new EncryptionTransformInfo(text, encryptionBlockSize, cipherMode);
			}

			public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
			{
				CryptoUtilities.WriteUTF8LpP4(EncryptionName, writer);
				if (EncryptionName != null)
				{
					writer.Write(EncryptionBlockSize);
					writer.Write(CipherMode);
				}
				writer.Write(4u);
			}
		}

		private class ExtensibilityHeader
		{
			public readonly uint Length;

			public ExtensibilityHeader(uint length)
			{
				Length = length;
			}

			public static ExtensibilityHeader Read(BinaryReader reader)
			{
				uint length = reader.ReadUInt32();
				return new ExtensibilityHeader(length);
			}

			public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
			{
				writer.Write(Length);
			}
		}

		private class IRMDSTransformInfo
		{
			public readonly TransformInfoHeader TransformInfoHeader;

			public readonly ExtensibilityHeader ExtensibilityHeader;

			public readonly string XrMLLicenseS;

			public IRMDSTransformInfo(TransformInfoHeader transformInfoHeader, ExtensibilityHeader extensibilityHeader, string xrMLLicenseS)
			{
				TransformInfoHeader = transformInfoHeader;
				ExtensibilityHeader = extensibilityHeader;
				XrMLLicenseS = xrMLLicenseS;
			}

			public static IRMDSTransformInfo Read(BinaryReader reader, bool readExtensibilityHeader, bool readXrMLLicenseS)
			{
				TransformInfoHeader transformInfoHeader = TransformInfoHeader.Read(reader);
				ExtensibilityHeader extensibilityHeader = (readExtensibilityHeader ? ExtensibilityHeader.Read(reader) : null);
				string xrMLLicenseS = (readXrMLLicenseS ? CryptoUtilities.ReadUTF8LpP4(reader) : null);
				return new IRMDSTransformInfo(transformInfoHeader, extensibilityHeader, xrMLLicenseS);
			}

			public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
			{
				TransformInfoHeader.Write(writer);
				ExtensibilityHeader.Write(writer);
				CryptoUtilities.WriteUTF8LpP4(XrMLLicenseS, writer);
			}
		}

		private class TransformInfoHeader
		{
			public const uint TransformTypeValue = 1u;

			public readonly uint TransformType;

			public readonly string TransformId;

			public readonly string TransformName;

			public readonly CryptoVersion ReaderVersion;

			public readonly CryptoVersion UpdaterVersion;

			public readonly CryptoVersion WriterVersion;

			public TransformInfoHeader(uint transformType, string transformId, string transformName, CryptoVersion readerVersion, CryptoVersion updaterVersion, CryptoVersion writerVersion)
			{
				TransformType = transformType;
				TransformId = transformId;
				TransformName = transformName;
				ReaderVersion = readerVersion;
				UpdaterVersion = updaterVersion;
				WriterVersion = writerVersion;
			}

			public static TransformInfoHeader Read(BinaryReader reader)
			{
				uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
				uint transformType = reader.ReadUInt32();
				string transformId = CryptoUtilities.ReadUnicodeLpP4(reader);
				string transformName = CryptoUtilities.ReadUnicodeLpP4(reader);
				CryptoVersion readerVersion = CryptoVersion.Read(reader);
				CryptoVersion updaterVersion = CryptoVersion.Read(reader);
				CryptoVersion writerVersion = CryptoVersion.Read(reader);
				return new TransformInfoHeader(transformType, transformId, transformName, readerVersion, updaterVersion, writerVersion);
			}

			public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
			{
				long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
				writer.Write(0u);
				writer.Write(TransformType);
				CryptoUtilities.WriteUnicodeLpP4(TransformId, writer);
				long position2 = writer.BaseStream.Position;
				writer.BaseStream.Position = position;
				writer.Write((uint)(position2 - position));
				writer.BaseStream.Position = position2;
				CryptoUtilities.WriteUnicodeLpP4(TransformName, writer);
				ReaderVersion.Write(writer);
				UpdaterVersion.Write(writer);
				WriterVersion.Write(writer);
			}
		}

		public static WorkItem Encrypt(Stream stream, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode encryptionMode, byte[] passwordUnicode, Func<Stream, WorkItem> savePackageAction)
		{
			return encryptionMode switch
			{
				OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode.Agile => EncryptAgile(stream, passwordUnicode, savePackageAction), 
				OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode.Standard => EncryptStandard(stream, passwordUnicode, savePackageAction), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsEncrypted(StructuredStorageManager manager)
		{
			if (manager.GetFileStream("EncryptionInfo") != null)
			{
				return manager.GetFileStream("EncryptedPackage") != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static WorkItem<bool> TryDecrypt(Stream stream, Func<byte[]> getPasswordUnicode, Func<Stream, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode, WorkItem> loadPackageAction, Action throwInvalidPasswordException, Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException)
		{
			if (!StructuredStorageManager.IsStructuredStorageStream(stream))
			{
				return WorkItem.FromResult(result: false);
			}
			long originalPosition = stream.Position;
			return Async.Using(new StructuredStorageManager(stream, containsValidData: true), delegate(StructuredStorageManager manager)
			{
				using (Stream stream2 = manager.GetFileStream("\u0006DataSpaces\\Version"))
				{
					if (stream2 != null)
					{
						using BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(stream2);
						DataSpaceVersionsInfo.Read(reader);
					}
				}
				ReadDataSpaceFiles(manager, out var protectedContentPath, out var dataSpaceDefinition);
				if (protectedContentPath == null)
				{
					protectedContentPath = "EncryptedPackage";
				}
				return Async.Using(manager.GetFileStream("EncryptionInfo"), (Stream encryptionInfoStream) => (encryptionInfoStream != null) ? Async.Using(new BinaryReader(encryptionInfoStream), delegate(BinaryReader binaryReader)
				{
					CryptoVersion encryptionVersion = CryptoVersion.Read(binaryReader);
					byte[] array = getPasswordUnicode();
					if (array == null)
					{
						throwInvalidPasswordException();
					}
					EncryptionTransformInfo encryptionTransformInfo = ReadPrimary(manager, encryptionVersion, dataSpaceDefinition);
					if (encryptionVersion.IsStandard)
					{
						_ = encryptionVersion.VMajor;
						_ = 3;
						return TryDecryptStandard(array, manager, binaryReader, protectedContentPath, loadPackageAction, throwInvalidPasswordException, throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException);
					}
					if (encryptionVersion.IsExtensible)
					{
						throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException();
						return (WorkItem<bool>)null;
					}
					if (encryptionVersion.IsAgile)
					{
						return TryDecryptAgile(array, manager, encryptionInfoStream, protectedContentPath, loadPackageAction, throwInvalidPasswordException, throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException);
					}
					throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException();
					return (WorkItem<bool>)null;
				}) : null);
			}).Then(delegate(WorkItem<bool> t)
			{
				if (t.GetResult())
				{
					return true;
				}
				stream.Position = originalPosition;
				return false;
			});
		}

		private static WorkItem EncryptAgile(Stream stream, byte[] passwordUnicode, Func<Stream, WorkItem> savePackageAction)
		{
			CipherConfig cipherConfig = new CipherConfig
			{
				BlockBits = 128,
				KeyBits = 128,
				Mode = "ChainingModeCBC",
				Name = "AES"
			};
			HashConfig hashConfig = new HashConfig
			{
				HashBits = 160,
				Name = "SHA1"
			};
			int saltSize = 16;
			int spinCount = 100000;
			AgileEncryptionSession session = new AgileEncryptionSession(new AgileEncryptionConfig
			{
				CipherConfig = cipherConfig,
				HashConfig = hashConfig,
				PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig = new PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig
				{
					CipherConfig = cipherConfig,
					HashConfig = hashConfig,
					SaltSize = saltSize,
					SpinCount = spinCount
				},
				SaltSize = saltSize
			});
			session.SetPassword(passwordUnicode);
			return Async.Using(new StructuredStorageManager(stream, containsValidData: false), delegate(StructuredStorageManager manager)
			{
				WriteDataSpaceFiles(manager);
				return Async.Using(manager.AddFile("EncryptedPackage"), (Stream encryptedPackage) => Async.Using(new MemoryStream(), (MemoryStream ms) => Async.Using(session.GetEncryptedStream(ms), savePackageAction).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					ms.Position = 0L;
					ms.CopyTo(encryptedPackage);
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default)).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					session.AddIntegrityCheck(encryptedPackage);
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default)).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					using Stream stream2 = manager.AddFile("EncryptionInfo");
					CryptoVersion.Agile.Write(stream2);
					session.WriteToStream(stream2);
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
			});
		}

		private static WorkItem EncryptStandard(Stream stream, byte[] passwordUnicode, Func<Stream, WorkItem> savePackageAction)
		{
			return Async.Using(new StructuredStorageManager(stream, containsValidData: false), delegate(StructuredStorageManager manager)
			{
				WriteDataSpaceFiles(manager);
				StandardEncryptionSession session = StandardEncryptionSession.Create(passwordUnicode);
				return Async.Using(manager.AddFile("EncryptedPackage"), (Stream encryptedPackage) => Async.Using(new MemoryStream(), (MemoryStream ms) => savePackageAction(ms).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					long length = ms.Length;
					ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = session.CreateEncryptor();
					while (ms.Length % cryptoTransform.InputBlockSize != 0L)
					{
						ms.WriteByte(0);
					}
					byte[] buffer = ms.GetBuffer();
					cryptoTransform.TransformInPlace(buffer, 0, (int)ms.Length);
					byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes((ulong)length);
					encryptedPackage.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
					encryptedPackage.Write(buffer, 0, (int)ms.Length);
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default))).Then((Action)delegate
				{
					using Stream output = manager.AddFile("EncryptionInfo");
					using BinaryWriter writer = new BinaryWriter(output);
					CryptoVersion.Standard.Write(writer);
					session.WriteToStream(writer);
				}, WorkItemContinuationType.Default);
			});
		}

			{
				DataSpaceMapEntry dataSpaceMapEntry = dataSpaceMap.MapEntries[0];
				protectedContentPath = dataSpaceMapEntry.GetProtectedContentPath();
				dataSpaceDefinition = ReadDataSpaceStream(manager, dataSpaceMapEntry.DataSpaceFullName);
			}
		}

			}
