		private static EncryptionTransformInfo ReadPrimary(StructuredStorageManager manager, CryptoVersion encryptionVersion, DataSpaceDefinition dataSpaceDefinition)
		{
			if (dataSpaceDefinition == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dataSpaceDefinition.TransformReferences.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string transformReferenceFullPath = GetTransformReferenceFullPath(dataSpaceDefinition.TransformReferences[0]);
			using Stream stream = manager.GetFileStream(transformReferenceFullPath);
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(stream);
			EncryptionTransformInfo result = null;
			if (encryptionVersion.VMajor == 3)
			{
				try
				{
					result = ReadPrimayHelper(reader, readExtensibilityHeader: false, readXrMLLicenseS: false);
					if (stream.Position == stream.Length)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				try
				{
					result = ReadPrimayHelper(reader, readExtensibilityHeader: true, readXrMLLicenseS: true);
					if (stream.Position == stream.Length)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					result = ReadPrimayHelper(reader, readExtensibilityHeader: true, readXrMLLicenseS: true);
					if (stream.Position == stream.Length)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				try
				{
					result = ReadPrimayHelper(reader, readExtensibilityHeader: false, readXrMLLicenseS: false);
					if (stream.Position == stream.Length)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			try
			{
				result = ReadPrimayHelper(reader, readExtensibilityHeader: true, readXrMLLicenseS: false);
				if (stream.Position == stream.Length)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			try
			{
				result = ReadPrimayHelper(reader, readExtensibilityHeader: false, readXrMLLicenseS: true);
				if (stream.Position == stream.Length)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static EncryptionTransformInfo ReadPrimayHelper(BinaryReader reader, bool readExtensibilityHeader, bool readXrMLLicenseS)
		{
			IRMDSTransformInfo transformInfo = IRMDSTransformInfo.Read(reader, readExtensibilityHeader, readXrMLLicenseS);
			return EncryptionTransformInfo.Read(reader, transformInfo);
		}

		private static WorkItem<bool> TryDecryptAgile(byte[] passwordUnicode, StructuredStorageManager manager, Stream encryptionInfoStream, string protectedContentPath, Func<Stream, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode, WorkItem> loadPackageAction, Action throwInvalidPasswordException, Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException)
		{
			AgileEncryptionSession session = null;
			return Async.Try<DocumentEncryptedException, InvalidOperationException>(delegate
			{
				session = AgileEncryptionSession.LoadFromStream(encryptionInfoStream);
				if (!session.UnlockWithPassword(passwordUnicode))
				{
					throwInvalidPasswordException();
				}
				return (WorkItem)null;
			}, delegate(DocumentEncryptedException e)
			{
				throw e;
			}, delegate
			{
				throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException();
			}).Then(() => Async.Using(manager.GetFileStream(protectedContentPath), delegate(Stream protectedContentStream)
			{
				if (protectedContentStream == null)
				{
					return WorkItem.FromResult(result: false);
				}
				return (!session.DoIntegrityCheck(protectedContentStream)) ? WorkItem.FromResult(result: false) : loadPackageAction(session.GetEncryptedStream(protectedContentStream), OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode.Agile).Then(() => true);
			}));
		}

		private static WorkItem<bool> TryDecryptStandard(byte[] passwordUnicode, StructuredStorageManager manager, BinaryReader encryptionInfoStreamReader, string protectedContentPath, Func<Stream, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode, WorkItem> loadPackageAction, Action throwInvalidPasswordException, Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException)
		{
			StandardEncryptionSession session = StandardEncryptionSession.LoadFromStream(encryptionInfoStreamReader);
			if (!session.UnlockWithPassword(passwordUnicode, throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException))
			{
				throwInvalidPasswordException();
			}
			return Async.Using(manager.GetFileStream(protectedContentPath), delegate(Stream protectedContentStream)
			{
				if (protectedContentStream == null)
				{
					WorkItem.FromResult(result: false);
				}
				return Async.Using(new BinaryReader(protectedContentStream), delegate(BinaryReader r)
				{
					ulong num = r.ReadUInt64();
					byte[] array = new byte[(uint)num];
					byte[] array2 = r.ReadBytes((int)(protectedContentStream.Length - protectedContentStream.Position));
					ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = session.CreateDecryptor();
					cryptoTransform.TransformBlock(array2, 0, array2.Length, array2, 0);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(array2, 0, array, 0, array.Length);
					return Async.Using(new MemoryStream(array), (MemoryStream m) => loadPackageAction(m, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode.Standard).Then(() => true));
				});
			});
		}

		private static void WriteDataSpaceFiles(StructuredStorageManager manager)
		{
			DataSpaceVersionsInfo dataSpaceVersionsInfo = new DataSpaceVersionsInfo("Microsoft.Container.DataSpaces", CryptoVersion.Version1_0, CryptoVersion.Version1_0, CryptoVersion.Version1_0);
			DataSpaceMapEntry dataSpaceMapEntry = new DataSpaceMapEntry("StrongEncryptionDataSpace", new DataSpaceReferenceComponent("EncryptedPackage", DataSpaceReferenceComponentType.Stream));
			DataSpaceMap dataSpaceMap = new DataSpaceMap(dataSpaceMapEntry);
			DataSpaceDefinition dataSpaceDefinition = new DataSpaceDefinition("StrongEncryptionTransform");
			IRMDSTransformInfo iRMDSTransformInfo = new IRMDSTransformInfo(new TransformInfoHeader(1u, "{FF9A3F03-56EF-4613-BDD5-5A41C1D07246}", "Microsoft.Container.EncryptionTransform", CryptoVersion.Version1_0, CryptoVersion.Version1_0, CryptoVersion.Version1_0), new ExtensibilityHeader(0u), null);
			EncryptionTransformInfo encryptionTransformInfo = new EncryptionTransformInfo(null, 0u, 0u);
			using (Stream output = manager.AddFile("\u0006DataSpaces\\Version"))
			{
				using BinaryWriter writer = new BinaryWriter(output);
				dataSpaceVersionsInfo.Write(writer);
			}
			using (Stream output2 = manager.AddFile("\u0006DataSpaces\\DataSpaceMap"))
			{
				using BinaryWriter writer2 = new BinaryWriter(output2);
				dataSpaceMap.Write(writer2);
			}
			using (Stream output3 = manager.AddFile(dataSpaceMapEntry.DataSpaceFullName))
			{
				using BinaryWriter writer3 = new BinaryWriter(output3);
				dataSpaceDefinition.Write(writer3);
			}
			string transformReferenceFullPath = GetTransformReferenceFullPath(dataSpaceDefinition.TransformReferences[0]);
			using Stream output4 = manager.AddFile(transformReferenceFullPath);
			using BinaryWriter writer4 = new BinaryWriter(output4);
			iRMDSTransformInfo.Write(writer4);
			encryptionTransformInfo.Write(writer4);
		}

	internal class PasswordBasedKey : ICipherProvider
	{
		private HashConfig hashInfo;

		private CipherConfig cipherInfo;

		private int spinCount;

		private byte[] saltValue;

		private byte[] passwordHash;

		public byte[] SaltValue => (byte[])saltValue.Clone();

		public int BlockBytes => cipherInfo.BlockBits / 8;

		public int SpinCount => spinCount;

		public PasswordBasedKey(PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config)
		{
			cipherInfo = config.CipherConfig.Copy();
			hashInfo = config.HashConfig.Copy();
			spinCount = config.SpinCount;
			saltValue = new byte[config.SaltSize];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(saltValue);
		}

		public PasswordBasedKey(PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config, PasswordKeyEncryptorData data)
		{
			cipherInfo = config.CipherConfig.Copy();
			hashInfo = config.HashConfig.Copy();
			spinCount = config.SpinCount;
			saltValue = (byte[])data.SaltValue.Clone();
		}

		public HashAlgorithm GetHashAlg()
		{
			return hashInfo.GetAlg();
		}

		public void SetPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode)
		{
			HashAlgorithm alg = hashInfo.GetAlg();
			using (alg)
			{
				alg.TransformBlock(saltValue, 0, saltValue.Length, null, 0);
				alg.TransformFinalBlock(passwordUnicode, 0, passwordUnicode.Length);
				byte[] hash = alg.Hash;
				for (int i = 0; i < spinCount; i++)
				{
					byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(i);
					alg.Initialize();
					alg.TransformBlock(bytes, 0, bytes.Length, null, 0);
					alg.TransformFinalBlock(hash, 0, hash.Length);
					hash = alg.Hash;
				}
				passwordHash = hash;
			}
		}

		public ICryptoTransform GetCryptoTransform(byte[] blockKey, bool isEncryption)
		{
			HashAlgorithm alg = hashInfo.GetAlg();
			using (alg)
			{
				alg.TransformBlock(passwordHash, 0, passwordHash.Length, null, 0);
				alg.TransformFinalBlock(blockKey, 0, blockKey.Length);
				byte[] rgbKey = alg.Hash.CloneToFit(cipherInfo.KeyBits / 8);
				byte[] rgbIV = SaltValue.CloneToFit(cipherInfo.BlockBits / 8);
				SymmetricAlgorithm alg2 = cipherInfo.GetAlg();
				using (alg2)
				{
					ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = null;
					if (isEncryption)
					{
						return alg2.CreateEncryptor(rgbKey, rgbIV);
					}
					return alg2.CreateDecryptor(rgbKey, rgbIV);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Save(PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config, PasswordKeyEncryptorData data)
		{
			config.CipherConfig = cipherInfo.Copy();
			config.HashConfig = hashInfo.Copy();
			config.SaltSize = saltValue.Length;
			config.SpinCount = spinCount;
			data.SaltValue = (byte[])SaltValue.Clone();
		}
	}
	internal class PasswordKeyEncryptor
	{
		private static readonly byte[] hashInputBlockKey = new byte[8] { 254, 167, 210, 118, 59, 75, 158, 121 };

		private static readonly byte[] hashValueBlockKey = new byte[8] { 215, 170, 15, 109, 48, 97, 52, 78 };

		private static readonly byte[] secretKeyBlockKey = new byte[8] { 20, 110, 11, 231, 171, 172, 208, 214 };

		private byte[] encryptedHashInput;

		private byte[] encryptedHashValue;

		private byte[] encryptedSecretKey;

		private PasswordBasedKey passwordEncryptor;

		internal byte[] EncryptedHashInput => encryptedHashInput;

		internal byte[] EncryptedHashValue => encryptedHashValue;

		internal byte[] EncryptedSecretKey => encryptedSecretKey;

		internal PasswordBasedKey PasswordEncryptor => passwordEncryptor;

		public PasswordKeyEncryptor(PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config)
		{
			passwordEncryptor = new PasswordBasedKey(config);
		}

		public PasswordKeyEncryptor(PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config, PasswordKeyEncryptorData data)
		{
			passwordEncryptor = new PasswordBasedKey(config, data);
			encryptedHashInput = (byte[])data.EncryptedHashInput.Clone();
			encryptedHashValue = (byte[])data.EncryptedHashValue.Clone();
			encryptedSecretKey = (byte[])data.EncryptedKeyValue.Clone();
		}

		public static byte[] CreateEncryptedHashInput(PasswordBasedKey passwordEncryptor, byte[] passwordUnicode)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[CryptoUtilities.RoundUp(passwordEncryptor.SaltValue.Length, passwordEncryptor.BlockBytes)];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
			ICryptoTransform encryptor = passwordEncryptor.GetEncryptor(hashValueBlockKey);
			using (encryptor)
			{
				encryptor.TransformInPlace(array, 0, array.Length);
				return array;
			}
		}

		public static byte[] CreateVerifier(PasswordBasedKey passwordEncryptor, byte[] encryptedHashInput)
		{
			byte[] array = (byte[])encryptedHashInput.Clone();
			ICryptoTransform decryptor = passwordEncryptor.GetDecryptor(hashInputBlockKey);
			using (decryptor)
			{
				decryptor.TransformInPlace(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			HashAlgorithm hashAlg = passwordEncryptor.GetHashAlg();
			byte[] array2;
			using (hashAlg)
			{
				int num = hashAlg.HashSize / 8;
				array2 = new byte[CryptoUtilities.RoundUp(num, passwordEncryptor.BlockBytes)];
				hashAlg.TransformFinalBlock(array, 0, array.Length);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(hashAlg.Hash, 0, array2, 0, num);
			}
			ICryptoTransform encryptor = passwordEncryptor.GetEncryptor(hashValueBlockKey);
			using (encryptor)
			{
				encryptor.TransformInPlace(array2, 0, array2.Length);
				return array2;
			}
		}

		public void SetPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode, byte[] secretKey)
		{
			passwordEncryptor.SetPassword(passwordUnicode);
			encryptedHashInput = CreateEncryptedHashInput(passwordEncryptor, passwordUnicode);
			encryptedHashValue = CreateVerifier(passwordEncryptor, encryptedHashInput);
			byte[] array = (byte[])secretKey.Clone();
			ICryptoTransform encryptor = passwordEncryptor.GetEncryptor(secretKeyBlockKey);
			using (encryptor)
			{
				encryptor.TransformInPlace(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			encryptedSecretKey = array;
		}

		public bool TryUnlock(byte[] passwordUnicode, out byte[] secretKey)
		{
			secretKey = null;
			if (encryptedHashInput == null || encryptedHashValue == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("No encrypted verifier");
			}
			if (encryptedSecretKey == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("No encrypted secret to unlock");
			}
			passwordEncryptor.SetPassword(passwordUnicode);
			byte[] arr = CreateVerifier(passwordEncryptor, encryptedHashInput);
			if (!arr.EqualBytes(encryptedHashValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			byte[] array = (byte[])encryptedSecretKey.Clone();
			ICryptoTransform decryptor = passwordEncryptor.GetDecryptor(secretKeyBlockKey);
			using (decryptor)
			{
				decryptor.TransformInPlace(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			secretKey = array;
			return true;
		}

		internal void Save(PasswordKeyEncryptorConfig config, PasswordKeyEncryptorData data)
		{
			passwordEncryptor.Save(config, data);
			data.EncryptedHashInput = (byte[])encryptedHashInput.Clone();
			data.EncryptedHashValue = (byte[])encryptedHashValue.Clone();
			data.EncryptedKeyValue = (byte[])encryptedSecretKey.Clone();
		}
	}
	internal class PrimaryCipher : ICipherProvider
	{
		private HashConfig hashInfo;

		private SymmetricAlgorithm cipherAlg;

		private byte[] secretKey;

		private byte[] saltValue;

		public byte[] SaltValue => (byte[])saltValue.Clone();

		public byte[] SecretKey => (byte[])secretKey.Clone();

		public int BlockBytes => cipherAlg.BlockSize / 8;

		public PrimaryCipher(HashConfig hashInfo, CipherConfig cipherInfo, byte[] saltValue, byte[] secretKey)
		{
			this.hashInfo = hashInfo;
			cipherAlg = cipherInfo.GetAlg();
			this.secretKey = (byte[])secretKey.Clone();
			this.saltValue = (byte[])saltValue.Clone();
		}

		public HashAlgorithm GetHashAlg()
		{
			return hashInfo.GetAlg();
		}

		public ICryptoTransform GetCryptoTransform(byte[] blockKey, bool isEncryption)
		{
			HashAlgorithm hashAlg = GetHashAlg();
			hashAlg.TransformBlock(saltValue, 0, saltValue.Length, null, 0);
			hashAlg.TransformFinalBlock(blockKey, 0, blockKey.Length);
			byte[] rgbIV = hashAlg.Hash.CloneToFit(BlockBytes);
			if (isEncryption)
			{
				return cipherAlg.CreateEncryptor(secretKey, rgbIV);
			}
			return cipherAlg.CreateDecryptor(secretKey, rgbIV);
		}
	}

			{
				HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm = CryptoUtilities.CreateHashAlgorithm(algorithmName);
				if (saltValue != null)
				{
					hashAlgorithm.TransformBlock(saltValue, 0, saltValue.Length, null, 0);
				}
				hashAlgorithm.TransformFinalBlock(passwordUnicode, 0, passwordUnicode.Length);
				byte[] hash = hashAlgorithm.Hash;

					hashAlgorithm.TransformBlock(array, 0, array.Length, null, 0);
					hashAlgorithm.TransformFinalBlock(BitConverter.GetBytes(i), 0, 4);
					array = hashAlgorithm.Hash;
				}
				return array;
			}

	internal class RC4
	{
		private const int StateSize = 256;

		private int _pointerI;

		private int _pointerJ;

		private byte[] _state = new byte[256];

		public void AdvanceState(int stepCount = 1)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < stepCount; i++)
			{
				_pointerI = (_pointerI + 1) % 256;
				_pointerJ = (_state[_pointerI] + _pointerJ) % 256;
				Swap(_state, _pointerI, _pointerJ);
			}
		}

		public void ConvertData(byte[] buffer)
		{
			ConvertData(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
		}

		public void ConvertData(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			int num = offset + count;
			for (int i = offset; i < num; i++)
			{
				AdvanceState();
				int num2 = (_state[_pointerI] + _state[_pointerJ]) % 256;
				buffer[i] ^= _state[num2];
			}
		}

		public void InitializeState(byte[] keyData)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
			{
				_state[i] = (byte)i;
			}
			_pointerI = 0;
			_pointerJ = 0;
			int num = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < 256; j++)
			{
				num = (num + keyData[j % keyData.Length] + _state[j]) % 256;
				Swap(_state, j, num);
			}
		}

		private static void Swap(byte[] b1, int offset1, int offset2)
		{
			byte b2 = b1[offset2];
			b1[offset2] = b1[offset1];
			b1[offset1] = b2;
		}
	}
	internal class RC4Algorithm : SymmetricAlgorithm
	{
		public RC4Algorithm()
		{
			LegalKeySizesValue = new KeySizes[1]
			{
				new KeySizes(40, 128, 8)
			};
		}

		public override ICryptoTransform CreateDecryptor(byte[] rgbKey, byte[] rgbIV)
		{
			RC4Transform rC4Transform = new RC4Transform();
			rC4Transform.InitializeState(rgbKey);
			return rC4Transform;
		}

		public override ICryptoTransform CreateEncryptor(byte[] rgbKey, byte[] rgbIV)
		{
			RC4Transform rC4Transform = new RC4Transform();
			rC4Transform.InitializeState(rgbKey);
			return rC4Transform;
		}

		public override void GenerateKey()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[KeySize / 8];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
			Key = array;
		}

		public override void GenerateIV()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[BlockSize / 8];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
			IV = array;
		}
	}
	internal class RC4Transform : RC4, ICryptoTransform, IDisposable
	{
		private MemoryStream _current = new MemoryStream();

		public bool CanReuseTransform => true;

		public bool CanTransformMultipleBlocks => true;

		public int InputBlockSize => 1;

		public int OutputBlockSize => 1;

		public int TransformBlock(byte[] inputBuffer, int inputOffset, int inputCount, byte[] outputBuffer, int outputOffset)
		{
			if (outputBuffer == null)
			{
				outputOffset = (int)_current.Position;
				_current.SetLength(_current.Position + inputCount);
				outputBuffer = _current.GetBuffer();
			}
			Buffer.BlockCopy(inputBuffer, inputOffset, outputBuffer, outputOffset, inputCount);
			ConvertData(outputBuffer, outputOffset, inputCount);
			return inputCount;
		}

		public byte[] TransformFinalBlock(byte[] inputBuffer, int inputOffset, int inputCount)
		{
			TransformBlock(inputBuffer, inputOffset, inputCount, null, 0);
			byte[] result = _current.ToArray();
			_current.Position = 0L;
			_current.SetLength(0L);
			return result;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_current.Dispose();
		}
	}
	internal class StandardEncryptionSession
	{
		private const int StandardEncryptionSpinCount = 50000;

		private SymmetricAlgorithm _encryptionAlgorithm;

		private readonly EncryptionHeader _encryptionHeader;

		private EncryptionVerifier _encryptionVerifier;

		private StandardEncryptionSession(EncryptionHeader encryptionHeader, EncryptionVerifier encryptionVerifier)
		{
			_encryptionHeader = encryptionHeader;
			_encryptionVerifier = encryptionVerifier;
		}

		public static StandardEncryptionSession Create(byte[] passwordUnicode)
		{
			EncryptionHeader encryptionHeader = default(EncryptionHeader);
			encryptionHeader.Flags = new EncryptionHeaderFlags
			{
				fCryptoAPI = true,
				fAES = true
			};
			encryptionHeader.SizeExtra = 0u;
			encryptionHeader.AlgId = 26126;
			encryptionHeader.AlgIdHash = 32772;
			encryptionHeader.KeySize = 128u;
			encryptionHeader.ProviderType = 24u;
			encryptionHeader.CSPName = "Microsoft Enhanced RSA and AES Cryptographic Provider";
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array);
			SHA1 sHA = CryptoUtilities.CreateSHA1();
			StandardEncryptionSession standardEncryptionSession = new StandardEncryptionSession(encryptionHeader, new EncryptionVerifier(array, (uint)(sHA.HashSize / 8)));
			byte[] array2 = new byte[16];
			new RNGCryptoServiceProvider().GetBytes(array2);
			byte[] array3 = sHA.ComputeHash(array2);
			byte[] array4 = new byte[32];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array3, 0, array4, 0, array3.Length);
			byte[] derivedKey = standardEncryptionSession.GetDerivedKey(passwordUnicode, 0);
			standardEncryptionSession.InitializeEncryptionAlgorithm(derivedKey);
			ICryptoTransform transform = standardEncryptionSession.CreateEncryptor();
			transform.TransformInPlace(array2, 0, array2.Length);
			transform.TransformInPlace(array4, 0, array4.Length);
			standardEncryptionSession._encryptionVerifier.EncryptedVerifier = array2;
			standardEncryptionSession._encryptionVerifier.EncryptedVerifierHash = array4;
			return standardEncryptionSession;
		}

		public static StandardEncryptionSession LoadFromStream(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
			uint num2 = reader.ReadUInt32();
			EncryptionHeader encryptionHeader = EncryptionHeader.Read(reader);
			EncryptionVerifier encryptionVerifier = EncryptionVerifier.Read(reader, 32);
			return new StandardEncryptionSession(encryptionHeader, encryptionVerifier);
		}

		public void WriteToStream(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_encryptionHeader.Flags.ValuesRaw);
			writer.Write(140u);
			_encryptionHeader.Write(writer);
			_encryptionVerifier.Write(writer);
		}

		public bool UnlockWithPassword(byte[] passwordUnicode, Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException)
		{
			byte[] derivedKey = GetDerivedKey(passwordUnicode, 0, throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException);
			InitializeEncryptionAlgorithm(derivedKey, throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException);
			ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = CreateDecryptor();
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			int num = cryptoTransform.TransformBlock(_encryptionVerifier.EncryptedVerifier, 0, _encryptionVerifier.EncryptedVerifier.Length, array, 0);
			byte[] array2 = new byte[32];
			int num2 = cryptoTransform.TransformBlock(_encryptionVerifier.EncryptedVerifierHash, 0, _encryptionVerifier.EncryptedVerifierHash.Length, array2, 0);
			byte[] array3 = CryptoUtilities.CreateSHA1().ComputeHash(array);
			return array3.SequenceEqual(array2.Take(array3.Length));
		}

		public ICryptoTransform CreateDecryptor()
		{
			return _encryptionAlgorithm.CreateDecryptor();
		}

		public ICryptoTransform CreateEncryptor()
		{
			return _encryptionAlgorithm.CreateEncryptor();
		}

		private void InitializeEncryptionAlgorithm(byte[] keyDerived, Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException = null)
		{
			_encryptionAlgorithm = _encryptionHeader.CreateEncryptionAlgorithm(throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException);
			_encryptionAlgorithm.Key = keyDerived;
			_encryptionAlgorithm.Mode = CipherMode.ECB;
			_encryptionAlgorithm.Padding = PaddingMode.None;
		}

		private byte[] GetDerivedKey(byte[] passwordUnicode, int block, Action throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException = null)
		{
			block = 0;
			HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm = _encryptionHeader.CreateHashAlgorithm(throwEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException);
			hashAlgorithm.TransformBlock(_encryptionVerifier.Salt, 0, _encryptionVerifier.Salt.Length, null, 0);
			hashAlgorithm.TransformFinalBlock(passwordUnicode, 0, passwordUnicode.Length);
			byte[] hash = hashAlgorithm.Hash;
			byte[] array = hash;
			for (int i = 0; i < 50000; i++)
			{
				hashAlgorithm.Initialize();
				hashAlgorithm.TransformBlock(BitConverter.GetBytes(i), 0, 4, null, 0);
				hashAlgorithm.TransformFinalBlock(array, 0, array.Length);
				array = hashAlgorithm.Hash;
			}
			hashAlgorithm.Initialize();
			hashAlgorithm.TransformBlock(array, 0, array.Length, null, 0);
			hashAlgorithm.TransformFinalBlock(BitConverter.GetBytes(block), 0, 4);
			byte[] hash2 = hashAlgorithm.Hash;
			uint num = _encryptionHeader.KeySize / 8;
			int num2 = hashAlgorithm.HashSize / 8;
			byte[] array2 = new byte[64];
			array2.SetAll((byte)54);
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				array2[j] ^= hash2[j];
			}
			hashAlgorithm.Initialize();
			byte[] array3 = hashAlgorithm.ComputeHash(array2);
			array2.SetAll((byte)92);
			for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
			{
				array2[k] ^= hash2[k];
			}
			hashAlgorithm.Initialize();
			byte[] array4 = hashAlgorithm.ComputeHash(array2);
			byte[] array5 = new byte[num];
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			while (num3 < num && num4 < array3.Length)
			{
				array5[num3] = array3[num4];
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
			int num5 = 0;
			while (num3 < num && num5 < array4.Length)
			{
				array5[num3] = array4[num5];
				num3++;
				num5++;
			}
			return array5;
		}
	}

	internal class ANPlusBExpression
	{
		public const string DashNDashTextLower = "-n-";

		public const string DashNTextLower = "-n";

		public const string NDashTextLower = "n-";

		public const string EvenTextLower = "even";

		public const string NTextLower = "n";

		public const string OddTextLower = "odd";

		public static readonly ANPlusBExpression Even = new ANPlusBExpression(2, 0);

		public static readonly ANPlusBExpression Odd = new ANPlusBExpression(2, 1);

		public int? A { get; private set; }

		public int? B { get; private set; }

		public ANPlusBExpression(int? a, int? b)
		{
			A = a;
			B = b;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ANPlusBExpression aNPlusBExpression && A == aNPlusBExpression.A)
			{
				return B == aNPlusBExpression.B;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (A ?? 0) ^ ((B ?? 0) << 16);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (this == Even)
			{
				return "even";
			}
			if (this == Odd)
			{
				return "odd";
			}
			if (A.HasValue)
			{
				if (B.HasValue)
				{
					return string.Format("{0}n{1}{2}", A.Value, (0 <= B.Value) ? "+" : "", B.Value);
				}
				return A.Value + "n";
			}
			if (B.HasValue)
			{
				return B.Value.ToString();
			}
			return "0";
		}
	}
	internal class CSSStyleSheet : StyleSheet, IRuleOwner
	{
		private string _defaultNamespace;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _namespaces;

		public StyleSheetList ImportedStyleSheets { get; private set; }

		public Rule OwnerRule { get; set; }

		public RuleList Rules { get; private set; }

		public HtmlNode Scope { get; set; }

		public CSSStyleSheet()
		{
			_namespaces = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			Rules = new RuleList(this);
			ImportedStyleSheets = new StyleSheetList();
		}

		void IRuleOwner.OnRuleAdded(IRuleOwner sender, Rule rule)
		{
			if (this == sender && rule is NamespaceRule namespaceRule)
			{
				AddNamespace(namespaceRule.Prefix, namespaceRule.NamespaceUri);
			}
		}

		void IRuleOwner.OnRuleRemove(IRuleOwner sender, Rule rule)
		{
			if (this == sender && rule is NamespaceRule namespaceRule)
			{
				RemoveNamespace(namespaceRule.Prefix);
			}
		}

		private void AddNamespace(string prefix, string namespaceUri)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
			{
				_defaultNamespace = namespaceUri;
			}
			else
			{
				_namespaces[prefix] = namespaceUri;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveNamespace(string prefix)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
			{
				_defaultNamespace = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_namespaces.Remove(prefix);
			}
		}

		public string GetNamespace(string prefix)
		{
			if (prefix == null)
			{
				return _defaultNamespace ?? "*";
			}
			if (prefix == "*")
			{
				return "*";
			}
			if (prefix == string.Empty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (_namespaces.TryGetValue(prefix, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsEquivalentTo(CSSStyleSheet other)
		{
			if (Rules.Count == other.Rules.Count)
			{
				return Rules.Zip(other.Rules, (Rule a, Rule b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Serialize(SerializationContext context)
		{
			SerializationRuleVisitor visitor = new SerializationRuleVisitor(context);
			foreach (Rule rule in Rules)
			{
				rule.Accept(visitor);
				context.Writer.WriteLine();
			}
		}
	}

			private void Register(string name, Color color)
			{
				_nameToColorMappings[name] = color;
				_colorToNameMappings[color] = name;
			}

			public bool TryGetColorFromName(string colorName, out Color color)
			{
				if (_nameToColorMappings.TryGetValue(colorName, out color))
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (colorName.ToLowerInvariant())
				{
				case "activeborder":
					color = SystemColors.ActiveBorderColor;
					return true;
				case "activecaption":
					color = SystemColors.ActiveCaptionColor;
					return true;
				case "appworkspace":
					color = SystemColors.AppWorkspaceColor;
					return true;
				case "graytext":
					color = SystemColors.GrayTextColor;
					return true;
				case "highlight":
					color = SystemColors.HighlightColor;
					return true;
				case "highlighttext":
					color = SystemColors.HighlightTextColor;
					return true;
				case "inactiveborder":
					color = SystemColors.InactiveBorderColor;
					return true;
				case "inactivecaption":
					color = SystemColors.InactiveCaptionColor;
					return true;
				case "inactivecaptiontext":
					color = SystemColors.InactiveCaptionTextColor;
					return true;
				case "infotext":
					color = SystemColors.InfoTextColor;
					return true;
				case "menu":
					color = SystemColors.MenuColor;
					return true;
				case "menutext":
					color = SystemColors.MenuTextColor;
					return true;
				case "window":
					color = SystemColors.WindowColor;
					return true;
				case "windowframe":
					color = SystemColors.WindowFrameColor;
					return true;
				case "windowtext":
					color = SystemColors.WindowTextColor;
					return true;
				default:
					color = default(Color);
					return false;
				}
			}

			public bool TryGetNameFromColor(Color color, out string colorName)
			{
				return _colorToNameMappings.TryGetValue(color, out colorName);
			}
		}

		public static bool AreSegmentBreaksCollapsible(this CSSWhiteSpace style)
		{
			switch (style)
			{
			case CSSWhiteSpace.Pre:
			case CSSWhiteSpace.PreWrap:
			case CSSWhiteSpace.PreLine:
				return false;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static string CreateStringLiteral(string value, char stringEnclosingChar = '\'')
		{
			if (_stringLiteralSb == null)
			{
				_stringLiteralSb = new StringBuilder();
			}
			_stringLiteralSb.Append(stringEnclosingChar);
			foreach (char c in value)
			{
				if (c == stringEnclosingChar || c == '\n')
				{
					_stringLiteralSb.Append(c.ToEscapedHexValue());
				}
				else
				{
					_stringLiteralSb.Append(c);
				}
			}
			_stringLiteralSb.Append(stringEnclosingChar);
			string result = _stringLiteralSb.ToString();
			_stringLiteralSb.Clear();
			return result;
		}

		public static string FormatListNumber(int number, CSSListStyleType listStyleType)
		{
			switch (listStyleType)
			{
			case CSSListStyleType.Disc:
				return "●";
			case CSSListStyleType.Circle:
				return "○";
			case CSSListStyleType.Square:
				return "■";
			default:
				return number.ToString();
			case CSSListStyleType.DecimalLeadingZero:
				return number.ToString("00");
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerRoman:
				return FormatListNumberAsAdditive(number, RomanSymbolsLower);
			case CSSListStyleType.UpperRoman:
				return FormatListNumberAsAdditive(number, RomanSymbolsUpper);
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerGreek:
				return FormatListNumberAsAlphabetic(number, 'α', 'ω');
			case CSSListStyleType.Armenian:
				return FormatListNumberAsAdditive(number, ArmenianSymbols);
			case CSSListStyleType.Georgian:
				return FormatListNumberAsAdditive(number, GeorgianSymbols);
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerLatin:
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerAlpha:
				return FormatListNumberAsAlphabetic(number, 'a', 'z');
			case CSSListStyleType.UpperLatin:
			case CSSListStyleType.UpperAlpha:
				return FormatListNumberAsAlphabetic(number, 'A', 'Z');
			case CSSListStyleType.None:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private static string FormatListNumberAsAlphabetic(int value, char firstLetter, char lastLetter)
		{
			if (value <= 0)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			int num = lastLetter - firstLetter + 1;
			string text = string.Empty;
			while (value != 0)
			{
				value--;
				text = (char)(firstLetter + value % num) + text;
				value /= num;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string FormatListNumberAsAdditive(int value, Tuple<int, string>[] symbols)
		{
			if (value <= 0)
			{
				Tuple<int, string> tuple = symbols.FirstOrDefault((Tuple<int, string> t) => t.Item1 == 0);
				if (tuple != null)
				{
					return tuple.Item2;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = 0;
			while (0 < value && num < symbols.Length)
			{
				int item = symbols[num].Item1;
				string item2 = symbols[num].Item2;
				int num2 = value / item;
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < num2; num3++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item2);
				}
				value -= item * num2;
				num++;
			}
			if (value == 0)
			{
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static DimensionValue GetAbsoluteLength(this CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, DimensionValue dimension, CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			return dimension.ResolveAbsoluteLength(computedStyle.GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(cascader), computedStyle.GetFontFamily());
		}

		public static DimensionValue GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(this CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			DimensionValue dimensionValue = null;
			if (computedStyle != null)
			{
				object value = computedStyle.GetValue(CSSPropertyTable.FontSize.Name);
				if (value is CSSFontSize)
				{
					dimensionValue = ((CSSFontSize)value).Length;
				}
			}
			if (dimensionValue == null)
			{
				dimensionValue = new DimensionValue(cascader.Context.NormalFontSizePoints, "pt");
			}
			return dimensionValue;
		}

		public static TokenType GetBlockEndType(TokenType blockStartType)
		{
			return blockStartType switch
			{
				TokenType.OpenBrace => TokenType.CloseBrace, 
				TokenType.OpenBracket => TokenType.CloseBracket, 
				TokenType.OpenParen => TokenType.CloseParen, 
				_ => TokenType.CloseBrace, 
			};
		}

		public static SimpleBlockType GetBlockType(TokenType blockStartType)
		{
			return blockStartType switch
			{
				TokenType.OpenBrace => SimpleBlockType.Brace, 
				TokenType.OpenBracket => SimpleBlockType.Bracket, 
				TokenType.OpenParen => SimpleBlockType.Paren, 
				_ => SimpleBlockType.Brace, 
			};
		}

		public static CSSDisplay GetComputedDisplay(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSDisplay> property, CSSDisplay specifiedValue)
		{
			if (specifiedValue == CSSDisplay.None)
			{
				return specifiedValue;
			}
			CSSPosition value = CSSPropertyTable.Position.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle);
			if (value == CSSPosition.Fixed || value == CSSPosition.Absolute)
			{
				return GetComputedDisplayForAbnormalFlow(specifiedValue);
			}
			if (CSSPropertyTable.Float.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle) != CSSFloat.None)
			{
				return GetComputedDisplayForAbnormalFlow(specifiedValue);
			}
			if (cascader.FinalizingElement.ParentNode == null || cascader.FinalizingElement.ParentNode.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Document)
			{
				return GetComputedDisplayForAbnormalFlow(specifiedValue);
			}
			return specifiedValue;
		}

		public static CSSDisplay GetComputedDisplayForAbnormalFlow(CSSDisplay specifiedValue)
		{
			switch (specifiedValue)
			{
			case CSSDisplay.InlineTable:
				return CSSDisplay.Table;
			case CSSDisplay.Inline:
			case CSSDisplay.InlineBlock:
			case CSSDisplay.TableRowGroup:
			case CSSDisplay.TableHeaderGroup:
			case CSSDisplay.TableFooterGroup:
			case CSSDisplay.TableRow:
			case CSSDisplay.TableColumnGroup:
			case CSSDisplay.TableColumn:
			case CSSDisplay.TableCell:
			case CSSDisplay.TableCaption:
				return CSSDisplay.Block;
			default:
				return specifiedValue;
			}
		}

		public static CSSFontWeight GetComputedFontWeight(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSFontWeight> property, CSSFontWeight specifiedValue)
		{
			switch (specifiedValue)
			{
			case CSSFontWeight.Bolder:
				if (cascader.FinalizingComputedStyleParent != null)
				{
					switch (CSSPropertyTable.FontWeight.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyleParent, CSSFontWeight.Value400))
					{
					case CSSFontWeight.Value100:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value200:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value300:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value400;
					case CSSFontWeight.Value400:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value500:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value700;
					case CSSFontWeight.Value600:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value700:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value800:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value900:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value900;
					default:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value700;
					}
				}
				goto case CSSFontWeight.Bold;
			case CSSFontWeight.Lighter:
				if (cascader.FinalizingComputedStyleParent != null)
				{
					switch (CSSPropertyTable.FontWeight.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyleParent, CSSFontWeight.Value400))
					{
					case CSSFontWeight.Value100:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value200:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value300:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value400:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value500:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value100;
					case CSSFontWeight.Value600:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value700:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value400;
					case CSSFontWeight.Value800:
					case CSSFontWeight.Value900:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value700;
					default:
						return CSSFontWeight.Value400;
					}
				}
				goto case CSSFontWeight.Normal;
			case CSSFontWeight.Normal:
				return CSSFontWeight.Value400;
			case CSSFontWeight.Bold:
				return CSSFontWeight.Value700;
			case CSSFontWeight.Value100:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value200:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value300:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value400:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value500:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value600:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value700:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value800:
			case CSSFontWeight.Value900:
				return specifiedValue;
			default:
				return CSSFontWeight.Value400;
			}
		}

		public static CSSTextAlign GetComputedTextAlign(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSTextAlign> property, CSSTextAlign specifiedValue)
		{
			if (specifiedValue != CSSTextAlign.DetectFromDirection)
			{
				return specifiedValue;
			}
			return (((CSSDirection?)cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetValue(CSSPropertyTable.Direction.Name)) ?? CSSPropertyTable.Direction.InitialValue) switch
			{
				CSSDirection.Ltr => CSSTextAlign.Left, 
				CSSDirection.Rtl => CSSTextAlign.Right, 
				_ => CSSTextAlign.Left, 
			};
		}

		public static CSSFontFamily GetFontFamily(this CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			return computedStyle?.GetValue(CSSPropertyTable.FontFamily).GetFirstInstalledFontFamily() ?? CSSFontFamily.Serif;
		}

		public static bool IsAllCaps(this CSSTextTransform textTransform)
		{
			return textTransform == CSSTextTransform.Uppercase;
		}

		public static bool IsBold(this CSSFontWeight fontWeight)
		{
			return (int)fontWeight >= 10;
		}

		public static bool IsCSSWideValue(object value, bool checkForUnsetValue = true)
		{
			if (!(value is string x))
			{
				return false;
			}
			StringComparer stringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase = StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase;
			if (!stringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(x, "inherit") && !stringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(x, "initial"))
			{
				if (checkForUnsetValue)
				{
					return stringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(x, "unset");
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsDigit(char c)
		{
			if ('0' <= c)
			{
				return c <= '9';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsFontInstalled(string fontName)
		{
			if (fontName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_installedFonts == null)
			{
				_installedFonts = new HashSet<string>(Fonts.SystemFontFamilies.Select((FontFamily f) => f.Source));
			}
			return _installedFonts.Contains(fontName);
		}

		public static bool IsHexDigit(char c)
		{
			if (!IsDigit(c) && ('A' > c || c > 'F'))
			{
				if ('a' <= c)
				{
					return c <= 'f';
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsIdentifierStart(char first, char second, char third)
		{
			if (IsNameStartCodePoint(first))
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (first)
			{
			case '-':
				if (!IsNameStartCodePoint(second))
				{
					return IsValidEscape(second, third);
				}
				return true;
			case '\\':
				return IsValidEscape(first, second);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsImportant(this DeclarationOrigin origin)
		{
			switch (origin)
			{
			case DeclarationOrigin.ImportantUserAgent:
			case DeclarationOrigin.ImportantAuthor:
				return true;
			case DeclarationOrigin.NormalAuthor:
			case DeclarationOrigin.NormalUserAgent:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsItalic(this CSSFontStyle fontStyle)
		{
			if (fontStyle != CSSFontStyle.Italic)
			{
				return fontStyle == CSSFontStyle.Oblique;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsLetter(char c)
		{
			if (!IsUppercaseLetter(c))
			{
				return IsLowercaseLetter(c);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsLowercaseLetter(char c)
		{
			if ('a' <= c)
			{
				return c <= 'z';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsNameCodePoint(char c)
		{
			if (!IsNameStartCodePoint(c) && !IsDigit(c))
			{
				return c == '-';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsNameStartCodePoint(char c)
		{
			if (!IsLetter(c) && !IsNonAsciiCodePoint(c))
			{
				return c == '_';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsNewline(char c)
		{
			return c == '\n';
		}

		public static bool IsNonAsciiCodePoint(char c)
		{
			return '\u0080' <= c;
		}

		public static bool IsNonPrintableCodePoint(char c)
		{
			if (('\0' > c || c > '\b') && c != '\v' && ('\u000e' > c || c > '\u001f'))
			{
				return c == '\u007f';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsNumberStart(char first, char second, char third)
		{
			if (IsDigit(first))
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (first)
			{
			case '+':
			case '-':
				if (IsDigit(second))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (second == '.' && IsDigit(third))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case '.':
				return IsDigit(second);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsOrderedListType(this CSSListStyleType listStyleType)
		{
			switch (listStyleType)
			{
			case CSSListStyleType.Disc:
			case CSSListStyleType.Circle:
			case CSSListStyleType.Square:
			case CSSListStyleType.None:
				return false;
			case CSSListStyleType.Decimal:
			case CSSListStyleType.DecimalLeadingZero:
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerRoman:
			case CSSListStyleType.UpperRoman:
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerGreek:
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerLatin:
			case CSSListStyleType.UpperLatin:
			case CSSListStyleType.Armenian:
			case CSSListStyleType.Georgian:
			case CSSListStyleType.LowerAlpha:
			case CSSListStyleType.UpperAlpha:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsSmallCaps(this CSSFontVariant fontVariant)
		{
			return fontVariant == CSSFontVariant.SmallCaps;
		}

		public static bool IsStrikethrough(this CSSTextDecoration textDecoration)
		{
			return textDecoration.HasFlag(CSSTextDecoration.LineThrough);
		}

		public static bool IsSurrogateCodePoint(char c)
		{
			if ('\ud800' <= c)
			{
				return c <= '\udfff';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsUppercaseLetter(char c)
		{
			if ('A' <= c)
			{
				return c <= 'Z';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsValidCounterName(string value)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(value, "none", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return !IsCSSWideValue(value, checkForUnsetValue: false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsValidEscape(char first, char second)
		{
			if (first != '\\')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsNewline(second))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsWhitespace(char c)
		{
			if (!IsNewline(c) && c != '\t')
			{
				return c == ' ';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsWhiteSpaceCollapsible(this CSSWhiteSpace style)
		{
			switch (style)
			{
			case CSSWhiteSpace.Normal:
			case CSSWhiteSpace.NoWrap:
			case CSSWhiteSpace.PreLine:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static DimensionValue ToAbsoluteSize(this CSSRelativeSize relativeSize, DimensionValue baseFontSize)
		{
			if (relativeSize == CSSRelativeSize.Larger || relativeSize != CSSRelativeSize.Smaller)
			{
				return new DimensionValue(1.2 * baseFontSize.Value, baseFontSize.Unit);
			}
			return new DimensionValue(baseFontSize.Value / 1.2, baseFontSize.Unit);
		}

		public static DimensionValue ToPtSize(this CSSAbsoluteSize absoluteSize, int normalFontSizePoints)
		{
			return new DimensionValue(absoluteSize switch
			{
				CSSAbsoluteSize.XXSmall => 0.55, 
				CSSAbsoluteSize.XSmall => 0.6, 
				CSSAbsoluteSize.Small => 0.8, 
				CSSAbsoluteSize.Large => 1.1, 
				CSSAbsoluteSize.XLarge => 1.5, 
				CSSAbsoluteSize.XXLarge => 2.0, 
				_ => 1.0, 
			} * (double)normalFontSizePoints, "pt");
		}

		public static string ToEscapedHexValue(this char c)
		{
			int num = c;
			return string.Format("\\{0} ", num.ToString("X").ToUpperInvariant());
		}

		public static bool TryParseAbsoluteSize(object value, out CSSAbsoluteSize absoluteSize)
		{
			absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.XXSmall;
			if (value is string text)
			{
				switch (text.ToLowerInvariant())
				{
				case "xx-small":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.XXSmall;
					return true;
				case "x-small":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.XSmall;
					return true;
				case "small":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.Small;
					return true;
				case "medium":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.Medium;
					return true;
				case "large":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.Large;
					return true;
				case "x-large":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.XLarge;
					return true;
				case "xx-large":
					absoluteSize = CSSAbsoluteSize.XXLarge;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryParseColor(object value, out Color color)
		{
			if (value is string colorName)
			{
				return ColorHelper.Instance.TryGetColorFromName(colorName, out color);
			}
			if (value is HashValue { Value: var text })
			{
				if (text.Length == 3)
				{
					text = string.Format("{0}{0}{1}{1}{2}{2}", text[0], text[1], text[2]);
				}
				if (text.Length == 6 && int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					byte r = (byte)((result & 0xFF0000) >> 16);
					byte g = (byte)((result & 0xFF00) >> 8);
					byte b = (byte)(result & 0xFF);
					color = Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, r, g, b);
					return true;
				}
				color = default(Color);
				return false;
			}
			if (value is CSSFunction cSSFunction)
			{
				object[] allArguments = cSSFunction.GetAllArguments();
				if (allArguments.Length == 3)
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[3];
					bool flag = true;
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						int val;
						if (allArguments[i] is int)
						{
							val = (int)allArguments[i];
						}
						else if (allArguments[i] is PercentValue percentValue)
						{
							val = (int)Utilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(percentValue.Value * 255.0 / 100.0);
						}
						else
						{
							val = 0;
							flag = false;
						}
						array[i] = (byte)Math.Max(0, Math.Min(val, 255));
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						color = Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, array[0], array[1], array[2]);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			color = default(Color);
			return false;
		}

		public static object ColorToCSSValue(Color color)
		{
			if (ColorHelper.Instance.TryGetNameFromColor(color, out var colorName))
			{
				return colorName;
			}
			return new HashValue($"{color.R:X2}{color.G:X2}{color.B:X2}");
		}

		public static bool TryParseColorAndTransparent(object value, out Color color)
		{
			if (string.Equals(value as string, "transparent", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				color = Colors.Transparent;
				return true;
			}
			return TryParseColor(value, out color);
		}

		public static object ColorAndTransparentToCSSValue(Color color)
		{
			if (color == Colors.Transparent)
			{
				return "transparent";
			}
			return ColorToCSSValue(color);
		}

		public static bool TryParseLength(object value, bool allowNegative, out DimensionValue length)
		{
			if (value is int || value is double)
			{
				if (Convert.ToDouble(value) == 0.0)
				{
					length = DimensionValue.ZeroPoints;
					return true;
				}
				length = null;
				return false;
			}
			if (value is DimensionValue)
			{
				length = (DimensionValue)value;
				if (length.Value < 0.0 && !allowNegative)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return length.HasLengthUnits();
			}
			length = null;
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryParseNumber(object value, out double number)
		{
			if (value is int || value is double)
			{
				number = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				return true;
			}
			number = 0.0;
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryParsePosition(object value, out CSSPosition position)
		{
			position = CSSPosition.Static;
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (text.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "auto":
				position = CSSPosition.Static;
				return true;
			case "always":
				position = CSSPosition.Relative;
				return true;
			case "avoid":
				position = CSSPosition.Absolute;
				return true;

		public static bool TryParseTextDecoration(object value, out CSSTextDecoration textDecoration)
		{
			if (value is string value2)
			{
				return TryParseTextDecorationHelper(value2, out textDecoration);
			}
			if (value is object[] array)
			{
				textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.None;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!TryParseTextDecorationHelper(array[i], out var textDecoration2))
					{
						textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.None;
						return false;
					}
					if (textDecoration2 == CSSTextDecoration.None)
					{
						textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.None;
						return true;
					}
					textDecoration |= textDecoration2;
				}
				return true;
			}
			textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.None;
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryParseTextDecorationHelper(object value, out CSSTextDecoration textDecoration)
		{
			textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.None;
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (text.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "none":
				textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.None;
				return true;
			case "underline":
				textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.Underline;
				return true;
			case "overline":
				textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.Overline;
				return true;
			case "line-through":
				textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.LineThrough;
				return true;
			case "blink":
				textDecoration = CSSTextDecoration.Blink;
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static object ToCSSValue(this CSSTextDecoration value)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (value.HasFlag(CSSTextDecoration.Underline))
			{
				list.Add(ToCSSTextHelper(CSSTextDecoration.Underline));
				value &= ~CSSTextDecoration.Underline;
			}
			if (value.HasFlag(CSSTextDecoration.Overline))
			{
				list.Add(ToCSSTextHelper(CSSTextDecoration.Overline));
				value &= ~CSSTextDecoration.Overline;
			}
			if (value.HasFlag(CSSTextDecoration.LineThrough))
			{
				list.Add(ToCSSTextHelper(CSSTextDecoration.LineThrough));
				value &= ~CSSTextDecoration.LineThrough;
			}
			if (value.HasFlag(CSSTextDecoration.Blink))
			{
				list.Add(ToCSSTextHelper(CSSTextDecoration.Blink));
				value &= ~CSSTextDecoration.Blink;
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static string ToCSSTextHelper(CSSTextDecoration value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				CSSTextDecoration.None => "none", 
				CSSTextDecoration.Underline => "underline", 
				CSSTextDecoration.Overline => "overline", 
				CSSTextDecoration.LineThrough => "line-through", 
				CSSTextDecoration.Blink => "blink", 
				_ => "none", 
			};
		}

				StructuralPseudoClassType.LastChild => "last-child", 
				StructuralPseudoClassType.FirstOfType => "first-of-type", 
				StructuralPseudoClassType.LastOfType => "last-of-type", 
				StructuralPseudoClassType.OnlyChild => "only-child", 
				StructuralPseudoClassType.OnlyOfType => "only-of-type", 
				StructuralPseudoClassType.Empty => "empty", 
				_ => "root", 
			};
		}

		public static string ToCSSText(this UIElementState type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				UIElementState.Disabled => "disabled", 
				UIElementState.Checked => "checked", 
				UIElementState.Indeterminate => "indeterminate", 
				_ => "enabled", 
			};
		}
	}

	internal class MediaContext
	{
		public static readonly MediaContext Screen = new MediaContext(MediaType.Screen, isReadOnly: true);

		public readonly Dictionary<MediaFeature, object> _features;

		public readonly bool IsReadOnly;

		public readonly MediaType Type;

		public MediaContext(MediaType type, bool isReadOnly = false)
		{
			_features = new Dictionary<MediaFeature, object>();
			Type = type;
		}

		public object GetFeatureValue(MediaFeature feature)
		{
			_features.TryGetValue(feature, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public void SetFeatureValue(MediaFeature feature, object value)
		{
			if (!IsReadOnly)
			{
				_features[feature] = value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MediaList : IEnumerable<MediaQuery>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<MediaQuery> _media;

		public int Count => _media.Count;

		public MediaQuery this[int index] => _media[index];

		public MediaList()
		{
			_media = new List<MediaQuery>();
		}

		public void Add(MediaQuery medium)
		{
			_media.Add(medium);
		}

		public IEnumerator<MediaQuery> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _media.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public bool IsEquivalentTo(MediaList other)
		{
			if (_media.Count == other._media.Count)
			{
				return _media.Zip(other._media, (MediaQuery a, MediaQuery b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsMediaAllowed(MediaContext context)
		{
			if (_media.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<MediaQuery> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					MediaQuery current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.IsMediaAllowed(context))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool RemoveAt(MediaQuery medium)
		{
			return _media.Remove(medium);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			_media.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Serialize(SerializationContext context)
		{
			if (_media.Count != 0)
			{
				_media[0].Serialize(context);
				for (int i = 1; i < _media.Count; i++)
				{
					context.Writer.Write(", ");
					_media[i].Serialize(context);
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _media.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class MediaQuery
	{
		public const string AndTextLower = "and";

		public static readonly MediaQuery AllQuery = new MediaQuery(MediaQueryQualifier.None, MediaType.All, new List<MediaQueryExpression>());

		public static readonly MediaQuery InvalidQuery = new MediaQuery(MediaQueryQualifier.Not, MediaType.All, new List<MediaQueryExpression>());

		public List<MediaQueryExpression> Expressions { get; private set; }

		public MediaQueryQualifier Qualifier { get; private set; }

		public MediaType Type { get; private set; }

		public MediaQuery(MediaQueryQualifier qualifier, MediaType type, List<MediaQueryExpression> expressions)
		{
			Qualifier = qualifier;
			Type = type;
			Expressions = expressions;
		}

		public bool IsEquivalentTo(MediaQuery other)
		{
			if (Qualifier == other.Qualifier && Type == other.Type && Expressions.Count == other.Expressions.Count)
			{
				return Expressions.Zip(other.Expressions, (MediaQueryExpression a, MediaQueryExpression b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsMediaAllowed(MediaContext context)
		{
			bool flag = IsMediaAllowedHelper(context);
			if (Qualifier == MediaQueryQualifier.Not)
			{
				return !flag;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool IsMediaAllowedHelper(MediaContext context)
		{
			if (Type == MediaType.Unknown)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Type != MediaType.All && Type != context.Type)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (MediaQueryExpression expression in Expressions)
			{
				if (!expression.IsMediaAllowed(context))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Serialize(SerializationContext context)
		{
			if (Qualifier != MediaQueryQualifier.None)
			{
				context.Writer.Write(Qualifier.ToCSSText());
				context.Writer.Write(' ');
			}
			context.Writer.Write(Type.ToCSSText());
			foreach (MediaQueryExpression expression in Expressions)
			{
				context.Writer.Write("and");
				context.Writer.Write(' ');
				expression.Serialize(context);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MediaQueryExpression
	{
		public const string MaxQualifierTextLower = "max-";

		public const string MinQualifierTextLower = "min-";

		public MediaFeature Feature { get; private set; }

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (Feature == MediaFeature.Unknown)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Qualifier != MediaFeatureQualifier.None)
				{
					switch (Feature)
					{
					case MediaFeature.Grid:
						return false;
					case MediaFeature.Orientation:
						return false;
					case MediaFeature.Scan:
						return false;
					}
				}
				return IsValueValid();
			}
		}

		public MediaFeatureQualifier Qualifier { get; private set; }

		public object Value { get; private set; }

		public MediaQueryExpression(MediaFeature feature, MediaFeatureQualifier qualifier, object value)
		{
			Feature = feature;
			Qualifier = qualifier;
			Value = value;
		}

		public static string GetQualifierText(MediaFeatureQualifier qualifier)
		{
			return qualifier switch
			{
				MediaFeatureQualifier.Min => "min-", 
				MediaFeatureQualifier.Max => "max-", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		public bool IsEquivalentTo(MediaQueryExpression other)
		{
			if (Feature == other.Feature && Qualifier == other.Qualifier)
			{
				return object.Equals(Value, other.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsMediaAllowed(MediaContext context)
		{
			object featureValue = context.GetFeatureValue(Feature);
			if (featureValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Value == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (object.Equals(Value, featureValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Value is IComparable comparable)
			{
				try
				{
					switch (Qualifier)
					{
					case MediaFeatureQualifier.Min:
						return comparable.CompareTo(featureValue) <= 0;
					case MediaFeatureQualifier.Max:
						return comparable.CompareTo(featureValue) >= 0;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsValueValid()
		{
			if (Value != null)
			{
				return IsValueValidHelper(Feature, Value);
			}
			if (!IsValueValidHelper(Feature, 1) && !IsValueValidHelper(Feature, new DimensionValue(1.0, "px")))
			{
				return IsValueValidHelper(Feature, new DimensionValue(1.0, "dpi"));
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidHelper(MediaFeature feature, object value)
		{
			switch (feature)
			{
			case MediaFeature.Width:
			case MediaFeature.Height:
			case MediaFeature.DeviceWidth:
			case MediaFeature.DeviceHeight:
				return IsValueValidLength(value, canBeNegative: false);
			case MediaFeature.Orientation:
				return IsValueValidOrientation(value);
			case MediaFeature.AspectRatio:
			case MediaFeature.DeviceAspectRatio:
				return IsValueValidRatio(value);
			case MediaFeature.Color:
			case MediaFeature.ColorIndex:
			case MediaFeature.Monochrome:
				return IsValueValidInteger(value, 0);
			case MediaFeature.Resolution:
				return IsValueValidResolution(value);
			case MediaFeature.Scan:
				return IsValueValidScan(value);
			case MediaFeature.Grid:
				return IsValueValidInteger(value, 0, 1);
			case MediaFeature.Unknown:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidInteger(object value, int minValue = int.MinValue, int maxValue = int.MaxValue)
		{
			if (!(value is int num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (minValue <= num)
			{
				return num <= maxValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidLength(object value, bool canBeNegative)
		{
			if (value is int)
			{
				return (int)value == 0;
			}
			if (value is double)
			{
				return (double)value == 0.0;
			}
			if (!(value is DimensionValue dimensionValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (dimensionValue.Unit.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			default:
				return false;
			case "em":
			case "ex":
			case "px":
			case "cm":
			case "mm":
			case "in":
			case "pt":
			case "pc":
				if (!canBeNegative && dimensionValue.Value < 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidOrientation(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text2 = text.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (text2 == "portrait" || text2 == "landscape")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidRatio(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is CSSBinaryExpression { Operator: CSSOperator.Fraction } cSSBinaryExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsValueValidInteger(cSSBinaryExpression.Left, 1))
			{
				return IsValueValidInteger(cSSBinaryExpression.Right, 1);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidResolution(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is DimensionValue dimensionValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = dimensionValue.Unit.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (!(text == "dpi") && !(text == "dpcm"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(dimensionValue.Value);
			if ((double)num != dimensionValue.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsValueValidInteger(num, 1);
		}

		private static bool IsValueValidScan(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text2 = text.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (text2 == "progressive" || text2 == "interlace")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static MediaFeature ParseFeature(string featureName, out MediaFeatureQualifier qualifier)
		{
			if (featureName.StartsWith("min-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				qualifier = MediaFeatureQualifier.Min;
				featureName = featureName.Substring(4);
			}
			else if (featureName.StartsWith("max-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				qualifier = MediaFeatureQualifier.Max;
				featureName = featureName.Substring(4);
			}
			else
			{
				qualifier = MediaFeatureQualifier.None;
			}
			return CSSUtilities.MediaFeatureFromCSSText(featureName);
		}

		public void Serialize(SerializationContext context)
		{
			context.Writer.Write('(');
			context.Writer.Write(GetQualifierText(Qualifier));
			context.Writer.Write(Feature.ToCSSText());
			if (Value != null)
			{
				context.Writer.Write(": ");
				context.Writer.Write(Value);
			}
			context.Writer.Write(')');
		}
	}
	internal class PageSelector
	{
		public readonly string Name;

		public readonly PagePseudoClass[] PagePseudoClasses;

		public PageSelector(params PagePseudoClass[] pagePseudoClasses)
			: this(null, pagePseudoClasses)
		{
		}

		public PageSelector(string name, params PagePseudoClass[] pagePseudoClasses)
		{
			Name = name;
			PagePseudoClasses = pagePseudoClasses;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is PageSelector pageSelector && string.Equals(Name, pageSelector.Name, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCulture) && PagePseudoClasses.Length == pageSelector.PagePseudoClasses.Length)
			{
				return PagePseudoClasses.Zip(pageSelector.PagePseudoClasses, (PagePseudoClass a, PagePseudoClass b) => a == b).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Name.GetHashCode() + PagePseudoClasses.Length;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = Name ?? string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < PagePseudoClasses.Length; i++)
			{
				text = text + ":" + PagePseudoClasses[i].ToCSSText();
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	internal class ParseContext
	{

		public string FilePathResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (FilePath != null)
				{
					return FilePath;
				}
				if (OwnerDocument != null)
				{
					return OwnerDocument.FilePath;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Encoding HttpEncoding { get; set; }

		public HtmlNode LinkNode { get; set; }

		public HtmlDocument OwnerDocument { get; set; }

		public XmlElement ProcessingInstruction { get; set; }

		public CSSStyleSheet ReferringStyleSheet { get; set; }
	}
	internal class SerializationContext
	{
		private const int DefualtSpacesPerIndent = 2;

		private int _indentCount;

		public readonly bool IsForInlineAttribute;

		public readonly int SpacesPerIndent;

		public readonly TextWriter Writer;

		public SerializationContext(TextWriter writer, bool isForInlineAttribute = false, int spacesPerIndent = 2)
		{
			Writer = writer;
			SpacesPerIndent = spacesPerIndent;
			IsForInlineAttribute = isForInlineAttribute;
		}

		public void Indent()
		{
			_indentCount++;
		}

		public void Unindent()
		{
			_indentCount--;
		}

		public void WriteIndent()
		{
			Writer.Write(new string(' ', SpacesPerIndent * _indentCount));
		}

		public void WriteNameEscaped(string name)
		{
			if (name.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			char c = name[0];
			if (CSSUtilities.IsNameStartCodePoint(c))
			{
				Writer.Write(c);
			}
			else
			{
				Writer.Write(c.ToEscapedHexValue());
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < name.Length; i++)
			{
				c = name[i];
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNameCodePoint(c))
				{
					Writer.Write(c);
				}
				else
				{
					Writer.Write(c.ToEscapedHexValue());
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SerializationRuleVisitor : RuleVisitor
	{
		private readonly SerializationContext _context;

		private readonly SerializationSelectorVisitor _selectorVisitor;

		public SerializationRuleVisitor(SerializationContext context)
		{
			_context = context;
			_selectorVisitor = new SerializationSelectorVisitor(_context);
		}

		public override void DefaultVisit(Rule rule)
		{
		}

		public override void VisitCharsetRule(CharsetRule rule)
		{
			string text = string.Format("@{0} \"{1}\";", "charset", rule.Encoding);
			if (_context.Writer is StreamWriter streamWriter)
			{
				Encoding aSCII = Encoding.ASCII;
				byte[] bytes = aSCII.GetBytes(text);
				streamWriter.BaseStream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				_context.WriteIndent();
				_context.Writer.Write(text);
			}
		}

		public override void VisitFontFaceRule(FontFaceRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.Write('@');
			_context.Writer.Write("font-face");
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			rule.Style.Serialize(_context);
		}

		public override void VisitImportRule(ImportRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.Write('@');
			_context.Writer.Write("import");
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			_context.Writer.Write(CSSUtilities.CreateStringLiteral(rule.HRef));
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			rule.Media.Serialize(_context);
			_context.Writer.Write(";");
		}

		public override void VisitMarginRule(MarginRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.Write('@');
			_context.Writer.Write(rule.Name);
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			rule.Style.Serialize(_context);
		}

		public override void VisitMediaRule(MediaRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.Write('@');
			_context.Writer.Write("media");
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			rule.Media.Serialize(_context);
			_context.Writer.Write(" {");
			_context.Writer.WriteLine();
			_context.Indent();
			foreach (Rule rule2 in rule.Rules)
			{
				rule2.Accept(this);
			}
			_context.Writer.WriteLine();
			_context.Unindent();
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.WriteLine('}');
		}

		public override void VisitNamespaceRule(NamespaceRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.Write('@');
			_context.Writer.Write("namespace");
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Prefix))
			{
				_context.WriteNameEscaped(rule.Prefix);
				_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			}
			_context.Writer.Write(CSSUtilities.CreateStringLiteral(rule.NamespaceUri));
			_context.Writer.Write(';');
		}

		public override void VisitPageRule(PageRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.Write('@');
			_context.Writer.Write("page");
			_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			if (rule.PageSelectors.Count != 0)
			{
				_context.Writer.Write(string.Join(", ", rule.PageSelectors));
				_context.Writer.Write(' ');
			}
			_context.Writer.Write("{");
			_context.Writer.WriteLine();
			_context.Indent();
			rule.Style.Serialize(_context, includeBraces: false);
			foreach (Rule rule2 in rule.Rules)
			{
				rule2.Accept(this);
			}
			_context.Writer.WriteLine();
			_context.Unindent();
			_context.WriteIndent();
			_context.Writer.WriteLine('}');
		}

		public override void VisitStyleRule(StyleRule rule)
		{
			_context.WriteIndent();
			rule.Selector.Accept(_selectorVisitor);
			rule.Style.Serialize(_context);
		}
	}
	internal class SerializationSelectorVisitor : SelectorVisitor
	{
		private readonly SerializationContext _context;

		public SerializationSelectorVisitor(SerializationContext context)
		{
			_context = context;
		}

		public override void DefaultVisit(Selector selector)
		{
		}

		public override void VisitAttributeSelector(AttributeSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write('[');
			if (selector.NamespacePrefix != null)
			{
				_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.NamespacePrefix);
				_context.Writer.Write('|');
			}
			_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.AttributeName);
			if (selector.Comparison != AttributeValueComparison.AnyValue)
			{
				_context.Writer.Write(selector.Comparison.ToCSSText());
				_context.Writer.Write(CSSUtilities.CreateStringLiteral(selector.ConditionalValue));
			}
			_context.Writer.Write(']');
		}

		public override void VisitClassSelector(ClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(".");
			_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.ClassName);
		}

		public override void VisitDescendantCombinatorSelector(DescendantCombinatorSelector selector)
		{
			selector.AncestorSelector.Accept(this);
			_context.Writer.Write(selector.Type.ToCSSText());
			selector.DescendantSelector.Accept(this);
		}

		public override void VisitDynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(':');
			_context.Writer.Write(selector.Type.ToCSSText());
		}

		public override void VisitIdSelector(IdSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write('#');
			_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.IdName);
		}

		public override void VisitLangPseudoClassSelector(LangPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(':');
			_context.Writer.Write("lang");
			_context.Writer.Write('(');
			_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.LangName);
			_context.Writer.Write(')');
		}

		public override void VisitNegationPseudoClassSelector(NegationPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(':');
			_context.Writer.Write("not");
			_context.Writer.Write('(');
			selector.Argument.Accept(this);
			_context.Writer.Write(')');
		}

		public override void VisitNullSingleElementSelector(NullSingleElementSelector selector)
		{
		}

		public override void VisitPseudoElementSelector(PseudoElementSelector selector)
		{
			selector.BaseSelector.Accept(this);
			_context.Writer.Write("::");
			_context.Writer.Write(selector.Type.ToCSSText());
		}

		public override void VisitSelectorGroup(SelectorGroup selector)
		{
			if (selector.Selectors.Count != 0)
			{
				selector.Selectors[0].Accept(this);
				for (int i = 1; i < selector.Selectors.Count; i++)
				{
					_context.Writer.Write(", ");
					selector.Selectors[i].Accept(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void VisitSiblingCombinatorSelector(SiblingCombinatorSelector selector)
		{
			selector.PreviousSelector.Accept(this);
			_context.Writer.Write(selector.Type.ToCSSText());
			selector.NextSelector.Accept(this);
		}

		public override void VisitSimpleSelectorSequence(SimpleSelectorSequence selector)
		{
			SimpleSelector[] components = selector.Components;
			foreach (SimpleSelector simpleSelector in components)
			{
				simpleSelector.Accept(this);
			}
		}

		public override void VisitStructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(':');
			_context.Writer.Write(selector.Type.ToCSSText());
			if (selector.NthExpression != null)
			{
				_context.Writer.Write('(');
				_context.Writer.Write(selector.NthExpression.ToString());
				_context.Writer.Write(')');
			}
		}

		public override void VisitTargetPseudoClassSelector(TargetPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(':');
			_context.Writer.Write("target");
		}

		public override void VisitTypeSelector(TypeSelector selector)
		{
			if (selector.NamespacePrefix != null)
			{
				_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.NamespacePrefix);
				_context.Writer.Write('|');
			}
			_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.ElementName);
		}

		public override void VisitUIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			_context.Writer.Write(':');
			_context.Writer.Write(selector.State.ToCSSText());
		}

		public override void VisitUniversalSelector(UniversalSelector selector)
		{
			if (selector.NamespacePrefix != null)
			{
				_context.WriteNameEscaped(selector.NamespacePrefix);
				_context.Writer.Write('|');
			}
			_context.Writer.Write('*');
		}
	}
	internal class StyleDeclaration
	{
		public const string ImportantDelimiter = "!";

		public const string ImportantTextLower = "important";

		public readonly bool IsImportant;

		public readonly string Name;

		public readonly object Value;

		public StyleDeclaration(string name, object value, bool isImportant = false)
		{
			IsImportant = isImportant;
			Name = name;
			Value = value;
		}

		private static bool IsValidValueType(object value)
		{
			if (value is int || value is double || value is string || value is DimensionValue || value is CSSFunction || value is HashValue || value is PercentValue || value is StringLiteral || value is UnicodeRangeValue || value is UrlValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value is CSSFunction cSSFunction)
			{
				return IsValidValueType(cSSFunction.Argument);
			}
			if (value is object[] source)
			{
				return source.All(IsValidValueType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			SerializationContext context = new SerializationContext(stringWriter, isForInlineAttribute: true);
			Serialize(context);
			stringWriter.Flush();
			return stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
		}

		public bool IsEquivalentTo(StyleDeclaration other)
		{
			if (IsImportant == other.IsImportant && string.Equals(Name, other.Name, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(Value, other.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Serialize(SerializationContext context)
		{
			if (!context.IsForInlineAttribute)
			{
				context.WriteIndent();
			}
			context.Writer.Write(Name);
			context.Writer.Write(": ");
			if (Value is object[] array)
			{
				string value = (string.Equals(Name, CSSPropertyTable.FontFamily.Name, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) ? ", " : " ");
				context.Writer.Write(array[0]);
				for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					context.Writer.Write(value);
					context.Writer.Write(ToStringInvariant(array[i]));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				context.Writer.Write(ToStringInvariant(Value));
			}
			if (IsImportant)
			{
				context.Writer.Write(' ');
				context.Writer.Write("!");
				context.Writer.Write("important");
			}
			context.Writer.Write(";");
			if (context.IsForInlineAttribute)
			{
				context.Writer.Write(' ');
			}
			else
			{
				context.Writer.WriteLine();
			}
		}

		private static string ToStringInvariant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", new object[1] { value });
		}
	}
	internal class StyleDeclarationBlock : IEnumerable<StyleDeclaration>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<StyleDeclaration> _declarations;

		public int Count => _declarations.Count;

		public StyleDeclaration this[int index] => _declarations[index];

		public StyleDeclaration this[string propertyName]
		{
			get
			{
				int num = IndexOf(propertyName);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _declarations[num];
			}
		}

		public Rule ParentRule { get; private set; }

		public StyleDeclarationBlock(Rule parentRule = null)
		{
			_declarations = new List<StyleDeclaration>();
			ParentRule = parentRule;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _declarations.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			SerializationContext context = new SerializationContext(stringWriter, isForInlineAttribute: true);
			Serialize(context);
			stringWriter.Flush();
			return stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
		}

		public void Add(StyleDeclaration declaration)
		{
			_declarations.Add(declaration);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_declarations.Clear();
		}

		public IEnumerator<StyleDeclaration> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _declarations.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(StyleDeclaration declaration)
		{
			return _declarations.IndexOf(declaration);
		}

		public int IndexOf(string propertyName)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _declarations.Count; i++)
			{
				if (string.Equals(propertyName, _declarations[i].Name, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, StyleDeclaration declaration)
		{
			_declarations.Insert(index, declaration);
		}

		public bool IsEquivalentTo(StyleDeclarationBlock other)
		{
			if (Count == other.Count)
			{
				return _declarations.Zip(other._declarations, (StyleDeclaration a, StyleDeclaration b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Remove(StyleDeclaration declaration)
		{
			return _declarations.Remove(declaration);
		}

		public bool Remove(string propertyName)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(propertyName);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			_declarations.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Serialize(SerializationContext context, bool includeBraces = true)
		{
			if (includeBraces && !context.IsForInlineAttribute)
			{
				context.Writer.Write(" {");
				context.Writer.WriteLine();
				context.Indent();
			}
			foreach (StyleDeclaration declaration in _declarations)
			{
				declaration.Serialize(context);
			}
			if (includeBraces && !context.IsForInlineAttribute)
			{
				context.Unindent();
				context.WriteIndent();
				context.Writer.WriteLine('}');
			}
		}

		public bool TryGetDeclarationValue(string propertyName, out object value)
		{
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = this[propertyName];
			if (styleDeclaration == null)
			{
				value = null;
				return false;
			}
			value = styleDeclaration.Value;
			return true;
		}
	}
