	internal class CSSBinaryExpression
	{
		public readonly object Left;

		public readonly CSSOperator Operator;

		public readonly object Right;

		public CSSBinaryExpression(object left, CSSOperator op, object right)
		{
			Left = left;
			Operator = op;
			Right = right;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Left.GetHashCode() ^ ((Right.GetHashCode() << 2) + (int)Operator);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CSSBinaryExpression cSSBinaryExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Operator == cSSBinaryExpression.Operator && Left.Equals(cSSBinaryExpression.Left))
			{
				return Right.Equals(cSSBinaryExpression.Right);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			CSSOperator cSSOperator = Operator;
			return string.Format("{0}{1}{2}", Left, cSSOperator switch
			{
				CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator => ", ", 
				CSSOperator.Fraction => "/", 
				_ => ", ", 
			}, Right);
		}

		public static CSSBinaryExpression CreateMultiple(CSSOperator @operator, params object[] arguments)
		{
			if (arguments.Length < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = arguments[arguments.Length - 1];
			for (int num = arguments.Length - 2; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				obj = new CSSBinaryExpression(arguments[num], CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator, obj);
			}
			return (CSSBinaryExpression)obj;
		}
	}
	internal class CSSFunction
	{
		public readonly object Argument;

		public readonly string Name;

		public CSSFunction(string name, object argument)
		{
			Argument = argument;
			Name = name;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CSSFunction cSSFunction))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Equals(Name, cSSFunction.Name, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return object.Equals(Argument, cSSFunction.Argument);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Name.GetHashCode() ^ Argument.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{Name}({Argument})";
		}

		public object[] GetAllArguments()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			GetAllArgumentsHelper(Argument, list);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void GetAllArgumentsHelper(object currentArgument, List<object> allObjects)
		{
			if (currentArgument is CSSBinaryExpression { Operator: CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator } cSSBinaryExpression)
			{
				GetAllArgumentsHelper(cSSBinaryExpression.Left, allObjects);
				GetAllArgumentsHelper(cSSBinaryExpression.Right, allObjects);
			}
			else
			{
				allObjects.Add(currentArgument);
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.CSS.Values
{
	internal struct CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength
	{
		public static readonly CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength Auto = new CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(isAuto: true);

		public static readonly CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength None = new CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(isAuto: false, isNone: true);

		public static readonly CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength Zero = new CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(DimensionValue.ZeroPoints);

		public readonly bool IsAuto;

		public readonly bool IsNone;

		public readonly DimensionValue Length;

		public readonly PercentValue Percentage;

		private CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(bool isAuto = false, bool isNone = false)
		{
			IsAuto = isAuto;
			IsNone = isNone;
			Length = null;
			Percentage = null;
		}

		public CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(DimensionValue length)
		{
			IsAuto = false;
			IsNone = false;
			Length = length;
			Percentage = null;
		}

		public CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(PercentValue percentage)
		{
			IsAuto = false;
			IsNone = false;
			Length = null;
			Percentage = percentage;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength? cSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength = obj as CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength?;
			if (cSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength.HasValue && IsAuto == cSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength.Value.IsAuto && IsNone == cSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength.Value.IsNone && object.Equals(Length, cSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength.Value.Length))
			{
				return object.Equals(Percentage, cSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength.Value.Percentage);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (IsAuto)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (IsNone)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length.Value.GetHashCode() << 4;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage.Value.GetHashCode() << 8;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue().ToString();
		}

		public static CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength> property, CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength specifiedValue)
		{
			if (specifiedValue.Length == null)
			{
				return specifiedValue;
			}
			return new CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteLength(specifiedValue.Length, cascader));
		}

		public static bool TryParseAllowAutoAndNegative(object value, out CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength result)
		{
			return TryParse(value, allowAuto: true, allowNone: false, allowNegative: true, out result);
		}

		public static bool TryParseAllowNegative(object value, out CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength result)
		{
			return TryParse(value, allowAuto: false, allowNone: false, allowNegative: true, out result);
		}

		public static bool TryParsePositiveOnly(object value, out CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength result)
		{
			return TryParse(value, allowAuto: false, allowNone: false, allowNegative: false, out result);
		}

		public static bool TryParsePositiveOnlyAllowNone(object value, out CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength result)
		{
			return TryParse(value, allowAuto: false, allowNone: true, allowNegative: false, out result);
		}

		private static bool TryParse(object value, bool allowAuto, bool allowNone, bool allowNegative, out CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength result)
		{
			if (allowAuto && StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(value as string, "auto"))
			{
				result = Auto;
				return true;
			}
			if (allowNone && StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(value as string, "none"))
			{
				result = None;
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(value, allowNegative, out var length))
			{
				result = new CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(length);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is PercentValue percentage)
			{
				result = new CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength(percentage);
				return true;
			}
			result = default(CSSAbsoluteOrRelativeLength);
			return false;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (IsAuto)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			if (IsNone)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSBackgroundPosition
	{
		public static readonly CSSBackgroundPosition ZeroZero = new CSSBackgroundPosition(new PercentValue(0.0), new PercentValue(0.0));

		public readonly CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType> HorizontalComponent;

		public readonly CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType> VerticalComponent;

		public CSSBackgroundPosition(CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType> horizontalComponent, CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType> verticalComponent)
		{
			HorizontalComponent = horizontalComponent;
			VerticalComponent = verticalComponent;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSBackgroundPosition? cSSBackgroundPosition = obj as CSSBackgroundPosition?;
			if (cSSBackgroundPosition.HasValue && object.Equals(HorizontalComponent, cSSBackgroundPosition.Value.HorizontalComponent))
			{
				return object.Equals(VerticalComponent, cSSBackgroundPosition.Value.VerticalComponent);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HorizontalComponent.GetHashCode() ^ (VerticalComponent.GetHashCode() << 4);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{HorizontalComponent} {VerticalComponent}";
		}

		public static CSSBackgroundPosition GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSBackgroundPosition> property, CSSBackgroundPosition specifiedValue)
		{
			CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType> horizontalComponent = default(CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType>);
			CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType> verticalComponent = default(CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType>);
			if (specifiedValue.HorizontalComponent.Length != null)
			{
				horizontalComponent = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteLength(specifiedValue.HorizontalComponent.Length, cascader);
			}
			else if (specifiedValue.HorizontalComponent.Percentage != null)
			{
				horizontalComponent = specifiedValue.HorizontalComponent.Percentage;
			}
			else if (specifiedValue.HorizontalComponent.Type.HasValue)
			{
				horizontalComponent = specifiedValue.HorizontalComponent.Type.Value.ToPercentage();
			}
			if (specifiedValue.VerticalComponent.Length != null)
			{
				verticalComponent = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteLength(specifiedValue.VerticalComponent.Length, cascader);
			}
			else if (specifiedValue.VerticalComponent.Percentage != null)
			{
				verticalComponent = specifiedValue.VerticalComponent.Percentage;
			}
			else if (specifiedValue.VerticalComponent.Type.HasValue)
			{
				verticalComponent = specifiedValue.VerticalComponent.Type.Value.ToPercentage();
			}
			return new CSSBackgroundPosition(horizontalComponent, verticalComponent);
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			return new object[2]
			{
				HorizontalComponent.ToCSSValue((CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType t) => t.ToCSSText()),
				VerticalComponent.ToCSSValue((CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType t) => t.ToCSSText())
			};
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSBackgroundPosition backgroundPosition)
		{
			backgroundPosition = default(CSSBackgroundPosition);
			CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType type;
			CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType type2;
			if (value is object[] array)
			{
				switch (array.Length)
				{
				default:
					return false;
				case 1:
					break;
				case 2:
				{
					CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType> horizontalComponent;
					if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(array[0], allowNegative: false, out var length))
					{
						horizontalComponent = length;
					}
					else if (array[0] is PercentValue percentValue)
					{
						horizontalComponent = percentValue;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!CSSUtilities.TryParseBackgroundPositionHorizontalType(array[0], out type))
						{
							return false;
						}
						horizontalComponent = type;
					}
					if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(array[1], allowNegative: false, out var length2))
					{
						backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(horizontalComponent, length2);
						return true;
					}
					if (array[1] is PercentValue percentValue2)
					{
						backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(horizontalComponent, percentValue2);
						return true;
					}
					if (CSSUtilities.TryParseBackgroundPositionVerticalType(array[1], out type2))
					{
						backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(horizontalComponent, type2);
						return true;
					}
					if (CSSUtilities.TryParseBackgroundPositionVerticalType(array[0], out type2) && CSSUtilities.TryParseBackgroundPositionHorizontalType(array[1], out type))
					{
						backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(type, type2);
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				}
				value = array[0];
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(value, allowNegative: false, out var length3))
			{
				backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(length3, CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType.Center);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is PercentValue percentValue3)
			{
				backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(percentValue3, CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType.Center);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseBackgroundPositionHorizontalType(value, out type))
			{
				backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(type, CSSBackgroundPositionVerticalType.Center);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseBackgroundPositionVerticalType(value, out type2))
			{
				backgroundPosition = new CSSBackgroundPosition(CSSBackgroundPositionHorizontalType.Center, type2);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T> where T : struct
	{
		public readonly DimensionValue Length;

		public readonly PercentValue Percentage;

		public readonly T? Type;

		public CSSBackgroundPositionComponent(DimensionValue length)
		{
			Length = length;
			Percentage = null;
			Type = null;
		}

		public CSSBackgroundPositionComponent(PercentValue percentage)
		{
			Length = null;
			Percentage = percentage;
			Type = null;
		}

		public CSSBackgroundPositionComponent(T type)
		{
			Length = null;
			Percentage = null;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>? cSSBackgroundPositionComponent = obj as CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>?;
			if (cSSBackgroundPositionComponent.HasValue && object.Equals(Length, cSSBackgroundPositionComponent.Value.Length) && object.Equals(Percentage, cSSBackgroundPositionComponent.Value.Percentage))
			{
				return object.Equals(Type, cSSBackgroundPositionComponent.Value.Type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue((T t) => t.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()).ToString();
		}

		public static implicit operator CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>(DimensionValue length)
		{
			return new CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>(length);
		}

		public static implicit operator CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>(PercentValue percentage)
		{
			return new CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>(percentage);
		}

		public static implicit operator CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>(T type)
		{
			return new CSSBackgroundPositionComponent<T>(type);
		}

		public object ToCSSValue(Func<T, string> typeToCSSValueCallback)
		{
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage;
			}
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return typeToCSSValueCallback(Type.Value);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSBorderSpacing
	{
		public static readonly CSSBorderSpacing Zero = new CSSBorderSpacing(DimensionValue.ZeroPoints);

		public readonly DimensionValue Length1;

		public readonly DimensionValue Length2;

		public CSSBorderSpacing(DimensionValue horizontalAndVerticalSpacing)
		{
			Length1 = horizontalAndVerticalSpacing;
			Length2 = null;
		}

		public CSSBorderSpacing(DimensionValue horizontalSpacing, DimensionValue verticalSpacing)
		{
			Length1 = horizontalSpacing;
			Length2 = verticalSpacing;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSBorderSpacing? cSSBorderSpacing = obj as CSSBorderSpacing?;
			if (cSSBorderSpacing.HasValue && object.Equals(Length1, cSSBorderSpacing.Value.Length1))
			{
				return object.Equals(Length2, cSSBorderSpacing.Value.Length2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Length1.GetHashCode() ^ (Length2.GetHashCode() << 4);
		}

		public static CSSBorderSpacing GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSBorderSpacing> property, CSSBorderSpacing specifiedValue)
		{
			DimensionValue absoluteFontSizeLength = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(cascader);
			CSSFontFamily fontFamily = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetFontFamily();
			DimensionValue dimensionValue = specifiedValue.Length1.ResolveAbsoluteLength(absoluteFontSizeLength, fontFamily);
			if (specifiedValue.Length2 == null)
			{
				return new CSSBorderSpacing(dimensionValue, dimensionValue);
			}
			return new CSSBorderSpacing(dimensionValue, specifiedValue.Length2.ResolveAbsoluteLength(absoluteFontSizeLength, fontFamily));
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSBorderSpacing spacing)
		{
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(value, allowNegative: false, out var length))
			{
				spacing = new CSSBorderSpacing(length);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is object[] array && array.Length == 2 && CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(array[0], allowNegative: false, out length) && CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(array[1], allowNegative: false, out var length2))
			{
				spacing = new CSSBorderSpacing(length, length2);
				return true;
			}
			spacing = default(CSSBorderSpacing);
			return false;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (Length1 == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (Length2 == null)
			{
				return Length1;
			}
			return new object[2] { Length1, Length2 };
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSBorderWidth
	{
		public static readonly CSSBorderWidth Thin = new CSSBorderWidth(CSSBorderWidthType.Thin);

		public static readonly CSSBorderWidth Medium = new CSSBorderWidth(CSSBorderWidthType.Medium);

		public static readonly CSSBorderWidth Thick = new CSSBorderWidth(CSSBorderWidthType.Thick);

		public static readonly CSSBorderWidth Zero = new CSSBorderWidth(DimensionValue.ZeroPoints);

		private static readonly CSSBorderWidth ThinAbsolute = new CSSBorderWidth(new DimensionValue(1.0, "px"));

		private static readonly CSSBorderWidth MediumAbsolute = new CSSBorderWidth(new DimensionValue(3.0, "px"));

		private static readonly CSSBorderWidth ThickAbsolute = new CSSBorderWidth(new DimensionValue(5.0, "px"));

		public readonly DimensionValue Length;

		public readonly CSSBorderWidthType? Type;

		public CSSBorderWidth(DimensionValue length)
		{
			Length = length;
			Type = null;
		}

		public CSSBorderWidth(CSSBorderWidthType type)
		{
			Length = null;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSBorderWidth? cSSBorderWidth = obj as CSSBorderWidth?;
			if (cSSBorderWidth.HasValue && object.Equals(Length, cSSBorderWidth.Value.Length))
			{
				return Type == cSSBorderWidth.Value.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			return Type.GetHashCode() << 4;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue().ToString();
		}

		public static CSSBorderWidth GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSBorderWidth> property, CSSBorderWidth specifiedValue)
		{
			CSSBorderStyle cSSBorderStyle = property.Name switch
			{
				"border-bottom-width" => CSSPropertyTable.BorderBottomStyle.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle), 
				"border-left-width" => CSSPropertyTable.BorderLeftStyle.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle), 
				"border-right-width" => CSSPropertyTable.BorderRightStyle.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle), 
				"border-top-width" => CSSPropertyTable.BorderTopStyle.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle), 
				"outline-width" => CSSPropertyTable.OutlineStyle.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle), 
				_ => CSSBorderStyle.None, 
			};
			if (cSSBorderStyle == CSSBorderStyle.None || cSSBorderStyle == CSSBorderStyle.Hidden)
			{
				return Zero;
			}
			if (specifiedValue.Length != null)
			{
				return new CSSBorderWidth(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteLength(specifiedValue.Length, cascader));
			}
			return specifiedValue.Type switch
			{
				CSSBorderWidthType.Thin => ThinAbsolute, 
				CSSBorderWidthType.Medium => MediumAbsolute, 
				CSSBorderWidthType.Thick => ThickAbsolute, 
				_ => specifiedValue, 
			};
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSBorderWidth width)
		{
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseBorderWidthType(value, out var borderWidthType))
			{
				width = new CSSBorderWidth(borderWidthType);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(value, allowNegative: false, out var length))
			{
				width = new CSSBorderWidth(length);
				return true;
			}
			width = default(CSSBorderWidth);
			return false;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length;
			}
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal class CSSContent
	{
		public static readonly CSSContent None = new CSSContent(CSSContentType.None);

		public static readonly CSSContent Normal = new CSSContent(CSSContentType.Normal);

		public readonly CSSContentType? Type;

		public readonly CSSContentComponent[] Components;

		private CSSContent(CSSContentType type)
		{
			Type = type;
			Components = new CSSContentComponent[0];
		}

		public CSSContent(params CSSContentComponent[] components)
		{
			Components = components;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CSSContent cSSContent))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type == cSSContent.Type;
			}
			if (Components.Length != cSSContent.Components.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Components.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!Components[i].Equals(cSSContent.Components[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.Value.GetHashCode();
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < Components.Length; i++)
			{
				num ^= Components[i].GetHashCode() << i % 16;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			return string.Join(" ", Components.Select((CSSContentComponent c) => c.ToString()));
		}

		public static CSSContent GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSContent> property, CSSContent specifiedValue)
		{
			switch (specifiedValue.Type)
			{
			default:
			{
				CSSContentComponent[] array = new CSSContentComponent[specifiedValue.Components.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < specifiedValue.Components.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = specifiedValue.Components[i].GetComputedValue(cascader);
				}
				return new CSSContent(array);
			}
			case CSSContentType.Normal:
			case CSSContentType.None:
				return None;
			}
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			if (Components.Length == 1)
			{
				return Components[0].ToCSSValue();
			}
			return Components.Select((CSSContentComponent c) => c.ToCSSValue()).ToArray();
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSContent content)
		{
			content = null;
			CSSContentComponent component;
			if (value is object[] array)
			{
				List<CSSContentComponent> list = new List<CSSContentComponent>(array.Length);
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length && CSSContentComponent.TryParse(array[i], out component); i++)
				{
					list.Add(component);
				}
				content = new CSSContent(list.ToArray());
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSContentComponent.TryParse(value, out component))
			{
				content = new CSSContent(component);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseContentType(value, out var type))
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case CSSContentType.Normal:
					content = Normal;
					return true;
				case CSSContentType.None:
					content = None;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CSSContentComponent
	{
		public abstract override bool Equals(object obj);

		public abstract override int GetHashCode();

		public sealed override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue().ToString();
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSContentComponent component)
		{
			if (value is StringLiteral stringLiteral)
			{
				component = new CSSContentStringComponent(stringLiteral.Value);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is UrlValue url)
			{
				component = new CSSContentUrlComponent(url);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is CSSFunction cSSFunction)
			{
				if (string.Equals(cSSFunction.Name, "attr", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					if (cSSFunction.Argument is string attributeName)
					{
						component = new CSSContentAttributeComponent(attributeName);
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (string.Equals(cSSFunction.Name, "counter", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						component = CSSContentCounterComponent.TryParse(cSSFunction);
						return component != null;
					}
					if (string.Equals(cSSFunction.Name, "counters", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						component = CSSContentCountersComponent.TryParse(cSSFunction);
						return component != null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseContentQuoteType(value, out var type))
			{
				component = new CSSContentQuoteComponent(type);
				return true;
			}
			component = null;
			return false;
		}

		public abstract CSSContentComponent GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader);

		public abstract object ToCSSValue();
	}
	internal sealed class CSSContentStringComponent : CSSContentComponent

		}

		public override object ToCSSValue()
		{
			return new StringLiteral(Text);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class CSSContentCounterComponent : CSSContentComponent
	{
		public readonly string CounterName;

		public readonly CSSListStyleType ListStyleType;

		public CSSContentCounterComponent(string counterName, CSSListStyleType listStyleType = CSSListStyleType.Decimal)
		{
			CounterName = counterName;
			ListStyleType = listStyleType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CSSContentCounterComponent cSSContentCounterComponent && CounterName == cSSContentCounterComponent.CounterName)
			{
				return ListStyleType == cSSContentCounterComponent.ListStyleType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return CounterName.GetHashCode() + (int)ListStyleType;
		}

		public override CSSContentComponent GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			return new CSSContentStringComponent(CSSUtilities.FormatListNumber(cascader.GetCounterValue(CounterName), ListStyleType));
		}

		public override object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (ListStyleType == CSSListStyleType.Decimal)
			{
				return new CSSFunction("counter", CounterName);
			}
			return new CSSFunction("counter", new CSSBinaryExpression(CounterName, CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator, ListStyleType.ToCSSText()));
		}

		public static CSSContentCounterComponent TryParse(CSSFunction function)
		{
			if (function.Argument is string counterName)
			{
				return new CSSContentCounterComponent(counterName);
			}
			object[] allArguments = function.GetAllArguments();
			if (allArguments.Length != 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(allArguments[0] is string counterName2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseListStyleType(allArguments[1], out var listStyleType))
			{
				return new CSSContentCounterComponent(counterName2, listStyleType);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CSSContentCountersComponent : CSSContentComponent
	{
		public readonly string CounterName;

		public readonly CSSListStyleType ListStyleType;

		public readonly string Separator;

		public CSSContentCountersComponent(string counterName, string separator, CSSListStyleType listStyleType = CSSListStyleType.Decimal)
		{
			CounterName = counterName;
			ListStyleType = listStyleType;
			Separator = separator;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CSSContentCountersComponent cSSContentCountersComponent && CounterName == cSSContentCountersComponent.CounterName && Separator == cSSContentCountersComponent.Separator)
			{
				return ListStyleType == cSSContentCountersComponent.ListStyleType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (CounterName.GetHashCode() ^ (Separator.GetHashCode() << 4)) + (int)ListStyleType;
		}

		public override CSSContentComponent GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			return new CSSContentStringComponent(string.Join(Separator, from c in cascader.GetCounterValues(CounterName)
				select CSSUtilities.FormatListNumber(c, ListStyleType)));
		}

		public override object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (ListStyleType == CSSListStyleType.Decimal)
			{
				return new CSSFunction("counters", new CSSBinaryExpression(CounterName, CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator, new StringLiteral(Separator)));
			}
			return CSSBinaryExpression.CreateMultiple(CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator, CounterName, Separator, ListStyleType.ToCSSText());
		}

		public static CSSContentCountersComponent TryParse(CSSFunction function)
		{
			object[] allArguments = function.GetAllArguments();
			if (allArguments.Length < 2 || allArguments.Length > 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = allArguments[0] as string;
			StringLiteral stringLiteral = allArguments[1] as StringLiteral;
			if (text == null || stringLiteral == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CSSListStyleType listStyleType = CSSListStyleType.Decimal;
			if (allArguments.Length == 3 && !CSSUtilities.TryParseListStyleType(allArguments[2], out listStyleType))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new CSSContentCountersComponent(text, stringLiteral.Value, listStyleType);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class CSSContentQuoteComponent : CSSContentComponent
	{
		public readonly CSSContentQuoteType Type;

		public CSSContentQuoteComponent(CSSContentQuoteType type)
		{
			Type = type;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CSSContentQuoteComponent cSSContentQuoteComponent)
			{
				return Type == cSSContentQuoteComponent.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Type.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override CSSContentComponent GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			default:
			{
				string openQuote = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetValue(CSSPropertyTable.Quotes).GetOpenQuote(cascader.CurrentQuoteLevel);
				cascader.IncrementQuoteLevel();
				return new CSSContentStringComponent(openQuote);
			}
			case CSSContentQuoteType.CloseQuote:
			{
				cascader.DecrementQuoteLevel();
				string closeQuote = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetValue(CSSPropertyTable.Quotes).GetCloseQuote(cascader.CurrentQuoteLevel);
				return new CSSContentStringComponent(closeQuote);
			}
			case CSSContentQuoteType.NoOpenQuote:
				cascader.IncrementQuoteLevel();
				return new CSSContentStringComponent(string.Empty);
			case CSSContentQuoteType.NoCloseQuote:
				cascader.DecrementQuoteLevel();
				return new CSSContentStringComponent(string.Empty);
			}
		}

		public override object ToCSSValue()
		{
			return Type.ToCSSText();
		}
	}
	internal class CSSCounterValuePairs
	{
		public static readonly CSSCounterValuePairs None = new CSSCounterValuePairs();

		private readonly CSSCounterValuePair[] _pairs;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static List<CSSCounterValuePair> _parsedPairs;

		public CSSCounterValuePairs(params CSSCounterValuePair[] pairs)
		{
			_pairs = pairs;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CSSCounterValuePairs cSSCounterValuePairs))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_pairs.Length != cSSCounterValuePairs._pairs.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _pairs.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!_pairs[i].Equals(cSSCounterValuePairs._pairs[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < _pairs.Length; i++)
			{
				num ^= _pairs[i].GetHashCode() << i % 16;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Join(" ", _pairs);
		}

		public static CSSCounterValuePairs GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSCounterValuePairs> property, CSSCounterValuePairs specifiedValue)
		{
			if (specifiedValue._pairs.Length != 0)
			{
				if (property == CSSPropertyTable.CounterIncrement)
				{
					CSSCounterValuePair[] pairs = specifiedValue._pairs;
					for (int i = 0; i < pairs.Length; i++)
					{
						CSSCounterValuePair cSSCounterValuePair = pairs[i];
						cascader.IncrementCounter(cSSCounterValuePair.CounterName, cSSCounterValuePair.Value);
					}
				}
				else if (property == CSSPropertyTable.CounterReset)
				{
					CSSCounterValuePair[] pairs2 = specifiedValue._pairs;
					for (int j = 0; j < pairs2.Length; j++)
					{
						CSSCounterValuePair cSSCounterValuePair2 = pairs2[j];
						cascader.ResetCounter(cSSCounterValuePair2.CounterName, cSSCounterValuePair2.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			return specifiedValue;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>(_pairs.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < _pairs.Length; i++)
			{
				_pairs[i].AddCSSValues(list);
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSCounterValuePairs pairs)
		{
			if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(value as string, "none"))
			{
				pairs = None;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is string counterName)
			{
				pairs = new CSSCounterValuePairs(new CSSCounterValuePair(counterName));
				return true;
			}
			pairs = null;
			if (value is object[] array)
			{
				if (_parsedPairs == null)
				{
					_parsedPairs = new List<CSSCounterValuePair>();
				}
				else
				{
					_parsedPairs.Clear();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!(array[i] is string text))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(text, "none"))
					{
						pairs = None;
						return true;
					}
					int? value2 = null;
					if (i + 1 < array.Length && array[i + 1] is int)
					{
						i++;
						value2 = (int)array[i];
					}
					_parsedPairs.Add(new CSSCounterValuePair(text, value2));
				}
				pairs = new CSSCounterValuePairs(_parsedPairs.ToArray());
				_parsedPairs.Clear();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSCounterValuePair
	{
		public readonly string CounterName;

		public readonly int? Value;

		public CSSCounterValuePair(string counterName, int? value = null)
		{
			CounterName = counterName;
			Value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSCounterValuePair? cSSCounterValuePair = obj as CSSCounterValuePair?;
			if (cSSCounterValuePair.HasValue && CounterName == cSSCounterValuePair.Value.CounterName)
			{
				return Value == cSSCounterValuePair.Value.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return CounterName.GetHashCode() ^ ((Value ?? 1) << 4);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!Value.HasValue)
			{
				return CounterName;
			}
			return $"{CounterName} {Value.Value}";
		}

		public void AddCSSValues(List<object> cssValues)
		{
			cssValues.Add(CounterName);
			if (Value.HasValue)
			{
				cssValues.Add(Value.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CSSFontFamilyCollection
	{
		public static readonly CSSFontFamilyCollection Default = new CSSFontFamilyCollection(CSSFontFamily.Serif);

		public readonly CSSFontFamily[] Families;

		public CSSFontFamilyCollection(params CSSFontFamily[] families)
		{
			Families = families;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CSSFontFamilyCollection cSSFontFamilyCollection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Families.Length != cSSFontFamilyCollection.Families.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Families.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!Families[i].Equals(cSSFontFamilyCollection.Families[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < Families.Length; i++)
			{
				num ^= Families[i].GetHashCode() << i % 16;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Families.Length == 1)
			{
				return Families[0].ToString();
			}
			return string.Join(", ", Families.Select((CSSFontFamily f) => f.ToString()));
		}

		public CSSFontFamily GetFirstInstalledFontFamily()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Families.Length; i++)
			{
				CSSFontFamily result = Families[i];
				if (result.GenericFamily.HasValue || CSSUtilities.IsFontInstalled(result.FamilyName))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			if (Families.Length != 0)
			{
				return Families[Families.Length - 1];
			}
			return CSSFontFamily.Serif;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (Families.Length == 1)
			{
				return Families[0].ToCSSValue();
			}
			return Families.Select((CSSFontFamily v) => v.ToCSSValue()).ToArray();
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSFontFamilyCollection fontFamilies)
		{
			fontFamilies = null;
			if (value is object[] array)
			{
				CSSFontFamily[] array2 = new CSSFontFamily[array.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!CSSFontFamily.TryParse(array[i], out array2[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				fontFamilies = new CSSFontFamilyCollection(array2);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSFontFamily.TryParse(value, out var fontFamily))
			{
				fontFamilies = new CSSFontFamilyCollection(fontFamily);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSFontFamily
	{
		private const string FontFamilyGenericCursive = "Comic Sans MS";

		private const string FontFamilyGenericFantasy = "Impact";

		private const string FontFamilyGenericMonospace = "Courier New";

		private const string FontFamilyGenericSansSerif = "Helvetica";

		private const string FontFamilyGenericSerif = "Times New Roman";

		public static readonly CSSFontFamily Serif = new CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily.Serif);

		public readonly string FamilyName;

		public readonly CSSGenericFamily? GenericFamily;

		public CSSFontFamily(string familyName)
		{
			FamilyName = familyName;
			GenericFamily = null;
		}

		public CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily genericFamily)
		{
			FamilyName = null;
			GenericFamily = genericFamily;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSFontFamily? cSSFontFamily = obj as CSSFontFamily?;
			if (cSSFontFamily.HasValue && FamilyName == cSSFontFamily.Value.FamilyName)
			{
				return GenericFamily == cSSFontFamily.Value.GenericFamily;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (FamilyName != null)
			{
				return FamilyName.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (GenericFamily.HasValue)
			{
				return GenericFamily.Value.GetHashCode() << 4;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue().ToString();
		}

		public static CSSFontFamily FromResolvedFamilyName(string familyName)
		{
			return familyName switch
			{
				"Comic Sans MS" => new CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily.Cursive), 
				"Impact" => new CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily.Fantasy), 
				"Courier New" => new CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily.Monospace), 
				"Helvetica" => new CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily.SansSerif), 
				"Times New Roman" => new CSSFontFamily(CSSGenericFamily.Serif), 
				_ => new CSSFontFamily(familyName), 
			};
		}

		public string GetResolvedFamilyName()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FamilyName))
			{
				return FamilyName;
			}
			return GenericFamily switch
			{
				CSSGenericFamily.Cursive => "Comic Sans MS", 
				CSSGenericFamily.Fantasy => "Impact", 
				CSSGenericFamily.SansSerif => "Helvetica", 
				CSSGenericFamily.Serif => "Times New Roman", 
				CSSGenericFamily.Monospace => "Courier New", 
				null => "Times New Roman", 
				_ => "Times New Roman", 
			};
		}

		public double GetXHeight()
		{
			return new Typeface(GetResolvedFamilyName()).XHeight;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSFontFamily fontFamily)
		{
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseGenericFamily(value, out var genericFamily))
			{
				fontFamily = new CSSFontFamily(genericFamily);
				return true;
			}
			string text = value as string;
			if (text == null && value is StringLiteral stringLiteral)
			{
				text = stringLiteral.Value;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				fontFamily = new CSSFontFamily(text);
				return true;
			}
			fontFamily = default(CSSFontFamily);
			return false;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (FamilyName != null)
			{
				return new StringLiteral(FamilyName);
			}
			if (GenericFamily.HasValue)
			{
				return GenericFamily.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal struct CSSFontSize
	{
		public static readonly CSSFontSize Medium = new CSSFontSize(CSSAbsoluteSize.Medium);

		public readonly CSSAbsoluteSize? AbsoluteSize;

		public readonly DimensionValue Length;

		public readonly PercentValue Percentage;

		public readonly CSSRelativeSize? RelativeSize;

		public CSSFontSize(CSSAbsoluteSize absoluteSize)
		{
			AbsoluteSize = absoluteSize;
			Length = null;
			Percentage = null;
			RelativeSize = null;
		}

		public CSSFontSize(DimensionValue length)
		{
			AbsoluteSize = null;
			Length = length;
			Percentage = null;
			RelativeSize = null;
		}

		public CSSFontSize(PercentValue percentage)
		{
			AbsoluteSize = null;
			Length = null;
			Percentage = percentage;
			RelativeSize = null;
		}

		public CSSFontSize(CSSRelativeSize relativeSize)
		{
			AbsoluteSize = null;
			Length = null;
			Percentage = null;
			RelativeSize = relativeSize;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSFontSize? cSSFontSize = obj as CSSFontSize?;
			if (cSSFontSize.HasValue)
			{
				CSSAbsoluteSize? absoluteSize = AbsoluteSize;
				CSSAbsoluteSize? absoluteSize2 = cSSFontSize.Value.AbsoluteSize;
				if (absoluteSize.GetValueOrDefault() == absoluteSize2.GetValueOrDefault() && absoluteSize.HasValue == absoluteSize2.HasValue && object.Equals(Length, cSSFontSize.Value.Length) && object.Equals(Percentage, cSSFontSize.Value.Percentage))
				{
					return RelativeSize == cSSFontSize.Value.RelativeSize;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (AbsoluteSize.HasValue)
			{
				return AbsoluteSize.GetHashCode() << 4;
			}
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length.GetHashCode() << 8;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage.GetHashCode() << 12;
			}
			if (RelativeSize.HasValue)
			{
				return RelativeSize.GetHashCode() << 16;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue().ToString();
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSFontSize width)
		{
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(value, allowNegative: false, out var length))
			{
				width = new CSSFontSize(length);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is PercentValue percentage)
			{
				width = new CSSFontSize(percentage);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseAbsoluteSize(value, out var absoluteSize))
			{
				width = new CSSFontSize(absoluteSize);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseRelativeSize(value, out var relativeSize))
			{
				width = new CSSFontSize(relativeSize);
				return true;
			}
			width = default(CSSFontSize);
			return false;
		}

		public static CSSFontSize GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSFontSize> property, CSSFontSize specifiedValue)
		{
			if (property == CSSPropertyTable.FontSize)
			{
				return specifiedValue.GetComputedValue(cascader, cascader.FinalizingComputedStyleParent.GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(cascader));
			}
			return specifiedValue.GetComputedValue(cascader, cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(cascader));
		}

		private CSSFontSize GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, DimensionValue baseFontSize)
		{
			if (AbsoluteSize.HasValue)
			{
				return new CSSFontSize(AbsoluteSize.Value.ToPtSize(cascader.Context.NormalFontSizePoints));
			}
			if (RelativeSize.HasValue)
			{
				return new CSSFontSize(RelativeSize.Value.ToAbsoluteSize(baseFontSize));
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return new CSSFontSize(Percentage.ResolveAbsoluteLength(baseFontSize));
			}
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return new CSSFontSize(Length.ResolveAbsoluteLength(baseFontSize, cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetFontFamily()));
			}
			return new CSSFontSize(CSSAbsoluteSize.Medium.ToPtSize(cascader.Context.NormalFontSizePoints));
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (AbsoluteSize.HasValue)
			{
				return AbsoluteSize.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage;
			}
			if (RelativeSize.HasValue)
			{
				return RelativeSize.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

				double? fontSizeFactor2 = cSSLineHeight.Value.FontSizeFactor;
				if (fontSizeFactor.GetValueOrDefault() == fontSizeFactor2.GetValueOrDefault() && fontSizeFactor.HasValue == fontSizeFactor2.HasValue && object.Equals(Length, cSSLineHeight.Value.Length))
				{

		{
			if (specifiedValue.Length != null || specifiedValue.Percentage != null)
			{
				DimensionValue absoluteFontSizeLength = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(cascader);
				if (specifiedValue.Length != null)
				{
					return new CSSLineHeight(specifiedValue.Length.ResolveAbsoluteLength(absoluteFontSizeLength, cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetFontFamily()));

				if (specifiedValue.Percentage != null)

		{
			if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(value as string, "normal"))
			{
				lineHeight = Normal;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is int || value is double)
			{
				double num = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					lineHeight = default(CSSLineHeight);
					return false;
				}
				lineHeight = new CSSLineHeight(num);
				return true;

			{
				lineHeight = new CSSLineHeight(length);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is PercentValue percentage)
			{
				lineHeight = new CSSLineHeight(percentage);
				return true;
			}
			lineHeight = default(CSSLineHeight);
			return false;
		}

			{
				return "normal";
			}

				return FontSizeFactor.Value;

			{

	internal class CSSQuotes
	{
		public static readonly CSSQuotes Default = new CSSQuotes("\"", "\"", "'", "'");

		public static readonly CSSQuotes None = new CSSQuotes();

		private readonly string[] _quotePairs;

		public CSSQuotes(params string[] quotePairs)
		{
			_quotePairs = quotePairs;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CSSQuotes cSSQuotes))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_quotePairs.Length != cSSQuotes._quotePairs.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _quotePairs.Length; i++)
			{
				if (_quotePairs[i] != cSSQuotes._quotePairs[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < _quotePairs.Length; i++)
			{
				num ^= _quotePairs[i].GetHashCode() << i % 16;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_quotePairs.Length == 0)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			return string.Concat(_quotePairs, " ");
		}

		public string GetOpenQuote(int level)
		{
			return GetQuoteHelper(level, 0);
		}

		public string GetCloseQuote(int level)
		{
			return GetQuoteHelper(level, 1);
		}

		private string GetQuoteHelper(int level, int offset)
		{
			if (level < 0 || _quotePairs.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = level * 2;
			if (_quotePairs.Length <= num)
			{
				num = _quotePairs.Length - 2;
			}
			return _quotePairs[num + offset];
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (_quotePairs.Length == 0)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			return _quotePairs;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSQuotes quotes)
		{
			if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(value as string, "none"))
			{
				quotes = None;
				return true;
			}
			quotes = null;
			object[] array = value as object[];
			if (array.Length % 2 != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] array2 = new string[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!(array[i] is StringLiteral stringLiteral))
				{
					return false;
				}
				array2[i] = stringLiteral.Value;
			}
			quotes = new CSSQuotes(array2);
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class CSSValueEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<object>
	{
		public static readonly IEqualityComparer<object> Instance = new CSSValueEqualityComparer();

		private CSSValueEqualityComparer()
		{
		}

		bool IEqualityComparer<object>.Equals(object x, object y)
		{
			Array array = x as Array;
			Array array2 = y as Array;
			if (array != null && array2 != null)
			{
				if (array.Length != array2.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!object.Equals(array.GetValue(i), array2.GetValue(i)))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return object.Equals(x, y);
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<object>.GetHashCode(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Array array)
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					num ^= array.GetValue(i).GetHashCode() << i % 16;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return obj.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		{
			Length = null;
			Percentage = null;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CSSVerticalAlign? cSSVerticalAlign = obj as CSSVerticalAlign?;
			if (cSSVerticalAlign.HasValue && object.Equals(Length, cSSVerticalAlign.Value.Length) && object.Equals(Percentage, cSSVerticalAlign.Value.Percentage))
			{
				return Type == cSSVerticalAlign.Value.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length.GetHashCode() << 8;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage.GetHashCode() << 12;
			}
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.GetHashCode() << 16;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToCSSValue().ToString();
		}

		public static CSSVerticalAlign GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<CSSVerticalAlign> property, CSSVerticalAlign specifiedValue)
		{
			if (specifiedValue.Type.HasValue)
			{
				return specifiedValue;
			}
			DimensionValue absoluteFontSizeLength = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetAbsoluteFontSizeLength(cascader);
			if (specifiedValue.Percentage != null)
			{
				CSSLineHeight value = CSSPropertyTable.LineHeight.GetValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle);
				return new CSSVerticalAlign(specifiedValue.Percentage.ResolveAbsoluteLength(value, absoluteFontSizeLength));
			}
			if (specifiedValue.Length != null)
			{
				return new CSSVerticalAlign(specifiedValue.Length.ResolveAbsoluteLength(absoluteFontSizeLength, cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetFontFamily()));
			}
			return specifiedValue;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out CSSVerticalAlign width)
		{
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseLength(value, allowNegative: true, out var length))
			{
				width = new CSSVerticalAlign(length);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is PercentValue percentage)
			{
				width = new CSSVerticalAlign(percentage);
				return true;
			}
			if (CSSUtilities.TryParseVerticalAlignType(value, out var type))
			{
				width = new CSSVerticalAlign(type);
				return true;
			}
			width = default(CSSVerticalAlign);
			return false;
		}

		public object ToCSSValue()
		{
			if (Length != null)
			{
				return Length;
			}
			if (Percentage != null)
			{
				return Percentage;
			}
			if (Type.HasValue)
			{
				return Type.Value.ToCSSText();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal class DimensionValue
	{
		public static readonly DimensionValue ZeroPoints = new DimensionValue(0.0, "pt");

		public readonly string Unit;

		public readonly double Value;

		public DimensionValue(double value, string unit)
		{
			Unit = unit;
			Value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DimensionValue dimensionValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Value != dimensionValue.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Value != 0.0)
			{
				return StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(Unit, dimensionValue.Unit);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Value == 0.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.GetHashCode(Unit) ^ Value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Math.Abs(Value) < 0.0001)
			{
				return "0" + Unit;
			}
			return Value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + Unit;
		}

		public static DimensionValue operator *(double x, DimensionValue y)
		{
			return new DimensionValue(x * y.Value, y.Unit);
		}

		public static DimensionValue operator *(DimensionValue x, double y)
		{
			return new DimensionValue(x.Value * y, x.Unit);
		}

		public static DimensionValue operator /(double x, DimensionValue y)
		{
			return new DimensionValue(x / y.Value, y.Unit);
		}

		public static DimensionValue operator /(DimensionValue x, double y)
		{
			return new DimensionValue(x.Value / y, x.Unit);
		}

		public bool HasLengthUnits()
		{
			switch (Unit.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "pt":
			case "cm":
			case "mm":
			case "in":
			case "pc":
			case "px":
			case "em":
			case "ex":
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DimensionValue ResolveAbsoluteLength(DimensionValue baseFontSize, CSSFontFamily fontFamily)
		{
			switch (Unit.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "pt":
			case "cm":
			case "mm":
			case "in":
			case "pc":
			case "px":
				return this;
			case "em":
				return new DimensionValue(baseFontSize.Value * Value, baseFontSize.Unit);
			case "ex":
				return new DimensionValue(baseFontSize.Value * fontFamily.GetXHeight() * Value, baseFontSize.Unit);
			default:
				return this;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class HashValue
	{
		public readonly string Value;

		public HashValue(string value)
		{
			Value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is HashValue hashValue)
			{
				return Value == hashValue.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "#" + Value;
		}
	}
	internal class PercentValue
	{
		public readonly double Value;

		public PercentValue(double value)
		{
			Value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is PercentValue percentValue)
			{
				return Value == percentValue.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Value.ToString("R") + "%";
		}

		public DimensionValue ResolveAbsoluteLength(DimensionValue baseAbsoluteLength)
		{
			return new DimensionValue(baseAbsoluteLength.Value * Value / 100.0, baseAbsoluteLength.Unit);
		}

		public DimensionValue ResolveAbsoluteLength(CSSLineHeight lineHeight, DimensionValue fontSize)
		{
			if (lineHeight.Length != null)
			{
				return new DimensionValue(lineHeight.Length.Value * Value / 100.0, lineHeight.Length.Unit);
			}
			if (lineHeight.FontSizeFactor.HasValue)
			{
				return new DimensionValue(fontSize.Value * lineHeight.FontSizeFactor.Value * Value / 100.0, fontSize.Unit);
			}
			if (lineHeight.IsNormal)
			{
				return new DimensionValue(fontSize.Value * 1.17 * Value / 100.0, fontSize.Unit);
			}
			return fontSize;
		}
	}

	internal class UnicodeRangeValue
	{
		public readonly int RangeEnd;

		public readonly int RangeStart;

		public UnicodeRangeValue(int rangeStart, int rangeEnd)
		{
			RangeEnd = rangeEnd;
			RangeStart = rangeStart;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is UnicodeRangeValue unicodeRangeValue && RangeStart == unicodeRangeValue.RangeStart)
			{
				return RangeEnd == unicodeRangeValue.RangeEnd;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return RangeStart | (RangeEnd << 16);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"U+{RangeStart:X2}-{RangeEnd:X2}";
		}
	}
	internal class UrlValue
	{
		public static readonly UrlValue None = new UrlValue(string.Empty);

		public const string FunctionNameLower = "url";

		public readonly string Url;

		public UrlValue(string url)
		{
			Url = url;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is UrlValue urlValue)
			{
				return Url == urlValue.Url;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Url.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Url == string.Empty)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			return string.Format("{0}({1})", "url", CSSUtilities.CreateStringLiteral(Url));
		}

		public static UrlValue GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<UrlValue> property, UrlValue specifiedValue)
		{
			return GetComputedValue(cascader, specifiedValue);
		}

		public static UrlValue GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, UrlValue specifiedValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(specifiedValue.Url))
			{
				return None;
			}
			return specifiedValue;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(object value, out UrlValue url)
		{
			if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(value as string, "none"))
			{
				url = None;
				return true;
			}
			url = value as UrlValue;
			return url != null;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.CSS.Selectors
{
	internal sealed class AttributeSelector : SimpleSelector
	{
		private static readonly char[] _spaceSeparator = new char[1] { ' ' };

		public string AttributeName { get; private set; }

		public AttributeValueComparison Comparison { get; private set; }

		public string ConditionalValue { get; private set; }

		public string NamespacePrefix { get; private set; }

		public AttributeSelector(string attributeName, string namespacePrefix = null, AttributeValueComparison comparison = AttributeValueComparison.AnyValue, string conditionalValue = null)
			: base(new SelectorSpecificity(0, 1, 0))
		{
			AttributeName = attributeName;
			Comparison = comparison;
			ConditionalValue = conditionalValue;
			NamespacePrefix = namespacePrefix;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitAttributeSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = info.ParentStyleSheet.GetNamespace(NamespacePrefix);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (HtmlAttribute item in (IEnumerable<HtmlAttribute>)info.Element.Attributes)
			{
				HtmlUtilities.ParsePrefixedName(item.Name, out var localName, out var prefix);
				if (!string.Equals(localName, AttributeName, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (text == string.Empty)
				{
					if (NamespacePrefix != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (text != "*" && !string.Equals(prefix, NamespacePrefix))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (Comparison == AttributeValueComparison.AnyValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ConditionalValue == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string value = item.Value;
				return Comparison switch
				{
					AttributeValueComparison.EqualsValue => ConditionalValue == value, 
					AttributeValueComparison.ContainsSpaceSeparatedValue => IsConditionalInSpaceSeparatedValue(value, ConditionalValue), 
					AttributeValueComparison.EqualsValueOrStartsWithValueDash => ConditionalValue == value || value.StartsWith(ConditionalValue + "-"), 
					AttributeValueComparison.StartsWithValue => ConditionalValue.Length != 0 && value.StartsWith(ConditionalValue), 
					AttributeValueComparison.EndsWithValue => ConditionalValue.Length != 0 && value.EndsWith(ConditionalValue), 
					AttributeValueComparison.ContainsValue => ConditionalValue.Length != 0 && value.Contains(ConditionalValue), 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is AttributeSelector attributeSelector && string.Equals(NamespacePrefix, attributeSelector.NamespacePrefix, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && string.Equals(AttributeName, attributeSelector.AttributeName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && Comparison == attributeSelector.Comparison)
			{
				return ConditionalValue == attributeSelector.ConditionalValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsConditionalInSpaceSeparatedValue(string value, string conditionalValue)
		{
			string[] array = value.Split(_spaceSeparator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (conditionalValue == text)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum AttributeValueComparison : byte
	{
		AnyValue,
		EqualsValue,
		ContainsSpaceSeparatedValue,
		EqualsValueOrStartsWithValueDash,
		StartsWithValue,
		EndsWithValue,
		ContainsValue
	}
	internal sealed class ClassSelector : SimpleSelector
	{
		public const string ClassNameDelimiter = ".";

		public string ClassName { get; private set; }

		public ClassSelector(string className)
			: base(new SelectorSpecificity(0, 1, 0))
		{
			ClassName = className;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string attributeValue = info.Element.GetAttributeValue("class", null);
			if (attributeValue != null)
			{
				return AttributeSelector.IsConditionalInSpaceSeparatedValue(attributeValue, ClassName);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is ClassSelector classSelector)
			{
				return string.Equals(ClassName, classSelector.ClassName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DescendantCombinatorSelector : SingleElementSelector
	{
		public SingleElementSelector AncestorSelector { get; private set; }

		public SingleElementSelector DescendantSelector { get; private set; }

		public DescendantCombinatorType Type { get; private set; }

		public DescendantCombinatorSelector(SingleElementSelector ancestorSelector, SingleElementSelector descendantSelector, DescendantCombinatorType type)
			: base(ancestorSelector.Specificity + descendantSelector.Specificity)
		{
			AncestorSelector = ancestorSelector;
			DescendantSelector = descendantSelector;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitDescendantCombinatorSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			HtmlNode parentNode = info.Element.ParentNode;
			if (parentNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DescendantSelector.DoesApplyTo(info))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (Type)
			{
			case DescendantCombinatorType.Direct:
				return AncestorSelector.DoesApplyTo(new SelectorQueryInfo(info.ParentStyleSheet, parentNode));
			case DescendantCombinatorType.General:
				while (parentNode != null)
				{
					if (AncestorSelector.DoesApplyTo(new SelectorQueryInfo(info.ParentStyleSheet, parentNode)))
					{
						return true;
					}
					parentNode = parentNode.ParentNode;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is DescendantCombinatorSelector descendantCombinatorSelector && Type == descendantCombinatorSelector.Type && AncestorSelector.IsEquivalentTo(descendantCombinatorSelector.AncestorSelector))
			{
				return DescendantSelector.IsEquivalentTo(descendantCombinatorSelector.DescendantSelector);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum DescendantCombinatorType : byte
	{
		Direct,
		General
	}
	internal sealed class DynamicPseudoClassSelector : PseudoClassSelector
	{
		public DynamicPseudoClassType Type { get; private set; }

		public DynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassType type)
		{
			Type = type;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitDynamicPseudoClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (Type)
			{
			case DynamicPseudoClassType.Link:
				if (!info.Element.IsVisited)
				{
					return IsLink(info.Element);
				}
				return false;
			case DynamicPseudoClassType.Visited:
				if (info.Element.IsVisited)
				{
					return IsLink(info.Element);
				}
				return false;
			case DynamicPseudoClassType.Hover:
				return info.Element.IsHovered;
			case DynamicPseudoClassType.Active:
				return info.Element.IsActive;
			case DynamicPseudoClassType.Focus:
				return info.Element.IsFocused;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is DynamicPseudoClassSelector dynamicPseudoClassSelector)
			{
				return Type == dynamicPseudoClassSelector.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsLink(HtmlNode element)
		{
			if (string.Equals(element.OriginalName, "a", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return element.GetAttributeValue("href", null) != null;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum DynamicPseudoClassType : byte
	{
		Link,
		Visited,
		Hover,
		Active,
		Focus
	}
	internal sealed class IdSelector : SimpleSelector
	{
		public string IdName { get; private set; }

		public IdSelector(string idName)
			: base(new SelectorSpecificity(1, 0, 0))
		{
			IdName = idName;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitIdSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IdName == info.Element.Id;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is IdSelector idSelector)
			{
				return string.Equals(IdName, idSelector.IdName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class LangPseudoClassSelector : PseudoClassSelector
	{
		public const string FunctionNameLower = "lang";

		public string LangName { get; private set; }

		public LangPseudoClassSelector(string langName)
		{
			LangName = langName;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitLangPseudoClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (HtmlNode htmlNode = info.Element; htmlNode != null; htmlNode = htmlNode.ParentNode)
			{
				if (htmlNode.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					string attributeValue = htmlNode.GetAttributeValue("lang", null);
					if (attributeValue != null)
					{
						return DoesLangMatch(attributeValue);
					}
				}
			}
			string defaultLang = info.Element.OwnerDocument.DefaultLang;
			if (defaultLang != null)
			{
				return DoesLangMatch(defaultLang);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool DoesLangMatch(string lang)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(lang, LangName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return lang.StartsWith(LangName + "-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is LangPseudoClassSelector langPseudoClassSelector)
			{
				return string.Equals(LangName, langPseudoClassSelector.LangName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class NegationPseudoClassSelector : PseudoClassSelector
	{
		public const string FunctionNameLower = "not";

		public SimpleSelector Argument { get; private set; }

		public NegationPseudoClassSelector(SimpleSelector argument)
		{
			Argument = argument;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitNegationPseudoClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			return !Argument.DoesApplyTo(info);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is NegationPseudoClassSelector negationPseudoClassSelector)
			{
				return Argument.IsEquivalentTo(negationPseudoClassSelector.Argument);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class NullSingleElementSelector : SingleElementSelector

		public static readonly NullSingleElementSelector Instance = new NullSingleElementSelector();

		private NullSingleElementSelector()
			: base(SelectorSpecificity.Zero)

		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitNullSingleElementSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)

			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			return other is NullSingleElementSelector;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class PseudoClassSelector : SimpleSelector
