		protected PseudoClassSelector()
			: base(new SelectorSpecificity(0, 1, 0))
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class PseudoElementSelector : SingleElementSelector
	{
		public SingleElementSelector BaseSelector { get; private set; }

		public PseudoElementType Type { get; private set; }

		public PseudoElementSelector(SingleElementSelector baseSelector, PseudoElementType type)
			: base(baseSelector.Specificity + new SelectorSpecificity(0, 0, 1))
		{
			BaseSelector = baseSelector;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitPseudoElementSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType == Type)
			{
				return BaseSelector.DoesApplyTo(new SelectorQueryInfo(info.ParentStyleSheet, info.Element));
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is PseudoElementSelector pseudoElementSelector)
			{
				return Type == pseudoElementSelector.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum PseudoElementType
	{
		FirstLine,
		FirstLetter,
		Before,
		After,
		Selection
	}
	internal abstract class Selector
	{
		public abstract void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor);

		public abstract bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info, out SelectorSpecificity specificity);

		public abstract bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other);

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			SerializationContext context = new SerializationContext(stringWriter, isForInlineAttribute: true);
			SerializationSelectorVisitor visitor = new SerializationSelectorVisitor(context);
			Accept(visitor);
			stringWriter.Flush();
			return stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SelectorGroup : Selector
	{
		public List<SingleElementSelector> Selectors { get; private set; }

		public SelectorGroup(List<SingleElementSelector> selectors)
		{
			Selectors = selectors;
		}

		public SelectorGroup(params SingleElementSelector[] selectors)
		{
			Selectors = new List<SingleElementSelector>(selectors);
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitSelectorGroup(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info, out SelectorSpecificity specificity)
		{
			foreach (SingleElementSelector selector in Selectors)
			{
				if (selector.DoesApplyTo(info, out specificity))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			specificity = default(SelectorSpecificity);
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is SelectorGroup selectorGroup && Selectors.Count == selectorGroup.Selectors.Count)
			{
				return Selectors.Zip(selectorGroup.Selectors, (SingleElementSelector a, SingleElementSelector b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal struct SelectorQueryInfo
	{
		public readonly HtmlNode Element;

		public readonly CSSStyleSheet ParentStyleSheet;

		public readonly PseudoElementType? PseudoElementType;

		public SelectorQueryInfo(CSSStyleSheet parentStyleSheet, HtmlNode element, PseudoElementType? pseudoElementType = null)
		{
			Element = element;
			ParentStyleSheet = parentStyleSheet;
			PseudoElementType = pseudoElementType;
		}
	}
	internal struct SelectorSpecificity : IComparable<SelectorSpecificity>
	{
		public static readonly SelectorSpecificity Highest = new SelectorSpecificity(int.MaxValue, int.MaxValue, int.MaxValue);

		public static readonly SelectorSpecificity Zero = default(SelectorSpecificity);

		public readonly int IdSelectorCount;

		public readonly int ClassSelectorCount;

		public readonly int TypeSelectorCount;

		public SelectorSpecificity(int idSelectorCount, int classSelectorCount, int typeSelectorCount)
		{
			IdSelectorCount = idSelectorCount;
			ClassSelectorCount = classSelectorCount;
			TypeSelectorCount = typeSelectorCount;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			SelectorSpecificity? selectorSpecificity = obj as SelectorSpecificity?;
			if (selectorSpecificity.HasValue && IdSelectorCount == selectorSpecificity.Value.IdSelectorCount && ClassSelectorCount == selectorSpecificity.Value.ClassSelectorCount)
			{
				return TypeSelectorCount == selectorSpecificity.Value.TypeSelectorCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return IdSelectorCount * 10000 + ClassSelectorCount * 100 + TypeSelectorCount;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Equals(Highest))
			{
				return "Highest";
			}
			return $"{IdSelectorCount}:{ClassSelectorCount}:{TypeSelectorCount}";
		}

		public static SelectorSpecificity operator +(SelectorSpecificity a, SelectorSpecificity b)
		{
			return new SelectorSpecificity(a.IdSelectorCount + b.IdSelectorCount, a.ClassSelectorCount + b.ClassSelectorCount, a.TypeSelectorCount + b.TypeSelectorCount);
		}

		public int CompareTo(SelectorSpecificity other)
		{
			int num = IdSelectorCount.CompareTo(other.IdSelectorCount);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = ClassSelectorCount.CompareTo(other.ClassSelectorCount);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = TypeSelectorCount.CompareTo(other.TypeSelectorCount);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal class SelectorVisitor
	{
		public virtual void DefaultVisit(Selector selector)
		{
		}

		public virtual void VisitAttributeSelector(AttributeSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitClassSelector(ClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitDescendantCombinatorSelector(DescendantCombinatorSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitDynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitIdSelector(IdSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitLangPseudoClassSelector(LangPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitNegationPseudoClassSelector(NegationPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitNullSingleElementSelector(NullSingleElementSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitPseudoElementSelector(PseudoElementSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitSelectorGroup(SelectorGroup selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitSiblingCombinatorSelector(SiblingCombinatorSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitSimpleSelectorSequence(SimpleSelectorSequence selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitStructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitTargetPseudoClassSelector(TargetPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitTypeSelector(TypeSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitUIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}

		public virtual void VisitUniversalSelector(UniversalSelector selector)
		{
			DefaultVisit(selector);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SelectorWalker : SelectorVisitor
	{
		public override void VisitDescendantCombinatorSelector(DescendantCombinatorSelector selector)
		{
			selector.AncestorSelector.Accept(this);
			selector.DescendantSelector.Accept(this);
		}

		public override void VisitNegationPseudoClassSelector(NegationPseudoClassSelector selector)
		{
			selector.Argument.Accept(this);
		}

		public override void VisitPseudoElementSelector(PseudoElementSelector selector)
		{
			selector.BaseSelector.Accept(this);
		}

		public override void VisitSelectorGroup(SelectorGroup selector)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < selector.Selectors.Count; i++)
			{
				selector.Selectors[i].Accept(this);
			}
		}

		public override void VisitSiblingCombinatorSelector(SiblingCombinatorSelector selector)
		{
			selector.PreviousSelector.Accept(this);
			selector.NextSelector.Accept(this);
		}

		public override void VisitSimpleSelectorSequence(SimpleSelectorSequence selector)
		{
			SimpleSelector[] components = selector.Components;
			foreach (SimpleSelector simpleSelector in components)
			{
				simpleSelector.Accept(this);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SiblingCombinatorSelector : SingleElementSelector
	{
		public SingleElementSelector PreviousSelector { get; private set; }

		public SingleElementSelector NextSelector { get; private set; }

		public SiblingCombinatorType Type { get; private set; }

		public SiblingCombinatorSelector(SingleElementSelector previousSelector, SingleElementSelector nextSelector, SiblingCombinatorType type)
			: base(previousSelector.Specificity + nextSelector.Specificity)
		{
			PreviousSelector = previousSelector;
			NextSelector = nextSelector;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitSiblingCombinatorSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			HtmlNode previousElementSibling = info.Element.GetPreviousElementSibling();
			if (previousElementSibling == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!NextSelector.DoesApplyTo(info))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (Type)
			{
			case SiblingCombinatorType.Direct:
				return PreviousSelector.DoesApplyTo(new SelectorQueryInfo(info.ParentStyleSheet, previousElementSibling));
			case SiblingCombinatorType.General:
				while (previousElementSibling != null)
				{
					if (PreviousSelector.DoesApplyTo(new SelectorQueryInfo(info.ParentStyleSheet, previousElementSibling)))
					{
						return true;
					}
					previousElementSibling = previousElementSibling.GetPreviousElementSibling();
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is SiblingCombinatorSelector siblingCombinatorSelector && Type == siblingCombinatorSelector.Type && PreviousSelector.IsEquivalentTo(siblingCombinatorSelector.PreviousSelector))
			{
				return NextSelector.IsEquivalentTo(siblingCombinatorSelector.NextSelector);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum SiblingCombinatorType : byte
	{
		Direct,
		General
	}
	internal abstract class SimpleSelector : SingleElementSelector
	{
		public SimpleSelector(SelectorSpecificity specificity)
			: base(specificity)
		{
		}

		public SimpleSelectorSequence WithClass(string className)
		{
			return new SimpleSelectorSequence(this, new ClassSelector(className));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SimpleSelectorSequence : SimpleSelector
	{
		public SimpleSelector[] Components { get; private set; }

		public SimpleSelectorSequence(params SimpleSelector[] components)
			: base(CalculateSpecificity(components))
		{
			Components = components;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitSimpleSelectorSequence(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Components.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!Components[i].DoesApplyTo(info))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is SimpleSelectorSequence simpleSelectorSequence && Components.Length == simpleSelectorSequence.Components.Length)
			{
				return Components.Zip(simpleSelectorSequence.Components, (SimpleSelector a, SimpleSelector b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static SelectorSpecificity CalculateSpecificity(SimpleSelector[] components)
		{
			SelectorSpecificity result = default(SelectorSpecificity);
			for (int i = 0; i < components.Length; i++)
			{
				result += components[i].Specificity;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void VerifyComponents()
		{
			for (int i = 1; i < Components.Length; i++)
			{
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SingleElementSelector : Selector
	{
		public readonly SelectorSpecificity Specificity;

		public SingleElementSelector(SelectorSpecificity specificity)
		{
			Specificity = specificity;
		}

		public abstract bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info);

		public sealed override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info, out SelectorSpecificity specificity)
		{
			if (DoesApplyTo(info))
			{
				specificity = Specificity;
				return true;
			}
			specificity = default(SelectorSpecificity);
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class StructuralPseudoClassSelector : PseudoClassSelector
	{
		public ANPlusBExpression NthExpression { get; private set; }

		public StructuralPseudoClassType Type { get; private set; }

		public StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType type, ANPlusBExpression nthExpression = null)
		{
			NthExpression = nthExpression;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitStructuralPseudoClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.Root:
				if (info.Element.ParentNode != null)
				{
					return info.Element.ParentNode.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Document;
				}
				return true;
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.FirstChild:
				return info.Element.IsFirst();
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.LastChild:
				return info.Element.IsLast();
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.OnlyChild:
				if (info.Element.IsFirst())
				{
					return info.Element.IsLast();
				}
				return false;
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.FirstOfType:
				return info.Element.IsFirstOfType();
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.LastOfType:
				return info.Element.IsLastOfType();
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.OnlyOfType:
				if (info.Element.IsFirstOfType())
				{
					return info.Element.IsLastOfType();
				}
				return false;
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.Empty:
				if (info.Element.HasChildNodes)
				{
					return !info.Element.ChildNodes.Any((HtmlNode e) => e.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Comment && !e.IsProcessingInstruction);
				}
				return true;
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.NthChild:
				return IsNth(info.Element.Get1BasedIndexFromStart());
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.NthLastChild:
				return IsNth(info.Element.Get1BasedIndexFromEnd());
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.NthOfType:
				return IsNth(info.Element.Get1BasedIndexOfTypeFromStart());
			case StructuralPseudoClassType.NthLastOfType:
				return IsNth(info.Element.Get1BasedIndexOfTypeFromEnd());
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is StructuralPseudoClassSelector structuralPseudoClassSelector && Type == structuralPseudoClassSelector.Type)
			{
				return object.Equals(NthExpression, structuralPseudoClassSelector.NthExpression);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsNth(int index)
		{
			if (NthExpression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int valueOrDefault = NthExpression.A.GetValueOrDefault();
			int valueOrDefault2 = NthExpression.B.GetValueOrDefault();
			if (valueOrDefault == 0)
			{
				return index == valueOrDefault2;
			}
			int num = index - valueOrDefault2;
			if (num % valueOrDefault != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = num / valueOrDefault;
			return 0 <= num2;
		}
	}
	internal enum StructuralPseudoClassType : byte
	{
		Root,
		NthChild,
		NthLastChild,
		NthOfType,
		NthLastOfType,
		FirstChild,
		LastChild,
		FirstOfType,
		LastOfType,
		OnlyChild,
		OnlyOfType,
		Empty
	}
	internal sealed class TargetPseudoClassSelector : PseudoClassSelector
	{
		public const string ClassNameLower = "target";

		public static readonly TargetPseudoClassSelector Instance = new TargetPseudoClassSelector();

		private TargetPseudoClassSelector()
		{
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitTargetPseudoClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.Element.Id != null)
			{
				return info.Element.OwnerDocument.TargetId == info.Element.Id;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			return other is TargetPseudoClassSelector;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TypeSelector : SimpleSelector
	{
		public string ElementName { get; private set; }

		public string NamespacePrefix { get; private set; }

		public TypeSelector(string elementName, string namespacePrefix = null)
			: base(new SelectorSpecificity(0, 0, 1))
		{
			ElementName = elementName;
			NamespacePrefix = namespacePrefix;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitTypeSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (info.PseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = info.ParentStyleSheet.GetNamespace(NamespacePrefix);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				return ElementName.Equals(info.Element.OriginalName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			if (text == "*")
			{
				return DoesLocalNameMatch(info.Element);
			}
			string text2 = NamespacePrefix + ":" + ElementName;
			return text2.Equals(info.Element.OriginalName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is TypeSelector typeSelector && string.Equals(NamespacePrefix, typeSelector.NamespacePrefix, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Equals(ElementName, typeSelector.ElementName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool DoesLocalNameMatch(HtmlNode elementNode)
		{
			HtmlUtilities.ParsePrefixedName(elementNode.OriginalName, out var localName, out var _);
			if (string.Equals(localName, ElementName, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector : PseudoClassSelector
	{
		public UIElementState State { get; private set; }

		public UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementState state)
		{
			State = state;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitUIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			if (!IsControlElement(info.Element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (State)
			{
			case UIElementState.Enabled:
				return info.Element.GetAttributeValue("disabled", null) == null;
			case UIElementState.Disabled:
				return info.Element.GetAttributeValue("disabled", null) != null;
			case UIElementState.Checked:
				if (info.Element.Name == "input")
				{
					return info.Element.GetAttributeValue("checked", null) != null;
				}
				return false;
			case UIElementState.Indeterminate:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector uIElementStatePseudoClassSelector)
			{
				return State == uIElementStatePseudoClassSelector.State;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsControlElement(HtmlNode element)
		{
			switch (element.Name)
			{
			case "button":
			case "input":
			case "textarea":
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum UIElementState : byte
	{
		Enabled,
		Disabled,
		Checked,
		Indeterminate
	}
	internal sealed class UniversalSelector : SimpleSelector
	{
		public const string Name = "*";

		public string NamespacePrefix { get; private set; }

		public UniversalSelector(string namespacePrefix = null)
			: base(SelectorSpecificity.Zero)
		{
			NamespacePrefix = namespacePrefix;
		}

		public override void Accept(SelectorVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitUniversalSelector(this);
		}

		public override bool DoesApplyTo(SelectorQueryInfo info)
		{
			string text = info.ParentStyleSheet.GetNamespace(NamespacePrefix);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			HtmlUtilities.ParsePrefixedName(info.Element.Name, out var _, out var prefix);
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				return prefix == null;
			}
			if (text == "*")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return prefix == NamespacePrefix;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Selector other)
		{
			if (other is UniversalSelector universalSelector)
			{
				return string.Equals(NamespacePrefix, universalSelector.NamespacePrefix, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.CSS.Rules
{
	internal sealed class CharsetRule : Rule
	{
		public const string RuleName = "charset";

		public override bool CanStyleElements => false;

		public string Encoding { get; private set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Charset;

		public CharsetRule(string encoding)
		{
			Encoding = encoding;
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitCharsetRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is CharsetRule charsetRule)
			{
				return Encoding.Equals(charsetRule.Encoding);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class FontFaceRule : Rule
	{
		public const string RuleName = "font-face";

		public override bool CanStyleElements => false;

		public StyleDeclarationBlock Style { get; private set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.FontFace;

		public FontFaceRule()
		{
			Style = new StyleDeclarationBlock(this);
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitFontFaceRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is FontFaceRule fontFaceRule)
			{
				return Style.IsEquivalentTo(fontFaceRule.Style);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class GroupingRule : Rule, IRuleOwner
	{
		public sealed override bool CanStyleElements => true;

		public RuleList Rules { get; private set; }

		protected GroupingRule()
		{
			Rules = new RuleList(this);
		}

		void IRuleOwner.OnRuleAdded(IRuleOwner sender, Rule rule)
		{
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				base.Owner.OnRuleAdded(sender, rule);
			}
		}

		void IRuleOwner.OnRuleRemove(IRuleOwner sender, Rule rule)
		{
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				base.Owner.OnRuleRemove(sender, rule);
			}
		}

		internal override void SetOwner(IRuleOwner owner)
		{
			base.SetOwner(owner);
			foreach (Rule rule in Rules)
			{
				rule.SetOwner(this);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ImportRule : Rule
	{
		public const string RuleName = "import";

		public override bool CanStyleElements => true;

		public string HRef { get; private set; }

		public MediaList Media { get; private set; }

		public CSSStyleSheet StyleSheet { get; private set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Import;

		public ImportRule(string href, MediaList media, CSSStyleSheet styleSheet = null)
		{
			HRef = href;
			Media = media;
			StyleSheet = styleSheet;
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitImportRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is ImportRule importRule && string.Equals(HRef, importRule.HRef, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return Media.IsEquivalentTo(importRule.Media);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void LoadStyleSheet(CSSStyleSheet owningStyleSheet, string sourcePath, Uri baseUri = null)
		{
			if (HRef == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string resolvedPath;
			using Stream stream = Utilities.TryGetFileStream(sourcePath, HRef, out resolvedPath);
			if (stream != null)
			{
				StyleSheet = StyleSheetParser.ParseCSSStyleSheet(new ParseContext
				{
					ReferringStyleSheet = owningStyleSheet,
					FilePath = resolvedPath
				}, stream, baseUri);
				if (StyleSheet != null)
				{
					StyleSheet.OwnerRule = this;
					StyleSheet.ParentStyleSheet = owningStyleSheet;
					owningStyleSheet.ImportedStyleSheets.Add(StyleSheet);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IRuleOwner
	{
		void OnRuleAdded(IRuleOwner sender, Rule rule);

		void OnRuleRemove(IRuleOwner sender, Rule rule);
	}
	internal sealed class MarginRule : Rule
	{
		public override bool CanStyleElements => false;

		public PageMarginArea Area { get; private set; }

		public string Name => Area.ToCSSText();

		public StyleDeclarationBlock Style { get; private set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Margin;

		public MarginRule(PageMarginArea area)
		{
			Area = area;
			Style = new StyleDeclarationBlock(this);
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitMarginRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is MarginRule marginRule && Area == marginRule.Area)
			{
				return Style.IsEquivalentTo(marginRule.Style);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MediaRule : GroupingRule
	{
		public const string RuleName = "media";

		public MediaList Media { get; private set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Media;

		public MediaRule(MediaList media)
		{
			Media = media;
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitMediaRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is MediaRule mediaRule && base.Rules.Count == mediaRule.Rules.Count && base.Rules.Zip(mediaRule.Rules, (Rule a, Rule b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r))
			{
				return Media.IsEquivalentTo(mediaRule.Media);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class NamespaceRule : Rule
	{
		public const string RuleName = "namespace";

		private readonly string _namespaceUri;

		private readonly string _prefix;

		public override bool CanStyleElements => false;

		public string NamespaceUri => _namespaceUri ?? "";

		public string Prefix => _prefix ?? "";

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Namespace;

		public NamespaceRule(string prefix, string namespaceUri)
		{
			_prefix = prefix;
			_namespaceUri = namespaceUri;
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitNamespaceRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is NamespaceRule namespaceRule && string.Equals(_namespaceUri, namespaceRule._namespaceUri, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Equals(_prefix, namespaceRule._prefix, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class PageRule : GroupingRule
	{
		public const string RuleName = "page";

		public List<PageSelector> PageSelectors { get; private set; }

		public StyleDeclarationBlock Style { get; private set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Page;

		public PageRule(List<PageSelector> pageSelectors)
		{
			PageSelectors = pageSelectors;
			Style = new StyleDeclarationBlock(this);
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitPageRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is PageRule pageRule && PageSelectors.Count == pageRule.PageSelectors.Count && PageSelectors.Zip(pageRule.PageSelectors, (PageSelector a, PageSelector b) => a.Equals(b)).All((bool r) => r) && base.Rules.Count == pageRule.Rules.Count && base.Rules.Zip(pageRule.Rules, (Rule a, Rule b) => a.IsEquivalentTo(b)).All((bool r) => r))
			{
				return Style.IsEquivalentTo(pageRule.Style);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class Rule
	{
		public abstract bool CanStyleElements { get; }

		public IRuleOwner Owner
		{
			get
			{
				if (ParentRule != null)
				{
					return ParentRule;
				}
				if (ParentStyleSheet != null)
				{
					return ParentStyleSheet;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public GroupingRule ParentRule { get; private set; }

		public CSSStyleSheet ParentStyleSheet { get; private set; }

		public abstract RuleType Type { get; }

		public Rule()
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			Accept(new SerializationRuleVisitor(new SerializationContext(stringWriter)));
			return stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
		}

		public abstract void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor);

		public abstract bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other);

		internal virtual void SetOwner(IRuleOwner owner)
		{
			ParentRule = owner as GroupingRule;
			if (ParentRule != null)
			{
				ParentStyleSheet = ParentRule.ParentStyleSheet;
			}
			else
			{
				ParentStyleSheet = owner as CSSStyleSheet;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RuleList : IEnumerable<Rule>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly IRuleOwner _owner;

		private readonly List<Rule> _rules;

		public int Count => _rules.Count;

		public Rule this[int index] => _rules[index];

		public RuleList(IRuleOwner owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_rules = new List<Rule>();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _rules.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(Rule rule)
		{
			Insert(Count, rule);
		}

		public IEnumerator<Rule> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _rules.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Rule rule)
		{
			_rules.Insert(index, rule);
			rule.SetOwner(_owner);
			_owner.OnRuleAdded(_owner, rule);
		}

		public bool Remove(Rule rule)
		{
			int num = _rules.IndexOf(rule);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Rule rule = _rules[index];
			_rules.RemoveAt(index);
			rule.SetOwner(null);
			_owner.OnRuleRemove(_owner, rule);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class RuleVisitor
	{
		public virtual void DefaultVisit(Rule rule)
		{
		}

		public virtual void VisitCharsetRule(CharsetRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitFontFaceRule(FontFaceRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitImportRule(ImportRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitMarginRule(MarginRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitMediaRule(MediaRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitNamespaceRule(NamespaceRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitPageRule(PageRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}

		public virtual void VisitStyleRule(StyleRule rule)
		{
			DefaultVisit(rule);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class StyleRule : Rule
	{
		public override bool CanStyleElements => true;

		public Selector Selector { get; private set; }

		public StyleDeclarationBlock Style { get; set; }

		public override RuleType Type => RuleType.Style;

		public StyleRule(Selector selector)
		{
			Selector = selector;
			Style = new StyleDeclarationBlock(this);
		}

		public override void Accept(RuleVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitStyleRule(this);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(Rule other)
		{
			if (other is StyleRule styleRule && Selector.IsEquivalentTo(styleRule.Selector))
			{
				return Style.IsEquivalentTo(styleRule.Style);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class CSSPropertyTableBase
	{
		private Dictionary<string, PropertyDefinitionBase> _allProperties = new Dictionary<string, PropertyDefinitionBase>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);

		private List<SinglePropertyDefinitionBase> _singleProperties = new List<SinglePropertyDefinitionBase>();

		public IEnumerable<SinglePropertyDefinitionBase> GetSingleProperties()
		{
			return _singleProperties;
		}

		public PropertyDefinitionBase GetProperty(string name)
		{
			if (_allProperties.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return UnknownPropertyDefinition.Instance;
		}

		protected static Func<T, object> IdentityConversion<T>()
		{
			return (T v) => v;
		}

		protected T Add<T>(T definition) where T : PropertyDefinitionBase
		{
			_allProperties[definition.Name] = definition;
			return definition;
		}

		protected SinglePropertyDefinition<T> AddProp<T>(string name, T initialValue, bool isInherited, TryParseValueDelegate<T> tryParseCallback, Func<T, object> toCSSValueCallback)
		{
			return AddProp(name, initialValue, isInherited, tryParseCallback, toCSSValueCallback, null, isComputedValueContextAgnostic: true);
		}

		protected SinglePropertyDefinition<T> AddProp<T>(string name, T initialValue, bool isInherited, TryParseValueDelegate<T> tryParseCallback, Func<T, object> toCSSValueCallback, Func<CSSCascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<T>, T, T> getComputedValueCallback, bool isComputedValueContextAgnostic)
		{
			SinglePropertyDefinition<T> singlePropertyDefinition = new SinglePropertyDefinition<T>(_singleProperties.Count, name, initialValue, isInherited, tryParseCallback, toCSSValueCallback, getComputedValueCallback, isComputedValueContextAgnostic);
			_singleProperties.Add(singlePropertyDefinition);
			return Add(singlePropertyDefinition);
		}

		protected SinglePropertyDefinition<T> AddProp<T>(string name, SinglePropertyDefinition<T> initialValueProperty, bool isInherited, TryParseValueDelegate<T> tryParseCallback, Func<T, object> toCSSValueCallback)
		{
			SinglePropertyDefinition<T> singlePropertyDefinition = new SinglePropertyDefinition<T>(_singleProperties.Count, name, initialValueProperty, isInherited, tryParseCallback, toCSSValueCallback, null);
			_singleProperties.Add(singlePropertyDefinition);
			return Add(singlePropertyDefinition);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DelimiterPlaceholderProperty : PropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		public static readonly DelimiterPlaceholderProperty Slash = new DelimiterPlaceholderProperty("/");

		private readonly string _delimiter;

		private DelimiterPlaceholderProperty(string delimiter)
			: base(delimiter)
		{
			_delimiter = delimiter;
		}

		public override void AddDeclaredValues(List<CSSCascader.DeclarationInfo> declarations, object valueRaw, DeclarationOrigin origin, SelectorSpecificity specificity, int scopeLevel)
		{
		}

		protected override void AddDeclaredValuesOnStyleAttributeCore(StyleDeclarationBlock style, object declaredValue, bool isImportant)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(object declaredValue)
		{
			return _delimiter.Equals(declaredValue);
		}

		public override bool CanParseSingleValue(object valueRaw)
		{
			return _delimiter.Equals(valueRaw);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class FourSidesPropertyDefinition : ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		public FourSidesPropertyDefinition(string name, PropertyDefinitionBase topProperty, PropertyDefinitionBase rightProperty, PropertyDefinitionBase bottomProperty, PropertyDefinitionBase leftProperty)
			: base(name, topProperty, rightProperty, bottomProperty, leftProperty)
		{
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>> GetSubDeclarations(object value, bool isValueRaw)
		{
			object[] array = value as object[];
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new object[1] { value };
			}
			if (array.Length != 1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (CSSUtilities.IsCSSWideValue(array[i]))
					{
						yield break;
					}
				}
			}
			PropertyDefinitionBase key = SubProperties[0];
			PropertyDefinitionBase rightProperty = SubProperties[1];
			PropertyDefinitionBase bottomProperty = SubProperties[2];
			PropertyDefinitionBase leftProperty = SubProperties[3];
			object leftValue;
			object bottomValue;
			object rightValue;
			object topValue;
			switch (array.Length)
			{
			default:
				yield break;
			case 1:
			{
				object obj;
				leftValue = (obj = array[0]);
				bottomValue = (obj = obj);
				rightValue = (obj = obj);
				topValue = obj;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				object obj;
				bottomValue = (obj = array[0]);
				topValue = obj;
				rightValue = (obj = array[1]);
				leftValue = obj;
				break;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				topValue = array[0];
				object obj;
				rightValue = (obj = array[1]);
				leftValue = obj;
				bottomValue = array[2];
				break;
			}
			case 4:
				topValue = array[0];
				rightValue = array[1];
				bottomValue = array[2];
				leftValue = array[3];
				break;
			}
			yield return new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(key, topValue);
			yield return new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(rightProperty, rightValue);
			yield return new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(bottomProperty, bottomValue);
			yield return new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(leftProperty, leftValue);
		}

		public override StyleDeclaration TryMergeSubProperties(CSSCascader cascader, StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			int num = style.IndexOf(SubProperties[0].Name);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = style.IndexOf(SubProperties[1].Name);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num3 = style.IndexOf(SubProperties[2].Name);
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num4 = style.IndexOf(SubProperties[3].Name);
			if (num4 < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = style[num];
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration2 = style[num2];
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration3 = style[num3];
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration4 = style[num4];
			if (styleDeclaration.IsImportant != styleDeclaration2.IsImportant || styleDeclaration.IsImportant != styleDeclaration3.IsImportant || styleDeclaration.IsImportant != styleDeclaration4.IsImportant)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(styleDeclaration4.Value, styleDeclaration2.Value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			object value = ((!CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(styleDeclaration.Value, styleDeclaration3.Value)) ? new object[3] { styleDeclaration.Value, styleDeclaration4.Value, styleDeclaration3.Value } : ((!CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(styleDeclaration.Value, styleDeclaration4.Value)) ? new object[2] { styleDeclaration.Value, styleDeclaration4.Value } : styleDeclaration.Value));
			int index = Math.Min(num, Math.Min(num4, Math.Min(num3, num2)));
			style.Remove(SubProperties[0].Name);
			style.Remove(SubProperties[1].Name);
			style.Remove(SubProperties[2].Name);
			style.Remove(SubProperties[3].Name);
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration5 = new StyleDeclaration(Name, value, styleDeclaration.IsImportant);
			style.Insert(index, styleDeclaration5);
			return styleDeclaration5;
		}
	}

			StyleName = mSOPropertyTable.AddProp("mso-style-name", string.Empty, isInherited: false, CSSUtilities.TryParseTextOrStringLiteral, CSSPropertyTableBase.IdentityConversion<string>());

		}
	}
	internal abstract class PropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		private List<ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase> _owningShorthandProperties;

		public readonly string Name;

		public virtual bool IsKnown => true;

		public bool IsInShorthandProperty => _owningShorthandProperties != null;

		protected PropertyDefinitionBase(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Property: " + Name;
		}

		public abstract void AddDeclaredValues(List<CSSCascader.DeclarationInfo> declarations, object valueRaw, DeclarationOrigin origin, SelectorSpecificity specificity, int scopeLevel);

		public void AddDeclaredValuesOnStyle(StyleDeclarationBlock style, object declaredValue, bool isImportant = false)
		{
			if (declaredValue != null)
			{
				AddDeclaredValuesOnStyleAttributeCore(style, declaredValue, isImportant);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void AddDeclaredValuesOnStyleAttributeCore(StyleDeclarationBlock style, object declaredValue, bool isImportant);

		public abstract bool CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(object declaredValue);

		public abstract bool CanParseSingleValue(object valueRaw);

		public IEnumerable<ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase> GetOwningShorthandProperties()
		{
			if (_owningShorthandProperties != null)
			{
				return _owningShorthandProperties;
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase>();
		}

		public void OnAddedToShorthandProperty(ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase property)
		{
			if (_owningShorthandProperties == null)
			{
				_owningShorthandProperties = new List<ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase>();
			}
			_owningShorthandProperties.Add(property);
		}
	}
	internal class ShorthandPropertyDefinition : ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase> _pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static List<SinglePropertyDefinitionBase> _skippedSubPropertiesInMerge;

		private readonly bool _isOrderRequired;

		private readonly Dictionary<PropertyDefinitionBase, PropertyDefinitionBase> _dependentPropertyPairs;

		private readonly HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase> _requiredProperties;

		public ShorthandPropertyDefinition(string name, params PropertyDefinitionBase[] subProperties)
			: this(name, isOrderRequired: true, subProperties)
		{
		}

		public ShorthandPropertyDefinition(string name, bool isOrderRequired, params PropertyDefinitionBase[] subProperties)
			: base(name, subProperties)
		{
			_isOrderRequired = isOrderRequired;
			_dependentPropertyPairs = new Dictionary<PropertyDefinitionBase, PropertyDefinitionBase>();
			_requiredProperties = new HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase>();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>> GetSubDeclarations(object value, bool isValueRaw)
		{
			object[] values = value as object[];
			if (values == null)
			{
				values = new object[1] { value };
			}
			if (values.Length == 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (values.Length == 1)
			{
				object onlyValue = values[0];
				if (CSSUtilities.IsCSSWideValue(onlyValue))
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < SubProperties.Length; i++)
					{
						yield return new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(SubProperties[i], onlyValue);
					}
					yield break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < values.Length; j++)
				{
					if (CSSUtilities.IsCSSWideValue(values[j]))
					{
						yield break;
					}
				}
			}
			List<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>> list = ExpandValues(values, isValueRaw);
			if (list != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object> item in list)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_isOrderRequired)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (IEnumerable<object> item2 in PermuteValues(values))
				{
					list = ExpandValues(item2.ToArray(), isValueRaw);
					if (list == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object> item3 in list)
					{
						yield return item3;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>> PermuteValues<T>(IEnumerable<T> items)
		{
			return from p in Enumerable.Range(0, Enumerable.Range(2, items.Count() - 1).Aggregate((int a, int b) => a * b))
				let mods = (from m in Enumerable.Range(2, items.Count() - 1)
					select p % m).ToArray()
				select mods.Aggregate(items.Take(1).ToArray(), (T[] s, int i) => s.Take(i).Concat(items.Skip(s.Length).Take(1)).Concat(s.Skip(i))
					.ToArray());
		}

		public ShorthandPropertyDefinition SetRequiredProperties(params PropertyDefinitionBase[] requiredProperties)
		{
			_requiredProperties.UnionWith(requiredProperties);
			return this;
		}

		public ShorthandPropertyDefinition SetDependentPropertyPair(PropertyDefinitionBase property1, PropertyDefinitionBase property2)
		{
			_dependentPropertyPairs.Add(property1, property2);
			_dependentPropertyPairs.Add(property2, property1);
			return this;
		}

		private List<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>> ExpandValues(object[] values, bool areValuesRaw)
		{
			List<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>>();
			HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase> hashSet = null;
			int num = 0;
			object obj = values[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < SubProperties.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinitionBase propertyDefinitionBase = SubProperties[i];
				if (!"initial".Equals(obj) && (areValuesRaw ? propertyDefinitionBase.CanParseSingleValue(obj) : propertyDefinitionBase.CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(obj)))
				{
					if (_dependentPropertyPairs.ContainsKey(propertyDefinitionBase))
					{
						if (hashSet == null)
						{
							hashSet = new HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase>();
						}
						hashSet.Add(propertyDefinitionBase);
					}
					list.Add(new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(propertyDefinitionBase, obj));
					obj = ((++num >= values.Length) ? "initial" : values[num]);
				}
				else
				{
					if (_requiredProperties.Contains(propertyDefinitionBase))
					{
						return null;
					}
					list.Add(new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(propertyDefinitionBase, "initial"));
				}
			}
			PropertyDefinitionBase propertyDefinitionBase2 = SubProperties[SubProperties.Length - 1];
			int num2 = values.Length - num;
			if (0 < num2)
			{
				object obj2;
				if (num2 == 1)
				{
					obj2 = values[num];
				}
				else
				{
					object[] array = new object[num2];
					Array.Copy(values, num, array, 0, num2);
					obj2 = array;
				}
				if (!(areValuesRaw ? propertyDefinitionBase2.CanParseSingleValue(obj2) : propertyDefinitionBase2.CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(obj2)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_dependentPropertyPairs.ContainsKey(propertyDefinitionBase2))
				{
					if (hashSet == null)
					{
						hashSet = new HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase>();
					}
					hashSet.Add(propertyDefinitionBase2);
				}
				list.Add(new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(propertyDefinitionBase2, obj2));
			}
			else
			{
				if (_requiredProperties.Contains(propertyDefinitionBase2))
				{
					return null;
				}
				list.Add(new KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>(propertyDefinitionBase2, "initial"));
			}
			if (hashSet != null)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDefinitionBase item in hashSet)
				{
					if (!hashSet.Contains(_dependentPropertyPairs[item]))
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override StyleDeclaration TryMergeSubProperties(CSSCascader cascader, StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			if (!CanMergeSubProperties(cascader, style, computedStyle))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return MergeSubPropertyValues(cascader, style);
		}

		private bool CanMergeSubProperties(CSSCascader cascader, StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			if (_pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge == null)
			{
				_pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge = new HashSet<PropertyDefinitionBase>();
			}
			else
			{
				_pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge.Clear();
			}
			if (_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge == null)
			{
				_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge = new List<SinglePropertyDefinitionBase>();
			}
			else
			{
				_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge.Clear();
			}
			bool? flag = null;
			PropertyDefinitionBase[] subProperties = SubProperties;
			foreach (PropertyDefinitionBase propertyDefinitionBase in subProperties)
			{
				if (propertyDefinitionBase is DelimiterPlaceholderProperty)
				{
					continue;
				}
				StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = style[propertyDefinitionBase.Name];
				object obj2;
				if (styleDeclaration == null)
				{
					if (_requiredProperties.Contains(propertyDefinitionBase))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!(propertyDefinitionBase is SinglePropertyDefinitionBase { IsInherited: false } singlePropertyDefinitionBase))
					{
						return false;
					}
					object computedInitialValue = singlePropertyDefinitionBase.GetComputedInitialValue(cascader);
					object obj = computedStyle?.GetValue(singlePropertyDefinitionBase.Name);
					if (obj != null && !CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(obj, computedInitialValue))
					{
						return false;
					}
					_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge.Add(singlePropertyDefinitionBase);
					obj2 = "initial";
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < _skippedSubPropertiesInMerge.Count; j++)
					{
						if (_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge[j].CanParseSingleValue(styleDeclaration.Value))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge.Clear();
					if (!flag.HasValue)
					{
						flag = styleDeclaration.IsImportant;
					}
					else if (flag != styleDeclaration.IsImportant)
					{
						return false;
					}
					obj2 = styleDeclaration.Value;
				}
				if (obj2 is object[] && propertyDefinitionBase != CSSPropertyTable.FontFamily)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!_pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge.Remove(propertyDefinitionBase) && _dependentPropertyPairs.TryGetValue(propertyDefinitionBase, out var value) && !(value is DelimiterPlaceholderProperty))
				{
					_pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge.Add(value);
				}
			}
			bool result = _pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge.Count == 0;
			_pendingDependentPropertiesInMerge.Clear();
			_skippedSubPropertiesInMerge.Clear();
			return result;
		}

		private StyleDeclaration MergeSubPropertyValues(CSSCascader cascader, StyleDeclarationBlock style)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			bool isImportant = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < SubProperties.Length; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinitionBase propertyDefinitionBase = SubProperties[i];
				if (propertyDefinitionBase is DelimiterPlaceholderProperty)
				{
					if (!_dependentPropertyPairs.TryGetValue(propertyDefinitionBase, out var value) || style[value.Name] != null)
					{
						list.Add(propertyDefinitionBase.Name);
					}
					continue;
				}
				int num2 = style.IndexOf(propertyDefinitionBase.Name);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = style[num2];
					isImportant = styleDeclaration.IsImportant;
					num = Math.Min(num, num2);
					style.RemoveAt(num2);
					if (styleDeclaration.Value is object[] collection)
					{
						list.AddRange(collection);
						break;
					}
					list.Add(styleDeclaration.Value);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration2 = new StyleDeclaration(Name, list.ToArray(), isImportant);
			style.Insert(num, styleDeclaration2);
			return styleDeclaration2;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase : PropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		public readonly PropertyDefinitionBase[] SubProperties;

		protected ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase(string name, params PropertyDefinitionBase[] subProperties)
			: base(name)
		{
			SubProperties = subProperties;
			PropertyDefinitionBase[] subProperties2 = SubProperties;
			foreach (PropertyDefinitionBase propertyDefinitionBase in subProperties2)
			{
				propertyDefinitionBase.OnAddedToShorthandProperty(this);
			}
		}

		public sealed override void AddDeclaredValues(List<CSSCascader.DeclarationInfo> declarations, object valueRaw, DeclarationOrigin origin, SelectorSpecificity specificity, int scopeLevel)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object> subDeclaration in GetSubDeclarations(valueRaw, isValueRaw: true))
			{
				subDeclaration.Key.AddDeclaredValues(declarations, subDeclaration.Value, origin, specificity, scopeLevel);
			}
		}

		protected sealed override void AddDeclaredValuesOnStyleAttributeCore(StyleDeclarationBlock style, object declaredValue, bool isImportant)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object> subDeclaration in GetSubDeclarations(declaredValue, isValueRaw: false))
			{
				subDeclaration.Key.AddDeclaredValuesOnStyle(style, subDeclaration.Value, isImportant);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(object declaredValue)
		{
			if (declaredValue is object[])
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < SubProperties.Length; i++)
			{
				if (SubProperties[i].CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(declaredValue))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanParseSingleValue(object value)
		{
			if (value is object[])
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < SubProperties.Length; i++)
			{
				if (SubProperties[i].CanParseSingleValue(value))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<PropertyDefinitionBase, object>> GetSubDeclarations(object value, bool isValueRaw);

		public virtual StyleDeclaration TryMergeSubProperties(CSSCascader cascader, StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class SinglePropertyDefinition<T> : SinglePropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		private readonly bool _hasInitialValue;

		private readonly bool _isComputedValueContextAgnostic;

		private readonly bool _isInherited;

		private readonly T _initialValue;

		private readonly object _initialValueComputed;

		private readonly SinglePropertyDefinition<T> _initialValueProperty;

		private readonly Func<CSSCascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<T>, T, T> _getComputedValueCallback;

		private readonly TryParseValueDelegate<T> _tryParseCallback;

		private readonly Func<T, object> _toCSSValueCallback;

		private bool CanUseUnsetValue
		{
			get
			{
				if ((object)this != CSSPropertyTable.CounterIncrement)
				{
					return (object)this == CSSPropertyTable.CounterReset;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public T InitialValue => _initialValue;

		public override bool IsInherited => _isInherited;

		private SinglePropertyDefinition(int indexInPropertyTable, string name, bool isInherited, TryParseValueDelegate<T> tryParseCallback, Func<T, object> toCSSValueCallback, Func<CSSCascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<T>, T, T> getComputedValueCallback, bool isComputedValueContextAgnostic)
			: base(indexInPropertyTable, name)
		{
			_getComputedValueCallback = getComputedValueCallback ?? ((Func<CSSCascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<T>, T, T>)((CSSCascader c, SinglePropertyDefinition<T> p, T s) => s));
			_isComputedValueContextAgnostic = isComputedValueContextAgnostic;
			_isInherited = isInherited;
			_toCSSValueCallback = toCSSValueCallback;
			_tryParseCallback = tryParseCallback;
		}

		public SinglePropertyDefinition(int indexInPropertyTable, string name, T initialValue, bool isInherited, TryParseValueDelegate<T> tryParseCallback, Func<T, object> toCSSValueCallback, Func<CSSCascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<T>, T, T> getComputedValueCallback, bool isComputedValueContextAgnostic)
			: this(indexInPropertyTable, name, isInherited, tryParseCallback, toCSSValueCallback, getComputedValueCallback, isComputedValueContextAgnostic)
		{
			_hasInitialValue = true;
			_initialValue = initialValue;
			if (isComputedValueContextAgnostic)
			{
				_initialValueComputed = _getComputedValueCallback(null, this, _initialValue);
			}
		}

		public SinglePropertyDefinition(int indexInPropertyTable, string name, SinglePropertyDefinition<T> initialValueProperty, bool isInherited, TryParseValueDelegate<T> tryParseCallback, Func<T, object> toCSSValueCallback, Func<CSSCascader, SinglePropertyDefinition<T>, T, T> getComputedValueCallback)
			: this(indexInPropertyTable, name, isInherited, tryParseCallback, toCSSValueCallback, getComputedValueCallback, isComputedValueContextAgnostic: false)
		{
			_initialValueProperty = initialValueProperty;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertSingleValueToCSSValue(object declaredValue)
		{
			return declaredValue is T;
		}

		public override bool CanParseSingleValue(object valueRaw)
		{
			T result;
			return _tryParseCallback(valueRaw, out result);
		}

		protected override StyleDeclaration CreateStyleDeclaration(object value, bool isImportant = false)
		{
			if (value is T)
			{
				return new StyleDeclaration(Name, _toCSSValueCallback((T)value), isImportant);
			}
			CSSUtilities.IsCSSWideValue(value);
			return new StyleDeclaration(Name, value, isImportant);
		}

		public override object GetComputedInitialValue(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			if (_initialValueComputed != null)
			{
				return _initialValueComputed;
			}
			if (_hasInitialValue)
			{
				return _getComputedValueCallback(cascader, this, _initialValue);
			}
			if (_initialValueProperty != null)
			{
				if (cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle != null)
				{
					object value = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetValue(_initialValueProperty.Name);
					if (value is T)
					{
						return _getComputedValueCallback(cascader, this, (T)value);
					}
				}
				return _initialValueProperty.GetComputedInitialValue(cascader);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, object specifiedValue)
		{
			if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(specifiedValue as string, "inherit"))
			{
				CSSComputedStyleBase finalizingComputedStyleParent = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyleParent;
				if (finalizingComputedStyleParent != null)
				{
					object value = finalizingComputedStyleParent.GetValue(Name);
					if (value != null)
					{
						return value;
					}
				}
				specifiedValue = "initial";
			}
			if (specifiedValue == null || StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(specifiedValue as string, "initial"))
			{
				specifiedValue = GetInitialValue(cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle);
			}
			if (!(specifiedValue is T))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _getComputedValueCallback(cascader, this, (T)specifiedValue);
		}

		public override object GetDeclaredValue(object valueRaw)
		{
			if (CSSUtilities.IsCSSWideValue(valueRaw, !CanUseUnsetValue))
			{
				return valueRaw;
			}
			if (_tryParseCallback(valueRaw, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetSpecifiedValue(object cascadedValue)
		{
			if (!CanUseUnsetValue && StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(cascadedValue as string, "unset"))
			{
				cascadedValue = base.UnsetValue;
			}
			return cascadedValue;
		}

		public T GetValue(HtmlNode element)
		{
			return GetValue(element.ComputedStyle, InitialValue);
		}

		public T GetValue(HtmlNode element, T defaultValue)
		{
			return GetValue(element.ComputedStyle, defaultValue);
		}

		public T GetValue(CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			return GetValue(computedStyle, InitialValue);
		}

		public T GetValue(CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, T defaultValue)
		{
			if (computedStyle != null)
			{
				object value = computedStyle.GetValue(Name);
				if (value is T)
				{
					return (T)value;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private object GetInitialValue(CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			if (_hasInitialValue)
			{
				return _initialValue;
			}
			if (_initialValueProperty != null)
			{
				object value = computedStyle.GetValue(_initialValueProperty.Name);
				if (value is T)
				{
					return (T)value;
				}
				return _initialValueProperty.GetInitialValue(computedStyle);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SinglePropertyDefinitionBase : PropertyDefinitionBase
	{
		private readonly int _indexInPropertyTable;

		public int IndexInPropertyTable => _indexInPropertyTable;

		public abstract bool IsInherited { get; }

		protected string UnsetValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsInherited)
				{
					return "initial";
				}
				return "inherit";
			}
		}

		protected SinglePropertyDefinitionBase(int indexInPropertyTable, string name)
			: base(name)
		{
			_indexInPropertyTable = indexInPropertyTable;
		}

		public sealed override void AddDeclaredValues(List<CSSCascader.DeclarationInfo> declarations, object valueRaw, DeclarationOrigin origin, SelectorSpecificity specificity, int scopeLevel)
		{
			object declaredValue = GetDeclaredValue(valueRaw);
			if (declaredValue != null)
			{
				declarations.Add(new CSSCascader.DeclarationInfo(this, declaredValue, origin, specificity, scopeLevel));
			}
		}

		protected sealed override void AddDeclaredValuesOnStyleAttributeCore(StyleDeclarationBlock style, object declaredValue, bool isImportant)
		{
			StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = CreateStyleDeclaration(declaredValue, isImportant);
			if (styleDeclaration != null)
			{
				style.Add(styleDeclaration);
			}
		}

		protected abstract StyleDeclaration CreateStyleDeclaration(object value, bool isImportant = false);

		public abstract object GetComputedInitialValue(CSSCascader cascader);

		public object GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			object obj = cascader.FinalizingComputedStyle.GetValue(Name);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = UnsetValue;
			}
			return GetComputedValue(cascader, obj);
		}

		public abstract object GetComputedValue(CSSCascader cascader, object specifiedValue);

		public object GetComputedValueFromRaw(CSSCascader cascader, object valueRaw)
		{
			object declaredValue = GetDeclaredValue(valueRaw);
			if (declaredValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetComputedValue(cascader, GetSpecifiedValue(declaredValue));
		}

		public abstract object GetDeclaredValue(object valueRaw);

		public object GetSpecifiedValue(Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues)
		{
			if (cascadedValues == null || !cascadedValues.TryGetValue(Name, out var value))
			{
				return UnsetValue;
			}
			return GetSpecifiedValue(value);
		}

		public abstract object GetSpecifiedValue(object cascadedValue);
	}
