namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.CSS.Parsing
{
	internal abstract class ComponentValue
	{
		public virtual bool IsEOF => false;

		public virtual Token GetToken()
		{
			return Token.EOFToken;
		}

		private object GetTokenValue()
		{
			return GetToken().Value;
		}

		public T GetTokenValue<T>() where T : class
		{
			return GetTokenValue() as T;
		}

		public T? GetTokenValueNullable<T>() where T : struct
		{
			return GetTokenValue() as T?;
		}

		public bool IsDelimiter(string value)
		{
			if (IsToken(TokenType.Delimiter))
			{
				return GetTokenValue<string>() == value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsIdentifierCaseInsensitive(string value)
		{
			if (IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				return string.Equals(GetTokenValue<string>(), value, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public abstract bool IsToken(TokenType type);

		public abstract object ToDeclarationValue(CSSParseContext context, string originalText);

		public abstract IEnumerable<Token> Tokenize();
	}
	internal class ComponentValueTokenizer : ITokenizer
	{
		private readonly IEnumerator<Token> _tokenEnumerable;

		private readonly List<ComponentValue> _values;

		public ComponentValueTokenizer(List<ComponentValue> values)
		{
			_values = values;
			_tokenEnumerable = _values.SelectMany((ComponentValue v) => v.Tokenize()).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public Token ConsumeToken()
		{
			if (_tokenEnumerable.MoveNext())
			{
				return _tokenEnumerable.Current;
			}
			return Token.EOFToken;
		}
	}
	internal class CSSComponentValueParser : ValueParseHelper<ComponentValue>
	{
		private class ComponentValueInfo
		{
			public bool HasTrailingWhitespace;

			public readonly ComponentValue Value;

			public ComponentValueInfo(ComponentValue value, bool hasTrailingWhitespace = false)
			{
				Value = value;
				HasTrailingWhitespace = hasTrailingWhitespace;
			}
		}

		private enum CombinatorType : byte
		{
			DescendantDirect,
			DescendantGeneral,
			SiblingDirect,
			SiblingGeneral
		}

		private const string AnyNamespaceDelimiter = "*";

		private const string NamespaceSeparator = "|";

		private const string NegativeSignText = "-";

		private const string PositiveSignText = "+";

		private readonly Action _onSyntaxErrorAction;

		private readonly string _originalText;

		private readonly CSSParseContext _parseContext;

		public bool HasParseError { get; private set; }

		public CSSComponentValueParser(CSSParseContext parseContext, List<ComponentValue> values, string originalText, Action onSyntaxErrorAction = null)
			: base(values, (ComponentValue)EOFComponentValue.Instance)
		{
			_onSyntaxErrorAction = onSyntaxErrorAction;
			_originalText = originalText;
			_parseContext = parseContext;
		}

		public void ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace()
		{
			while (PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Whitespace))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
			}
		}

		public Rule ParseAtRulePrelude(CSSParseContext context)
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.AtKeyword))
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "font-face":
				return ParseAtFontFaceRule();
			case "import":
				return ParseAtImportRule();
			case "media":
				return ParseAtMediaRule();
			case "namespace":
				return ParseAtNamespaceRule();
			case "page":
				return ParseAtPageRule();
			default:
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void ParseDeclarationBlock(StyleDeclarationBlock declarationBlock)
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			while (true)
			{
				ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
				if (componentValue.IsEOF)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
				{
					OnParseError();
					break;
				}
				StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = ParseDeclaration();
				if (styleDeclaration == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				declarationBlock.Add(styleDeclaration);
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			}
			if (HasParseError)
			{
				declarationBlock.Clear();
			}
		}

		public object ParseExpression()
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			object obj = ParseTerm();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CSSOperator? cSSOperator;
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				cSSOperator = ParseOperator();
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				object obj2 = ParseTerm();
				if (obj2 == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				obj = new CSSBinaryExpression(obj, cSSOperator ?? CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator, obj2);
			}
			if (cSSOperator.HasValue)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public bool ParsePageRuleList(PageRule owningPageRule)
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			while (true)
			{
				ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
				if (componentValue.IsEOF)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.AtKeyword))
				{
					MarginRule marginRule = ParsePageMarginBox();
					if (marginRule != null)
					{
						owningPageRule.Rules.Add(marginRule);
						ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (!componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
				{
					OnParseError();
					break;
				}
				StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = ParseDeclaration();
				if (styleDeclaration == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				owningPageRule.Style.Add(styleDeclaration);
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			}
			return !HasParseError;
		}

		public Selector ParseSelectorsGroup()
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			SingleElementSelector singleElementSelector = ParseSelector();
			if (singleElementSelector == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<SingleElementSelector> list = new List<SingleElementSelector> { singleElementSelector };
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				ConsumeNextValue();
				if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Comma))
				{
					break;
				}
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				singleElementSelector = ParseSelector();
				if (singleElementSelector == null)
				{
					OnParseError();
					break;
				}
				list.Add(singleElementSelector);
			}
			if (!base.IsEOF)
			{
				OnParseError();
			}
			if (HasParseError)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			return new SelectorGroup(list);
		}

		private static SingleElementSelector CreateCombinatorRule(SingleElementSelector previous, CombinatorType combinatorType, SingleElementSelector next)
		{
			return combinatorType switch
			{
				CombinatorType.DescendantGeneral => new DescendantCombinatorSelector(previous, next, DescendantCombinatorType.General), 
				CombinatorType.SiblingDirect => new SiblingCombinatorSelector(previous, next, SiblingCombinatorType.Direct), 
				CombinatorType.SiblingGeneral => new SiblingCombinatorSelector(previous, next, SiblingCombinatorType.General), 
				_ => new DescendantCombinatorSelector(previous, next, DescendantCombinatorType.Direct), 
			};
		}

		private SingleElementSelector CreatePseudoClassSelector(string elementName)
		{
			switch (elementName)
			{
			case "target":
				return TargetPseudoClassSelector.Instance;
			case "enabled":
				return new UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementState.Enabled);
			case "disabled":
				return new UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementState.Disabled);
			case "checked":
				return new UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementState.Checked);
			case "indeterminate":
				return new UIElementStatePseudoClassSelector(UIElementState.Indeterminate);
			case "link":
				return new DynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassType.Link);
			case "visited":
				return new DynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassType.Visited);
			case "hover":
				return new DynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassType.Hover);
			case "active":
				return new DynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassType.Active);
			case "focus":
				return new DynamicPseudoClassSelector(DynamicPseudoClassType.Focus);
			case "root":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.Root);
			case "first-child":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.FirstChild);
			case "last-child":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.LastChild);
			case "first-of-type":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.FirstOfType);
			case "last-of-type":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.LastOfType);
			case "only-child":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.OnlyChild);
			case "only-of-type":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.OnlyOfType);
			case "empty":
				return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(StructuralPseudoClassType.Empty);
			default:
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
		}

		private SingleElementSelector CreatePseudoClassSelector(FunctionComponentValue function)
		{
			string text = function.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (text == "lang" && function.Arguments.Count == 1 && function.Arguments[0].IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				return new LangPseudoClassSelector(function.Arguments[0].GetTokenValue<string>());
			}
			StructuralPseudoClassType? structuralPseudoClassType = GetStructuralPseudoClassType(text);
			if (structuralPseudoClassType.HasValue)
			{
				CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(_parseContext, function.Arguments, _originalText, OnParseError);
				ANPlusBExpression aNPlusBExpression = cSSComponentValueParser.ParseANPlusBExpression();
				if (aNPlusBExpression != null)
				{
					return new StructuralPseudoClassSelector(structuralPseudoClassType.Value, aNPlusBExpression);
				}
			}
			OnParseError();
			return null;
		}

		private SingleElementSelector CreatePseudoElementSelector(SingleElementSelector baseSelector, ParserSnapshot revertPointForMissingBaseSelector, string elementName)
		{
			if (baseSelector == null)
			{
				Revert(revertPointForMissingBaseSelector);
				return null;
			}
			switch (elementName)
			{
			case "first-line":
				return new PseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, PseudoElementType.FirstLine);
			case "first-letter":
				return new PseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, PseudoElementType.FirstLetter);
			case "before":
				return new PseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, PseudoElementType.Before);
			case "after":
				return new PseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, PseudoElementType.After);
			case "selection":
				return new PseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, PseudoElementType.Selection);
			default:
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static int GetSign(string text)
		{
			if (!(text == "+"))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		private static StructuralPseudoClassType? GetStructuralPseudoClassType(string nameLower)
		{
			return nameLower switch
			{
				"nth-child" => StructuralPseudoClassType.NthChild, 
				"nth-last-child" => StructuralPseudoClassType.NthLastChild, 
				"nth-of-type" => StructuralPseudoClassType.NthOfType, 
				"nth-last-of-type" => StructuralPseudoClassType.NthLastOfType, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static bool IsSign(string text)
		{
			if (!(text == "+"))
			{
				return text == "-";
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnParseError()
		{
			HasParseError = true;
			if (_onSyntaxErrorAction != null)
			{
				_onSyntaxErrorAction();
			}
		}

		private ANPlusBExpression ParseANPlusBExpression()
		{
			List<ComponentValueInfo> list = new List<ComponentValueInfo>();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			while (!base.IsEOF)
			{
				if (!(base.CurrentValue is PreservedToken))
				{
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
				if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Whitespace))
				{
					if (list.Count != 0)
					{
						list[list.Count - 1].HasTrailingWhitespace = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(new ComponentValueInfo(base.CurrentValue));
				}
				ConsumeNextValue();
			}
			return list.Count switch
			{
				1 => ParseANPlusBExpression1Value(list), 
				2 => ParseANPlusBExpression2Value(list), 
				3 => ParseANPlusBExpression3Value(list), 
				4 => ParseANPlusBExpression4Value(list), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private ANPlusBExpression ParseANPlusBExpression1Value(List<ComponentValueInfo> significantValues)
		{
			ComponentValue value = significantValues[0].Value;
			if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				string tokenValue = value.GetTokenValue<string>();
				switch (tokenValue.ToLowerInvariant())
				{
				case "even":
					return ANPlusBExpression.Even;
				case "odd":
					return ANPlusBExpression.Odd;
				case "n":
					return new ANPlusBExpression(1, null);
				case "-n":
					return new ANPlusBExpression(-1, null);
				}
				if (TryParseNDashDigitIdentifier(tokenValue, out var number))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(1, number);
				}
				if (TryParseDashNDashDigitIdentifier(tokenValue, out number))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(-1, number);
				}
			}
			else if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Number))
			{
				int? tokenValueNullable = value.GetTokenValueNullable<int>();
				if (tokenValueNullable.HasValue)
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(null, tokenValueNullable);
				}
			}
			else if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Dimension))
			{
				Token token = value.GetToken();
				if (TryParseNDimension(token, out var number2))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(number2, null);
				}
				if (TryParseNDashDigitDimension(token, out number2, out var unitNumber))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(number2, unitNumber);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ANPlusBExpression ParseANPlusBExpression2Value(List<ComponentValueInfo> significantValues)
		{
			ComponentValue value = significantValues[0].Value;
			ComponentValue value2 = significantValues[1].Value;
			if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Delimiter) && value2.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				if (significantValues[0].HasTrailingWhitespace)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string tokenValue = value.GetTokenValue<string>();
				string tokenValue2 = value2.GetTokenValue<string>();
				if (IsSign(tokenValue))
				{
					if (TryParseNDashDigitIdentifier(tokenValue2, out var number))
					{
						return new ANPlusBExpression(GetSign(tokenValue), number);
					}
					if (tokenValue2.ToLowerInvariant() == "n")
					{
						return new ANPlusBExpression(GetSign(tokenValue), null);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Dimension) && value2.IsToken(TokenType.Number))
			{
				Token token = value.GetToken();
				Token token2 = value2.GetToken();
				int number4;
				if (TryParseNDimension(token, out var number2))
				{
					if (TryParseSignedInteger(token2, out var number3))
					{
						return new ANPlusBExpression(number2, number3);
					}
				}
				else if (TryParseNDashDimension(token, out number2) && TryParseSignlessInteger(token2, out number4))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(number2, -number4);
				}
			}
			else if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier) && value2.IsToken(TokenType.Number))
			{
				string text = value.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant();
				Token token3 = value2.GetToken();
				int value3 = ((text[0] != '-') ? 1 : (-1));
				switch (text)
				{
				case "n":
				case "-n":
				{
					if (TryParseSignedInteger(token3, out var number6))
					{
						return new ANPlusBExpression(value3, number6);
					}
					break;
				}
				case "n-":
				case "-n-":
				{
					if (TryParseSignlessInteger(token3, out var number5))
					{
						return new ANPlusBExpression(value3, -number5);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ANPlusBExpression ParseANPlusBExpression3Value(List<ComponentValueInfo> significantValues)
		{
			ComponentValue value = significantValues[0].Value;
			ComponentValue value2 = significantValues[1].Value;
			ComponentValue value3 = significantValues[2].Value;
			if (value.IsDelimiter("+") && value2.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier) && value3.IsToken(TokenType.Number))
			{
				if (significantValues[0].HasTrailingWhitespace)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = value2.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant();
				Token token = value3.GetToken();
				int number2;
				if (text == "n")
				{
					if (TryParseSignedInteger(token, out var number))
					{
						return new ANPlusBExpression(1, number);
					}
				}
				else if (text == "n-" && TryParseSignlessInteger(token, out number2))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(1, -number2);
				}
			}
			else if (value2.IsToken(TokenType.Delimiter) && value3.IsToken(TokenType.Number))
			{
				string tokenValue = value2.GetTokenValue<string>();
				Token token2 = value3.GetToken();
				if (IsSign(tokenValue) && TryParseSignlessInteger(token2, out var number3))
				{
					int value4 = GetSign(tokenValue) * number3;
					if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Dimension))
					{
						Token token3 = value.GetToken();
						if (TryParseNDimension(token3, out var number4))
						{
							return new ANPlusBExpression(number4, value4);
						}
					}
					else if (value.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
					{
						string text2 = value.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant();
						if (text2 == "n")
						{
							return new ANPlusBExpression(1, value4);
						}
						if (text2 == "-n")
						{
							return new ANPlusBExpression(-1, value4);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ANPlusBExpression ParseANPlusBExpression4Value(List<ComponentValueInfo> significantValues)
		{
			ComponentValue value = significantValues[0].Value;
			ComponentValue value2 = significantValues[1].Value;
			ComponentValue value3 = significantValues[2].Value;
			ComponentValue value4 = significantValues[3].Value;
			if (value.IsDelimiter("+") && value2.IsIdentifierCaseInsensitive("n") && value3.IsToken(TokenType.Delimiter) && value4.IsToken(TokenType.Number))
			{
				if (significantValues[0].HasTrailingWhitespace)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string tokenValue = value3.GetTokenValue<string>();
				Token token = value4.GetToken();
				if (IsSign(tokenValue) && TryParseSignlessInteger(token, out var number))
				{
					return new ANPlusBExpression(1, GetSign(tokenValue) * number);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FontFaceRule ParseAtFontFaceRule()
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsEOF)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FontFaceRule();
		}

		private ImportRule ParseAtImportRule()
		{
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Whitespace))
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Url) || base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.String))
			{
				string tokenValue = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
				MediaList media = ParseMediaQueryList(isRequired: false, TokenType.Semicolon);
				ConsumeNextValue();
				if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Semicolon))
				{
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
				return new ImportRule(tokenValue, media);
			}
			OnParseError();
			return null;
		}

		private MediaRule ParseAtMediaRule()
		{
			MediaList mediaList = ParseMediaQueryList(isRequired: true);
			if (mediaList == null)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			return new MediaRule(mediaList);
		}

		private NamespaceRule ParseAtNamespaceRule()
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			string prefix = null;
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				prefix = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				ConsumeNextValue();
			}
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.String) && !base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Url))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string tokenValue = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Semicolon))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsEOF)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new NamespaceRule(prefix, tokenValue);
		}

		private PageRule ParseAtPageRule()
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			List<PageSelector> pageSelectors = ParsePageSelectorList();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.IsEOF)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new PageRule(pageSelectors);
		}

		private AttributeSelector ParseAttrib()
		{
			if (!(PeekNextValue(1) is SimpleBlock { Type: SimpleBlockType.Bracket } simpleBlock))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(_parseContext, simpleBlock.Values, _originalText, OnParseError);
			string namespacePrefix = cSSComponentValueParser.ParseNamespacePrefix();
			cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeNextValue();
			if (cSSComponentValueParser.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				string tokenValue = cSSComponentValueParser.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
				cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				string text = null;
				cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeNextValue();
				AttributeValueComparison? attributeValueComparison;
				if (cSSComponentValueParser.IsEOF)
				{
					attributeValueComparison = AttributeValueComparison.AnyValue;
					text = null;
				}
				else
				{
					ComponentValue currentValue = cSSComponentValueParser.CurrentValue;
					attributeValueComparison = (currentValue.IsToken(TokenType.PrefixMatch) ? new AttributeValueComparison?(AttributeValueComparison.StartsWithValue) : (currentValue.IsToken(TokenType.SuffixMatch) ? new AttributeValueComparison?(AttributeValueComparison.EndsWithValue) : (currentValue.IsToken(TokenType.SubStringMatch) ? new AttributeValueComparison?(AttributeValueComparison.ContainsValue) : (currentValue.IsToken(TokenType.IncludeMatch) ? new AttributeValueComparison?(AttributeValueComparison.ContainsSpaceSeparatedValue) : (currentValue.IsToken(TokenType.DashMatch) ? new AttributeValueComparison?(AttributeValueComparison.EqualsValueOrStartsWithValueDash) : ((!currentValue.IsDelimiter("=")) ? ((AttributeValueComparison?)null) : new AttributeValueComparison?(AttributeValueComparison.EqualsValue)))))));
					cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
					cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeNextValue();
					if (cSSComponentValueParser.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier) || cSSComponentValueParser.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.String))
					{
						text = cSSComponentValueParser.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
						cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
					}
					cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeNextValue();
					if (text == null || !cSSComponentValueParser.IsEOF)
					{
						OnParseError();
						return null;
					}
				}
				if (attributeValueComparison.HasValue)
				{
					return new AttributeSelector(tokenValue, namespacePrefix, attributeValueComparison.Value, text);
				}
			}
			OnParseError();
			return null;
		}

		private ClassSelector ParseClass()
		{
			if (!PeekNextValue(1).IsDelimiter("."))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				return new ClassSelector(base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
			}
			OnParseError();
			return null;
		}

		private CombinatorType? ParseCombinator()
		{
			ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
			bool flag = componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Whitespace);
			ComponentValue componentValue2 = (flag ? PeekNextValue(2) : componentValue);
			if (componentValue2.IsToken(TokenType.Delimiter))
			{
				CombinatorType? combinatorType = componentValue2.GetTokenValue<string>() switch
				{
					"+" => CombinatorType.SiblingDirect, 
					">" => CombinatorType.DescendantDirect, 
					"~" => CombinatorType.SiblingGeneral, 
					_ => null, 
				};
				if (combinatorType.HasValue)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						ConsumeNextValue();
					}
					ConsumeNextValue();
					ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
					return combinatorType.Value;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				return CombinatorType.DescendantGeneral;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private StyleDeclaration ParseDeclaration()
		{
			ConsumeNextValue();
			string tokenValue = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Colon))
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			List<ComponentValue> list = new List<ComponentValue>();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				ConsumeNextValue();
				if (base.IsEOF)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (base.CurrentValue is FunctionComponentValue item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (!(base.CurrentValue is PreservedToken preservedToken))
				{
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
				if (!preservedToken.IsToken(TokenType.Comma))
				{
					if (preservedToken.IsToken(TokenType.Semicolon))
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(preservedToken);
				}
			}
			bool isImportant = false;
			if (2 <= list.Count && list[list.Count - 2].IsDelimiter("!") && list[list.Count - 1].IsIdentifierCaseInsensitive("important"))
			{
				isImportant = true;
				list.RemoveRange(list.Count - 2, 2);
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = (from v in list
				select v.ToDeclarationValue(_parseContext, _originalText) into dv
				where dv != null
				select dv).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				return new StyleDeclaration(tokenValue, array[0], isImportant);
			}
			return new StyleDeclaration(tokenValue, array, isImportant);
		}

		private string ParseElementName()
		{
			if (!PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			return base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
		}

		private MediaQueryExpression ParseMediaExpression(out bool isError)
		{
			if (!(PeekNextValue(1) is SimpleBlock { Type: SimpleBlockType.Paren } simpleBlock))
			{
				isError = false;
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(_parseContext, simpleBlock.Values, _originalText, OnParseError);
			MediaQueryExpression mediaQueryExpression = cSSComponentValueParser.ParseMediaExpressionHelper();
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			isError = mediaQueryExpression == null;
			return mediaQueryExpression;
		}

		private MediaQueryExpression ParseMediaExpressionHelper()
		{
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			string text = ParseMediaFeature();
			if (text == null)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			object obj = null;
			if (PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Colon))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				obj = ParseExpression();
				if (obj == null)
				{
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.IsEOF)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			MediaFeatureQualifier qualifier;
			MediaFeature feature = MediaQueryExpression.ParseFeature(text, out qualifier);
			return new MediaQueryExpression(feature, qualifier, obj);
		}

		private string ParseMediaFeature()
		{
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			return base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
		}

		private MediaQuery ParseMediaQuery(bool isRequired)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			MediaQueryQualifier qualifier = MediaQueryQualifier.None;
			ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
			if (componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				MediaQueryQualifier? mediaQueryQualifier = CSSUtilities.MediaQueryQualifierFromCSSText(componentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
				if (mediaQueryQualifier.HasValue)
				{
					qualifier = mediaQueryQualifier.Value;
					ConsumeNextValue();
					ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			List<MediaQueryExpression> list = new List<MediaQueryExpression>();
			bool flag2 = false;
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			MediaType? mediaType = ParseMediaType();
			if (!mediaType.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					mediaType = MediaType.All;
					bool isError;
					MediaQueryExpression mediaQueryExpression = ParseMediaExpression(out isError);
					if (mediaQueryExpression != null)
					{
						list.Add(mediaQueryExpression);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!isRequired)
						{
							return null;
						}
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			}
			while (true)
			{
				bool flag3 = false;
				componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
				if (componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
				{
					string text = componentValue.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant();
					if (text == "and")
					{
						ConsumeNextValue();
						ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag3)
				{
					break;
				}
				bool isError2;
				MediaQueryExpression mediaQueryExpression2 = ParseMediaExpression(out isError2);
				if (mediaQueryExpression2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(mediaQueryExpression2);
				}
				else
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag2 || list.Any((MediaQueryExpression e) => !e.IsValid))
			{
				while (true)
				{
					componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
					if (componentValue.IsEOF || componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Comma))
					{
						break;
					}
					ConsumeNextValue();
				}
				return MediaQuery.InvalidQuery;
			}
			return new MediaQuery(qualifier, mediaType.Value, list);
		}

		private MediaList ParseMediaQueryList(bool isRequired, TokenType endTokenType = TokenType.EOF)
		{
			MediaList mediaList = new MediaList();
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			if (PeekNextValue(1).IsEOF)
			{
				if (isRequired)
				{
					mediaList.Add(MediaQuery.AllQuery);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MediaQuery mediaQuery = ParseMediaQuery(isRequired);
				if (mediaQuery != null)
				{
					mediaList.Add(mediaQuery);
					while (true)
					{
						ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
						if (componentValue.IsToken(endTokenType) || componentValue.IsEOF)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (!componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Comma))
						{
							mediaList.RemoveAt(mediaList.Count - 1);
							mediaList.Add(MediaQuery.InvalidQuery);
							do
							{
								ConsumeNextValue();
								componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
							}
							while (!componentValue.IsToken(endTokenType) && !componentValue.IsEOF && !componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Comma));
							if (componentValue.IsToken(endTokenType) || componentValue.IsEOF)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						ConsumeNextValue();
						ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
						mediaList.Add(ParseMediaQuery(isRequired: true));
					}
				}
			}
			return mediaList;
		}

		private MediaType? ParseMediaType()
		{
			if (!PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			return CSSUtilities.MediaTypeFromCSSText(base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
		}

		private string ParseNamespacePrefix()
		{
			ParserSnapshot snapshot = Snapshot();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsDelimiter("|"))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				text = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
			}
			else if (base.CurrentValue.IsDelimiter("*"))
			{
				text = "*";
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				if (base.CurrentValue.IsDelimiter("|"))
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			Revert(snapshot);
			return null;
		}

		private NegationPseudoClassSelector ParseNegation()
		{
			ParserSnapshot snapshot = Snapshot();
			if (!PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Colon))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!(base.CurrentValue is FunctionComponentValue functionComponentValue) || !string.Equals(functionComponentValue.Name, "not", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				Revert(snapshot);
				return null;
			}
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(_parseContext, functionComponentValue.Arguments, _originalText, OnParseError);
			SimpleSelector simpleSelector = cSSComponentValueParser.ParseNegationArg();
			cSSComponentValueParser.ConsumeNextValue();
			if (simpleSelector == null || !cSSComponentValueParser.IsEOF)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			return new NegationPseudoClassSelector(simpleSelector);
		}

		private SimpleSelector ParseNegationArg()
		{
			TypeSelector typeSelector = ParseTypeSelector();
			if (typeSelector != null)
			{
				return typeSelector;
			}
			UniversalSelector universalSelector = ParseUniversal();
			if (universalSelector != null)
			{
				return universalSelector;
			}
			ClassSelector classSelector = ParseClass();
			if (classSelector != null)
			{
				return classSelector;
			}
			AttributeSelector attributeSelector = ParseAttrib();
			if (attributeSelector != null)
			{
				return attributeSelector;
			}
			SingleElementSelector singleElementSelector = ParsePseudo();
			if (singleElementSelector != null)
			{
				if (!(singleElementSelector is SimpleSelector result))
				{
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
				return result;
			}
			ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
			if (componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.HashId) || componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.HashUnrestricted))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				return new IdSelector(componentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CSSOperator? ParseOperator()
		{
			ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
			if (componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Comma))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				return CSSOperator.ArgumentSeparator;
			}
			if (componentValue.IsDelimiter("/"))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
				return CSSOperator.Fraction;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private MarginRule ParsePageMarginBox()
		{
			ConsumeNextValue();
			PageMarginArea? pageMarginArea = CSSUtilities.PageMarginAreaFromCSSText(base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
			if (!pageMarginArea.HasValue)
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (!(base.CurrentValue is SimpleBlock { Type: SimpleBlockType.Brace } simpleBlock))
			{
				OnParseError();
				return null;
			}
			MarginRule marginRule = new MarginRule(pageMarginArea.Value);
			simpleBlock.ToCSSStyleDeclarationBlock(_parseContext, marginRule.Style, _originalText);
			return marginRule;
		}

		private PagePseudoClass? ParsePagePseudoClass()
		{
			if (!PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Colon))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				PagePseudoClass? result = CSSUtilities.PagePseudoClassFromCSSText(base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
				if (result.HasValue)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			OnParseError();
			return null;
		}

		private PageSelector ParsePageSelector()
		{
			string text = null;
			if (PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				text = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>();
			}
			List<PagePseudoClass> list = new List<PagePseudoClass>();
			while (true)
			{
				PagePseudoClass? pagePseudoClass = ParsePagePseudoClass();
				if (!pagePseudoClass.HasValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(pagePseudoClass.Value);
			}
			if (text == null && list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new PageSelector(text, list.ToArray());
		}

		private List<PageSelector> ParsePageSelectorList()
		{
			List<PageSelector> list = new List<PageSelector>();
			PageSelector pageSelector = ParsePageSelector();
			if (pageSelector != null)
			{
				list.Add(pageSelector);
				while (true)
				{
					ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
					ConsumeNextValue();
					if (!base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Comma))
					{
						break;
					}
					ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
					pageSelector = ParsePageSelector();
					if (pageSelector == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(pageSelector);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private SingleElementSelector ParsePseudo(SingleElementSelector baseSelector = null)
		{
			ParserSnapshot revertPointForMissingBaseSelector = Snapshot();
			if (!PeekNextValue(1).IsToken(TokenType.Colon))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ConsumeNextValue();
			ConsumeNextValue();
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Colon))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				return CreatePseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, revertPointForMissingBaseSelector, base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant());
			}
			if (base.CurrentValue.IsToken(TokenType.Identifier))
			{
				string text = base.CurrentValue.GetTokenValue<string>().ToLowerInvariant();
				switch (text)
				{
				case "first-line":
				case "first-letter":
				case "before":
				case "after":
					return CreatePseudoElementSelector(baseSelector, revertPointForMissingBaseSelector, text);
				}
				if (baseSelector == null)
				{
					return CreatePseudoClassSelector(text);
				}
			}
			else if (base.CurrentValue is FunctionComponentValue function && baseSelector == null)
			{
				return CreatePseudoClassSelector(function);
			}
			OnParseError();
			return null;
		}

		private SingleElementSelector ParseSelector()
		{
			SimpleSelector simpleSelector = ParseSimpleSelectorSequence();
			if (simpleSelector == null)
			{
				SingleElementSelector singleElementSelector = ParsePseudo(NullSingleElementSelector.Instance);
				if (singleElementSelector != null)
				{
					return singleElementSelector;
				}
				return null;
			}
			SingleElementSelector singleElementSelector2 = simpleSelector;
			while (true)
			{
				ParserSnapshot snapshot = Snapshot();
				CombinatorType? combinatorType = ParseCombinator();
				if (!combinatorType.HasValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				simpleSelector = ParseSimpleSelectorSequence();
				if (simpleSelector == null)
				{
					if (combinatorType.Value == CombinatorType.DescendantGeneral)
					{
						Revert(snapshot);
						return singleElementSelector2;
					}
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
				singleElementSelector2 = CreateCombinatorRule(singleElementSelector2, combinatorType.Value, simpleSelector);
			}
			SingleElementSelector singleElementSelector3 = ParsePseudo(singleElementSelector2);
			if (singleElementSelector3 != null)
			{
				return singleElementSelector3;
			}
			return singleElementSelector2;
		}

		private SimpleSelector ParseSimpleSelectorSequence()
		{
			List<SimpleSelector> list = new List<SimpleSelector>();
			TypeSelector typeSelector = ParseTypeSelector();
			if (typeSelector != null)
			{
				list.Add(typeSelector);
			}
			else
			{
				UniversalSelector universalSelector = ParseUniversal();
				if (universalSelector != null)
				{
					list.Add(universalSelector);
				}
			}
			while (true)
			{
				SimpleSelector simpleSelector = ParseSimpleSelectorSequenceSuffix();
				if (simpleSelector == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(simpleSelector);
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			return new SimpleSelectorSequence(list.ToArray());
		}

		private SimpleSelector ParseSimpleSelectorSequenceSuffix()
		{
			ClassSelector classSelector = ParseClass();
			if (classSelector != null)
			{
				return classSelector;
			}
			AttributeSelector attributeSelector = ParseAttrib();
			if (attributeSelector != null)
			{
				return attributeSelector;
			}
			NegationPseudoClassSelector negationPseudoClassSelector = ParseNegation();
			if (negationPseudoClassSelector != null)
			{
				return negationPseudoClassSelector;
			}
			SingleElementSelector singleElementSelector = ParsePseudo();
			if (singleElementSelector != null)
			{
				if (!(singleElementSelector is SimpleSelector result))
				{
					OnParseError();
					return null;
				}
				return result;
			}
			ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
			if (componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.HashId) || componentValue.IsToken(TokenType.HashUnrestricted))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				return new IdSelector(componentValue.GetTokenValue<string>());
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object ParseTerm()
		{
			object obj = PeekNextValue(1).ToDeclarationValue(_parseContext, _originalText);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				ConsumeInsignificantWhitespace();
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private TypeSelector ParseTypeSelector()
		{
			ParserSnapshot snapshot = Snapshot();
			string namespacePrefix = ParseNamespacePrefix();
			string text = ParseElementName();
			if (text == null)
			{
				Revert(snapshot);
				return null;
			}
			return new TypeSelector(text, namespacePrefix);
		}

		private UniversalSelector ParseUniversal()
		{
			ParserSnapshot snapshot = Snapshot();
			string namespacePrefix = ParseNamespacePrefix();
			ComponentValue componentValue = PeekNextValue(1);
			if (componentValue.IsDelimiter("*"))
			{
				ConsumeNextValue();
				return new UniversalSelector(namespacePrefix);
			}
			Revert(snapshot);
			return null;
		}

		private bool TryParseDashNDashDigitIdentifier(string identifierName, out int number)
		{
			if (identifierName.StartsWith("-n-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				string s = identifierName.Substring(2);
				if (int.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out number))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			number = 0;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseNDimension(Token dimensionToken, out int number)
		{
			if (!(dimensionToken.Value is int))
			{
				number = 0;
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(dimensionToken.ValueUnit, "n", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				number = 0;
				return false;
			}
			number = (int)dimensionToken.Value;
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryParseNDashDigitDimension(Token dimensionToken, out int number, out int unitNumber)
		{
			if (!(dimensionToken.Value is int))
			{
				number = 0;
				unitNumber = 0;
				return false;
			}
			number = (int)dimensionToken.Value;
			if (dimensionToken.ValueUnit.StartsWith("n-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				string s = dimensionToken.ValueUnit.Substring(1);
				if (int.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out unitNumber))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			unitNumber = 0;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseNDashDigitIdentifier(string identifierName, out int number)
		{
			if (identifierName.StartsWith("n-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				string s = identifierName.Substring(1);
				if (int.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out number))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			number = 0;
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryParseNDashDimension(Token dimensionToken, out int number)
		{
			if (!(dimensionToken.Value is int))
			{
				number = 0;
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(dimensionToken.ValueUnit, "n-", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				number = 0;
				return false;
			}
			number = (int)dimensionToken.Value;
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryParseSignedInteger(Token numberToken, out int number)
		{
			if (!(numberToken.Value is int))
			{
				number = 0;
				return false;
			}
			number = (int)numberToken.Value;
			return !CSSUtilities.IsDigit(numberToken.GetText(_originalText)[0]);
		}

		private bool TryParseSignlessInteger(Token numberToken, out int number)
		{
			if (!(numberToken.Value is int))
			{
				number = 0;
				return false;
			}
			number = (int)numberToken.Value;
			return CSSUtilities.IsDigit(numberToken.GetText(_originalText)[0]);
		}
	}
	internal class CSSParseContext
	{
		public Uri BaseUri { get; private set; }

		public ParseContext ParseContext { get; private set; }

		public GroupingRule OwningRule { get; set; }

		public CSSStyleSheet OwningStyleSheet { get; set; }

		public string StyleSheetContent { get; private set; }

		public CSSParseContext(ParseContext parseContext, string styleSheetContent, Uri baseUri)
		{
			BaseUri = baseUri;
			ParseContext = parseContext;
			StyleSheetContent = styleSheetContent;
		}
	}

	{
		Brace,
		Bracket,
		Paren
	}

	{
		EOF,
		Identifier,
		Function,
		AtKeyword,
		HashUnrestricted,
		HashId,
		String,
		BadString,
		Url,
		BadUrl,
		Delimiter,
		Number,
		Percentage,
		Dimension,
		UnicodeRange,
		IncludeMatch,

		CDC,
