	internal sealed class EOFComponentValue : ComponentValue
	{
		public static readonly EOFComponentValue Instance = new EOFComponentValue();

		public override bool IsEOF => true;

		private EOFComponentValue()
		{
		}

		public override bool IsToken(TokenType type)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override object ToDeclarationValue(CSSParseContext context, string originalText)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<Token> Tokenize()
		{
			yield break;
		}
	}
	internal class FunctionComponentValue : ComponentValue
	{
		private readonly Token _functionToken;

		public List<ComponentValue> Arguments { get; private set; }

		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public FunctionComponentValue(Token functionToken)
		{
			Arguments = new List<ComponentValue>();
			_functionToken = functionToken;
			Name = (string)_functionToken.Value;
		}

		public override bool IsToken(TokenType type)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override object ToDeclarationValue(CSSParseContext context, string originalText)
		{
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(context, Arguments, originalText);
			object obj = cSSComponentValueParser.ParseExpression();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new CSSFunction(Name, obj);
		}

		public override IEnumerable<Token> Tokenize()
		{
			yield return _functionToken;
			Token lastToken = _functionToken;
			foreach (Token item in Arguments.SelectMany((ComponentValue a) => a.Tokenize()))
			{
				Token token;
				lastToken = (token = item);
				yield return token;
			}
			yield return new Token(TokenType.CloseParen, lastToken.StartIndex + lastToken.Length, 1);
		}
	}
	internal interface ITokenizer
	{
		Token ConsumeToken();
	}
	internal class PreservedToken : ComponentValue
	{
		private readonly Token _token;

		public PreservedToken(Token token)
		{
			_token = token;
		}

		public override Token GetToken()
		{
			return _token;
		}

		public override bool IsToken(TokenType type)
		{
			return _token.Type == type;
		}

		public override object ToDeclarationValue(CSSParseContext context, string originalText)
		{
			switch (_token.Type)
			{
			case TokenType.Dimension:
				return new DimensionValue(Convert.ToDouble(_token.Value), _token.ValueUnit);
			case TokenType.HashUnrestricted:
			case TokenType.HashId:
				return new HashValue((string)_token.Value);
			case TokenType.Identifier:
			case TokenType.Delimiter:
			case TokenType.Number:
				return _token.Value;
			case TokenType.String:
				return new StringLiteral((string)_token.Value);
			case TokenType.Percentage:
				return new PercentValue(Convert.ToDouble(_token.Value));
			case TokenType.UnicodeRange:
				return new UnicodeRangeValue((int)_token.Value, _token.EndUnicodeRange);
			case TokenType.Url:
			{
				string text = (string)_token.Value;
				if (context.BaseUri != null && Uri.TryCreate(context.BaseUri, text, out var result))
				{
					return new UrlValue(result.OriginalString);
				}
				return new UrlValue(text);
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_token.Value != null)
			{
				return _token.Type.ToString() + ": " + _token.Value.ToString();
			}
			return _token.Type.ToString();
		}

		public override IEnumerable<Token> Tokenize()
		{
			yield return _token;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class RuleInternal
	{
		private readonly List<ComponentValue> _prelude;

		public SimpleBlock Block { get; set; }

		public RuleInternal()
		{
			_prelude = new List<ComponentValue>();
		}

		public void AddPreludeValue(ComponentValue value)
		{
			_prelude.Add(value);
		}

		protected Rule ConvertPreludeToCSSAtRule(CSSParseContext context)
		{
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(context, _prelude, context.StyleSheetContent);
			return cSSComponentValueParser.ParseAtRulePrelude(context);
		}

		protected Selector ConvertPreludeToCSSSelector(CSSParseContext context, string originalText)
		{
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(context, _prelude, originalText);
			return cSSComponentValueParser.ParseSelectorsGroup();
		}

		public abstract Rule ToCSSRule(CSSParseContext context);
	}
	internal class AtRuleInternal : RuleInternal
	{
		public override Rule ToCSSRule(CSSParseContext context)
		{
			Rule rule = ConvertPreludeToCSSAtRule(context);
			if (rule is MediaRule mediaRule)
			{
				if (base.Block == null || base.Block.Type != SimpleBlockType.Brace)
				{
					return null;
				}
				CSSParseContext cSSParseContext = new CSSParseContext(context.ParseContext, context.StyleSheetContent, context.BaseUri);
				cSSParseContext.OwningStyleSheet = context.OwningStyleSheet;
				cSSParseContext.OwningRule = mediaRule;
				if (!StyleSheetParser.ParseCSSRules(mediaRule.Rules, cSSParseContext, new ComponentValueTokenizer(base.Block.Values)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return mediaRule;
			}
			if (rule is FontFaceRule fontFaceRule)
			{
				if (base.Block == null || base.Block.Type != SimpleBlockType.Brace)
				{
					return null;
				}
				base.Block.ToCSSStyleDeclarationBlock(context, fontFaceRule.Style, context.StyleSheetContent);
				return fontFaceRule;
			}
			if (rule is PageRule pageRule)
			{
				if (base.Block == null || base.Block.Type != SimpleBlockType.Brace)
				{
					return null;
				}
				CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(context, base.Block.Values, context.StyleSheetContent);
				if (!cSSComponentValueParser.ParsePageRuleList(pageRule))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return pageRule;
			}
			if (base.Block != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rule;
		}
	}
	internal class QualifiedRuleInternal : RuleInternal
	{
		public override Rule ToCSSRule(CSSParseContext context)
		{
			if (base.Block == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Selector selector = ConvertPreludeToCSSSelector(context, context.StyleSheetContent);
			if (selector == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StyleRule styleRule = new StyleRule(selector);
			base.Block.ToCSSStyleDeclarationBlock(context, styleRule.Style, context.StyleSheetContent);
			return styleRule;
		}
	}
	internal class SimpleBlock : ComponentValue
	{
		private readonly Token _openToken;

		public SimpleBlockType Type { get; private set; }

		public List<ComponentValue> Values { get; private set; }

		public SimpleBlock(Token openToken)
		{
			_openToken = openToken;
			Type = CSSUtilities.GetBlockType(_openToken.Type);
			Values = new List<ComponentValue>();
		}

		public override bool IsToken(TokenType type)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override object ToDeclarationValue(CSSParseContext context, string originalText)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<Token> Tokenize()
		{
			yield return _openToken;
			Token lastToken = _openToken;
			foreach (Token item in Values.SelectMany((ComponentValue v) => v.Tokenize()))
			{
				Token token;
				lastToken = (token = item);
				yield return token;
			}
			yield return new Token(CSSUtilities.GetBlockEndType(_openToken.Type), lastToken.StartIndex + lastToken.Length, 1);
		}

		public void ToCSSStyleDeclarationBlock(CSSParseContext context, StyleDeclarationBlock declarationBlock, string originalText)
		{
			if (Type == SimpleBlockType.Brace)
			{
				CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(context, Values, originalText);
				cSSComponentValueParser.ParseDeclarationBlock(declarationBlock);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class StyleSheetInternal
	{
		public List<RuleInternal> Rules { get; set; }
	}
	internal class StyleSheetParser
	{
		public static Encoding Encoding1252 = Utilities.EncodingGetEncoding(1252);

		private readonly ParseContext _context;

		private Token _currentInputToken;

		private Token _nextInputToken;

		private bool _shouldReconsumeCurrentInputToken;

		private readonly ITokenizer _tokenizer;

		private StyleSheetParser(ParseContext context, ITokenizer tokenizer)
		{
			_context = context;
			_tokenizer = tokenizer;
			_nextInputToken = _tokenizer.ConsumeToken();
		}

		public static StyleDeclarationBlock ParseCSSAttribute(string attributeValue, Uri baseUri = null)
		{
			CSSParseContext cSSParseContext = new CSSParseContext(new ParseContext(), attributeValue, baseUri);
			Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(attributeValue);
			StyleSheetParser styleSheetParser = new StyleSheetParser(cSSParseContext.ParseContext, tokenizer);
			List<ComponentValue> values = styleSheetParser.ParseStyleAttribute();
			CSSComponentValueParser cSSComponentValueParser = new CSSComponentValueParser(cSSParseContext, values, attributeValue);
			StyleDeclarationBlock styleDeclarationBlock = new StyleDeclarationBlock();
			cSSComponentValueParser.ParseDeclarationBlock(styleDeclarationBlock);
			return styleDeclarationBlock;
		}

		public static bool ParseCSSRules(RuleList rules, CSSParseContext context, ITokenizer tokenizer)
		{
			StyleSheetParser styleSheetParser = new StyleSheetParser(context.ParseContext, tokenizer);
			StyleSheetInternal styleSheetInternal = styleSheetParser.ParseStyleSheet();
			if (styleSheetInternal == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (RuleInternal rule2 in styleSheetInternal.Rules)
			{
				Rule rule = rule2.ToCSSRule(context);
				if (rule != null)
				{
					rules.Add(rule);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static CSSStyleSheet ParseCSSStyleSheet(ParseContext context, Stream styleSheetStream, Uri baseUri = null)
		{
			StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(styleSheetStream, DetectEncoding(context, styleSheetStream));
			return ParseCSSStyleSheet(context, streamReader.ReadToEnd(), baseUri);
		}

		public static CSSStyleSheet ParseCSSStyleSheet(ParseContext context, string styleSheetContent, Uri baseUri = null)
		{
			return ParseCSSStyleSheet(new CSSParseContext(context, styleSheetContent, baseUri), new Tokenizer(styleSheetContent));
		}

		private static CSSStyleSheet ParseCSSStyleSheet(CSSParseContext context, ITokenizer tokenizer)
		{
			CSSStyleSheet cSSStyleSheet = new CSSStyleSheet();
			RuleList rules = cSSStyleSheet.Rules;
			if (context.OwningStyleSheet == null)
			{
				context.OwningStyleSheet = cSSStyleSheet;
			}
			if (!ParseCSSRules(rules, context, tokenizer))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (Rule item in rules)
			{
				if (!(item is CharsetRule))
				{
					if (!(item is ImportRule importRule))
					{
						break;
					}
					importRule.LoadStyleSheet(cSSStyleSheet, context.ParseContext.FilePathResolved, context.BaseUri);
				}
			}
			return cSSStyleSheet;
		}

		private AtRuleInternal ConsumeAtRule()
		{
			AtRuleInternal atRuleInternal = new AtRuleInternal();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextInputToken();
				switch (_currentInputToken.Type)
				{
				case TokenType.EOF:
				case TokenType.Semicolon:
					if (_currentInputToken.Type == TokenType.Semicolon)
					{
						atRuleInternal.AddPreludeValue(new PreservedToken(_currentInputToken));
					}
					return atRuleInternal;
				case TokenType.OpenBrace:
					atRuleInternal.Block = ConsumeSimpleBlock(_currentInputToken);
					return atRuleInternal;
				}
				ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
				atRuleInternal.AddPreludeValue(ConsumeComponentValue());
			}
		}

		private ComponentValue ConsumeComponentValue()
		{
			ConsumeNextInputToken();
			switch (_currentInputToken.Type)
			{
			case TokenType.OpenBracket:
			case TokenType.OpenParen:
			case TokenType.OpenBrace:
				return ConsumeSimpleBlock(_currentInputToken);
			case TokenType.Function:
				return ConsumeFunction();
			default:
				return new PreservedToken(_currentInputToken);
			}
		}

		private FunctionComponentValue ConsumeFunction()
		{
			FunctionComponentValue functionComponentValue = new FunctionComponentValue(_currentInputToken);
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextInputToken();
				TokenType type = _currentInputToken.Type;
				if (type == TokenType.EOF || type == TokenType.CloseParen)
				{
					break;
				}
				ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
				functionComponentValue.Arguments.Add(ConsumeComponentValue());
			}
			return functionComponentValue;
		}

		private void ConsumeNextInputToken()
		{
			if (_shouldReconsumeCurrentInputToken)
			{
				_shouldReconsumeCurrentInputToken = false;
				return;
			}
			_currentInputToken = _nextInputToken;
			_nextInputToken = _tokenizer.ConsumeToken();
		}

		private RuleInternal ConsumeQualifiedRule()
		{
			QualifiedRuleInternal qualifiedRuleInternal = new QualifiedRuleInternal();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextInputToken();
				switch (_currentInputToken.Type)
				{
				case TokenType.EOF:
					return null;
				case TokenType.OpenBrace:
					qualifiedRuleInternal.Block = ConsumeSimpleBlock(_currentInputToken);
					return qualifiedRuleInternal;
				}
				ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
				qualifiedRuleInternal.AddPreludeValue(ConsumeComponentValue());
			}
		}

		private List<RuleInternal> ConsumeRulesList(bool topLevel)
		{
			List<RuleInternal> list = new List<RuleInternal>();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextInputToken();
				switch (_currentInputToken.Type)
				{
				case TokenType.Whitespace:
					break;
				case TokenType.EOF:
					return list;
				case TokenType.CDO:
				case TokenType.CDC:
					if (!topLevel)
					{
						ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
						RuleInternal ruleInternal2 = ConsumeQualifiedRule();
						if (ruleInternal2 != null)
						{
							list.Add(ruleInternal2);
						}
					}
					break;
				case TokenType.AtKeyword:
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
					AtRuleInternal atRuleInternal = ConsumeAtRule();
					if (atRuleInternal != null)
					{
						list.Add(atRuleInternal);
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
					RuleInternal ruleInternal = ConsumeQualifiedRule();
					if (ruleInternal != null)
					{
						list.Add(ruleInternal);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		private SimpleBlock ConsumeSimpleBlock(Token startToken)
		{
			TokenType blockEndType = CSSUtilities.GetBlockEndType(startToken.Type);
			SimpleBlock simpleBlock = new SimpleBlock(startToken);
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextInputToken();
				if (_currentInputToken.Type == blockEndType || _currentInputToken.Type == TokenType.EOF)
				{
					break;
				}
				ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
				simpleBlock.Values.Add(ConsumeComponentValue());
			}
			return simpleBlock;
		}

		private static Encoding DetectEncoding(ParseContext context, Stream styleSheetStream)
		{
			Encoding encoding = null;
			long num = styleSheetStream.Position;
			byte[] array = new byte[3];
			int num2 = styleSheetStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
			if ((long)num2 >= 2L)
			{
				if (byte.MaxValue == array[0] && 254 == array[1])
				{
					num += 2;
					encoding = Encoding.Unicode;
				}
				else if (254 == array[0] && byte.MaxValue == array[1])
				{
					num += 2;
					encoding = Encoding.BigEndianUnicode;
				}
				else if ((long)num2 >= 3L && 239 == array[0] && 187 == array[1] && 191 == array[2])
				{
					num += 3;
					encoding = Encoding.UTF8;
				}
			}
			styleSheetStream.Seek(num, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return encoding ?? DetermineFallbackEncoding(context, styleSheetStream);
		}

		private static Encoding DetermineFallbackEncoding(ParseContext context, Stream styleSheetStream)
		{
			if (context.HttpEncoding != null)
			{
				return context.HttpEncoding;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[10];
			int num = styleSheetStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
			if (num == array.Length && array[0] == 64 && array[1] == 99 && array[2] == 104 && array[3] == 97 && array[4] == 114 && array[5] == 115 && array[6] == 101 && array[7] == 116 && array[8] == 32 && array[9] == 34)
			{
				List<byte> list = new List<byte>();
				while (styleSheetStream.Position < styleSheetStream.Length - 1)
				{
					byte b = (byte)styleSheetStream.ReadByte();
					if (b == 34)
					{
						b = (byte)styleSheetStream.ReadByte();
						if (b != 59)
						{
							break;
						}
						try
						{
							Encoding encoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(Encoding1252.GetString(list.ToArray()));
							string a = Utilities.EncodingGetWebName(encoding);
							if (string.Equals(a, "utf-16", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(a, "utf-16be", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								return Encoding.UTF8;
							}
							return encoding;
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						break;
					}
					list.Add(b);
				}
			}
			Encoding environmentEncoding = GetEnvironmentEncoding(context);
			if (environmentEncoding != null)
			{
				return environmentEncoding;
			}
			return Encoding.UTF8;
		}

		private static Encoding GetEnvironmentEncoding(ParseContext context)
		{
			if (context.ReferringStyleSheet != null)
			{
				return context.ReferringStyleSheet.Encoding;
			}
			if (context.LinkNode != null)
			{
				string attributeValue = context.LinkNode.GetAttributeValue("charset", null);
				if (attributeValue != null)
				{
					try
					{
						return Encoding.GetEncoding(attributeValue);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return context.LinkNode.OwnerDocument.Encoding;
			}
			_ = context.ProcessingInstruction;
			return null;
		}

		private List<ComponentValue> ParseStyleAttribute()
		{
			List<ComponentValue> list = new List<ComponentValue>();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextInputToken();
				if (_currentInputToken.Type == TokenType.EOF)
				{
					break;
				}
				ReconsumeCurrentInputToken();
				list.Add(ConsumeComponentValue());
			}
			return list;
		}

		private StyleSheetInternal ParseStyleSheet()
		{
			StyleSheetInternal styleSheetInternal = new StyleSheetInternal();
			styleSheetInternal.Rules = ConsumeRulesList(topLevel: true);
			return styleSheetInternal;
		}

		private void ReconsumeCurrentInputToken()
		{
			_shouldReconsumeCurrentInputToken = true;
		}
	}
	internal struct Token
	{
		public static Token EOFToken = new Token(TokenType.EOF, -1, -1);

		public readonly TokenType Type;

		public readonly object Value;

		public readonly string ValueUnit;

		public readonly int EndUnicodeRange;

		public readonly int StartIndex;

		public readonly int Length;

		public Token(TokenType type, int startIndex, int length, object value = null, string valueUnit = null)
		{
			Type = type;
			Value = value;
			ValueUnit = valueUnit;
			EndUnicodeRange = 0;
			StartIndex = startIndex;
			Length = length;
		}

		public Token(TokenType type, int startIndex, int length, int unicodeRangeLowerBound, int unicodeRangeUpperBound)
		{
			Type = type;
			Value = unicodeRangeLowerBound;
			ValueUnit = null;
			EndUnicodeRange = unicodeRangeUpperBound;
			StartIndex = startIndex;
			Length = length;
		}

		public string GetText(string text)
		{
			return text.Substring(StartIndex, Length);
		}
	}
	internal class Tokenizer : ITokenizer
	{
		private const char EOFCodePoint = '\0';

		private const int MaxHexDigitCount = 6;

		private readonly StringBuilder _builder;

		private char _currentChar;

		private int _nextIndex;

		private bool _shouldReconsumeCurrentCodePoint;

		private readonly string _styleSheetContent;

		public Tokenizer(string styleSheetContent)
		{
			_builder = new StringBuilder();
			_nextIndex = 0;
			_styleSheetContent = styleSheetContent;
		}

		public Token ConsumeToken()
		{
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			ConsumeNextCodePoint();
			switch (_currentChar)
			{
			case '"':
				return ConsumeStringToken('"');
			case '#':
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNameCodePoint(PeekCodePoint(1)) || CSSUtilities.IsValidEscape(PeekCodePoint(1), PeekCodePoint(2)))
				{
					TokenType type = TokenType.HashUnrestricted;
					if (CSSUtilities.IsIdentifierStart(PeekCodePoint(1), PeekCodePoint(2), PeekCodePoint(3)))
					{
						type = TokenType.HashId;
					}
					return new Token(type, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, ConsumeName());
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "#");
			case '$':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '=')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.SuffixMatch, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "$");
			case '\'':
				return ConsumeStringToken('\'');
			case '(':
				return new Token(TokenType.OpenParen, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case ')':
				return new Token(TokenType.CloseParen, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case '*':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '=')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.SubStringMatch, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "*");
			case '+':
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNumberStart(_currentChar, PeekCodePoint(1), PeekCodePoint(2)))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeNumericToken();
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "+");
			case ',':
				return new Token(TokenType.Comma, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case '-':
			{
				char currentChar = _currentChar;
				char c = PeekCodePoint(1);
				char third = PeekCodePoint(2);
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNumberStart(currentChar, c, third))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeNumericToken();
				}
				if (CSSUtilities.IsIdentifierStart(currentChar, c, third))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeIdentifierLikeToken();
				}
				if (currentChar == '-' && c == '>')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.CDC, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "-");
			}
			case '.':
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNumberStart(_currentChar, PeekCodePoint(1), PeekCodePoint(2)))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeNumericToken();
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, ".");
			case '/':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '*')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					bool flag = true;
					while (flag)
					{
						ConsumeNextCodePoint();
						switch (_currentChar)
						{
						case '*':
							if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '/')
							{
								ConsumeNextCodePoint();
								flag = false;
							}
							break;
						case '\0':
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					return ConsumeToken();
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "/");
			case ':':
				return new Token(TokenType.Colon, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case ';':
				return new Token(TokenType.Semicolon, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case '<':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '!' && PeekCodePoint(2) == '-' && PeekCodePoint(3) == '-')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.CDO, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "<");
			case '@':
				if (CSSUtilities.IsIdentifierStart(PeekCodePoint(1), PeekCodePoint(2), PeekCodePoint(3)))
				{
					string value = ConsumeName();
					return new Token(TokenType.AtKeyword, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, value);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "@");
			case '[':
				return new Token(TokenType.OpenBracket, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case '\\':
				if (CSSUtilities.IsValidEscape(_currentChar, PeekCodePoint(1)))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeIdentifierLikeToken();
				}
				OnParseError();
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "\\");
			case ']':
				return new Token(TokenType.CloseBracket, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case '^':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '=')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.PrefixMatch, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "^");
			case '{':
				return new Token(TokenType.OpenBrace, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case '}':
				return new Token(TokenType.CloseBrace, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			case 'U':
			case 'u':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '+' && (CSSUtilities.IsHexDigit(PeekCodePoint(2)) || PeekCodePoint(2) == '?'))
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return ConsumeUnicodeRangeToken();
				}
				ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
				return ConsumeIdentifierLikeToken();
			case '|':
				switch (PeekCodePoint(1))
				{
				case '=':
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.DashMatch, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				case '|':
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.Column, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				default:
					return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "|");
				}
			case '~':
				if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '=')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.IncludeMatch, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, "~");
			case '\0':
				return Token.EOFToken;
			default:
				if (CSSUtilities.IsWhitespace(_currentChar))
				{
					ConsumeAllWhitespace();
					return new Token(TokenType.Whitespace, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				if (CSSUtilities.IsDigit(_currentChar))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeNumericToken();
				}
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNameStartCodePoint(_currentChar))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					return ConsumeIdentifierLikeToken();
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Delimiter, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, _currentChar.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void ConsumeAllWhitespace()
		{
			do
			{
				int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
			}
			while (CSSUtilities.IsWhitespace(_currentChar));
			ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
		}

		private char ConsumeEscapedCodePoint()
		{
			ConsumeNextCodePoint();
			if (CSSUtilities.IsHexDigit(_currentChar))
			{
				int startIndex = GetNextIndex() - 1;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				do
				{
					num2++;
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				}
				while (++num != 6 && CSSUtilities.IsHexDigit(_currentChar));
				if (!CSSUtilities.IsWhitespace(_currentChar))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
				}
				int num3 = int.Parse(_styleSheetContent.Substring(startIndex, num2), NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (num3 == 0 || 65535 < num3 || CSSUtilities.IsSurrogateCodePoint((char)num3))
				{
					return '\ufffd';
				}
				return (char)num3;
			}
			if (_currentChar == '\0')
			{
				return '\ufffd';
			}
			return _currentChar;
		}

		private Token ConsumeIdentifierLikeToken()
		{
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			string text = ConsumeName();
			if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '(')
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				if (string.Equals(text, "url", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return ConsumeUrlToken();
				}
				return new Token(TokenType.Function, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, text);
			}
			return new Token(TokenType.Identifier, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, text);
		}

		private string ConsumeName()
		{
			_builder.Clear();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNameCodePoint(_currentChar))
				{
					_builder.Append(_currentChar);
					continue;
				}
				if (!CSSUtilities.IsValidEscape(_currentChar, PeekCodePoint(1)))
				{
					break;
				}
				_builder.Append(ConsumeEscapedCodePoint());
			}
			ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
			return _builder.ToString();
		}

		private void ConsumeNextCodePoint()
		{
			if (_shouldReconsumeCurrentCodePoint)
			{
				_shouldReconsumeCurrentCodePoint = false;
			}
			else
			{
				_currentChar = PeekCodePointHelper(1, ref _nextIndex);
			}
		}

		private object ConsumeNumber()
		{
			_builder.Clear();
			bool flag = true;
			char c = PeekCodePoint(1);
			if (c == '+' || c == '-')
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				_builder.Append(c);
			}
			while (CSSUtilities.IsDigit(PeekCodePoint(1)))
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				_builder.Append(_currentChar);
			}
			if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '.' && CSSUtilities.IsDigit(PeekCodePoint(2)))
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				_builder.Append(_currentChar);
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				_builder.Append(_currentChar);
				flag = false;
				while (CSSUtilities.IsDigit(PeekCodePoint(1)))
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					_builder.Append(_currentChar);
				}
			}
			c = PeekCodePoint(1);
			if (c == 'E' || c == 'e')
			{
				int num = -1;
				char c2 = PeekCodePoint(2);
				char c3 = PeekCodePoint(3);
				if (CSSUtilities.IsDigit(c2))
				{
					num = 2;
				}
				else if ((c2 == '+' || c2 == '-') && CSSUtilities.IsDigit(c3))
				{
					num = 3;
				}
				if (num != -1)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						ConsumeNextCodePoint();
						_builder.Append(_currentChar);
					}
					flag = false;
					while (CSSUtilities.IsDigit(PeekCodePoint(1)))
					{
						ConsumeNextCodePoint();
						_builder.Append(_currentChar);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return int.Parse(_builder.ToString(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return double.Parse(_builder.ToString(), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private Token ConsumeNumericToken()
		{
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			object value = ConsumeNumber();
			char c = PeekCodePoint(1);
			if (CSSUtilities.IsIdentifierStart(c, PeekCodePoint(2), PeekCodePoint(3)))
			{
				string valueUnit = ConsumeName();
				return new Token(TokenType.Dimension, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, value, valueUnit);
			}
			if (c == '%')
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				return new Token(TokenType.Percentage, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, value);
			}
			return new Token(TokenType.Number, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, value);
		}

		private void ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				switch (_currentChar)
				{
				case '\0':
				case ')':
					return;
				case '\\':
					if (CSSUtilities.IsValidEscape(_currentChar, PeekCodePoint(1)))
					{
						ConsumeEscapedCodePoint();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private Token ConsumeStringToken(char endingCodePoint)
		{
			_builder.Clear();
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			while (true)
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				if (_currentChar == endingCodePoint || _currentChar == '\0')
				{
					return new Token(TokenType.String, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, _builder.ToString());
				}
				if (CSSUtilities.IsNewline(_currentChar))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (_currentChar == '\\')
				{
					char c = PeekCodePoint(1);
					if (c != 0)
					{
						if (CSSUtilities.IsNewline(c))
						{
							ConsumeNextCodePoint();
						}
						else if (CSSUtilities.IsValidEscape(_currentChar, c))
						{
							_builder.Append(ConsumeEscapedCodePoint());
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_builder.Append(_currentChar);
				}
			}
			OnParseError();
			ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
			return new Token(TokenType.BadString, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
		}

		private Token ConsumeUnicodeRangeToken()
		{
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			int num = nextIndex - 2;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				if (!CSSUtilities.IsHexDigit(_currentChar))
				{
					ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
					break;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (i < 6)
			{
				for (; i < 6; i++)
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					if (_currentChar != '?')
					{
						ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
						break;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			string text = _styleSheetContent.Substring(nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			int unicodeRangeLowerBound;
			int unicodeRangeUpperBound;
			if (flag)
			{
				unicodeRangeLowerBound = int.Parse(text.Replace('?', '0'), NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				unicodeRangeUpperBound = int.Parse(text.Replace('?', 'F'), NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				return new Token(TokenType.UnicodeRange, num, GetNextIndex() - num, unicodeRangeLowerBound, unicodeRangeUpperBound);
			}
			unicodeRangeLowerBound = int.Parse(text, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (PeekCodePoint(1) == '-' && CSSUtilities.IsHexDigit(PeekCodePoint(2)))
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				i = 0;
				nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
				for (; i < 6; i++)
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					if (!CSSUtilities.IsHexDigit(_currentChar))
					{
						ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint();
						break;
					}
				}
				string s = _styleSheetContent.Substring(nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				unicodeRangeUpperBound = int.Parse(s, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			else
			{
				unicodeRangeUpperBound = unicodeRangeLowerBound;
			}
			return new Token(TokenType.UnicodeRange, num, GetNextIndex() - num, unicodeRangeLowerBound, unicodeRangeUpperBound);
		}

		private Token ConsumeUrlToken()
		{
			ConsumeAllWhitespace();
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			char c = PeekCodePoint(1);
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\0':
				return new Token(TokenType.Url, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, string.Empty);
			case '"':
			case '\'':
			{
				ConsumeNextCodePoint();
				Token token = ConsumeStringToken(c);
				if (token.Type == TokenType.BadString)
				{
					ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl();
					return new Token(TokenType.BadUrl, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
				}
				ConsumeAllWhitespace();
				c = PeekCodePoint(1);
				if (c == ')' || c == '\0')
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					return new Token(TokenType.Url, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, token.Value);
				}
				ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl();
				return new Token(TokenType.BadUrl, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			}
			default:
				_builder.Clear();
				while (true)
				{
					ConsumeNextCodePoint();
					if (CSSUtilities.IsWhitespace(_currentChar))
					{
						ConsumeAllWhitespace();
						c = PeekCodePoint(1);
						if (c == ')' || c == '\0')
						{
							ConsumeNextCodePoint();
							return new Token(TokenType.Url, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, _builder.ToString());
						}
						ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl();
						return new Token(TokenType.BadUrl, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
					}
					if (CSSUtilities.IsNonPrintableCodePoint(_currentChar))
					{
						break;
					}
					switch (_currentChar)
					{
					case '\0':
					case ')':
						return new Token(TokenType.Url, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex, _builder.ToString());
					case '"':
					case '\'':
					case '(':
						OnParseError();
						ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl();
						return new Token(TokenType.BadUrl, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
					case '\\':
						if (CSSUtilities.IsValidEscape(_currentChar, PeekCodePoint(1)))
						{
							_builder.Append(ConsumeEscapedCodePoint());
							break;
						}
						OnParseError();
						ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl();
						return new Token(TokenType.BadUrl, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
					default:
						_builder.Append(_currentChar);
						break;
					}
				}
				OnParseError();
				ConsumeRemnantsOfBadUrl();
				return new Token(TokenType.BadUrl, nextIndex, GetNextIndex() - nextIndex);
			}
		}

		private int GetNextIndex()
		{
			if (_shouldReconsumeCurrentCodePoint)
			{
				return _nextIndex - 1;
			}
			return _nextIndex;
		}

		private static bool IsEOFCodePoint(char c)
		{
			return c == '\0';
		}

		private void OnParseError()
		{
		}

		private char PeekCodePoint(int offsetFromCurrent)
		{
			if (offsetFromCurrent <= 0)
			{
				return _currentChar;
			}
			int nextIndex = GetNextIndex();
			return PeekCodePointHelper(offsetFromCurrent, ref nextIndex);
		}

		private char PeekCodePointHelper(int offsetFromCurrent, ref int nextIndex)
		{
			if (nextIndex == _styleSheetContent.Length)
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			char c = _styleSheetContent[nextIndex++];
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\r':
				if (nextIndex < _styleSheetContent.Length && _styleSheetContent[nextIndex] == '\n')
				{
					nextIndex++;
				}
				c = '\n';
				break;
			case '\f':
				c = '\n';
				break;
			}
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				c = '\ufffd';
			}
			if (offsetFromCurrent == 1)
			{
				return c;
			}
			return PeekCodePointHelper(offsetFromCurrent - 1, ref nextIndex);
		}

		private void ReconsumeCurrentInputCodePoint()
		{
			_shouldReconsumeCurrentCodePoint = true;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ValueParseHelper<T>
	{
		public struct ParserSnapshot
		{
			public readonly int Index;

			public ParserSnapshot(int index)
			{
				Index = index;
			}
		}

		private int _currentIndex;

		private readonly T _eofValue;

		private readonly List<T> _valueStream;

		public T CurrentValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEOF)
				{
					return _valueStream[_currentIndex];
				}
				return _eofValue;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEOF => _valueStream.Count <= _currentIndex;

		protected ValueParseHelper(List<T> valueStream, T eofValue)
		{
			_currentIndex = -1;
			_eofValue = eofValue;
			_valueStream = valueStream;
		}

		public void ConsumeNextValue()
		{
			_currentIndex++;
		}

		public T PeekNextValue(int offset)
		{
			int num = _currentIndex + offset;
			if (_valueStream.Count <= num)
			{
				return _eofValue;
			}
			return _valueStream[num];
		}

		public void Revert(ParserSnapshot snapshot)
		{
			_currentIndex = snapshot.Index;
		}

		public ParserSnapshot Snapshot()
		{
			return new ParserSnapshot(_currentIndex);
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Core.CSS.Cascading
{
	internal sealed class CSSCascadeContext
	{
		private const int DefaultNormalFontSizePoints = 12;

		public static readonly CSSCascadeContext DefaultScreen = new CSSCascadeContext(MediaContext.Screen, new CSSComputedStyleFactory());

		private readonly List<CSSPropertyTableBase> _propertyTables;

		public CSSComputedStyleFactory ComputedStyleFactory { get; private set; }

		public MediaContext MediaContext { get; private set; }

		public int NormalFontSizePoints { get; set; }

		public CSSCascadeContext(MediaContext mediaContext, CSSComputedStyleFactory computedStyleFactory, params CSSPropertyTableBase[] additionalPropertyTables)
		{
			_propertyTables = new List<CSSPropertyTableBase> { CSSPropertyTable.Instance };
			_propertyTables.AddRange(additionalPropertyTables);
			ComputedStyleFactory = computedStyleFactory;
			MediaContext = mediaContext;
			NormalFontSizePoints = 12;
		}

		public IEnumerable<SinglePropertyDefinitionBase> GetAllSingleProperties()
		{
			return _propertyTables.SelectMany((CSSPropertyTableBase p) => p.GetSingleProperties());
		}

		public SinglePropertyDefinitionBase GetSingleProperty(string name)
		{
			SinglePropertyDefinitionBase singlePropertyDefinitionBase = GetProperty(name) as SinglePropertyDefinitionBase;
			return singlePropertyDefinitionBase ?? UnknownPropertyDefinition.Instance;
		}

		public PropertyDefinitionBase GetProperty(string name)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _propertyTables.Count; i++)
			{
				PropertyDefinitionBase property = _propertyTables[i].GetProperty(name);
				if (property.IsKnown)
				{
					return property;
				}
			}
			return UnknownPropertyDefinition.Instance;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CSSCascader
	{
		private class AddDeclaredValuesVisitor : RuleVisitor
		{
			private readonly CSSCascader _owner;

			public List<DeclarationInfo> Declarations { get; set; }

			public HtmlNode Element { get; set; }

			public DeclarationOrigin OriginImportant { get; set; }

			public DeclarationOrigin OriginNormal { get; set; }

			public PseudoElementType? PseudoElementType { get; set; }

			public int ScopeLevel { get; set; }

			public AddDeclaredValuesVisitor(CSSCascader owner)
			{
				_owner = owner;
			}

			public override void DefaultVisit(Rule rule)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitCharsetRule(CharsetRule rule)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitFontFaceRule(FontFaceRule rule)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitImportRule(ImportRule rule)
			{
				if (rule.StyleSheet == null || !rule.Media.IsMediaAllowed(_owner._context.MediaContext))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Rule rule2 in rule.StyleSheet.Rules)
				{
					rule2.Accept(this);
				}
			}

			public override void VisitMediaRule(MediaRule rule)
			{
				if (!rule.Media.IsMediaAllowed(_owner._context.MediaContext))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Rule rule2 in rule.Rules)
				{
					rule2.Accept(this);
				}
			}

			public override void VisitNamespaceRule(NamespaceRule rule)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitPageRule(PageRule rule)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitStyleRule(StyleRule rule)
			{
				if (!rule.Selector.DoesApplyTo(new SelectorQueryInfo(rule.ParentStyleSheet, Element, PseudoElementType), out var specificity))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (StyleDeclaration item in rule.Style)
				{
					_owner._context.GetProperty(item.Name).AddDeclaredValues(Declarations, item.Value, item.IsImportant ? OriginImportant : OriginNormal, specificity, ScopeLevel);
				}
			}
		}

		internal struct ComputedStyleInfo
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _cascadedValues;

			private readonly CSSComputedStyle _parentStyle;

			private readonly int _hashCode;

			public ComputedStyleInfo(CSSComputedStyle parentStyle, Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues)
			{
				_parentStyle = parentStyle;
				_cascadedValues = cascadedValues;
				_hashCode = GetHashCode(_parentStyle, _cascadedValues);
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is ComputedStyleInfo computedStyleInfo))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_parentStyle != computedStyleInfo._parentStyle)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_cascadedValues == computedStyleInfo._cascadedValues)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (_cascadedValues == null || computedStyleInfo._cascadedValues == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_cascadedValues.Count != computedStyleInfo._cascadedValues.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> cascadedValue in _cascadedValues)
				{
					if (!computedStyleInfo._cascadedValues.TryGetValue(cascadedValue.Key, out var value) || !object.Equals(cascadedValue.Value, value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _hashCode;
			}

			public static int GetHashCode(CSSComputedStyle parentStyle, Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues)
			{
				int num = parentStyle?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
				if (cascadedValues != null)
				{
					num ^= cascadedValues.Count;
					foreach (string key in cascadedValues.Keys)
					{
						num ^= key.GetHashCode();
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private class Counter
		{
			public int Value { get; set; }
		}

		private class CounterScope
		{
			private Dictionary<string, Counter> _counters;

			public Counter GetCounter(string counterName)
			{
				if (_counters == null)
				{
					_counters = new Dictionary<string, Counter>();
				}
				if (!_counters.TryGetValue(counterName, out var value))
				{
					value = (_counters[counterName] = new Counter());
				}
				return value;
			}

			public bool TryGetCounter(string counterName, out Counter counter)
			{
				if (_counters == null)
				{
					counter = null;
					return false;
				}
				return _counters.TryGetValue(counterName, out counter);
			}
		}

		public struct DeclarationInfo
		{
			public readonly SinglePropertyDefinitionBase Definition;

			public readonly DeclarationOrigin Origin;

			public readonly int ScopeLevel;

			public readonly SelectorSpecificity Specificity;

			public readonly object Value;

			public DeclarationInfo(SinglePropertyDefinitionBase definition, object value, DeclarationOrigin origin, SelectorSpecificity specificity, int scopeLevel)
			{
				Definition = definition;
				Origin = origin;
				ScopeLevel = scopeLevel;
				Specificity = specificity;
				Value = value;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return $"{Definition.Name}: {Value}; from {Origin}; specificity - {Specificity}";
			}
		}

		private class DeclarationInfoComparer : IComparer<DeclarationInfo>
		{
			public static readonly DeclarationInfoComparer Instance = new DeclarationInfoComparer();

			private DeclarationInfoComparer()
			{
			}

			public int Compare(DeclarationInfo x, DeclarationInfo y)
			{
				int num = y.Origin - x.Origin;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = ((!x.Origin.IsImportant()) ? x.ScopeLevel.CompareTo(y.ScopeLevel) : y.ScopeLevel.CompareTo(x.ScopeLevel));
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = x.Specificity.CompareTo(y.Specificity);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private class PossiblePseudoElementRuleVisitor : RuleVisitor
		{
			private readonly CSSCascader _cascader;

			public PossiblePseudoElementRuleVisitor(CSSCascader cascader)
			{
				_cascader = cascader;
			}

			public override void VisitImportRule(ImportRule rule)
			{
				if (rule.StyleSheet != null && rule.Media.IsMediaAllowed(_cascader._context.MediaContext))
				{
					_cascader.OnStyleSheetIncluded(rule.StyleSheet);
				}
			}

			public override void VisitMediaRule(MediaRule rule)
			{
				if (!rule.Media.IsMediaAllowed(_cascader._context.MediaContext))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Rule rule2 in rule.Rules)
				{
					rule2.Accept(this);
					if (_cascader._possiblePseudoElements == PossiblePseudoElements.All)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void VisitStyleRule(StyleRule rule)
			{
				rule.Selector.Accept(_cascader._possiblePseudoElementSelectorVisitor);
			}
		}

		[Flags]
		private enum PossiblePseudoElements : byte
		{
			Before = 1,
			After = 2,
			FirstLetter = 4,
			FirstLine = 8,
			Selection = 0x10,
			All = 0x1F
		}

		private class PossiblePseudoElementSelectorVisitor : SelectorWalker
		{
			private readonly CSSCascader _cascader;

			public PossiblePseudoElementSelectorVisitor(CSSCascader cascader)
			{
				_cascader = cascader;
			}

			public override void VisitPseudoElementSelector(PseudoElementSelector selector)
			{
				switch (selector.Type)
				{
				case PseudoElementType.FirstLine:
					_cascader.OnPseudoElementStyled(PossiblePseudoElements.FirstLine);
					break;
				case PseudoElementType.FirstLetter:
					_cascader.OnPseudoElementStyled(PossiblePseudoElements.FirstLetter);
					break;
				case PseudoElementType.Before:
					_cascader.OnPseudoElementStyled(PossiblePseudoElements.Before);
					break;
				case PseudoElementType.After:
					_cascader.OnPseudoElementStyled(PossiblePseudoElements.After);
					break;
				case PseudoElementType.Selection:
					_cascader.OnPseudoElementStyled(PossiblePseudoElements.Selection);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private struct ScopedStyleSheets
		{
			public readonly int ScopeLevel;

			public readonly List<StyleSheetInfo> StyleSheets;

			public ScopedStyleSheets(List<StyleSheetInfo> styleSheets, int scopeLevel)
			{
				ScopeLevel = scopeLevel;
				StyleSheets = styleSheets;
			}
		}

		private class StyleSheetInfo
		{
			private class SelectorFilteringRulePopulator : SelectorVisitor
			{
				private readonly HashSet<string> _allElementNameFilters;

				private bool _canUseRuleFilters;

				private readonly StyleSheetInfo _owner;

				private HashSet<string> _ruleFilters;

				public SelectorFilteringRulePopulator(StyleSheetInfo owner)
				{
					_owner = owner;
					_allElementNameFilters = new HashSet<string>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
					_ruleFilters = new HashSet<string>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				}

				public override void VisitDescendantCombinatorSelector(DescendantCombinatorSelector selector)
				{
					selector.DescendantSelector.Accept(this);
				}

				public override void VisitPseudoElementSelector(PseudoElementSelector selector)
				{
					selector.BaseSelector.Accept(this);
				}

				public override void VisitSelectorGroup(SelectorGroup selector)
				{
					foreach (SingleElementSelector selector2 in selector.Selectors)
					{
						selector2.Accept(this);
					}
				}

				public override void VisitSiblingCombinatorSelector(SiblingCombinatorSelector selector)
				{
					selector.NextSelector.Accept(this);
				}

				public override void VisitSimpleSelectorSequence(SimpleSelectorSequence selector)
				{
					SimpleSelector[] components = selector.Components;
					foreach (SimpleSelector simpleSelector in components)
					{
						simpleSelector.Accept(this);
					}
				}

				public override void VisitTypeSelector(TypeSelector selector)
				{
					if (selector.NamespacePrefix == null)
					{
						_allElementNameFilters.Add(selector.ElementName);
						_ruleFilters.Add(selector.ElementName);
					}
					else
					{
						_canUseRuleFilters = false;
					}
				}

				public override void VisitUniversalSelector(UniversalSelector selector)
				{
					_canUseRuleFilters = false;
				}

				public static void Populate(StyleSheetInfo info)
				{
					new SelectorFilteringRulePopulator(info).Populate();
				}

				public void Populate()
				{
					Dictionary<Rule, HashSet<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<Rule, HashSet<string>>();
					foreach (StyleRule item in _owner._styleSheet.Rules.OfType<StyleRule>())
					{
						_canUseRuleFilters = true;
						_ruleFilters.Clear();
						item.Selector.Accept(this);
						if (_canUseRuleFilters && _ruleFilters.Count != 0)
						{
							dictionary.Add(item, new HashSet<string>(_ruleFilters, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
						}
					}
					IEnumerable<Rule> enumerable = _owner._styleSheet.Rules.Where((Rule r) => r.CanStyleElements);
					foreach (string allElementNameFilter in _allElementNameFilters)
					{
						List<Rule> list = new List<Rule>();
						foreach (Rule item2 in enumerable)
						{
							if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(item2, out var value) || value.Contains(allElementNameFilter))
							{
								list.Add(item2);
							}
						}
						_owner._filteredRules.Add(allElementNameFilter, list);
					}
					foreach (Rule item3 in enumerable)
					{
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item3))
						{
							_owner._unfilteredRules.Add(item3);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private readonly CSSCascader _cascader;

			private readonly List<Rule> _unfilteredRules;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, List<Rule>> _filteredRules;

			private readonly CSSStyleSheet _styleSheet;

			public StyleSheetInfo(CSSCascader cascader, CSSStyleSheet styleSheet)
			{
				_cascader = cascader;
				_styleSheet = styleSheet;
				_filteredRules = new Dictionary<string, List<Rule>>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				_unfilteredRules = new List<Rule>();
				SelectorFilteringRulePopulator.Populate(this);
			}

			public void AddDeclaredValuesFromSheet()
			{
				if (_filteredRules.TryGetValue(_cascader._addDeclaredValuesVisitor.Element.OriginalName, out var value))
				{
					foreach (Rule item in value)
					{
						item.Accept(_cascader._addDeclaredValuesVisitor);
					}
					return;
				}
				foreach (Rule unfilteredRule in _unfilteredRules)
				{
					unfilteredRule.Accept(_cascader._addDeclaredValuesVisitor);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Lazy<CSSStyleSheet> _userAgentStyleSheetFactory = new Lazy<CSSStyleSheet>(delegate
		{
			using Stream styleSheetStream = Utilities.GetAssemblyFromType(typeof(CSSCascader)).GetManifestResourceStream("Infragistics.Documents.Core.CSS.UserAgentStyles.css");
			return StyleSheetParser.ParseCSSStyleSheet(new ParseContext(), styleSheetStream);
		}, isThreadSafe: true);

		private readonly bool _isCaseSensitive;

		private readonly Dictionary<HtmlNode, List<StyleSheetInfo>> _scopedStyleSheets;

		private readonly Stack<bool> _tablesHaveBorderAttribute;

		public CSSCascadeContext Context => _context;

		public CSSCascader(HtmlDocument document, CSSCascadeContext context)
		{
			_context = context;
			_document = document;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor = new AddDeclaredValuesVisitor(this);
			_isCaseSensitive = _document.OptionOutputAsXml;
			_elementNameComparer = (_document.OptionOutputAsXml ? StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCulture : StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			_parentCounterScopes = new Stack<CounterScope>();
			_possiblePseudoElementRuleVisitor = new PossiblePseudoElementRuleVisitor(this);
			_possiblePseudoElementSelectorVisitor = new PossiblePseudoElementSelectorVisitor(this);
			_presentationalAttributeToDeclaredValueCallbacks = CreatePresentationalAttributeToDeclaredValueCallbacks();
			_scopedStyleSheets = new Dictionary<HtmlNode, List<StyleSheetInfo>>();
			_sharedComputedStyles = new Dictionary<ComputedStyleInfo, CSSComputedStyle>();
			_tablesHaveBorderAttribute = new Stack<bool>();
			CSSStyleSheet value = _userAgentStyleSheetFactory.Value;
			OnStyleSheetIncluded(value);
			_userAgentStyleSheetInfo = new StyleSheetInfo(this, value);
			List<StyleSheetInfo> list = new List<StyleSheetInfo>();
			foreach (CSSStyleSheet item2 in _document.StyleSheets.OfType<CSSStyleSheet>())
			{
				OnStyleSheetIncluded(item2);
				StyleSheetInfo item = new StyleSheetInfo(this, item2);
				if (item2.Scope == null)
				{
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (!_scopedStyleSheets.TryGetValue(item2.Scope, out var value2))
				{
					value2 = new List<StyleSheetInfo>();
					_scopedStyleSheets[item2.Scope] = value2;
				}
				value2.Add(item);
			}
			_styleSheetsInScope = new List<ScopedStyleSheets>
			{
				new ScopedStyleSheets(list, _currentNestingLevel)
			};
		}

		public bool ApplyStyleAttributeDeclarationBlock(HtmlNode element, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, StyleDeclarationBlock style, HashSet<string> force = null)
		{
			PerformComputation(element, computedStyle, delegate
			{
				IOrderedEnumerable<int> orderedEnumerable = from i in Enumerable.Range(0, style.Count)
					orderby _context.GetSingleProperty(style[i].Name)?.IndexInPropertyTable ?? int.MaxValue
					select i;
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				foreach (int item in orderedEnumerable)
				{
					StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = style[item];
					SinglePropertyDefinitionBase singleProperty = _context.GetSingleProperty(styleDeclaration.Name);
					object obj = (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals((styleDeclaration.Value == null) ? null : styleDeclaration.Value.ToString(), "initial") ? singleProperty.GetComputedInitialValue(this) : singleProperty.GetComputedValueFromRaw(this, styleDeclaration.Value));
					if (obj == null)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						object y = computedStyle.GetValue(singleProperty.Name) ?? singleProperty.GetComputedInitialValue(this);
						if (CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(obj, y) && (force == null || !force.Contains(singleProperty.Name)))
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
						else
						{
							computedStyle.SetValue(singleProperty.Name, obj);
						}
					}
				}
				if (list.Count != 0)
				{
					if (list.Count == style.Count)
					{
						style.Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						list.Sort();
						for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
						{
							style.RemoveAt(list[num]);
						}
						list.Clear();
					}
				}
			});
			if (style.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			MergeProperties(style, computedStyle);
			element.Attributes.Add("style", style.ToString());
			return true;
		}

		public void Cascade()
		{
			GetSpecifiedValuesRecursive(_document.DocumentNode, null);
			_sharedComputedStyles.Clear();
			FinalizeComputedStylesRecursive(_document.DocumentNode);
		}

		public object ComputeProperty(HtmlNode element, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, SinglePropertyDefinitionBase property, object rawValue)
		{
			object result = null;
			PerformComputation(element, computedStyle, delegate
			{
				result = property.GetComputedValueFromRaw(this, rawValue);
			});
			return result;
		}

		public void DecrementQuoteLevel()
		{
			CurrentQuoteLevel--;
		}

		public void FinalizeComputedStyle(HtmlNode element)
		{
			if (element.ComputedStyle != null)
			{
				PerformComputation(element, element.ComputedStyle, delegate
				{
					element.ComputedStyle.FinalizeComputedValues(this);
				});
			}
		}

		public Dictionary<string, object> GetCascadedValues(HtmlNode element, PseudoElementType? pseudoElementType = null)
		{
			return GetCascadedValues(GetDeclaredValues(element, pseudoElementType));
		}

		public int GetCounterValue(string counterName)
		{
			if (_parentCounterScopes.Count == 0 || !CSSUtilities.IsValidCounterName(counterName))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			foreach (CounterScope parentCounterScope in _parentCounterScopes)
			{
				if (parentCounterScope.TryGetCounter(counterName, out var counter))
				{
					return counter.Value;
				}
			}
			return _parentCounterScopes.Peek().GetCounter(counterName).Value;
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> GetCounterValues(string counterName)
		{
			if (!CSSUtilities.IsValidCounterName(counterName))
			{
				yield return 0;
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (CounterScope item in _parentCounterScopes.Reverse())
			{
				if (item.TryGetCounter(counterName, out var counter))
				{
					yield return counter.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public void IncrementCounter(string counterName, int? incrementValue)
		{
			if (_parentCounterScopes.Count == 0 || !CSSUtilities.IsValidCounterName(counterName))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = incrementValue ?? 1;
			foreach (CounterScope parentCounterScope in _parentCounterScopes)
			{
				if (parentCounterScope.TryGetCounter(counterName, out var counter))
				{
					counter.Value += num;
					return;
				}
			}
			_parentCounterScopes.Peek().GetCounter(counterName).Value += num;
		}

		public void IncrementQuoteLevel()
		{
			CurrentQuoteLevel++;
		}

		public void MergeProperties(StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			CSSComputedStyleBase finalizingComputedStyle = FinalizingComputedStyle;
			try
			{
				FinalizingComputedStyle = computedStyle;
				MergePropertiesCore(style, computedStyle);
			}
			finally
			{
				FinalizingComputedStyle = finalizingComputedStyle;
			}
		}

		private void MergePropertiesCore(StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			int num = 0;
			object[] array = null;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < style.Count; i++)
			{
				StyleDeclaration declaration = style[i];
				TryMergeSinglePropertyDeclaration(style, computedStyle, ref declaration);
				if (!(declaration.Value is object[] array2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				PropertyDefinitionBase property = _context.GetProperty(declaration.Name);
				if (property == CSSPropertyTable.BorderTop || property == CSSPropertyTable.BorderRight || property == CSSPropertyTable.BorderBottom || property == CSSPropertyTable.BorderLeft)
				{
					if (num == 0)
					{
						array = array2;
						flag = declaration.IsImportant;
					}
					else if (flag != declaration.IsImportant || !CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(array2, array))
					{
						array = null;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num == 4 && array != null)
			{
				style.Remove(CSSPropertyTable.BorderTop.Name);
				style.Remove(CSSPropertyTable.BorderRight.Name);
				style.Remove(CSSPropertyTable.BorderBottom.Name);
				style.Remove(CSSPropertyTable.BorderLeft.Name);
				style.Insert(0, new StyleDeclaration(CSSPropertyTable.Border.Name, array, flag));
			}
		}

		private void TryMergeSinglePropertyDeclaration(StyleDeclarationBlock style, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, ref StyleDeclaration declaration)
		{
			if (declaration.Value is object[])
			{
				return;
			}
			SinglePropertyDefinitionBase singleProperty = _context.GetSingleProperty(declaration.Name);
			if (!singleProperty.IsInShorthandProperty)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ShorthandPropertyDefinitionBase owningShorthandProperty in singleProperty.GetOwningShorthandProperties())
			{
				StyleDeclaration styleDeclaration = owningShorthandProperty.TryMergeSubProperties(this, style, computedStyle);
				if (styleDeclaration != null)
				{
					declaration = styleDeclaration;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetCounter(string counterName, int? resetValue)
		{
			if (_parentCounterScopes.Count != 0 && CSSUtilities.IsValidCounterName(counterName))
			{
				_parentCounterScopes.Peek().GetCounter(counterName).Value = resetValue ?? 0;
			}
		}

		private CSSComputedStyle CreateComputedStyle(HtmlNode element, CSSComputedStyle parentStyle)
		{
			Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues = GetCascadedValues(element);
			ComputedStyleInfo key = new ComputedStyleInfo(parentStyle, cascadedValues);
			if (!_sharedComputedStyles.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = _context.ComputedStyleFactory.CreateComputedStyle(_context, cascadedValues);
				if (value.IsSharable)
				{
					_sharedComputedStyles[key] = value;
				}
			}
			value.IncrementShareCount();
			element.ComputedStyle = value;
			return value;
		}

		private static bool DoesContainContentProperty(List<DeclarationInfo> declarations)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < declarations.Count; i++)
			{
				if (declarations[i].Definition == CSSPropertyTable.Content)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void FinalizeComputedStyle(CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle)
		{
			if (computedStyle != null)
			{
				FinalizingComputedStyle = computedStyle;
				computedStyle.FinalizeComputedValues(this);
				FinalizingComputedStyle = null;
			}
		}

		private void FinalizeComputedStylesRecursive(HtmlNode element)
		{
			HtmlNode finalizingElement = FinalizingElement;
			FinalizingElement = element;
			FinalizeComputedStyle(element.ComputedStyle);
			_parentCounterScopes.Push(new CounterScope());
			CSSComputedStyleBase finalizingComputedStyleParent = FinalizingComputedStyleParent;
			FinalizingComputedStyleParent = element.ComputedStyle;
			FinalizeComputedStyle(element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementBefore);
			FinalizeComputedStyle(element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementFirstLetter);
			FinalizeComputedStyle(element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementFirstLine);
			FinalizeComputedStyle(element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementSelection);
			if (element.HasChildNodes)
			{
				foreach (HtmlNode childNode in element.ChildNodes)
				{
					FinalizeComputedStylesRecursive(childNode);
				}
			}
			FinalizeComputedStyle(element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementAfter);
			FinalizingComputedStyleParent = finalizingComputedStyleParent;
			_parentCounterScopes.Pop();
			FinalizingElement = finalizingElement;
		}

		private Dictionary<string, object> GetCascadedValues(List<DeclarationInfo> declaredValues)
		{
			if (declaredValues == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			foreach (DeclarationInfo declaredValue in declaredValues)
			{
				dictionary[declaredValue.Definition.Name] = declaredValue.Value;
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private List<DeclarationInfo> GetDeclaredValues(HtmlNode element, PseudoElementType? pseudoElementType = null)
		{
			if (element.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<DeclarationInfo> list = new List<DeclarationInfo>();
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.Declarations = list;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.PseudoElementType = pseudoElementType;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.Element = element;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.OriginImportant = DeclarationOrigin.ImportantUserAgent;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.OriginNormal = DeclarationOrigin.NormalUserAgent;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.ScopeLevel = 0;
			_userAgentStyleSheetInfo.AddDeclaredValuesFromSheet();
			if (!pseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				GetDeclaredValuesFromPresentationalAttributes(list, element);
			}
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.OriginImportant = DeclarationOrigin.ImportantAuthor;
			_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.OriginNormal = DeclarationOrigin.NormalAuthor;
			foreach (ScopedStyleSheets item in _styleSheetsInScope)
			{
				_addDeclaredValuesVisitor.ScopeLevel = item.ScopeLevel;
				foreach (StyleSheetInfo styleSheet in item.StyleSheets)
				{
					styleSheet.AddDeclaredValuesFromSheet();
				}
			}
			if (!pseudoElementType.HasValue)
			{
				string attributeValue = element.GetAttributeValue("style", null);
				if (attributeValue != null)
				{
					StyleDeclarationBlock styleDeclarationBlock = StyleSheetParser.ParseCSSAttribute(attributeValue);
					foreach (StyleDeclaration item2 in styleDeclarationBlock)
					{
						_context.GetProperty(item2.Name).AddDeclaredValues(list, item2.Value, item2.IsImportant ? DeclarationOrigin.ImportantAuthor : DeclarationOrigin.NormalAuthor, SelectorSpecificity.Highest, (!item2.IsImportant) ? _currentNestingLevel : 0);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				PseudoElementType value = pseudoElementType.Value;
				if ((value == PseudoElementType.Before || value == PseudoElementType.After) && !DoesContainContentProperty(list))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				Utilities.SortMergeGeneric(list, DeclarationInfoComparer.Instance);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void GetDeclaredValuesFromPresentationalAttributes(List<DeclarationInfo> declarations, HtmlNode element)
		{
			if (_presentationalAttributeToDeclaredValueCallbacks.TryGetValue(element.OriginalName, out var value))
			{
				value(declarations, element);
			}
		}

		{
			SelectorSpecificity zero = SelectorSpecificity.Zero;
			string attributeValue = element.GetAttributeValue("dir", null);
			if (attributeValue != null)
			{
				CSSPropertyTable.Direction.AddDeclaredValues(declarations, attributeValue, DeclarationOrigin.NormalAuthor, zero, 0);
			}
		}

		}

		private void GetDeclaredValuesFromPresentationalAttributes_Caption(List<DeclarationInfo> declarations, HtmlNode element)
		{
			SelectorSpecificity zero = SelectorSpecificity.Zero;
			string attributeValue = element.GetAttributeValue("align", null);
			if (attributeValue != null)
			{
				switch (attributeValue.ToLowerInvariant())
				{
				case "left":
				case "right":
					CSSPropertyTable.TextAlign.AddDeclaredValues(declarations, attributeValue, DeclarationOrigin.NormalAuthor, zero, 0);
					break;
				case "top":
				case "bottom":
					CSSPropertyTable.CaptionSide.AddDeclaredValues(declarations, attributeValue, DeclarationOrigin.NormalAuthor, zero, 0);
					break;
				}

		private static string GetListStyleTypeFromType(string typeValue)
		{
			return typeValue switch
			{
				"1" => "decimal", 
				"a" => "lower-alpha", 
				"A" => "upper-alpha", 
				"i" => "lower-roman", 
				"I" => "upper-roman", 
				_ => typeValue, 
			};
		}

		private void GetPseudoElementSpecifiedValues(HtmlNode element)
		{
			if (IsPseudoElementPossible(PossiblePseudoElements.Before))
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues = GetCascadedValues(element, PseudoElementType.Before);
				if (cascadedValues != null)
				{
					element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementBefore = _context.ComputedStyleFactory.CreateComputedStyle(_context, cascadedValues);
				}
			}
			if (IsPseudoElementPossible(PossiblePseudoElements.After))
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues = GetCascadedValues(element, PseudoElementType.After);
				if (cascadedValues != null)
				{
					element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementAfter = _context.ComputedStyleFactory.CreateComputedStyle(_context, cascadedValues);
				}
			}
			if (IsPseudoElementPossible(PossiblePseudoElements.FirstLetter))
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues = GetCascadedValues(element, PseudoElementType.FirstLetter);
				if (cascadedValues != null)
				{
					element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementFirstLetter = _context.ComputedStyleFactory.CreateComputedStyle(_context, cascadedValues);
				}
			}
			if (IsPseudoElementPossible(PossiblePseudoElements.FirstLine))
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues = GetCascadedValues(element, PseudoElementType.FirstLine);
				if (cascadedValues != null)
				{
					element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementFirstLine = _context.ComputedStyleFactory.CreateComputedStyle(_context, cascadedValues);
				}
			}
			if (IsPseudoElementPossible(PossiblePseudoElements.Selection))
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues = GetCascadedValues(element, PseudoElementType.Selection);
				if (cascadedValues != null)
				{
					element.ComputedStyleForPseudoElementSelection = _context.ComputedStyleFactory.CreateComputedStyle(_context, cascadedValues);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetSpecifiedValuesRecursive(HtmlNode element, CSSComputedStyle parentStyle)
		{
			_currentNestingLevel++;
			bool flag = false;
			if (_scopedStyleSheets.TryGetValue(element, out var value))
			{
				_styleSheetsInScope.Add(new ScopedStyleSheets(value, _currentNestingLevel));
				flag = true;
			}
			switch (element.NodeType)
			{
			case HtmlNodeType.Text:
			{
				HtmlNode parentNode = element.ParentNode;
				if (parentNode.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					bool usesInlineBox = false;
					PerformComputation(parentNode, parentStyle, delegate
					{
						usesInlineBox = ((CSSDisplay)CSSPropertyTable.Display.GetComputedValue(this)).UsesInlineBox();
					});
					if (usesInlineBox)
					{
						element.ComputedStyle = parentStyle;
						break;
					}
				}
				goto case HtmlNodeType.Element;
			}
			case HtmlNodeType.Element:
			{
				bool flag2 = _elementNameComparer.Equals(element.OriginalName, "table");
				if (flag2)
				{
					_tablesHaveBorderAttribute.Push(item: false);
				}
				CSSComputedStyle parentStyle2 = CreateComputedStyle(element, parentStyle);
				GetPseudoElementSpecifiedValues(element);
				if (element.HasChildNodes)
				{
					foreach (HtmlNode childNode in element.ChildNodes)
					{
						GetSpecifiedValuesRecursive(childNode, parentStyle2);
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					_tablesHaveBorderAttribute.Pop();
				}
				break;
			}
			case HtmlNodeType.Document:
				foreach (HtmlNode childNode2 in element.ChildNodes)
				{
					GetSpecifiedValuesRecursive(childNode2, null);
				}
				break;
			}
			_currentNestingLevel--;
			if (flag)
			{
				_styleSheetsInScope.RemoveAt(_styleSheetsInScope.Count - 1);
			}
		}

		private void InsertStyleSheetAtTopOfDocument(CSSStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			StyleSheetInfo item = new StyleSheetInfo(this, styleSheet);
			if (_styleSheetsInScope.Count == 0 || _styleSheetsInScope[0].ScopeLevel != 0)
			{
				_styleSheetsInScope.Insert(0, new ScopedStyleSheets(new List<StyleSheetInfo> { item }, 0));
			}
			else
			{
				_styleSheetsInScope[0].StyleSheets.Insert(0, item);
			}
			OnStyleSheetIncluded(styleSheet);
		}

		private bool IsPseudoElementPossible(PossiblePseudoElements flag)
		{
			return (_possiblePseudoElements & flag) == flag;
		}

		private void OnPseudoElementStyled(PossiblePseudoElements flag)
		{
			_possiblePseudoElements |= flag;
		}

		private void PerformComputation(HtmlNode element, CSSComputedStyleBase computedStyle, Action computation)
		{
			if (element.ParentNode != null)
			{
				FinalizingComputedStyleParent = element.ParentNode.ComputedStyle;
			}
			FinalizingElement = element;
			FinalizingComputedStyle = computedStyle;
			computation();
			FinalizingComputedStyle = null;
			FinalizingElement = null;
			if (element.ParentNode != null)
			{
				FinalizingComputedStyleParent = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnStyleSheetIncluded(CSSStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			foreach (Rule rule in styleSheet.Rules)
			{
				if (_possiblePseudoElements == PossiblePseudoElements.All)
				{
					break;
				}
				rule.Accept(_possiblePseudoElementRuleVisitor);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CSSComputedStyleBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _computedValues;

		public CSSComputedStyleBase()
		{
			_computedValues = new Dictionary<string, object>();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is CSSComputedStyleBase cSSComputedStyleBase) || GetType() != cSSComputedStyleBase.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_computedValues.Count != cSSComputedStyleBase._computedValues.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> computedValue in _computedValues)
			{
				if (!cSSComputedStyleBase._computedValues.TryGetValue(computedValue.Key, out var value) || !CSSValueEqualityComparer.Instance.Equals(computedValue.Value, value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = _computedValues.Count;
			foreach (string key in _computedValues.Keys)
			{
				num ^= key.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public abstract void FinalizeComputedValues(CSSCascader cascader);

		public IEnumerable<string> GetPropertyNames()
		{
			return _computedValues.Keys;
		}

		public object GetValue(string name)
		{
			_computedValues.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public T GetValue<T>(SinglePropertyDefinition<T> property)
		{
			object value = GetValue(property.Name);
			if (value is T)
			{
				return (T)value;
			}
			return property.InitialValue;
		}

		public void SetValue(string name, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				_computedValues.Remove(name);
			}
			else
			{
				_computedValues[name] = value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CSSComputedStyle : CSSComputedStyleBase
	{
		private bool _areValuesComputed;

		private int _shareCount;

		public bool IsSharable
		{
			get
			{
				if (object.Equals(CSSPropertyTable.CounterIncrement.GetValue(this), CSSCounterValuePairs.None))
				{
					return object.Equals(CSSPropertyTable.CounterReset.GetValue(this), CSSCounterValuePairs.None);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int ShareCount => _shareCount;

		public CSSComputedStyle(CSSCascadeContext context, Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues)
		{
			foreach (SinglePropertyDefinitionBase allSingleProperty in context.GetAllSingleProperties())
			{
				SetValue(allSingleProperty.Name, allSingleProperty.GetSpecifiedValue(cascadedValues));
			}
		}

		public override void FinalizeComputedValues(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			if (_areValuesComputed)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SinglePropertyDefinitionBase allSingleProperty in cascader.Context.GetAllSingleProperties())
			{
				SetValue(allSingleProperty.Name, allSingleProperty.GetComputedValue(cascader));
			}
			_areValuesComputed = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "CSSComputedStyle: " + _shareCount + " shares";
		}

		public void IncrementShareCount()
		{
			_shareCount++;
		}
	}
	internal class CSSComputedStylePartial : CSSComputedStyleBase
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static List<string> _tempPropertyNames;

		public CSSComputedStylePartial(CSSCascadeContext context, Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues)
		{
			foreach (string key in cascadedValues.Keys)
			{
				SetValue(key, context.GetSingleProperty(key).GetSpecifiedValue(cascadedValues));
			}
		}

		public override void FinalizeComputedValues(CSSCascader cascader)
		{
			if (_tempPropertyNames == null)
			{
				_tempPropertyNames = new List<string>();
			}
			else
			{
				_tempPropertyNames.Clear();
			}
			_tempPropertyNames.AddRange(GetPropertyNames());
			foreach (string tempPropertyName in _tempPropertyNames)
			{
				SetValue(tempPropertyName, cascader.Context.GetSingleProperty(tempPropertyName).GetComputedValue(cascader));
			}
			_tempPropertyNames.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal class CSSComputedStyleFactory
	{
		public virtual CSSComputedStyle CreateComputedStyle(CSSCascadeContext context, Dictionary<string, object> cascadedValues)
		{
			return new CSSComputedStyle(context, cascadedValues);
		}
	}
}
