	{
		public Uri SourceUri { get; internal set; }

		public virtual Uri TargetUri { get; internal set; }

		public string Id { get; internal set; }

		public string RelationshipType { get; internal set; }

		public RelationshipTargetMode TargetMode { get; internal set; }
	}
	internal class InvalidTargetPackageRelationship : SimplePackageRelationship, IInvalidPackageRelationshipTarget, IPackageRelationship
	{
		public override Uri TargetUri
		{
			get
			{
				if (TargetString != null && base.TargetUri == null)
				{
					TargetUri = UriUtilities.CreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(TargetString);
				}
				return base.TargetUri;
			}
			internal set
			{
				base.TargetUri = value;
			}
		}

		public string TargetString { get; internal set; }
	}
	internal static class PackageUtilities
	{
		private const string ParentDirectoryValue = "..";

		internal const string RelationshipsPartsSubFolder = "_rels";

		internal const string RelationshipsPartsSuffix = ".rels";

		public const char SegmentSeparator = '/';

		internal const string RelationshipIdPrefix = "rId";

		internal const string DefaultContentType = "application/xml";

		internal const RegexOptions RegexOptionsCompiled = RegexOptions.Compiled;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Regex percentEncodedRegex;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Regex unreservedCharRegex;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Regex validPCharsRegex;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Regex nonDotRegex;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Regex driveLetterRegex;

		internal static Regex PercentEncodedRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (percentEncodedRegex == null)
				{
					percentEncodedRegex = new Regex("%[0-9A-F]{2}", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return percentEncodedRegex;
			}
		}

		internal static Regex UnreservedCharRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (unreservedCharRegex == null)
				{
					unreservedCharRegex = new Regex("[\\-\\._~0-9A-Z]", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return unreservedCharRegex;
			}
		}

		internal static Regex ValidPCharsRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (validPCharsRegex == null)
				{
					validPCharsRegex = new Regex("([:@\\-\\._~!$&'()*+,;=0-9A-Z]|(%[0-9A-F]{2}))*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return validPCharsRegex;
			}
		}

		internal static Regex NonDotRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (nonDotRegex == null)
				{
					nonDotRegex = new Regex("[^.]", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return nonDotRegex;
			}
		}

		internal static Regex DriveLetterRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (driveLetterRegex == null)
				{
					driveLetterRegex = new Regex("\\w:", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return driveLetterRegex;
			}
		}

		public static string CombinePaths(string parentPath, string childPath)
		{
			if (childPath.StartsWith("../"))
			{
				return CombinePaths(GetDirectoryName(parentPath), childPath.Substring(3));
			}
			bool flag = parentPath.Length > 0 && parentPath[parentPath.Length - 1] == '/';
			bool flag2 = childPath.Length > 0 && childPath[0] == '/';
			if (flag2)
			{
				return childPath;
			}
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return parentPath + childPath;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return parentPath + childPath.Substring(1);
			}
			return parentPath + "/" + childPath;
		}

		public static Uri CombinePaths(Uri parentPath, Uri childPath)
		{
			string parentPath2 = parentPath.ToString();
			string childPath2 = childPath.ToString();
			return UriUtilities.CreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(CombinePaths(parentPath2, childPath2));
		}

		public static IPackage CreatePackage(Stream stream, bool isLoading)
		{
			if (isLoading)
			{
				return new PackageWrapper(Package.Open(stream, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read));
			}
			return new PackageWrapper(Package.Open(stream, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite));
		}

		public static string DateTimeToW3CDTFValue(DateTime dateTime)
		{
			return dateTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString("s") + "Z";
		}

		public static string GetAssociatedRelationshipsPartPath(string sourcePartPath)
		{
			string directoryName = GetDirectoryName(sourcePartPath);
			string partName = GetPartName(sourcePartPath);
			string parentPath = CombinePaths(directoryName, "_rels");
			string childPath = partName + ".rels";
			return CombinePaths(parentPath, childPath);
		}

		public static string GetDirectoryName(string partPath)
		{
			int num = partPath.LastIndexOf('/');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return partPath;
			}
			return partPath.Substring(0, num);
		}

		public static Uri GetDirectoryName(Uri partPath)
		{
			return new Uri(GetDirectoryName(partPath.ToString()), UriKind.Relative);
		}

		public static string GetPartName(string partPath)
		{
			int num = partPath.LastIndexOf('/');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return partPath;
			}
			return partPath.Substring(num + 1);
		}

		internal static byte GetPercentEncodedValue(string percentEncoded)
		{
			if (percentEncoded == null || percentEncoded.Length != 3 || percentEncoded[0] != '%')
			{
				DebugFail("The value passed to GetPercentEncodedValue was not expoected: " + percentEncoded);
				return 0;
			}
			try
			{
				return Convert.ToByte(percentEncoded.Substring(1), 16);
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				DebugFail("The value passed to GetPercentEncodedValue was not expoected: " + percentEncoded);
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public static Uri GetRelativePath(Uri sourcePart, Uri targetPart)
		{
			return GetRelativePath(sourcePart, targetPart, '/');
		}

		public static Uri GetRelativePath(Uri sourcePart, Uri targetPart, char segmentSeparator)
		{
			string relativePath = GetRelativePath(sourcePart.ToString(), targetPart.ToString(), '/', useFullPathIfTargetIsParent: false);
			return UriUtilities.CreateRelativeOrAbsoluteURI(relativePath);
		}

		public static string GetRelativePath(string sourcePart, string targetPart)
		{
			return GetRelativePath(sourcePart, targetPart, '/', useFullPathIfTargetIsParent: false);
		}

		public static string GetRelativePath(string sourcePart, string targetPart, char segmentSeparator, bool useFullPathIfTargetIsParent)
		{
			List<string> segments = GetSegments(sourcePart, segmentSeparator);
			List<string> segments2 = GetSegments(targetPart, segmentSeparator);
			int num = 0;
			while (num < segments.Count - 1 && num < segments2.Count)
			{
				if (segments[num] == segments2[num])
				{
					segments.RemoveAt(num);
					segments2.RemoveAt(num);
					num--;
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				if (useFullPathIfTargetIsParent)
				{
					string text = DriveLetterRegex.Replace(targetPart, string.Empty);
					return text.Replace(segmentSeparator, '/');
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < segments.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					segments2.Insert(0, "..");
				}
				break;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (string item in segments2)
			{
				if (segmentSeparator != '/')
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Replace(segmentSeparator, '/'));
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append('/');
			}
			stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 1, 1);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static List<string> GetSegments(string partPath)
		{
			return GetSegments(partPath, '/');
		}

		internal static List<string> GetSegments(string partPath, char segmentSeparator)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(partPath))
			{
				return new List<string>();
			}
			return new List<string>(partPath.Split(segmentSeparator));
		}

		public static Uri GetTargetPartPath(IPackageRelationship relationship)
		{
			Uri directoryName = GetDirectoryName(relationship.SourceUri);
			return CombinePaths(directoryName, relationship.TargetUri);
		}

		public static bool IsValidPartPath(string partPath)
		{
			List<string> segments = GetSegments(partPath);
			if (segments.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (segments[0].Length != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < segments.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!IsValidSegmentName(segments[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsValidPartPath(Uri partPath)
		{
			return IsValidPartPath(partPath.ToString());
		}

		internal static bool IsValidSegmentName(string segmentName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(segmentName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (segmentName[segmentName.Length - 1] == '.')
			{
				return false;
			}
			Match match = ValidPCharsRegex.Match(segmentName);
			if (!match.Success || match.Length != segmentName.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Match match2 = PercentEncodedRegex.Match(segmentName);
			while (match2.Success)
			{
				byte percentEncodedValue = GetPercentEncodedValue(match2.Value);
				char c = Convert.ToChar(percentEncodedValue);
				if (c == '/' || c == '\\')
				{
					return false;
				}
				string input = c.ToString();
				if (UnreservedCharRegex.Match(input).Success)
				{
					return false;
				}
				match2 = match2.NextMatch();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static DateTime ParseW3CDTFValue(string value)
		{
			if (!value.EndsWith("Z"))
			{
				DebugFail("The date format was not correct.");
				return DateTime.Now;
			}
			value = value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1);
			if (!Utilities.TryParseExactDate(value, "s", null, out var result) && !Utilities.TryParseExactDate(value, "o", null, out result))
			{
				DebugFail("Error occurred while parsing the date in W3CDTF format: " + value);
				return DateTime.Now;
			}
			return result.ToLocalTime();
		}

		internal static void DebugFail(string message)
		{
			_ = Utilities.ShouldDisableDebugMessages;
		}
	}
